export default function PlanFormSection() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<IActionPlanFormData>({
    commitment: '',
    specificAction: '',
    targetDate: addDays(new Date(), 7),
    reminderDays: [7],
    reflection: '',
    foggElements: defaultFoggElements
  });
  
  const [plans, setPlans] = useState<IActionPlan[]>(mockActionPlans);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [activeReflection, setActiveReflection] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    
    // 模拟提交延迟
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
    
    const newPlan: IActionPlan = {
      ...formData,
      id: `plan_${Date.now()}`,
      status: 'active',
      createdAt: new Date(),
      progress: 0,
      reflections: [],
      difficultyScore: formData.foggElements.ability.difficulty,
      executionLog: []
    };
    
    setPlans([newPlan, ...plans]);
    setFormData({
      commitment: '',
      specificAction: '',
      targetDate: addDays(new Date(), 7),
      reminderDays: [7],
      reflection: '',
      foggElements: defaultFoggElements
    });
    setIsSubmitting(false);
  };

  const handleReminderToggle = (day: number) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      reminderDays: prev.reminderDays.includes(day)
        ? prev.reminderDays.filter(d => d !== day)
        : [...prev.reminderDays, day]
    }));
  };

  const handleAddReflection = (planId: string) => {
    if (!formData.reflection.trim()) return;
    
    setPlans(prev => prev.map(plan => {
      if (plan.id === planId) {
        return {
          ...plan,
          reflections: [
            ...plan.reflections,
            {
              id: `ref_${Date.now()}`,
              content: formData.reflection,
              reminderDay: 0,
              createdAt: new Date()
            }
          ]
        };
      }
      return plan;
    }));
    
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, reflection: '' }));
    setActiveReflection(null);
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status: IActionPlan['status']) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'active':
        return <Badge className="bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/20">进行中</Badge>;
      case 'completed':
        return <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-700 border-green-200">已完成</Badge>;
      case 'abandoned':
        return <Badge variant="secondary">已放弃</Badge>;
    }
  };

  const getDaysRemaining = (targetDate: Date) => {
    const diff = Math.ceil((targetDate.getTime() - new Date().getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    return diff;
  };

  return (
    <section className="w-full space-y-8">
      {/* 行动计划表单 */}
      <Card className="border-border/50">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
              <Target className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <CardTitle>制定行动计划</CardTitle>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                每次陪练结束后，请制定一个具体的改进行动计划
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
            {/* 行动承诺 */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="commitment" className="text-base">
                未来一周我承诺尝试的管理行为
                <span className="text-destructive ml-1">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Textarea
                id="commitment"
                placeholder="例如：每天与团队成员进行一次简短的沟通..."
                value={formData.commitment}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, commitment: e.target.value }))}
                className="min-h-[80px] resize-none"
                required
              />
            </div>

            {/* 具体行动 */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="specificAction" className="text-base">
                具体行动步骤
                <span className="text-destructive ml-1">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Textarea
                id="specificAction"
                placeholder="描述具体的执行步骤、时间安排、预期结果等..."
                value={formData.specificAction}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, specificAction: e.target.value }))}
                className="min-h-[100px] resize-none"
                required
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              {/* 目标日期 */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-base">目标完成日期</Label>
                <Popover>
                  <PopoverTrigger asChild>
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      className="w-full justify-start text-left font-normal"
                    >
                      <CalendarIcon className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                      {formData.targetDate ? (
                        format(formData.targetDate, 'yyyy年MM月dd日', { locale: zhCN })
                      ) : (
                        <span>选择日期</span>
                      )}
                    </Button>
                  </PopoverTrigger>
                  <PopoverContent className="w-auto p-0">
                    <Calendar
                      mode="single"
                      selected={formData.targetDate}
                      onSelect={(date) => date && setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, targetDate: date }))}
                      locale={zhCN}
                    />
                  </PopoverContent>
                </Popover>
              </div>

              {/* 提醒设置 */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Bell className="w-4 h-4" />
                  设置提醒
                </Label>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {reminderOptions.map((option) => (
                    <Button
                      key={option.value}
                      type="button"
                      variant={formData.reminderDays.includes(option.value) ? 'default' : 'outline'}
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => handleReminderToggle(option.value)}
                      className="text-xs"
                    >
                      {option.label}
                    </Button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 福格行为模型要素 - 动机挖掘 */}
            <div className="space-y-4 pt-4 border-t border-border/50">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="p-1.5 rounded-md bg-orange-100">
                  <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-600" />
                </div>
                <h4 className="font-medium">动机挖掘（Motivation）</h4>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-3 pl-8">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">为什么要做这件事？（内在动机）</Label>
                  <Textarea
                    placeholder="例如：我想成为团队信赖的领导..."
                    value={formData.foggElements.motivation.why}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({
                      ...prev,
                      foggElements: {
                        ...prev.foggElements,
                        motivation: { ...prev.foggElements.motivation, why: e.target.value }
                      }
                    }))}
                    className="min-h-[60px] resize-none"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">如果不做，会有什么代价？（损失厌恶）</Label>
                  <Textarea
                    placeholder="例如：团队士气会持续低落..."
                    value={formData.foggElements.motivation.costOfNotDoing}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({
                      ...prev,
                      foggElements: {
                        ...prev.foggElements,
                        motivation: { ...prev.foggElements.motivation, costOfNotDoing: e.target.value }
                      }
                    }))}
                    className="min-h-[60px] resize-none"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">完成后，对自己/团队有什么价值？（愿景连接）</Label>
                  <Textarea
                    placeholder="例如：团队成员会更加积极主动..."
                    value={formData.foggElements.motivation.valueVision}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({
                      ...prev,
                      foggElements: {
                        ...prev.foggElements,
                        motivation: { ...prev.foggElements.motivation, valueVision: e.target.value }
                      }
                    }))}
                    className="min-h-[60px] resize-none"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 福格行为模型要素 - 能力评估 */}
            <div className="space-y-4 pt-4 border-t border-border/50">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="p-1.5 rounded-md bg-blue-100">
                  <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                </div>
                <h4 className="font-medium">能力评估（Ability）</h4>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-3 pl-8">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">执行难度自评（1-5分，5分最难）</Label>
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((score) => (
                      <Button
                        key={score}
                        type="button"
                        variant={formData.foggElements.ability.difficulty === score ? 'default' : 'outline'}
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => setFormData(prev => ({
                          ...prev,
                          foggElements: {
                            ...prev.foggElements,
                            ability: { ...prev.foggElements.ability, difficulty: score }
                          }
                        }))}
                        className="w-10 h-10"
                      >
                        {score}
                      </Button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  {formData.foggElements.ability.difficulty >= 4 && (
                    <p className="text-xs text-amber-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <AlertCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
                      难度较高，建议拆分为微习惯版本
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">可能的障碍是什么？</Label>
                  <Input
                    placeholder="例如：临时会议冲突、资源不足..."
                    value={formData.foggElements.ability.obstacles.join(', ')}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({
                      ...prev,
                      foggElements: {
                        ...prev.foggElements,
                        ability: { ...prev.foggElements.ability, obstacles: e.target.value.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean) }
                      }
                    }))}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">如果障碍发生，我的预案是？</Label>
                  <Textarea
                    placeholder="例如：会议冲突时调整到周四执行..."
                    value={formData.foggElements.ability.contingencyPlan}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({
                      ...prev,
                      foggElements: {
                        ...prev.foggElements,
                        ability: { ...prev.foggElements.ability, contingencyPlan: e.target.value }
                      }
                    }))}
                    className="min-h-[60px] resize-none"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 福格行为模型要素 - 提示设计 */}
            <div className="space-y-4 pt-4 border-t border-border/50">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="p-1.5 rounded-md bg-green-100">
                  <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" />
                </div>
                <h4 className="font-medium">提示设计（Prompt）</h4>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 pl-8">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">时间锚点（何时触发？）</Label>
                  <Input
                    placeholder="例如：每周五下午3点"
                    value={formData.foggElements.prompt.timeAnchor}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({
                      ...prev,
                      foggElements: {
                        ...prev.foggElements,
                        prompt: { ...prev.foggElements.prompt, timeAnchor: e.target.value }
                      }
                    }))}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">场景锚点（在哪里做？）</Label>
                  <Input
                    placeholder="例如：办公室会议室"
                    value={formData.foggElements.prompt.sceneAnchor}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({
                      ...prev,
                      foggElements: {
                        ...prev.foggElements,
                        prompt: { ...prev.foggElements.prompt, sceneAnchor: e.target.value }
                      }
                    }))}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">关联锚点（关联什么已有习惯？）</Label>
                  <Input
                    placeholder="例如：做完周报后"
                    value={formData.foggElements.prompt.habitAnchor}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({
                      ...prev,
                      foggElements: {
                        ...prev.foggElements,
                        prompt: { ...prev.foggElements.prompt, habitAnchor: e.target.value }
                      }
                    }))}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">提醒时间</Label>
                  <Input
                    type="time"
                    value={formData.foggElements.prompt.reminderTime}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({
                      ...prev,
                      foggElements: {
                        ...prev.foggElements,
                        prompt: { ...prev.foggElements.prompt, reminderTime: e.target.value }
                      }
                    }))}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 提交按钮 */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-4">
              <Button 
                type="submit" 
                className="px-8"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              >
                {isSubmitting ? (
                  <>
                    <RotateCcw className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                    提交中...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Send className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                    提交行动计划
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
              <Button 
                type="button" 
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => setFormData({
                  commitment: '',
                  specificAction: '',
                  targetDate: addDays(new Date(), 7),
                  reminderDays: [7],
                  reflection: '',
                  foggElements: defaultFoggElements
                })}
              >
                重置
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* 行动计划列表 */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">我的行动计划</h3>
          </div>
          <Badge variant="secondary">{plans.filter(p => p.status === 'active').length} 个进行中</Badge>
        </div>

        {plans.length === 0 ? (
          <Card className="border-dashed border-2 border-muted">
            <CardContent className="py-12 text-center">
              <AlertCircle className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">暂无行动计划，请制定您的第一个行动计划</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {plans.map((plan) => {
              const daysRemaining = getDaysRemaining(plan.targetDate);
              const isOverdue = daysRemaining < 0 && plan.status === 'active';
              
              return (
                <Card 
                  key={plan.id} 
                  className={`border-border/50 ${isOverdue ? 'border-red-200 bg-red-50/30' : ''}`}
                >
                  <CardHeader className="pb-4">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                          {getStatusBadge(plan.status)}
                          {isOverdue && (
                            <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-xs">
                              已逾期 {Math.abs(daysRemaining)} 天
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                          {daysRemaining > 0 && plan.status === 'active' && (
                            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                              剩余 {daysRemaining} 天
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <h4 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
                          {plan.commitment}
                        </h4>
                      </div>
                      {plan.status === 'active' && (
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <Button 
                            variant="outline" 
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={() => setPlans(prev => prev.map(p => 
                              p.id === plan.id ? { ...p, status: 'completed', completedAt: new Date(), progress: 100 } : p
                            ))}
                          >
                            <CheckCircle className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />
                            完成
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </CardHeader>
                  
                  <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                    {/* 具体行动 */}
                    <div className="p-4 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">具体行动</p>
                      <p className="text-foreground">{plan.specificAction}</p>
                    </div>

                    {/* 进度 */}
                    {plan.status === 'active' && (
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground">执行进度</span>
                          <span className="font-medium">{plan.progress}%</span>
                        </div>
                        <Progress value={plan.progress} className="h-2" />
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* 时间信息 */}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <CalendarIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                        目标日期：{format(plan.targetDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
                        创建于：{format(plan.createdAt, 'yyyy-MM-dd')}
                      </div>
                      {plan.reminderDays.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <Bell className="w-4 h-4" />
                          提醒：{plan.reminderDays.map(d => `${d}天`).join('、')}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* 反思记录 */}
                    {plan.reflections.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="space-y-3 pt-4 border-t">
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">执行反思</p>
                        {plan.reflections.map((reflection) => (
                          <div 
                            key={reflection.id}
                            className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-accent/50 text-sm"
                          >
                            <p className="text-foreground">{reflection.content}</p>
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
                              {format(reflection.createdAt, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* 添加反思 */}
                    {plan.status === 'active' && (
                      <div className="pt-4 border-t">
                        {activeReflection === plan.id ? (
                          <div className="space-y-3">
                            <Textarea
                              placeholder="记录您的执行反思..."
                              value={formData.reflection}
                              onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, reflection: e.target.value }))}
                              className="min-h-[80px] resize-none"
                            />
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <Button 
                                size="sm"
                                onClick={() => handleAddReflection(plan.id)}
                                disabled={!formData.reflection.trim()}
                              >
                                <PenLine className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />
                                添加反思
                              </Button>
                              <Button 
                                size="sm" 
                                variant="outline"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setActiveReflection(null);
                                  setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, reflection: '' }));
                                }}
                              >
                                取消
                              </Button>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <Button 
                            variant="outline" 
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={() => setActiveReflection(plan.id)}
                          >
                            <PenLine className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />
                            添加执行反思
                          </Button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </CardContent>

                  {plan.status === 'completed' && plan.completedAt && (
                    <CardFooter className="bg-green-50/50 border-t border-green-100">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-green-700 text-sm">
                        <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                        已完成于 {format(plan.completedAt, 'yyyy-MM-dd')}
                      </div>
                    </CardFooter>
                  )}
                </Card>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import {
  Download,
  FileJson,
  Copy,
  Target,
  Users,
  Heart,
  Settings,
  Search,
  BookOpen,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  FileText,
  Wand2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getAllScenes, getSceneById, getExportData, type ICoachingScene } from '@/api/coaching';
import { axiosForBackend } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/utils/getAxiosForBackend';
import { exportSceneToPDF } from '@/utils/sceneExporter';
import { exportCoursesAndScenesToExcel } from '@/utils/excelExporter';

const DIMENSION_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
  result: '拿结果',
  people: '带团队',
  field: '传文化',
};

const DIMENSION_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  result: '#5B9A8B',
  people: '#4A90D9',
  field: '#D4A564',
};

const DIFFICULTY_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
  easy: '入门',
  medium: '进阶',
  hard: '挑战',
};

const DIFFICULTY_COLORS: Record<string, { bg: string; text: string }> = {
  easy: { bg: '#EDF5F2', text: '#5B9A8B' },
  medium: { bg: '#FDF5EC', text: '#B8863E' },
  hard: { bg: '#FDE8E8', text: '#C53030' },
};

interface AdminCoachingManagePageProps {}

const AdminCoachingManagePage: React.FC<AdminCoachingManagePageProps> = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [scenes, setScenes] = useState<ICoachingScene[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [filterDimension, setFilterDimension] = useState<string>('all');
  const [exportDialogOpen, setExportDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [exportJson, setExportJson] = useState('');
  const [exportSceneName, setExportSceneName] = useState('');
  const [exportSceneId, setExportSceneId] = useState('');
  const [exportingPdf, setExportingPdf] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [exportingConfig, setExportingConfig] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [exportingExcel, setExportingExcel] = useState(false);
  const [filterAI, setFilterAI] = useState<'all' | 'ai_generated'>('all');

  const handleExportPRScenes = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await axiosForBackend({
        url: '/api/coaching/export-pr-scenes-html',
        method: 'GET',
        responseType: 'blob',
      });
      const blob = new Blob([response.data], { type: 'text/html' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'pr-scenes-background.html';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      link.remove();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      toast.success('导出成功');
    } catch {
      toast.error('导出失败，请重试');
    }
  };

  const handleExportExcel = async () => {
    setExportingExcel(true);
    try {
      const data = await getExportData();
      exportCoursesAndScenesToExcel(data);
      toast.success('Excel导出成功');
    } catch {
      toast.error('Excel导出失败，请重试');
    } finally {
      setExportingExcel(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadScenes();
  }, []);

  const loadScenes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const data = await getAllScenes();
      setScenes(data);
    } catch {
      toast.error('加载场景列表失败');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExportPDF = async (scene: ICoachingScene) => {
    setExportingPdf(scene.id);
    try {
      await exportSceneToPDF(scene);
      toast.success(`"${scene.name}" 文档已导出`);
    } catch {
      toast.error('导出失败，请重试');
    } finally {
      setExportingPdf(null);
    }
  };

  const handleExportConfig = async (scene: ICoachingScene) => {
    setExportingConfig(scene.id);
    try {
      const fullScene = await getSceneById(scene.id);
      if (!fullScene) throw new Error('Scene not found');
      const config = {
        meta: {
          exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          version: '1.0',
        },
        scene: fullScene,
      };
      setExportJson(JSON.stringify(config, null, 2));
      setExportSceneName(scene.name);
      setExportSceneId(scene.id);
      setExportDialogOpen(true);
    } catch {
      toast.error('导出配置失败，请重试');
    } finally {
      setExportingConfig(null);
    }
  };

  const filteredScenes = scenes.filter((scene: ICoachingScene) => {
    const matchesSearch = !searchTerm || scene.name.includes(searchTerm) || scene.description.includes(searchTerm);
    const matchesDimension = filterDimension === 'all' || scene.dimension === filterDimension;
    const matchesAI = filterAI === 'all' || (scene.tags && scene.tags.includes('ai_generated'));
    return matchesSearch && matchesDimension && matchesAI;
  });

  const dimensionStats = {
    result: scenes.filter((s: ICoachingScene) => s.dimension === 'result').length,
    people: scenes.filter((s: ICoachingScene) => s.dimension === 'people').length,
    field: scenes.filter((s: ICoachingScene) => s.dimension === 'field').length,
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-6 pb-8">
      <div className="rounded-xl p-6" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #EDF5F2 0%, #F5FAF8 100%)', border: '1px solid #B8D8CE' }}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: '#5B9A8B' }}>
              <Settings className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-xl font-bold" style={{ color: '#2D2A26' }}>陪练场景管理</h1>
              <p className="text-sm" style={{ color: '#7A7168' }}>管理所有陪练场景，导出场景文档和配置</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              className="gap-2 text-sm font-medium shadow-sm"
              style={{ background: '#5B9A8B', color: '#FFFFFF' }}
              disabled={exportingExcel}
              onClick={handleExportExcel}
            >
              <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4" />
              {exportingExcel ? '导出中...' : '导出Excel报表'}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              className="gap-2 text-sm font-medium"
              onClick={handleExportPRScenes}
            >
              <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
              导出绩效面谈背景
            </Button>
            <Button
              className="gap-2 text-sm font-medium shadow-sm"
              style={{ background: '#7C3AED', color: '#FFFFFF' }}
              onClick={() => navigate('/admin/scenario-generator')}
            >
              <Wand2 className="w-4 h-4" />
              智能生成场景
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {(['result', 'people', 'field'] as const).map((dim) => (
          <Card key={dim} className="border-0 shadow-sm">
            <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: `${DIMENSION_COLORS[dim]}15` }}>
                {dim === 'result' && <Target className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: DIMENSION_COLORS[dim] }} />}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Shield, Lock, Eye, EyeOff, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';

import { verifyAdmin } from '@client/src/api/admin';

const ADMIN_STORAGE_KEY = 'mdp_admin_auth';

interface IAdminLoginPageProps {}

const AdminLoginPage: React.FC<IAdminLoginPageProps> = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isSuccess, setIsSuccess] = useState(false);

  const handleLogin = async () => {
    setError('');
    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      const result = await verifyAdmin(password);
      if (result.isAdmin) {
        const adminSession = {
          isAdmin: true,
          isLoggedIn: true,
          adminName: result.adminName || '管理员',
        };
        localStorage.setItem(ADMIN_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(adminSession));
        setIsSuccess(true);

        setTimeout(() => {
          navigate('/expert-dashboard');
        }, 1000);
      }
    } catch {
      setError('密码错误，请重新输入');
    }

    setIsLoading(false);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      handleLogin();
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="w-full min-h-full flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md">
        <Card className="border-border/50 shadow-lg">
          <CardHeader className="space-y-4 pb-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center">
              <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Shield className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-center space-y-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                管理员登录
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="text-muted-foreground">
                请输入管理员密码进入管理后台
              </CardDescription>
            </div>
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="mx-auto bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/20">
              MDP管理者陪练·团队领导力进化器
            </Badge>
          </CardHeader>
          
          <CardContent className="space-y-6">
            {/* 密码输入框 */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="password" className="text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
                <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                管理员密码
              </Label>
              <div className="relative">
                <Input
                  id="password"
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  placeholder="请输入管理员密码"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
                  className="pr-10"
                  disabled={isLoading || isSuccess}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
                  disabled={isLoading || isSuccess}
                >
                  {showPassword ? (
                    <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" />
                  ) : (
                    <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>

            </div>

            {/* 错误提示 */}
            {error && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20 text-destructive text-sm">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" />
                <span>{error}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* 成功提示 */}
            {isSuccess && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-lg bg-success/10 border border-success/20 text-success text-sm">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" />
                <span>登录成功，正在跳转...</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* 登录按钮 */}
            <Button
              onClick={handleLogin}
              disabled={!password || isLoading || isSuccess}
              className="w-full"
              size="lg"
            >
              {isLoading ? (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" />
                  验证中...
                </span>
              ) : isSuccess ? (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  登录成功
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Shield className="w-4 h-4" />
                  进入管理后台
                </span>
              )}
            </Button>

            {/* 返回用户端 */}
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={() => navigate('/')}
              className="w-full"
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              返回用户端
            </Button>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 管理员权限说明 */}
        <div className="mt-6 p-4 rounded-xl bg-muted/50 border border-border/50">
          <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-2">管理员权限包括：</h4>
          <ul className="space-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <li className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />
              专家智囊团管理
            </li>
            <li className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />
              专家评审工作台
            </li>
            <li className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />
              建议优化中心
            </li>
            <li className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />
              系统数据看板
            </li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

export default AdminLoginPage;

// 导出检查管理员状态的辅助函数
export const checkAdminStatus = (): boolean => {
  try {
    const adminSession = localStorage.getItem(ADMIN_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!adminSession) return false;
    
    const session = JSON.parse(adminSession);
    if (!session.isAdmin) return false;
    
    // 检查是否过期
    const expiresAt = new Date(session.expiresAt);
    if (expiresAt < new Date()) {
      localStorage.removeItem(ADMIN_STORAGE_KEY);
      return false;
    }
    
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
};

// 导出退出管理员登录的辅助函数
export const logoutAdmin = (): void => {
  localStorage.removeItem(ADMIN_STORAGE_KEY);
};

              <>
                {/* 表头 */}
                <div className="hidden md:grid grid-cols-12 gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground border-b border-border/50">
                  <div className="col-span-3">场景名称</div>
                  <div className="col-span-1">维度</div>
                  <div className="col-span-1">状态</div>
                  <div className="col-span-1 text-center">轮次</div>
                  <div className="col-span-1 text-center">消息数</div>
                  <div className="col-span-3 text-center">评分（结果/团队/文化）</div>
                  <div className="col-span-2 text-right">创建时间</div>
                </div>

                {/* 数据行 */}
                <div className="divide-y divide-border/30">
                  {sessionData.items.map(session => {
                    const st = statusStyles[session.status] || statusStyles.active;
                    const msgCount = session.messages?.length || 0;
                    const dimColor = dimensionColors[session.dimension || 'result'] || '#5B9A8B';
                    const dimLabel = dimensionLabels[session.dimension || 'result'] || '拿结果';

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={session.id}
                        className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-2 md:gap-3 px-4 py-3 hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                        onClick={() => handleViewDetail(session)}
                      >
                        <div className="col-span-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                          <div
                            className="w-1 h-8 rounded-full flex-shrink-0"
                            style={{ backgroundColor: dimColor }}
                          />
                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground truncate">
                            {session.sceneName || session.sceneId}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="col-span-1 flex items-center">
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] px-1.5 h-5 border-0" style={{ backgroundColor: `${dimColor}15`, color: dimColor }}>
                            {dimLabel}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <div className="col-span-1 flex items-center">
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] px-1.5 h-5 border-0" style={{ backgroundColor: st.bg, color: st.color }}>
                            {st.text}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <div className="col-span-1 flex items-center justify-center text-sm text-foreground">
                          {session.roundCount || Math.ceil(msgCount / 2)}
                        </div>
                        <div className="col-span-1 flex items-center justify-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {msgCount}
                        </div>
                        <div className="col-span-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-3 text-xs">
                          <span style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }}>{session.scoreResult}</span>
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground">/</span>
                          <span style={{ color: '#4A6FA5' }}>{session.scorePeople}</span>
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground">/</span>
                          <span style={{ color: '#D4A564' }}>{session.scoreField}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="col-span-2 flex items-center justify-end text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          <Clock className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                          {session.createdAt
                            ? new Date(session.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')
                            : '-'}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>

                {/* 分页 */}
                {totalPages > 1 && (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-border/30">
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      第 {currentPage}/{totalPages} 页
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        className="h-7 w-7 p-0"
                        disabled={currentPage <= 1}
                        onClick={() => setCurrentPage(p => p - 1)}
                      >
                        <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        className="h-7 w-7 p-0"
                        disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
                        onClick={() => setCurrentPage(p => p + 1)}
                      >
                        <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </section>

      <SessionDetailDialog
        open={dialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}
        session={selectedSession}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default AdminStudentDataPage;

===FILE:./client/src/pages/AssessmentPage/AssessmentPage.tsx===
import React, { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from '@/components/ui/radio-group';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Slider } from '@/components/ui/slider';
import {
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Clock,
  Smartphone,
  Save,
  AlertCircle,
  RotateCcw,
  ClipboardCheck,
  HelpCircle,
  Sparkles,
  Download,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { logger } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/logger';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { awardPoints } from '@/api/gamification';
import { SUB_DIM_MAP } from '@/types';
import type { SubDimKey, ISubDimensionScores, IFullAssessmentScores } from '@/types';
import {
  situationQuestions,
  selfAssessmentQuestions,
  dimensionConfig,
} from './questions-data';
import type { ISituationQuestion, ISelfAssessmentQuestion, DimensionType } from './questions-data';
import { exportAssessmentDocument } from '@/utils/export-assessment';



const STORAGE_KEY = 'mdp_assessment_progress';

interface IAssessmentProgress {
  currentStep: number;
  answers: Record<string, number>;
  selfRatings: Record<string, number>;
  lastSavedAt: string;
}

// ============================================
// 测评页面组件
// ============================================
const AssessmentPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState<number>(0);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [selfRatings, setSelfRatings] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [showResumeDialog, setShowResumeDialog] = useState(false);
  const [lastSavedAt, setLastSavedAt] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showSaveToast, setShowSaveToast] = useState(false);
  const [savedProgress, setSavedProgress] = useState<IAssessmentProgress | null>(null);
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false);

  const handleExport = async () => {
    setIsExporting(true);
    try {
      await exportAssessmentDocument();
      toast.success('题目文档已导出');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('导出失败，请重试');
      logger.error('导出测评文档失败', String(err));
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const totalQuestions = situationQuestions.length + selfAssessmentQuestions.length;
  const answeredCount = Object.keys(answers).length + Object.keys(selfRatings).length;
  const progressPercent = Math.round((answeredCount / totalQuestions) * 100);

  // 检查是否有保存的进度
  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (saved) {
      try {
        const progress: IAssessmentProgress = JSON.parse(saved);
        if (progress.currentStep > 0 && progress.currentStep < totalQuestions) {
          setSavedProgress(progress);
          setShowResumeDialog(true);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        logger.error('解析保存的进度失败', String(e));
      }
    }
  }, [totalQuestions]);

  // 自动保存进度（每3题保存一次）
  useEffect(() => {
    if (answeredCount > 0 && answeredCount % 3 === 0) {
      const progress: IAssessmentProgress = {
        currentStep,
        answers,
        selfRatings,
        lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(progress));
      setLastSavedAt(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
      setShowSaveToast(true);
      setTimeout(() => setShowSaveToast(false), 3000);
    }
  }, [answeredCount, currentStep, answers, selfRatings]);

  // 页面关闭前紧急保存
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforeUnload = () => {
      if (answeredCount > 0 && answeredCount < totalQuestions) {
        const progress: IAssessmentProgress = {
          currentStep,
          answers,
          selfRatings,
          lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(progress));
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
  }, [currentStep, answers, selfRatings, answeredCount, totalQuestions]);

  // 继续之前的进度
  const handleResume = () => {
    if (savedProgress) {
      setCurrentStep(savedProgress.currentStep);
      setAnswers(savedProgress.answers);
      setSelfRatings(savedProgress.selfRatings);
      setLastSavedAt(new Date(savedProgress.lastSavedAt).toLocaleTimeString());
    }
    setShowResumeDialog(false);
  };

  // 重新开始
  const handleRestart = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    setCurrentStep(0);
    setAnswers({});
    setSelfRatings({});
    setSavedProgress(null);
    setShowResumeDialog(false);
  };

  // 计算当前显示的问题
  const isSituationPhase = currentStep < situationQuestions.length;
  const currentQuestion = isSituationPhase
    ? situationQuestions[currentStep]
    : selfAssessmentQuestions[currentStep - situationQuestions.length];

  // 处理情境题答案
  const handleSituationAnswer = useCallback((questionId: string, score: number) => {
    setAnswers(prev => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: score }));
  }, []);

  // 处理自评题答案
  const handleSelfRating = useCallback((questionId: string, value: number[]) => {
    setSelfRatings(prev => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: value[0] }));
  }, []);

  // 计算分数
  const calculateScores = useCallback(() => {
    const dimensionScores: Record<DimensionType, { situation: number; self: number; composite: number }> = {
      result: { situation: 0, self: 0, composite: 0 },
      people: { situation: 0, self: 0, composite: 0 },
      field: { situation: 0, self: 0, composite: 0 },
    };

    // 计算情境题分数
    situationQuestions.forEach(q => {
      const score = answers[q.id] || 0;
      dimensionScores[q.dimensionId].situation += score;
    });

    // 转换情境分：(原始分+6)/12*100（因题数从6变为8，满分从6变为8）
    (Object.keys(dimensionScores) as DimensionType[]).forEach(dim => {
      const rawScore = dimensionScores[dim].situation;
      dimensionScores[dim].situation = Math.round(((rawScore + 6) / 12) * 100);
    });

    // 计算自评分
    selfAssessmentQuestions.forEach(q => {
      const score = selfRatings[q.id] || 3;
      dimensionScores[q.dimensionId].self += score;
    });

    // 转换自评分：(两题和-2)/8*100
    (Object.keys(dimensionScores) as DimensionType[]).forEach(dim => {
      const rawScore = dimensionScores[dim].self;
      dimensionScores[dim].self = Math.round(((rawScore - 2) / 8) * 100);
    });

    // 计算综合分：情境分×0.7+自评分×0.3
    (Object.keys(dimensionScores) as DimensionType[]).forEach(dim => {
      dimensionScores[dim].composite = Math.round(
        dimensionScores[dim].situation * 0.7 + dimensionScores[dim].self * 0.3
      );
    });

    return dimensionScores;
  }, [answers, selfRatings]);

  // 提交测评
  const handleSubmit = useCallback(async () => {
    if (answeredCount < totalQuestions) {
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    const scores = calculateScores();
    
    // 清除保存的进度
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    
    // 模拟提交延迟
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
    
    // 保存综合分数到localStorage，供陪练和成长轨迹等模块读取
    const compositeScores = {
      result: scores.result.composite,
      people: scores.people.composite,
      field: scores.field.composite,
    };

    // 计算10子维度分数（从24题subBehavior聚合到10个标准子维度）
    const subDimRaw: Record<string, { total: number; count: number }> = {};
    situationQuestions.forEach(q => {
      const subKey = SUB_DIM_MAP[q.subBehavior];
      if (!subKey) return;
      if (!subDimRaw[subKey]) subDimRaw[subKey] = { total: 0, count: 0 };
      subDimRaw[subKey].total += (answers[q.id] || 0);
      subDimRaw[subKey].count += 1;
    });
    // 自评题映射到子维度
    const selfDimMap: Record<string, SubDimKey> = {
      S1: 'goalSetting', S2: 'review',
      S3: 'atmosphere', S4: 'atmosphere',
      S5: 'culturePenetration', S6: 'roleModel',
    };
    selfAssessmentQuestions.forEach(q => {
      const subKey = selfDimMap[q.id];
      if (!subKey) return;
      if (!subDimRaw[subKey]) subDimRaw[subKey] = { total: 0, count: 0 };
      subDimRaw[subKey].total += (selfRatings[q.id] || 3);
      subDimRaw[subKey].count += 1;
    });
    const calcSubScore = (key: string): number => {
      const raw = subDimRaw[key];
      if (!raw || raw.count === 0) return 50;
      return Math.round(((raw.total + raw.count) / (raw.count * 2)) * 100);
    };
    const subScores: ISubDimensionScores = {
      goalSetting: calcSubScore('goalSetting'),
      execution: calcSubScore('execution'),
      review: calcSubScore('review'),
      goalAlignment: calcSubScore('goalAlignment'),
      atmosphere: calcSubScore('atmosphere'),
      mechanism: calcSubScore('mechanism'),
      collaboration: calcSubScore('collaboration'),
      valueTransmission: calcSubScore('valueTransmission'),
      roleModel: calcSubScore('roleModel'),
      culturePenetration: calcSubScore('culturePenetration'),
    };
    const fullScores: IFullAssessmentScores = {
      ...compositeScores,
      subScores,
    };
    localStorage.setItem('mdp_assessment_scores', JSON.stringify(fullScores));

    awardPoints('assessment_complete', 50, '完成领导力测评');
    toast.success('🎉 完成测评获得50积分！');

    // 计算薄弱子行为
    const subBehaviorScores: Record<string, { total: number; count: number }> = {};
    situationQuestions.forEach(q => {
      const score = answers[q.id] || 0;
      if (!subBehaviorScores[q.subBehavior]) {
        subBehaviorScores[q.subBehavior] = { total: 0, count: 0 };
      }
      subBehaviorScores[q.subBehavior].total += score;
      subBehaviorScores[q.subBehavior].count += 1;
    });
    const weakSubBehaviors = Object.entries(subBehaviorScores)
      .map(([name, { total, count }]) => ({ name, avg: total / count }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.avg - b.avg)
      .slice(0, 3)
      .map(s => s.name);

    // 导航到结果页，传递分数数据
    navigate('/assessment-result', { state: { scores, weakSubBehaviors } });
  }, [answeredCount, totalQuestions, calculateScores, navigate]);

  // 下一步
  const handleNext = useCallback(() => {
    if (currentStep < totalQuestions - 1) {
      setCurrentStep(prev => prev + 1);
    } else {
      handleSubmit();
    }
  }, [currentStep, totalQuestions, handleSubmit]);

  // 上一步
  const handlePrev = useCallback(() => {
    if (currentStep > 0) {
      setCurrentStep(prev => prev - 1);
    }
  }, [currentStep]);

  // 检查当前问题是否已回答
  const isCurrentQuestionAnswered = isSituationPhase
    ? answers[currentQuestion.id] !== undefined
    : selfRatings[currentQuestion.id] !== undefined;

  // 获取已答题数（用于恢复对话框显示）
  const getSavedAnsweredCount = () => {
    if (!savedProgress) return 0;
    return Object.keys(savedProgress.answers).length + Object.keys(savedProgress.selfRatings).length;
  };

  // 获取最后保存时间（用于恢复对话框显示）
  const getSavedTime = () => {
    if (!savedProgress) return '';
    return new Date(savedProgress.lastSavedAt).toLocaleString('zh-CN', {
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      {/* 恢复进度对话框 */}
      <Dialog open={showResumeDialog} onOpenChange={setShowResumeDialog}>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <HelpCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
              发现未完成的测评
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription className="space-y-2">
              <p>您之前有未完成的测评进度，是否继续？</p>
              <div className="bg-muted/50 p-3 rounded-lg text-sm space-y-1">
                <p className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">已答题数：</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{getSavedAnsweredCount()} / {totalQuestions} 题</span>
                </p>
                <p className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">完成进度：</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{Math.round((getSavedAnsweredCount() / totalQuestions) * 100)}%</span>
                </p>
                <p className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">最后保存：</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{getSavedTime()}</span>
                </p>
              </div>
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <DialogFooter className="flex gap-3">
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={handleRestart}>
              <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              重新开始
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleResume}>
              继续测评
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* 页面头部 */}
      <section className="w-full">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <ClipboardCheck className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">前置测评</h1>
            </div>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleExport}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="gap-2"
            >
              <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
              {isExporting ? '导出中...' : '导出题目文档'}
            </Button>
          </div>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-2">
            完成30道测评题目，了解您在“拿结果、带团队、传文化”三维度上的能力水平
          </p>
          <p className="text-sm text-amber-600 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
            领导力测评是自我认知的起点，每一次反思都在让你更接近卓越。
          </p>
        </motion.div>
      </section>

      {/* 进度条 */}
      <section className="w-full">
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="py-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">预计耗时 8-10 分钟</span>
                </div>
                <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Smartphone className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">支持手机端单手操作</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                {showSaveToast && (
                  <motion.div
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                    exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-emerald-600"
                  >
                    <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                    已自动保存
                  </motion.div>
                )}
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                  {answeredCount} / {totalQuestions} 题
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <Progress value={progressPercent} className="h-2" />
            <div className="flex justify-between mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <span>情境题 {Math.min(currentStep + 1, situationQuestions.length)} / {situationQuestions.length}</span>
              <span>自评题 {Math.max(0, currentStep - situationQuestions.length + 1)} / {selfAssessmentQuestions.length}</span>
            </div>
            {lastSavedAt && (
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2 text-right">
                上次保存: {lastSavedAt}
              </p>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </section>

      {/* 问题区域 */}
      <section className="w-full">
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
          <motion.div
            key={currentStep}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
          >
            {isSituationPhase ? (
              // 情境题
              <Card className="border-2">
                <CardHeader>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                    {(() => {
                      const config = dimensionConfig[(currentQuestion as ISituationQuestion).dimensionId];
                      const Icon = config.icon;
                      return (
                        <Badge className={`${config.bgColor} ${config.color} border-0`}>
                          <Icon className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                          {config.name}
                        </Badge>
                      );
                    })()}
                    <Badge variant="outline">{(currentQuestion as ISituationQuestion).subBehavior}</Badge>
                  </div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-xl leading-relaxed">
                    {currentQuestion.id}. {(currentQuestion as ISituationQuestion).scenario}
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <RadioGroup
                    value={answers[currentQuestion.id]?.toString()}
                    onValueChange={(value) => handleSituationAnswer(currentQuestion.id, parseFloat(value))}
                    className="space-y-3"
                  >
                    {(currentQuestion as ISituationQuestion).options.map((option, index) => (
                      <div
                        key={index}
                        className={`flex items-start space-x-3 p-4 rounded-lg border-2 cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                          answers[currentQuestion.id] === option.score
                            ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5'
                            : 'border-border hover:border-primary/50 hover:bg-accent'
                        }`}
                        onClick={() => handleSituationAnswer(currentQuestion.id, option.score)}
                      >
                        <RadioGroupItem value={option.score.toString()} id={`option-${index}`} className="mt-1" />
                        <Label htmlFor={`option-${index}`} className="flex-1 cursor-pointer text-sm leading-relaxed">
                          {option.text}
                        </Label>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </RadioGroup>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            ) : (
              // 自评题
              <Card className="border-2">
                <CardHeader>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                    {(() => {
                      const config = dimensionConfig[(currentQuestion as ISelfAssessmentQuestion).dimensionId];
                      const Icon = config.icon;
                      return (
                        <Badge className={`${config.bgColor} ${config.color} border-0`}>
                          <Icon className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                          {config.name}
                        </Badge>
                      );
                    })()}
                    <Badge variant="outline">自我评估</Badge>
                  </div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-xl leading-relaxed">
                    {currentQuestion.id}. {(currentQuestion as ISelfAssessmentQuestion).question}
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="space-y-6">
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    {/* 分数选择器 - 1-5分可点击 */}
                    <div className="flex justify-center items-center gap-3 sm:gap-4">
                      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((score) => (
                        <button
                          key={score}
                          onClick={() => handleSelfRating(currentQuestion.id, [score])}
                          className={`
                            relative w-12 h-12 sm:w-14 sm:h-14 rounded-full text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold
                            transition-all duration-200 ease-out
                            flex items-center justify-center
                            ${
                              selfRatings[currentQuestion.id] === score
                                ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground scale-110 shadow-lg ring-4 ring-primary/20'
                                : 'bg-muted hover:bg-muted/80 text-foreground hover:scale-105'
                            }
                          `}
                          title={score === 1 ? '完全不同意' : score === 5 ? '完全同意' : `${score}分`}
                        >
                          {score}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* 标签说明 */}
                    <div className="flex justify-between text-sm text-muted-foreground px-2 sm:px-8">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span className="text-xs">1</span>
                        <span>完全不同意</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>完全同意</span>
                        <span className="text-xs">5</span>
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* 当前选择提示 */}
                    <div className="text-center">
                      <Badge 
                        variant={selfRatings[currentQuestion.id] ? 'default' : 'secondary'}
                        className="text-sm px-4 py-1"
                      >
                        {selfRatings[currentQuestion.id] 
                          ? `当前选择: ${selfRatings[currentQuestion.id]}分 - ${
                              selfRatings[currentQuestion.id] === 1 ? '完全不同意' :
                              selfRatings[currentQuestion.id] === 2 ? '不同意' :
                              selfRatings[currentQuestion.id] === 3 ? '中立' :
                              selfRatings[currentQuestion.id] === 4 ? '同意' : '完全同意'
                            }`
                          : '请点击上方数字选择您的评分'
                        }
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>
      </section>

      {/* 导航按钮 */}
      <section className="w-full">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={handlePrev}
            disabled={currentStep === 0}
            className="gap-2"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            上一题
          </Button>
          
          <Button
            onClick={handleNext}
            disabled={!isCurrentQuestionAnswered || isSubmitting}
            className="gap-2"
          >
            {currentStep === totalQuestions - 1 ? (
              isSubmitting ? '提交中...' : '提交测评'
            ) : (
              <>
                下一题
                <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              </>
            )}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* 提示信息 */}
      {currentStep === 0 && (
        <motion.section
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          transition={{ delay: 0.5 }}
          className="w-full"
        >
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 p-4 rounded-lg bg-muted/50 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-primary shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div>
              <p className="font-medium text-foreground mb-1">测评提示</p>
              <ul className="space-y-1 list-disc list-inside">
                <li>测评包含24道情境题和6道自评题，共30题</li>
                <li>进度每3题自动保存，页面关闭前也会紧急保存</li>
                <li>您可以随时退出，下次进入会自动恢复进度</li>
                <li>请根据您的真实想法选择，无需刻意追求完美答案</li>
              </ul>
            </div>
          </div>
        </motion.section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default AssessmentPage;

===FILE:./client/src/pages/AssessmentPage/ProgressSection.tsx===
import React from 'react';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';

interface IProgressSectionProps {
  currentQuestion: number;
  totalQuestions: number;
  sectionName?: string;
  sectionProgress?: number;
}

const ProgressSection: React.FC<IProgressSectionProps> = ({
  currentQuestion,
  totalQuestions,
  sectionName = '情境判断题',
  sectionProgress = 0,
}) => {
  const progressPercentage = Math.round((currentQuestion / totalQuestions) * 100);

  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3 mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
              {sectionName}
            </Badge>
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              第 {currentQuestion} / {totalQuestions} 题
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
            {progressPercentage}%
          </span>
        </div>
        
        <div className="relative">
          <Progress value={progressPercentage} className="h-2" />
          <div 
            className="absolute top-0 left-0 h-2 bg-primary/30 rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
            style={{ width: `${sectionProgress}%` }}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <span>开始</span>
          <div className="flex gap-1">
            {Array.from({ length: Math.min(totalQuestions, 10) }).map((_, index) => {
              const questionNum = index + 1;
              const isCompleted = questionNum < currentQuestion;
              const isCurrent = questionNum === currentQuestion;
              
              return (
                <div
                  key={index}
                  className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-200 ${
                    isCompleted
                      ? 'bg-primary'
                      : isCurrent
                      ? 'bg-primary ring-2 ring-primary/30'
                      : 'bg-muted'
                  }`}
                />
              );
            })}
          </div>
          <span>完成</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

export default ProgressSection;

===FILE:./client/src/pages/AssessmentPage/QuestionSection.tsx===
import React from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from '@/components/ui/radio-group';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Target, Users, Heart, HelpCircle } from 'lucide-react';

interface IOption {
  text: string;
  score: number;
  label: 'best' | 'good' | 'average' | 'poor';
}

interface IQuestion {
  id: string;
  dimensionId: 'result' | 'people' | 'field';
  subBehaviorId: string;
  subBehaviorName: string;
  scenario: string;
  question: string;
  options: IOption[];
}

interface IQuestionSectionProps {
  question: IQuestion;
  questionNumber: number;
  totalQuestions: number;
  selectedOptionIndex: number | null;
  onOptionSelect: (optionIndex: number) => void;
}

const dimensionConfig = {
  result: {
    name: '拿结果',
    icon: Target,
    color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200',
    gradient: 'from-emerald-500 to-teal-600',
  },
  people: {
    name: '带团队',
    icon: Users,
    color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 border-blue-200',
    gradient: 'from-blue-500 to-indigo-600',
  },
  field: {
    name: '传文化',
    icon: Heart,
    color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 border-amber-200',
    gradient: 'from-amber-500 to-orange-600',
  },
};

const optionLabelConfig = {
  best: { text: '最佳', color: 'text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200' },
  good: { text: '次佳', color: 'text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 border-blue-200' },
  average: { text: '一般', color: 'text-amber-600 bg-amber-50 border-amber-200' },
  poor: { text: '待改进', color: 'text-red-600 bg-red-50 border-red-200' },
};

const QuestionSection: React.FC<IQuestionSectionProps> = ({
  question,
  questionNumber,
  totalQuestions,
  selectedOptionIndex,
  onOptionSelect,
}) => {
  const dimension = dimensionConfig[question.dimensionId];
  const DimensionIcon = dimension.icon;

  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      <Card className="border-border/50 shadow-sm">
        <CardContent className="p-6 md:p-8">
          {/* 题目头部信息 */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 mb-6">
            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-sm px-3 py-1">
              第 {questionNumber} / {totalQuestions} 题
            </Badge>
            <Badge className={`${dimension.color} border`}>
              <DimensionIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
              {dimension.name}
            </Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
              {question.subBehaviorName}
            </Badge>
          </div>

          {/* 情境描述 */}
          <div className="mb-6 p-4 md:p-5 bg-muted/50 rounded-xl border border-border/50">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                <HelpCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  情境描述
                </h4>
                <p className="text-foreground leading-relaxed">
                  {question.scenario}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 问题 */}
          <div className="mb-6">
            <h3 className="text-lg md:text-xl font-semibold text-foreground leading-relaxed">
              {question.question}
            </h3>
          </div>

          {/* 选项列表 */}
          <RadioGroup
            value={selectedOptionIndex?.toString()}
            onValueChange={(value) => onOptionSelect(parseInt(value))}
            className="space-y-3"
          >
            {question.options.map((option, index) => {
              const labelConfig = optionLabelConfig[option.label];
              const isSelected = selectedOptionIndex === index;

              return (
                <div
                  key={index}
                  onClick={() => onOptionSelect(index)}
                  className={`
                    relative flex items-start gap-4 p-4 md:p-5 rounded-xl border-2 cursor-pointer
                    transition-all duration-200
                    ${isSelected 
                      ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5 shadow-sm' 
                      : 'border-border/50 bg-card hover:border-primary/30 hover:bg-accent/30'
                    }
                  `}
                >
                  <RadioGroupItem
                    value={index.toString()}
                    id={`option-${index}`}
                    className="mt-0.5 shrink-0"
                  />
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <Label
                      htmlFor={`option-${index}`}
                      className="text-base md:text-lg font-medium text-foreground cursor-pointer leading-relaxed block"
                    >
                      {option.text}
                    </Label>
                  </div>
                  <Badge
                    variant="outline"
                    className={`shrink-0 text-xs ${labelConfig.color}`}
                  >
                    {labelConfig.text}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </RadioGroup>

          {/* 提示信息 */}
          <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-border/50">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary/60" />
              请选择最符合您实际做法的选项，系统将记录您的选择用于生成个性化学习推荐
            </p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </section>
  );
};

export default QuestionSection;

interface IAssessmentResult {
  situationScores: {

    people: number;

    result: number;
    people: number;
    field: number;
  };

    result: number;
    people: number;
    field: number;
  };
  overallScore: number;
  recommendedCourseIds: string[];
  recommendedSceneIds: string[];
  weakSubBehaviorIds: string[];
  weakSubBehaviors?: string[];
}
