// 管理风格画像配置
const getManagementStyle = (scores: IAssessmentResult['compositeScores']) => {
  const { result, people, field } = scores;
  
  if (result >= 70 && people >= 70 && field >= 70) {
    return {
      title: '全能型管理者',
      description: '您在拿结果、带团队、传文化三个维度都表现出色，是一位全面发展的管理者。',
      icon: Award,
      color: 'from-emerald-500 to-teal-600',
    };
  } else if (result >= people && result >= field) {
    if (people >= 65) {
      return {
        title: '目标驱动型领导者',
        description: '您善于设定目标并推动执行，同时具备较强的团队管理能力。',
        icon: Target,
        color: 'from-emerald-500 to-teal-600',
      };
    }
    return {
      title: '结果导向型管理者',
      description: '您专注于目标达成和任务执行，建议多关注团队氛围和成员感受。',
      icon: Target,
      color: 'from-emerald-500 to-teal-600',
    };
  } else if (people >= result && people >= field) {
    if (result >= 65) {
      return {
        title: '团队赋能型领导者',
        description: '您善于培养和发展团队成员，同时也能确保目标达成。',
        icon: Users,
        color: 'from-blue-500 to-indigo-600',
      };
    }
    return {
      title: '人文关怀型管理者',
      description: '您注重团队成员的成长和感受，建议加强目标管理和执行推动。',
      icon: Users,
      color: 'from-blue-500 to-indigo-600',
    };
  } else {
    if (result >= 65) {
      return {
        title: '协作型领导者',
        description: '您善于营造团队氛围和推动目标达成，团队成员愿意追随您。',
        icon: Heart,
        color: 'from-amber-500 to-orange-600',
      };
    }
    return {
      title: '氛围营造型管理者',
      description: '您注重团队协作和氛围建设，建议加强目标设定和执行管理。',
      icon: Heart,
      color: 'from-amber-500 to-orange-600',
    };
  }
};

                          <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br ${config.gradient} flex items-center justify-center`}>
                            <DimensionIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <div className="font-semibold text-foreground">{config.name}</div>
                            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                              情境: {result.situationScores[dimensionKey]} | 
                              自评: {result.selfAssessmentScores[dimensionKey]}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-right">
                          <div className="text-2xl font-bold" style={{ color: config.color }}>
                            {score}
                          </div>
                          <div className={`text-xs ${diff >= 0 ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-amber-600'}`}>
                            行业平均: {industryScore} ({diff >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{diff})
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      
                      {/* 进度条 */}
                      <div className="mt-3">
                        <div className="h-2 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                          <div
                            className={`h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r ${config.gradient}`}
                            style={{ width: `${score}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </section>
  );
};

// ============================================
// 行为建议区块
// ============================================
const BehaviorSuggestionsSection: React.FC<{ result: IAssessmentResult }> = ({ result }) => {
  const sortedDimensions = Object.entries(result.compositeScores)
    .sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
  const weakSubs = result.weakSubBehaviors || result.weakSubBehaviorIds || [];

  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      <Card className="border-0 shadow-md">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
              <Lightbulb className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <CardTitle className="text-lg">具体行为建议</CardTitle>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            根据您的测评结果，以下是您可以立即执行的提升建议
          </p>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="space-y-6">
            {weakSubs.length > 0 && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />
                  <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">薄弱项专项提升</span>
                  <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-xs">重点关注</Badge>
                </div>
                {weakSubs.map((subName, idx) => {
                  const suggestions = subBehaviorSuggestions[subName] || [];
                  return (
                    <div key={subName} className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 border border-red-100">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                        <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-red-100 text-red-600 text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                          {idx + 1}
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-medium text-sm text-red-800">{subName}</span>
                      </div>
                      {suggestions.length > 0 ? (
                        <ul className="space-y-1 ml-7">
                          {suggestions.map((s, i) => (
                            <li key={i} className="text-sm text-red-700">
                              {s}
                            </li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      ) : (
                        <p className="text-sm text-red-600 ml-7">
                          该能力项有待加强，建议优先学习对应课程并进行AI陪练实践。
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}

            {sortedDimensions.map(([dimension, score]) => {
              const config = dimensionConfig[dimension as 'result' | 'people' | 'field'];
              const suggestions = behaviorSuggestions[dimension];
              const DimensionIcon = config.icon;

              return (
                <div key={dimension} className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <DimensionIcon className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: config.color }} />
                    <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{config.name}</span>
                    <Badge variant={score >= 65 ? 'default' : 'secondary'} className={score >= 65 ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700' : ''}>
                      {score}分
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <ul className="space-y-2">
                    {suggestions.map((suggestion, index) => (
                      <li key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                          {index + 1}
                        </span>
                        <span>{suggestion}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </section>
  );
};

// ============================================
// 来自一线的真实挑战
// ============================================
const RealChallengesSection: React.FC<{ result: IAssessmentResult }> = ({ result }) => {
  const [problems, setProblems] = useState<StudentProblem[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchProblems = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const entries = Object.entries(result.compositeScores) as [keyof typeof dimensionConfig, number][];
        const weakestDimension = entries.reduce(
          (min, [key, val]) => (val < min.score ? { key, score: val } : min),
          { key: entries[0][0], score: entries[0][1] }
        ).key;
        const data = await getProblems({ dimension: weakestDimension });
        setProblems(data.slice(0, 3));
      } catch {
        setProblems([]);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchProblems();
  }, [result.compositeScores]);

  const entries = Object.entries(result.compositeScores) as [keyof typeof dimensionConfig, number][];
  const weakestDimension = entries.reduce(
    (min, [key, val]) => (val < min.score ? { key, score: val } : min),
    { key: entries[0][0], score: entries[0][1] }
  ).key;
  const config = dimensionConfig[weakestDimension];
  const DimIcon = config.icon;

  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      <Card className="border-0 shadow-md">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-red-100">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600" />
            </div>
            <CardTitle className="text-lg">来自一线的真实挑战</CardTitle>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            与您弱项维度「{config.name}」相关的真实管理场景
          </p>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {loading ? (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-8">
              <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-6 w-6 border-b-2 border-primary" />
            </div>
          ) : problems.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-8">暂无相关挑战数据</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {problems.map((problem: StudentProblem, index: number) => (
                <motion.div
                  key={problem.id}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  transition={{ delay: index * 0.1 }}
                  className="p-4 rounded-lg border border-border/50 hover:border-red-200 transition-colors"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-2">
                    <h4 className="font-medium text-foreground flex-1">{problem.challengeTheme}</h4>
                    <Badge className="bg-red-100 text-red-700 shrink-0">{problem.businessType}</Badge>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <DimIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>{problem.company}{problem.region ? ` · ${problem.region}` : ''}</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                    {problem.currentSituation.length > 100
                      ? problem.currentSituation.slice(0, 100) + '...'
                      : problem.currentSituation}
                  </p>
                  <div className="text-xs text-red-600 flex items-start gap-1">
                    <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                    <span>希望获得帮助：{problem.helpNeeded.length > 80 ? problem.helpNeeded.slice(0, 80) + '...' : problem.helpNeeded}</span>
                  </div>
                </motion.div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </section>
  );
};

// ============================================
// 深度学习反馈区块 - 布鲁姆认知层次
// ============================================
const DeepLearningSection: React.FC<{ result: IAssessmentResult }> = ({ result }) => {
  const avgScore = result.overallScore;
  
  // 根据分数判断认知层次
  const cognitiveLevel = avgScore >= 80 ? '创造' : avgScore >= 65 ? '评价' : avgScore >= 50 ? '分析' : avgScore >= 35 ? '应用' : '理解';
  const levelDescriptions: Record<string, { level: number; desc: string; advice: string }> = {
    '理解': { level: 1, desc: '您能够理解管理概念和方法，但在实际应用中可能需要更多指导', advice: '建议重点学习基础课程，多做案例分析，建立管理知识框架' },
    '应用': { level: 2, desc: '您能够在熟悉场景中应用所学知识，但面对复杂情境时灵活性不足', advice: '建议通过AI陪练练习不同场景，培养举一反三的能力' },
    '分析': { level: 3, desc: '您能够分析复杂管理情境，拆解问题要素，但在决策时可能犹豫不决', advice: '建议学习决策框架，多做情境题训练，提升决策果断性' },
    '评价': { level: 4, desc: '您能够对管理方法进行评估和选择，具备一定的管理判断力', advice: '建议学习更多实战案例，培养管理直觉，同时关注团队反馈' },
    '创造': { level: 5, desc: '您能够创造性地解决管理问题，形成自己的管理风格', advice: '建议开始指导他人，将您的管理经验沉淀为可复用的方法论' },
  };
  
  const currentLevel = levelDescriptions[cognitiveLevel];
  
  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      <Card className="border-0 shadow-md">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-purple-100">
              <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600" />
            </div>
            <CardTitle className="text-lg">深度学习反馈</CardTitle>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            基于布鲁姆认知层次理论，分析您的管理能力发展阶段
          </p>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {/* 认知层次阶梯 */}
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-sm font-medium">当前认知层次</span>
              <Badge className="bg-purple-100 text-purple-700">{cognitiveLevel}层</Badge>
            </div>
            
            {/* 层次可视化 */}
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="flex items-end justify-center gap-2 h-24">
                {['理解', '应用', '分析', '评价', '创造'].map((level, idx) => {
                  const isActive = idx < currentLevel.level;
                  const isCurrent = level === cognitiveLevel;
                  const heights = ['h-8', 'h-12', 'h-16', 'h-20', 'h-24'];
                  return (
                    <div key={level} className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
                      <div
                        className={`w-12 ${heights[idx]} rounded-t-lg transition-all ${
                          isCurrent
                            ? 'bg-purple-500 ring-2 ring-purple-300'
                            : isActive
                            ? 'bg-purple-300'
                            : 'bg-gray-200'
                        }`}
                      />
                      <span className={`text-xs ${isCurrent ? 'font-medium text-purple-700' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                        {level}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* 当前层次说明 */}
            <div className="p-4 rounded-lg bg-purple-50 border border-purple-100">
              <p className="text-sm text-purple-900 mb-2">
                <span className="font-medium">当前状态：</span>{currentLevel.desc}
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-purple-800">
                <span className="font-medium">进阶建议：</span>{currentLevel.advice}
              </p>
            </div>
            
            {/* 学习路径建议 */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-2">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 border border-blue-100">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                  <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-blue-900">知识建构</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-blue-800">
                  {cognitiveLevel === '理解' ? '从基础课程开始，建立系统知识框架' : '通过案例学习，将知识内化为能力'}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-100">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                  <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-emerald-900">情境演练</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-emerald-800">
                  {cognitiveLevel === '创造' ? '通过指导他人，固化自己的管理方法论' : '通过AI陪练，在模拟情境中练习决策'}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </section>
  );
};

// ============================================
// 推荐列表区块
// ============================================
const RecommendationsListSection: React.FC<{ result: IAssessmentResult }> = ({ result }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [courses, setCourses] = useState<ApiCourse[]>([]);
  const [scenes, setScenes] = useState<ICoachingScene[]>([]);
  const [loadingCourses, setLoadingCourses] = useState(true);
  const [loadingScenes, setLoadingScenes] = useState(true);

  const weakDimension = React.useMemo(() => {
    const entries = Object.entries(result.compositeScores) as ['result' | 'people' | 'field', number][];
    return entries.reduce(
      (min, [key, val]) => (val < min.score ? { key, score: val } : min),
      { key: entries[0][0], score: entries[0][1] }
    ).key;
  }, [result.compositeScores]);

  const filteredCourses = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (courses.length === 0) return [];
    const recIds = result.recommendedCourseIds ?? [];
    if (recIds.length > 0) {
      const matched = courses.filter((c: ApiCourse) => recIds.includes(c.id));
      if (matched.length > 0) return matched;
    }
    return courses.filter((c: ApiCourse) => c.dimensionId === weakDimension);
  }, [courses, result.recommendedCourseIds, weakDimension]);

  const filteredScenes = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (scenes.length === 0) return [];
    const recIds = result.recommendedSceneIds ?? [];
    if (recIds.length > 0) {
      const matched = scenes.filter((s: ICoachingScene) => recIds.includes(s.id));
      if (matched.length > 0) return matched;
    }
    return scenes.filter((s: ICoachingScene) => s.dimension === weakDimension);
  }, [scenes, result.recommendedSceneIds, weakDimension]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoadingCourses(true);
    getAllCourses()
      .then((data: ApiCourse[]) => { if (!cancelled) setCourses(data); })
      .catch(() => { if (!cancelled) setCourses([]); })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setLoadingCourses(false); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoadingScenes(true);
    getAllScenes()
      .then((data: ICoachingScene[]) => { if (!cancelled) setScenes(data); })
      .catch(() => { if (!cancelled) setScenes([]); })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setLoadingScenes(false); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      <Tabs defaultValue="courses" className="w-full">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-2 mb-6">
          <TabsTrigger value="courses" className="gap-2">
            <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4" />
            推荐课程
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="scenes" className="gap-2">
            <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
            推荐陪练场景
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="courses" className="mt-0">
          {loadingCourses ? (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-12">
              <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-6 w-6 border-b-2 border-primary" />
            </div>
          ) : filteredCourses.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center py-12">
              <Image src={EMPTY_STATE_ILLUSTRATIONS.telescope} width={120} height={120} alt="暂无推荐课程" className="mb-4 object-contain" />
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center">暂无推荐课程</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {filteredCourses.map((course: ApiCourse, index: number) => {
                const config = dimensionConfig[course.dimensionId];
                const DimensionIcon = config.icon;
                
                return (
                  <motion.div
                    key={course.id}
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    transition={{ delay: index * 0.1 }}
                  >
                    <Card
                      className="cursor-pointer hover:shadow-lg transition-all border-0 shadow-md h-full"
                      onClick={() => navigate(`/courses/${course.id}`)}
                    >
                      <CardContent className="p-5">
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 mb-3">
                          <div className={`p-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br ${config.gradient}`}>
                            <DimensionIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
                          </div>
                          <Badge variant="secondary" className={config.bgColor + ' ' + config.textColor}>
                            {config.name}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        
                        <h3 className="font-semibold text-foreground mb-2 line-clamp-2">
                          {course.title}
                        </h3>
                        
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 mb-4">
                          {course.description}
                        </p>
                        
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                            {course.duration}分钟
                          </span>
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-primary">
                            <Zap className="w-3 h-3" />
                            针对薄弱项
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  </motion.div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="scenes" className="mt-0">
          {loadingScenes ? (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-12">
              <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-6 w-6 border-b-2 border-primary" />
            </div>
          ) : filteredScenes.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center py-12">
              <Image src={EMPTY_STATE_ILLUSTRATIONS.stageCurtain} width={120} height={120} alt="暂无推荐陪练场景" className="mb-4 object-contain" />
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center">暂无推荐陪练场景</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              {filteredScenes.map((scene: ICoachingScene, index: number) => {
                const config = dimensionConfig[scene.dimension];
                const DimensionIcon = config.icon;
                const difficulty = difficultyConfig[scene.difficulty];
                
                return (
                  <motion.div
                    key={scene.id}
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    transition={{ delay: index * 0.1 }}
                  >
                    <Card
                      className="cursor-pointer hover:shadow-lg transition-all border-0 shadow-md"
                      onClick={() => navigate(`/coaching/${scene.id}`)}
                    >
                      <CardContent className="p-5">
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div className={`p-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br ${config.gradient}`}>
                              <DimensionIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <Badge variant="secondary" className={config.bgColor + ' ' + config.textColor}>
                                {config.name}
                              </Badge>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full ${difficulty.color}`}>
                            {difficulty.label}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        
                        <h3 className="font-semibold text-foreground mb-2">
                          {scene.name}
                        </h3>
                        
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          <span>AI角色: {scene.aiRole}</span>
                          <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                        </div>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  </motion.div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </section>
  );
};

// ============================================
// 能力分析区块
// ============================================
const AnalysisSection: React.FC<{ result: IAssessmentResult }> = ({ result }) => {
  const strengths = Object.entries(result.compositeScores)
    .filter(([_, score]) => score >= 65)
    .map(([key, score]) => ({ dimension: key, score }));
  
  const weaknesses = Object.entries(result.compositeScores)
    .filter(([_, score]) => score < 65)
    .map(([key, score]) => ({ dimension: key, score }));

  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        {/* 优势维度 */}
        <Card className="border-0 shadow-md">
          <CardHeader className="pb-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-green-100">
                <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" />
              </div>
              <CardTitle className="text-lg">优势维度</CardTitle>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {strengths.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {strengths.map(({ dimension, score }) => {
                  const config = dimensionConfig[dimension as 'result' | 'people' | 'field'];
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={dimension}
                      className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-lg bg-green-50"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <config.icon className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: config.color }} />
                        <span className="font-medium">{config.name}</span>
                      </div>
                      <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-700">{score}分</Badge>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-4">
                  这些是您的管理优势，建议在工作中继续发挥，并可指导他人提升。
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">
                暂无突出优势维度，建议全面学习提升
              </p>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 待提升维度 */}
        <Card className="border-0 shadow-md">
          <CardHeader className="pb-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-100">
                <Zap className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600" />
              </div>
              <CardTitle className="text-lg">待提升维度</CardTitle>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {weaknesses.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {weaknesses.map(({ dimension, score }) => {
                  const config = dimensionConfig[dimension as 'result' | 'people' | 'field'];
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={dimension}
                      className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-50"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <config.icon className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: config.color }} />
                        <span className="font-medium">{config.name}</span>
                      </div>
                      <Badge className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-700">{score}分</Badge>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-4">
                  建议优先学习相关课程并进行AI陪练，系统已为您推荐针对性内容。
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-green-600 justify-center py-4">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5" />
                <span>各维度表现均衡，继续保持！</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

const ShareDialog: React.FC<{
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  result: IAssessmentResult;
}> = ({ open, onOpenChange, result }) => {
  const style = getManagementStyle(result.compositeScores);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const cardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const handleCopyImage = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!cardRef.current) return;
    
    try {
      // 使用 html-to-image 或 canvas 转换
      // 这里简化处理，实际项目中可以使用 html2canvas
      toast.success('分享卡片已复制到剪贴板');
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('复制失败，请尝试下载图片');
    }
  }, []);

  const handleDownload = useCallback(() => {
    toast.success('分享卡片下载中...');
    // 实际项目中实现下载逻辑
  }, []);

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>分享我的测评结果</DialogTitle>

        </DialogHeader>
        
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 py-4">
          {/* 预览卡片 */}
          <div ref={cardRef} className="transform scale-90 origin-center">

          {/* 操作按钮 */}
          <div className="flex gap-3 w-full">
            <Button 
              variant="outline" 
              className="flex-1 gap-2"
              onClick={handleCopyImage}
            >
              {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />}
              {copied ? '已复制' : '复制图片'}
            </Button>
            <Button 
              className="flex-1 gap-2"
              onClick={handleDownload}
            >
              <Download className="w-4 h-4" />

            </Button>
          </div>

            分享至朋友圈或发送给同事，邀请他们一起测评

  );

const AssessmentResultPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const state = location.state as {
    scores?: Record<string, { situation: number; self: number; composite: number }>;
    weakSubBehaviors?: string[];
  } | null;

  const result: IAssessmentResult = state?.scores
    ? {
        ...mockResult,
        situationScores: {
          result: state.scores.result.situation,
          people: state.scores.people.situation,
          field: state.scores.field.situation,
        },
        selfAssessmentScores: {
          result: state.scores.result.self,
          people: state.scores.people.self,
          field: state.scores.field.self,
        },
        compositeScores: {
          result: state.scores.result.composite,
          people: state.scores.people.composite,
          field: state.scores.field.composite,
        },
        overallScore: Math.round(
          (state.scores.result.composite + state.scores.people.composite + state.scores.field.composite) / 3,
        ),
        weakSubBehaviors: state.weakSubBehaviors || mockResult.weakSubBehaviors,
      }

            </Button>
            <Button onClick={() => navigate('/dashboard')}>
              <BarChart3 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              查看成长仪表盘
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* 管理风格画像 */}
      <ManagementStyleSection result={result} />

      {/* 雷达图结果 */}
      <ResultRadarSection result={result} />

      {/* 能力分析 */}
      <AnalysisSection result={result} />

      {/* 行为建议 */}
      <BehaviorSuggestionsSection result={result} />

      {/* 深度学习反馈 - 布鲁姆认知层次 */}
      <DeepLearningSection result={result} />

      {/* 来自一线的真实挑战 */}
      <RealChallengesSection result={result} />

      {/* 推荐内容 */}
      <section className="w-full">

        <RecommendationsListSection result={result} />
      </section>

      {/* 分享对话框 */}
      <ShareDialog 
        open={shareDialogOpen} 
        onOpenChange={setShareDialogOpen}
        result={result}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

const getSortedDimensions = (scores: IThreeDimensionsScore) =>
  [
    { key: 'result' as const, score: scores.result },
    { key: 'people' as const, score: scores.people },
    { key: 'field' as const, score: scores.field },
  ].sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score);

export default function RecommendationsListSection({ scores }: IRecommendationsListSectionProps) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [courses, setCourses] = useState<ICourse[]>([]);
  const [scenes, setScenes] = useState<ICoachingScene[]>([]);
  const [subScores, setSubScores] = useState<ISubDimensionScores | null>(null);
  const [showSubDetail, setShowSubDetail] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    Promise.all([
      getAllCourses().catch(() => []),
      getAllScenes().catch(() => []),
    ]).then(([courseData, sceneData]) => {
      setCourses(courseData);
      setScenes(sceneData);
    });
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem('mdp_assessment_scores');
      if (stored) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
        if (parsed.subScores) setSubScores(parsed.subScores);
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, []);

  // 找出最薄弱的子维度
  const weakSubDims = subScores
    ? SUB_DIMENSIONS.map((sd) => ({ ...sd, score: subScores[sd.key] }))
        .sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score)
        .slice(0, 3)
    : [];

  const sortedDimensions = getSortedDimensions(scores);
  const weakDimKey = sortedDimensions[0].key;
  const weakDimScore = sortedDimensions[0].score;

  // 按维度筛选并排序课程
  const recommendedCourses: (ICourse & { priority: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'; reason: string })[] = [];
  sortedDimensions.forEach((dim, index) => {
    const priority: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' = index === 0 ? 'high' : index === 1 ? 'medium' : 'low';
    const dimCourses = courses
      .filter((c: ICourse) => c.dimensionId === dim.key)
      .slice(0, index === 0 ? 3 : 2)
      .map((c: ICourse) => ({
        ...c,
        priority,
        reason: `针对${dimensionConfig[dim.key].name}维度提升`,
      }));
    recommendedCourses.push(...dimCourses);
  });
  const displayCourses = recommendedCourses.slice(0, 6);

  // 按维度筛选并排序场景
  const recommendedScenes: (ICoachingScene & { reason: string })[] = [];
  sortedDimensions.forEach((dim) => {
    const dimScenes = scenes
      .filter((s: ICoachingScene) => s.dimension === dim.key)
      .slice(0, 2)
      .map((s: ICoachingScene) => ({
        ...s,
        reason: `针对${dimensionConfig[dim.key].name}维度提升练习`,
      }));
    recommendedScenes.push(...dimScenes);
  });
  const displayScenes = recommendedScenes.slice(0, 4);
  
  const handleCourseClick = (courseId: string) => {
    navigate(`/courses/${courseId}`);
  };
  
  const handleSceneClick = (sceneId: string) => {
    navigate(`/coaching/${sceneId}`);
  };

  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      {/* 薄弱维度提示 */}
      <Card className="mb-8 border-l-4 border-l-primary bg-gradient-to-r from-primary/5 to-transparent">
        <CardContent className="p-6">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <TrendingUp className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground mb-1">
                重点关注维度：{dimensionConfig[weakDimKey].name}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mb-3">
                您在{dimensionConfig[weakDimKey].name}维度得分为 <span className="font-semibold text-primary">{weakDimScore.toFixed(1)}分</span>，
                是当前最需要提升的能力维度。我们为您推荐了针对性的课程和陪练场景。
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-3">
                <Badge variant="outline" className={dimensionConfig[weakDimKey].color}>
                  {dimensionConfig[weakDimKey].name}
                </Badge>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/20">
                  得分: {weakDimScore.toFixed(1)}
                </Badge>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border-orange-200">
                  优先提升
                </Badge>
              </div>

              {/* 子维度详情 */}
              {weakSubDims.length > 0 && (
                <div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setShowSubDetail(!showSubDetail)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-primary hover:text-primary/80 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <ChevronDown className={`w-3 h-3 transition-transform ${showSubDetail ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
                    查看薄弱子维度详情
                  </button>
                  {showSubDetail && (
                    <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
                      {weakSubDims.map((wd) => {
                        const c = SUB_DIM_COLOR[wd.parentDim];
                        return (
                          <div key={wd.key} className="flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: c.light }}>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className="text-xs font-medium" style={{ color: c.text }}>{wd.name}</span>
                              <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: c.bg, color: c.text }}>
                                {wd.theories[0]}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <div className="w-20 h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: '#F0EDE7' }}>
                                <div className="h-full rounded-full" style={{ width: `${wd.score}%`, backgroundColor: c.bar }} />
                              </div>
                              <span className="text-xs font-bold w-8 text-right" style={{ color: c.text }}>{wd.score}</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                        以上为测评中得分最低的3项子能力，对应课程和陪练场景将优先推荐。

          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-3">
            {displayCourses.map((course, index) => {
              const DimensionIcon = dimensionConfig[course.dimensionId].icon;
              return (
                <div
                  key={course.id}
                  onClick={() => handleCourseClick(course.id)}
                  className="group p-4 rounded-xl border border-border/50 bg-card hover:bg-accent/50 hover:border-primary/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-3">

import ReactECharts from 'echarts-for-react';

interface IThreeDimensionsScore {
  result: number;
  people: number;
  field: number;
}

interface IResultRadarSectionProps {
  situationScores: IThreeDimensionsScore;
  selfAssessmentScores: IThreeDimensionsScore;
  compositeScores: IThreeDimensionsScore;
  overallScore: number;
}

  result: {
    name: '拿结果',
    nameEn: 'Result',
    color: '#1A7B6E',
    icon: Target,
    description: '目标设定、计划拆解、进度跟进',
  },
  people: {
    name: '带团队',
    nameEn: 'People',
    color: '#0B3B3F',
    icon: Users,
    description: '授权信任、教练辅导、绩效反馈',
  },
  field: {
    name: '传文化',
    nameEn: 'Field',
    color: '#2C9A8A',
    icon: Heart,
    description: '跨部门协调、冲突调解、心理安全',
  },
};

const getScoreLevel = (score: number): { label: string; color: string } => {
  if (score >= 80) return { label: '优秀', color: 'bg-emerald-500' };
  if (score >= 65) return { label: '良好', color: 'bg-blue-500' };
  if (score >= 50) return { label: '一般', color: 'bg-yellow-500' };
  return { label: '待提升', color: 'bg-orange-500' };
};

const ResultRadarSection: React.FC<IResultRadarSectionProps> = ({

// Upload Dialog
// ============================================
const UploadDialog: React.FC<{
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}> = ({ open, onOpenChange }) => {
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState<IUploadProgress | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const intervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (intervalRef.current) clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleFileSelect = (file: File) => {
    if (!file.name.match(/\.(mp3|wav|m4a|ogg)$/i)) {
      toast.error('请上传 MP3, WAV, M4A 或 OGG 格式的音频文件');
      return;
    }

    setUploadProgress({
      fileName: file.name,
      progress: 0,
      status: 'uploading',
    });

    let progress = 0;
    intervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      progress += 5;
      setUploadProgress(prev => prev ? { ...prev, progress } : null);

      if (progress >= 100) {
        if (intervalRef.current) { clearInterval(intervalRef.current); intervalRef.current = null; }
        setUploadProgress(prev => prev ? { ...prev, status: 'processing' } : null);
        
        setTimeout(() => {
          setUploadProgress(prev => prev ? { ...prev, status: 'completed' } : null);
          toast.success('音频上传成功，开始转录...');
          
          setTimeout(() => {
            setUploadProgress(null);
            onOpenChange(false);
          }, 1500);
        }, 2000);
      }
    }, 100);
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragging(false);
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
    if (file) handleFileSelect(file);
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(v) => { if (!v && intervalRef.current) { clearInterval(intervalRef.current); intervalRef.current = null; } onOpenChange(v); }}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Upload className="w-5 h-5" />
            上传专家录音
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            支持 MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG 格式，文件大小不超过 500MB
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {!uploadProgress ? (
            <div
              className={`border-2 border-dashed rounded-xl p-8 text-center transition-colors ${
                isDragging ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5' : 'border-border'
              }`}
              onDrop={handleDrop}
              onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setIsDragging(true); }}
              onDragLeave={() => setIsDragging(false)}
              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            >
              <input
                ref={fileInputRef}
                type="file"
                accept=".mp3,.wav,.m4a,.ogg"
                className="hidden"
                onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && handleFileSelect(e.target.files[0])}
              />
              <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
                <Mic className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-foreground font-medium mb-2">
                点击或拖拽音频文件到此处
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                支持 MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG 格式
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="p-6 border rounded-xl space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <FileAudio className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="font-medium truncate">{uploadProgress.fileName}</p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {uploadProgress.status === 'uploading' && '上传中...'}
                    {uploadProgress.status === 'processing' && '处理中...'}
                    {uploadProgress.status === 'completed' && '上传完成'}
                  </p>
                </div>
                {uploadProgress.status === 'completed' ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />
                ) : (
                  <X className="w-5 h-5 text-muted-foreground cursor-pointer" 
                     onClick={() => setUploadProgress(null)} />
                )}
              </div>
              <Progress value={uploadProgress.progress} className="h-2" />
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="bg-muted rounded-lg p-4">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium mb-2">上传说明：</p>
            <ul className="text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-1">
              <li>• 文件将自动进行语音识别转文字</li>
              <li>• 转录完成后可编辑和校对文本</li>
              <li>• 支持标记精彩片段和金句</li>
              <li>• 转录文本可用于课程配套内容</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
};

const AudioDetailDialog: React.FC<{

const AudioListSection: React.FC<{
  audios: IAudioFile[];
  onSelect: (audio: IAudioFile) => void;
}> = ({ audios, onSelect }) => {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('all');

  const filteredAudios = audios.filter(audio => {
    const matchesSearch = audio.fileName.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    const matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'all' || audio.status === statusFilter;
    return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
  });

  return (
    <Card className="border-0 shadow-sm">
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <CardTitle className="text-lg">录音列表</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>共 {filteredAudios.length} 条记录</CardDescription>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input
                placeholder="搜索录音..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="pl-9 w-48"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-4">
          <Button
            variant={statusFilter === 'all' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setStatusFilter('all')}
          >
            全部
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={statusFilter === 'pending' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setStatusFilter('pending')}
          >
            待处理
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={statusFilter === 'processing' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setStatusFilter('processing')}
          >
            转录中
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={statusFilter === 'completed' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setStatusFilter('completed')}
          >
            已完成
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {filteredAudios.map((audio) => {
            const status = statusConfig[audio.status];
            const StatusIcon = status.icon;

            return (
              <motion.div
                key={audio.id}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                className="p-4 rounded-lg border border-border/50 hover:bg-accent/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                onClick={() => onSelect(audio)}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <Headphones className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <p className="font-medium text-foreground truncate">{audio.fileName}</p>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {audio.duration}
                      </span>
                      <span>{audio.uploadTime}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <Badge className={`${status.color} gap-1`}>
                      <StatusIcon className={`w-3 h-3 ${audio.status === 'processing' ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                      {status.name}
                    </Badge>
                    {audio.highlights && audio.highlights.length > 0 && (
                      <Badge variant="secondary" className="gap-1">
                        <Quote className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {audio.highlights.length}
                      </Badge>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}

          {filteredAudios.length === 0 && (
            <div className="text-center py-12">
              <FileAudio className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">暂无匹配的录音</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

const AudioProcessingPage: React.FC = () => {

              上传、转录和编辑专家录音内容
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button onClick={() => setUploadDialogOpen(true)} className="gap-2">
            <Upload className="w-4 h-4" />
            上传录音
          </Button>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* 统计卡片 */}
      <StatsSection audios={mockAudios} />

      {/* 录音列表 */}

      {/* 详情对话框 */}
      <AudioDetailDialog
        audio={selectedAudio}
        open={detailDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setDetailDialogOpen}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

const IMPACT_TYPE_CONFIG: Record<
  string,
  { label: string; color: string; bg: string }
> = {
  efficiency: {
    label: '效率提升',
    color: 'text-emerald-700',

const ImpactFormCard: React.FC<{ onCreated: () => void }> = ({
  onCreated,
}) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [impactType, setImpactType] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [metricName, setMetricName] = useState('');
  const [metricBefore, setMetricBefore] = useState('');
  const [metricAfter, setMetricAfter] = useState('');
  const [confidenceLevel, setConfidenceLevel] = useState('');

  const resetForm = useCallback(() => {
    setImpactType('');
    setDescription('');
    setMetricName('');
    setMetricBefore('');
    setMetricAfter('');
    setConfidenceLevel('');
  }, []);

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!impactType || !description) {
      toast.error('请选择影响类型并填写描述');
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await createBusinessImpact({
        impactType,
        description,
        metricName: metricName || undefined,
        metricBefore: metricBefore || undefined,
        metricAfter: metricAfter || undefined,
        confidenceLevel: confidenceLevel
          ? Number(confidenceLevel)
          : undefined,
      });
      toast.success('业务影响记录成功');
      resetForm();
      setOpen(false);
      onCreated();
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('Failed to create business impact', err);
      toast.error('记录失败，请重试');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card className="border-border/50 border-dashed">
      <CardContent className="p-4">
        {!open ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 text-primary hover:text-primary/80 transition-colors"
            onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">记录业务影响</span>
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-medium text-sm">记录业务影响</h3>
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => {
                  setOpen(false);
                  resetForm();
                }}
              >
                取消
              </Button>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <Select value={impactType} onValueChange={setImpactType}>
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder="影响类型" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="efficiency">效率提升</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="team_culture">团队文化</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="result_quality">质量改善</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="cost_saving">成本节约</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <Select
                value={confidenceLevel}
                onValueChange={setConfidenceLevel}
              >
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder="信心等级" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="1">1 - 初步估计</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="2">2 - 有参考</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="3">3 - 较确定</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="4">4 - 有数据支撑</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="5">5 - 精确量化</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <Textarea
              placeholder="描述具体的业务影响变化..."
              value={description}
              onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) =>
                setDescription(e.target.value)
              }
              rows={2}
            />
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <Input
                placeholder="指标名称（如：成交转化率）"
                value={metricName}
                onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) =>
                  setMetricName(e.target.value)
                }
              />
              <Input
                placeholder="改善前（如：12%）"
                value={metricBefore}
                onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) =>
                  setMetricBefore(e.target.value)
                }
              />
              <Input
                placeholder="改善后（如：18%）"
                value={metricAfter}
                onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) =>
                  setMetricAfter(e.target.value)
                }
              />
            </div>
            <Button
              onClick={handleSubmit}
              disabled={submitting}
              className="w-full"
            >
              {submitting && <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />}
              提交记录
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

                  {impact.metricName && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                        {impact.metricName}
                      </span>
                      <span>{impact.metricBefore ?? '-'}</span>
                      <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
                      <span className="font-medium text-emerald-600">
                        {impact.metricAfter ?? '-'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground shrink-0">
                  {new Date(impact.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

const ROISection: React.FC<{ stats: IUserStats | null }> = ({ stats }) => {
  const [showMethodology, setShowMethodology] = useState(false);

  if (!stats) return null;

  return (
    <Card className="border-border/50 bg-gradient-to-br from-primary/5 to-transparent">
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
            <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <CardTitle>学习投资回报率(ROI)</CardTitle>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
              ROI = (业务价值 - 学习投入) / 学习投入 × 100%
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-6">
        {!stats.hasEnoughData ? (
          <div className="text-center p-6 bg-amber-50 rounded-xl border border-amber-200">
            <Info className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-500 mx-auto mb-3" />
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-amber-800 mb-1">
              数据积累中
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-amber-700">
              需完成至少3次陪练和2个行动计划，才能计算可靠的ROI
            </p>
            <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-4 text-xs text-amber-600">
              <span>
                陪练: {stats.totalSessions}/3次
              </span>
              <span>
                计划: {stats.totalPlans}/2个
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-center p-8 bg-primary/5 rounded-xl">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
              整体投资回报率 (ROI)
            </p>
            <div className="flex items-baseline justify-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-5xl font-bold text-primary">
                {stats.roi}%
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <div className="p-4 bg-muted/50 rounded-lg text-center">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">学习投入</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold">
              ¥{stats.learningCost.toLocaleString()}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">含时间成本折算</p>
          </div>
          <div className="p-4 bg-green-50 rounded-lg text-center border border-green-200">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">业务价值</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">
              ¥{stats.estimatedBusinessValue.toLocaleString()}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-green-600">量化业务价值</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">行为改变评分</span>
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              {stats.behaviorScore.toFixed(1)} / 5
            </span>
          </div>
          <Progress value={stats.behaviorScore * 20} className="h-2" />

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">行动计划执行率</span>
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              {(stats.executionRate * 100).toFixed(0)}%
            </span>
          </div>
          <Progress value={stats.executionRate * 100} className="h-2" />
        </div>

        {stats.methodology && (
          <div className="border-t border-border/50 pt-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors w-full"
              onClick={() => setShowMethodology(!showMethodology)}
            >
              <Info className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>计算说明</span>
              {showMethodology ? (
                <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4 ml-auto" />
              ) : (
                <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4 ml-auto" />
              )}
            </button>
            <AnimatePresence>
              {showMethodology && (
                <motion.div
                  initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                  animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
                  exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                  className="overflow-hidden"
                >
                  <div className="pt-3 space-y-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <p>
                      <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                        学习投入：
                      </span>
                      {stats.methodology.learningCostFormula}
                    </p>
                    <p>
                      <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                        业务价值：
                      </span>
                      {stats.methodology.businessValueFormula}
                    </p>
                    <p>
                      <span className="font-medium text-foreground">ROI：</span>
                      {stats.methodology.roiFormula}
                    </p>
                    <p>
                      <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                        行为评分：
                      </span>
                      {stats.methodology.behaviorScoreFormula}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </motion.div>
              )}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

const TrendChartCard: React.FC<{ stats: IUserStats | null }> = ({ stats }) => {
  const trend = [
    { month: '2026-01', learningHours: 8, businessValue: 12.5, roi: 150 },
    { month: '2026-02', learningHours: 12, businessValue: 28.3, roi: 235 },
    { month: '2026-03', learningHours: 16, businessValue: 45.6, roi: 285 },

    {
      month: '2026-06',
      learningHours: stats?.coachingHours ?? 48,
      businessValue: (stats?.estimatedBusinessValue ?? 156800) / 1000,
      roi: stats?.roi ?? 385,

  ];
  const maxValue = Math.max(...trend.map((t) => t.businessValue));

  return (
    <Card className="border-border/50">
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-orange-100">

          </div>
          <div>

              <CardTitle>学习价值趋势</CardTitle>

                组织级数据
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
              学习投入与业务价值的月度变化
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">业务价值（千元）</span>
            <div className="flex items-end gap-2 h-32">
              {trend.map((item, idx) => (
                <div
                  key={idx}
                  className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-1"
                >
                  <div
                    className="w-full bg-primary/80 rounded-t"
                    style={{
                      height: `${(item.businessValue / maxValue) * 100}%`,
                    }}
                  />
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {item.month.split('-')[1]}月
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">ROI 趋势</span>
            <div className="relative h-24">
              <svg
                className="w-full h-full"
                viewBox="0 0 100 40"
                preserveAspectRatio="none"
              >
                <defs>
                  <linearGradient
                    id="roiGradient"
                    x1="0%"
                    y1="0%"
                    x2="0%"
                    y2="100%"
                  >
                    <stop
                      offset="0%"
                      stopColor="hsl(var(--primary))"
                      stopOpacity="0.3"
                    />
                    <stop
                      offset="100%"
                      stopColor="hsl(var(--primary))"
                      stopOpacity="0"
                    />
                  </linearGradient>
                </defs>
                <path
                  d={`M 0,${40 - (trend[0].roi / 6000) * 40} ${trend.map((t, i) => `L ${(i / (trend.length - 1)) * 100},${40 - (t.roi / 6000) * 40}`).join(' ')}`}
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="hsl(var(--primary))"
                  strokeWidth="2"
                />
                <path
                  d={`M 0,${40 - (trend[0].roi / 6000) * 40} ${trend.map((t, i) => `L ${(i / (trend.length - 1)) * 100},${40 - (t.roi / 6000) * 40}`).join(' ')} L 100,40 L 0,40 Z`}
                  fill="url(#roiGradient)"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {trend.map((item, idx) => (
                <span key={idx}>{item.month.split('-')[1]}月</span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

const PlanningItemCard: React.FC<{
  item: IPlanningItem;
  phaseColor: string;
}> = ({ item, phaseColor }) => {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  const priorityConfig = {
    P0: { color: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 border-red-200', label: 'P0' },
    P1: {
      color: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border-orange-200',
      label: 'P1',
    },
    P2: { color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 border-blue-200', label: 'P2' },
  };

  const statusConfig = {
    todo: { color: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600', label: '待开始', icon: Clock3 },
    in_progress: {
      color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-600',
      label: '进行中',
      icon: Rocket,
    },
    done: {
      color: 'bg-green-100 text-green-600',
      label: '已完成',
      icon: CheckCircle2,
    },
  };

  const StatusIcon = statusConfig[item.status].icon;

  return (
    <motion.div
      layout
      className="bg-card rounded-xl border border-border/50 overflow-hidden"
    >
      <div className="p-4">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap mb-2">
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className={`text-xs ${priorityConfig[item.priority].color}`}
              >
                {priorityConfig[item.priority].label}
              </Badge>
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className={`text-xs ${statusConfig[item.status].color}`}
              >
                <StatusIcon className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                {statusConfig[item.status].label}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <h4 className="font-medium text-foreground mb-1">{item.title}</h4>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">
              {item.description}
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            className="shrink-0"
            onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}
          >
            {expanded ? (
              <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" />
            ) : (
              <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />
            )}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">进度</span>
            <span className={`font-medium ${phaseColor}`}>
              {item.progress}%
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="relative h-2 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
            <motion.div
              className={`absolute left-0 top-0 h-full rounded-full ${phaseColor.replace('text-', 'bg-')}`}
              initial={{ width: 0 }}
              animate={{ width: `${item.progress}%` }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: 'easeOut' }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <User className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span>{item.owner}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <CalendarDays className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span>截止 {item.deadline}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {expanded && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
            className="border-t border-border/50 bg-muted/30"
          >
            <div className="p-4">
              <h5 className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                验收标准
              </h5>
              <ul className="space-y-1.5">
                {item.acceptanceCriteria.map((criteria, idx) => (
                  <li
                    key={idx}
                    className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground"
                  >
                    <span className="text-primary mt-0.5">•</span>
                    <span>{criteria}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

            totalCount > 0 ? (doneCount / totalCount) * 100 : 0;

                      {phase.name}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {phase.timeframe}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-white/80">
                  {doneCount}/{totalCount}
                </Badge>
              </div>

              <div className="mb-4">
                <div className="relative h-2 bg-white/60 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                  <motion.div
                    className={`absolute left-0 top-0 h-full rounded-full ${phase.color.replace('text-', 'bg-')}`}
                    initial={{ width: 0 }}
                    animate={{ width: `${phaseProgress}%` }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: 'easeOut' }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                {phase.items.map((item) => (
                  <PlanningItemCard
                    key={item.id}
                    item={item}
                    phaseColor={phase.color}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { capabilityClient } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@client/src/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@client/src/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@client/src/components/ui/textarea';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@client/src/components/ui/alert';
import { CheckCircle2, XCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

const PLUGIN_ID = 'mdp_coach_ai_conversation_reply_1';
const ACTION_KEY = 'textGenerate';

const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `你是一个测试助手。用户会给你三个词，你需要把它们组织成 JSON 格式输出。

你必须只输出 JSON。不得在 JSON 前后添加任何解释、markdown 标记、或额外文字。输出必须以 { 开始，以 } 结束。

JSON 格式：
{
  "words": ["词1", "词2", "词3"],
  "count": 3,
  "reversed": ["词3", "词2", "词1"]
}`;

const USER_INPUT = '苹果 香蕉 橘子';

const ENHANCED_PROMPT = `${SYSTEM_PROMPT}

如果你在 JSON 前后添加了任何文字，你的整个输出将被视为失败。直接输出 {。`;

interface TestResult {
  passed: boolean;
  rawOutput: string;
  parsed?: any;
  error?: string;
  usedEnhanced: boolean;
}

export default function Test1_SingleNodeJSON() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<TestResult | null>(null);
  const [useEnhanced, setUseEnhanced] = useState(false);

  const runTest = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setResult(null);

    try {
      const plugin = capabilityClient.load(PLUGIN_ID);
      const prompt = useEnhanced ? ENHANCED_PROMPT : SYSTEM_PROMPT;

      const response = await plugin.call(ACTION_KEY, {
        system_prompt: prompt,
        user_message_history: USER_INPUT,
      });

      const rawOutput = (response as any)?.content || (response as any)?.response || '';

      // 尝试解析JSON
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(rawOutput);
        setResult({
          passed: true,
          rawOutput,
          parsed,
          usedEnhanced: useEnhanced,
        });
      } catch (parseError) {
        // 检查是否包含markdown标记
        const hasMarkdown = rawOutput.includes('```');
        setResult({
          passed: false,
          rawOutput,
          error: hasMarkdown
            ? 'AI输出了markdown标记（```json ... ```）'
            : `JSON解析失败: ${(parseError as Error).message}`,
          usedEnhanced: useEnhanced,
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setResult({
        passed: false,
        rawOutput: '',
        error: `调用失败: ${(error as Error).message}`,
        usedEnhanced: useEnhanced,
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          测试1：单AI节点输出纯JSON
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          验证AI插件是否支持自定义system_prompt并输出纯JSON（不附加markdown标记或说明文字）
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">System Prompt</h3>
          <Textarea
            value={SYSTEM_PROMPT}
            readOnly
            className="font-mono text-xs h-32"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">用户输入</h3>
          <div className="p-3 bg-muted rounded-md font-mono text-sm">
            {USER_INPUT}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            id="enhanced"
            checked={useEnhanced}
            onChange={(e) => setUseEnhanced(e.target.checked)}
            className="rounded"
          />
          <label htmlFor="enhanced" className="text-sm">
            使用"输出格式锁"强化（追加约束语句）
          </label>
        </div>

        <Button onClick={runTest} disabled={loading} className="w-full">
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              运行测试中...
            </>
          ) : (
            '运行测试'
          )}
        </Button>

        {result && (
          <Alert variant={result.passed ? 'default' : 'destructive'}>
            {result.passed ? (
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
            ) : (
              <XCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
            )}
            <AlertDescription>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <p className="font-semibold">
                  {result.passed ? '通过：AI输出纯JSON' : '不通过'}
                </p>
                {result.error && (
                  <p className="text-sm">{result.error}</p>
                )}
                {result.parsed && (
                  <div className="text-xs">
                    <p className="font-semibold mb-1">解析结果：</p>
                    <pre className="bg-muted p-2 rounded overflow-auto">
                      {JSON.stringify(result.parsed, null, 2)}
                    </pre>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="text-xs">
                  <p className="font-semibold mb-1">AI原始输出：</p>
                  <pre className="bg-muted p-2 rounded overflow-auto whitespace-pre-wrap">
                    {result.rawOutput}
                  </pre>
                </div>
                {!result.passed && !useEnhanced && (
                  <p className="text-sm text-amber-600">
                    建议：勾选"使用输出格式锁强化"后重试
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
