import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { capabilityClient } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@client/src/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@client/src/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@client/src/components/ui/textarea';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@client/src/components/ui/alert';
import { CheckCircle2, XCircle, Loader2, ArrowDown } from 'lucide-react';

const PLUGIN_ID = 'mdp_coach_ai_conversation_reply_1';
const ACTION_KEY = 'textGenerate';

const NODE_A_PROMPT = `你是一个数据生成器。用户给你一个数字 N，你输出一个 JSON 数组，包含 N 个 1-200 之间的随机整数。

你必须只输出 JSON。格式：
{ "numbers": [数字列表], "sum": 总和, "count": N }`;

const NODE_B_PROMPT = `你是一个数据分析器。你会收到一个 JSON 对象，格式为 { "numbers": [数字列表], "sum": 总和, "count": 数量 }。

你需要输出一个新的 JSON：
{
  "original": [原数字列表],
  "sum": 总和,
  "count": 数量,
  "average": 平均值(保留2位小数),
  "max": 最大值,
  "min": 最小值,
  "range": 最大值减最小值
}

你必须只输出 JSON。`;

const USER_INPUT = '8';

interface NodeResult {
  rawOutput: string;
  parsed?: any;
  error?: string;
}

interface TestResult {
  nodeA: NodeResult;
  nodeB: NodeResult;
  validation: {
    sumMatch: boolean;
    averageCorrect: boolean;
    maxCorrect: boolean;
    minCorrect: boolean;
    rangeCorrect: boolean;
  };
  passed: boolean;
}

export default function Test2_NodeChain() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<TestResult | null>(null);

  const runTest = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setResult(null);

    try {
      const plugin = capabilityClient.load(PLUGIN_ID);

      // 节点A：生成数据
      const responseA = await plugin.call(ACTION_KEY, {
        system_prompt: NODE_A_PROMPT,
        user_message_history: USER_INPUT,
      });

      const rawA = (responseA as any)?.content || (responseA as any)?.response || '';
      const nodeA: NodeResult = { rawOutput: rawA };

      try {
        nodeA.parsed = JSON.parse(rawA);
      } catch (e) {
        nodeA.error = `节点A JSON解析失败: ${(e as Error).message}`;
      }

      // 如果节点A失败，提前返回
      if (nodeA.error) {
        setResult({
          nodeA,
          nodeB: { rawOutput: '', error: '节点A失败，跳过节点B' },
          validation: {
            sumMatch: false,
            averageCorrect: false,
            maxCorrect: false,
            minCorrect: false,
            rangeCorrect: false,
          },
          passed: false,
        });
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      // 节点B：分析数据
      const responseB = await plugin.call(ACTION_KEY, {
        system_prompt: NODE_B_PROMPT,
        user_message_history: rawA,
      });

      const rawB = (responseB as any)?.content || (responseB as any)?.response || '';
      const nodeB: NodeResult = { rawOutput: rawB };

      try {
        nodeB.parsed = JSON.parse(rawB);
      } catch (e) {
        nodeB.error = `节点B JSON解析失败: ${(e as Error).message}`;
      }

      // 验证结果
      const validation = {
        sumMatch: false,
        averageCorrect: false,
        maxCorrect: false,
        minCorrect: false,
        rangeCorrect: false,
      };

      if (nodeA.parsed && nodeB.parsed) {
        const a = nodeA.parsed;
        const b = nodeB.parsed;

        validation.sumMatch = a.sum === b.sum;
        validation.averageCorrect =
          Math.abs(b.average - a.sum / a.count) < 0.01;
        validation.maxCorrect = b.max === Math.max(...a.numbers);
        validation.minCorrect = b.min === Math.min(...a.numbers);
        validation.rangeCorrect = b.range === b.max - b.min;
      }

      const passed =
        !nodeA.error &&
        !nodeB.error &&
        Object.values(validation).every((v) => v);

      setResult({ nodeA, nodeB, validation, passed });
    } catch (error) {
      setResult({
        nodeA: { rawOutput: '', error: `调用失败: ${(error as Error).message}` },
        nodeB: { rawOutput: '', error: '未执行' },
        validation: {
          sumMatch: false,
          averageCorrect: false,
          maxCorrect: false,
          minCorrect: false,
          rangeCorrect: false,
        },
        passed: false,
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          测试2：双节点串联传JSON
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          验证两个AI调用能否串联，第一个的输出JSON能否正确传给第二个作为输入
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">节点A System Prompt（数据生成器）</h3>
          <Textarea
            value={NODE_A_PROMPT}
            readOnly
            className="font-mono text-xs h-24"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex justify-center">
          <ArrowDown className="h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground" />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">节点B System Prompt（数据分析器）</h3>
          <Textarea
            value={NODE_B_PROMPT}
            readOnly
            className="font-mono text-xs h-32"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">用户输入</h3>
          <div className="p-3 bg-muted rounded-md font-mono text-sm">
            {USER_INPUT}
          </div>
        </div>

        <Button onClick={runTest} disabled={loading} className="w-full">
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              运行串联测试中...
            </>
          ) : (
            '运行串联测试'
          )}
        </Button>

        {result && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <Alert variant={result.passed ? 'default' : 'destructive'}>
              {result.passed ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
              ) : (
                <XCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              )}
              <AlertDescription>
                <p className="font-semibold">
                  {result.passed ? '通过：双节点串联成功' : '不通过：串联失败'}
                </p>
              </AlertDescription>
            </Alert>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">节点A输出</h3>
              {result.nodeA.error ? (
                <Alert variant="destructive">
                  <XCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <AlertDescription>{result.nodeA.error}</AlertDescription>
                </Alert>
              ) : (
                <pre className="bg-muted p-3 rounded-md text-xs overflow-auto">
                  {result.nodeA.rawOutput}
                </pre>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">节点B输出</h3>
              {result.nodeB.error ? (
                <Alert variant="destructive">
                  <XCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <AlertDescription>{result.nodeB.error}</AlertDescription>
                </Alert>
              ) : (
                <pre className="bg-muted p-3 rounded-md text-xs overflow-auto">
                  {result.nodeB.rawOutput}
                </pre>
              )}
            </div>

            {!result.nodeA.error && !result.nodeB.error && (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">验证结果</h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-sm">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {result.validation.sumMatch ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-green-600" />
                    ) : (
                      <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-600" />
                    )}
                    <span>sum传递正确</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {result.validation.averageCorrect ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-green-600" />
                    ) : (
                      <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-600" />
                    )}
                    <span>average计算正确</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {result.validation.maxCorrect ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-green-600" />
                    ) : (
                      <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-600" />
                    )}
                    <span>max正确</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {result.validation.minCorrect ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-green-600" />
                    ) : (
                      <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-600" />
                    )}
                    <span>min正确</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 col-span-2">
                    {result.validation.rangeCorrect ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-green-600" />
                    ) : (
                      <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-600" />
                    )}
                    <span>range计算正确</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

===FILE:./client/src/pages/CapabilityTestPage/Test3_DataStorage.tsx===
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@client/src/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@client/src/components/ui/button';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@client/src/components/ui/alert';
import { CheckCircle2, XCircle, Database, Globe, Link as LinkIcon } from 'lucide-react';

interface TestResult {
  localStorage: {
    writeSuccess: boolean;
    readSuccess: boolean;
    sizeBytes: number;
    error?: string;
  };
  sessionStorage: {
    writeSuccess: boolean;
    readSuccess: boolean;
    sizeBytes: number;
    error?: string;
  };
  urlParams: {
    generateSuccess: boolean;
    readSuccess: boolean;
    paramValue?: string;
    error?: string;
  };
}

const SCENARIO_CARD_DATA = {
  scenario_id: 'TEST-001',
  title: '首开倒计时——空降者的20天',
  difficulty: 'medium',
  context: {
    learner_role: {
      identity: '被紧急派往新项目支援的销售管理者',
      relationship_to_team: '空降支援者，非直属上级',
    },
    situation: {
      project_status: '项目示范区已开放一周，来访量很高但认筹转化远未达预期',
      deadline: '首开倒计时20天',
    },
    team_state: {
      size: 8,
      energy_level: '低',
      observable_signals: ['早会上没人说话', '眼神无光', '有人迅速关掉招聘网站'],
    },
  },
  decision_points: [
    {
      dp_id: 'TG001-DP1',
      p_step: 'P2_建立信任',
      options: [
        { id: 'A', text: '明天召开全员动员会，宣布新的推售策略', is_best_path: false },
        { id: 'B', text: '用2-3天自己消化说辞、爬楼看户型、筛选高意向客户', is_best_path: true },
      ],
    },
  ],
};

export default function Test3_DataStorage() {
  const [result, setResult] = useState<TestResult | null>(null);
  const [lsData, setLsData] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [ssData, setSsData] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 检查localStorage是否有之前写入的数据
    const lsExisting = localStorage.getItem('mdp_test_scenario_card');
    if (lsExisting) setLsData(lsExisting);

    // 检查sessionStorage
    const ssExisting = sessionStorage.getItem('mdp_test_scenario_card');
    if (ssExisting) setSsData(ssExisting);
  }, []);

  const runTest = () => {
    const testData = JSON.stringify(SCENARIO_CARD_DATA);
    const sizeBytes = new Blob([testData]).size;

    const newResult: TestResult = {
      localStorage: {
        writeSuccess: false,
        readSuccess: false,
        sizeBytes: 0,
      },
      sessionStorage: {
        writeSuccess: false,
        readSuccess: false,
        sizeBytes: 0,
      },
      urlParams: {
        generateSuccess: false,
        readSuccess: false,
      },
    };

    // 测试localStorage
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('mdp_test_scenario_card', testData);
      newResult.localStorage.writeSuccess = true;
      newResult.localStorage.sizeBytes = sizeBytes;

      const read = localStorage.getItem('mdp_test_scenario_card');
      newResult.localStorage.readSuccess = read === testData;
      setLsData(read);
    } catch (e) {
      newResult.localStorage.error = (e as Error).message;
    }

    // 测试sessionStorage
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem('mdp_test_scenario_card', testData);
      newResult.sessionStorage.writeSuccess = true;
      newResult.sessionStorage.sizeBytes = sizeBytes;

      const read = sessionStorage.getItem('mdp_test_scenario_card');
      newResult.sessionStorage.readSuccess = read === testData;
      setSsData(read);
    } catch (e) {
      newResult.sessionStorage.error = (e as Error).message;
    }

    // 测试URL参数
    try {
      const scenarioId = 'TEST-001';
      const currentUrl = window.location.href.split('?')[0];
      const newUrl = `${currentUrl}?scenario_id=${encodeURIComponent(scenarioId)}&mode=dialogue`;
      newResult.urlParams.generateSuccess = true;
      newResult.urlParams.paramValue = newUrl;

      // 尝试读取URL参数
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const sid = params.get('scenario_id');
      newResult.urlParams.readSuccess = sid === scenarioId;
    } catch (e) {
      newResult.urlParams.error = (e as Error).message;
    }

    setResult(newResult);
  };

  const clearStorage = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('mdp_test_scenario_card');
    sessionStorage.removeItem('mdp_test_scenario_card');
    setLsData(null);
    setSsData(null);
    setResult(null);
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          测试3：中间数据存储
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          验证localStorage/sessionStorage/URL参数三种存储方式在低代码平台页面中是否可用
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">测试数据（约2KB场景卡）</h3>
          <pre className="bg-muted p-3 rounded-md text-xs overflow-auto max-h-48">
            {JSON.stringify(SCENARIO_CARD_DATA, null, 2)}
          </pre>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button onClick={runTest} className="flex-1">
            运行存储测试
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={clearStorage} variant="outline">
            清除数据
          </Button>
        </div>

        {result && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                <Database className="h-4 w-4" />
                localStorage
              </h3>
              <Alert
                variant={
                  result.localStorage.writeSuccess && result.localStorage.readSuccess
                    ? 'default'
                    : 'destructive'
                }
              >
                {result.localStorage.writeSuccess && result.localStorage.readSuccess ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <XCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
                <AlertDescription>
                  <div className="space-y-1 text-sm">
                    <p>
                      写入：
                      {result.localStorage.writeSuccess ? '成功' : '失败'}
                    </p>
                    <p>
                      读取：
                      {result.localStorage.readSuccess ? '成功' : '失败'}
                    </p>
                    {result.localStorage.sizeBytes > 0 && (
                      <p>数据大小：{(result.localStorage.sizeBytes / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB</p>
                    )}
                    {result.localStorage.error && (
                      <p className="text-destructive">错误：{result.localStorage.error}</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </AlertDescription>
              </Alert>
              {lsData && (
                <details className="text-xs">
                  <summary className="cursor-pointer text-muted-foreground">
                    查看localStorage数据
                  </summary>
                  <pre className="bg-muted p-2 rounded mt-1 overflow-auto max-h-32">
                    {lsData}
                  </pre>
                </details>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                <Globe className="h-4 w-4" />
                sessionStorage
              </h3>
              <Alert
                variant={
                  result.sessionStorage.writeSuccess && result.sessionStorage.readSuccess
                    ? 'default'
                    : 'destructive'
                }
              >
                {result.sessionStorage.writeSuccess && result.sessionStorage.readSuccess ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <XCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
                <AlertDescription>
                  <div className="space-y-1 text-sm">
                    <p>
                      写入：
                      {result.sessionStorage.writeSuccess ? '成功' : '失败'}
                    </p>
                    <p>
                      读取：
                      {result.sessionStorage.readSuccess ? '成功' : '失败'}
                    </p>
                    {result.sessionStorage.sizeBytes > 0 && (
                      <p>数据大小：{(result.sessionStorage.sizeBytes / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB</p>
                    )}
                    {result.sessionStorage.error && (
                      <p className="text-destructive">错误：{result.sessionStorage.error}</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </AlertDescription>
              </Alert>
              {ssData && (
                <details className="text-xs">
                  <summary className="cursor-pointer text-muted-foreground">
                    查看sessionStorage数据
                  </summary>
                  <pre className="bg-muted p-2 rounded mt-1 overflow-auto max-h-32">
                    {ssData}
                  </pre>
                </details>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                <LinkIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                URL参数
              </h3>
              <Alert
                variant={
                  result.urlParams.generateSuccess ? 'default' : 'destructive'
                }
              >
                {result.urlParams.generateSuccess ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <XCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
                <AlertDescription>
                  <div className="space-y-1 text-sm">
                    <p>
                      生成URL：
                      {result.urlParams.generateSuccess ? '成功' : '失败'}
                    </p>
                    {result.urlParams.paramValue && (
                      <div className="text-xs">
                        <p className="font-semibold mb-1">生成的URL：</p>
                        <code className="bg-muted px-2 py-1 rounded break-all">
                          {result.urlParams.paramValue}
                        </code>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                      提示：点击生成的URL跳转后，页面应能读取到scenario_id=TEST-001参数
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </AlertDescription>
              </Alert>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 bg-blue-50 rounded-md">
              <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm mb-2">测试结论</h4>
              <ul className="text-sm space-y-1">
                <li>
                  localStorage：
                  {result.localStorage.writeSuccess && result.localStorage.readSuccess
                    ? '可用（数据可持久化到浏览器）'
                    : '不可用'}
                </li>
                <li>
                  sessionStorage：
                  {result.sessionStorage.writeSuccess && result.sessionStorage.readSuccess
                    ? '可用（数据在当前会话中保留）'
                    : '不可用'}
                </li>
                <li>
                  URL参数：
                  {result.urlParams.generateSuccess ? '可用（支持页面间传参）' : '不可用'}
                </li>
              </ul>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

===FILE:./client/src/pages/CoachingChatPage/ChatInterfaceSection.tsx===
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ui/scroll-area';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Streamdown } from '@/components/ui/streamdown';
import {
  Send,
  Bot,
  User,
  Sparkles,
  Clock,
  AlertCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  X,
  Lightbulb,
  Moon,
  Shield,
  Cloud,
  CheckCircle2,
  Flame,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface IChatMessage {
  id: string;
  role: 'user' | 'ai';
  content: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  scoreChange?: {
    result: number;
    people: number;
    field: number;
  };
}

interface IChatInterfaceSectionProps {
  messages: IChatMessage[];
  onSendMessage: (message: string) => void;
  isLoading?: boolean;
  aiCharacter: {
    name: string;
    role: string;
    avatar?: string;
  };
  currentRound: number;
  maxRounds: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  explainContent?: string;
  isExplaining?: boolean;
  onExplainScore?: () => void;
}

const STATE_STYLES: Record<string, { bg: string; border: string; text: string; icon: React.ElementType }> = {
  '躺平态': { bg: 'bg-slate-50', border: 'border-l-slate-400', text: 'text-slate-700', icon: Moon },
  '防备态': { bg: 'bg-amber-50', border: 'border-l-amber-500', text: 'text-amber-700', icon: Shield },
  '松动态': { bg: 'bg-sky-50', border: 'border-l-sky-400', text: 'text-sky-700', icon: Cloud },
  '尝试态': { bg: 'bg-emerald-50', border: 'border-l-emerald-500', text: 'text-emerald-700', icon: CheckCircle2 },
  '崩溃态': { bg: 'bg-red-50', border: 'border-l-red-500', text: 'text-red-700', icon: Flame },
};

const FALLBACK_STATE_STYLE = { bg: 'bg-gray-50', border: 'border-l-gray-400', text: 'text-gray-700', icon: AlertCircle };

const resolveStateStyle = (stateText: string) => {
  for (const [key, style] of Object.entries(STATE_STYLES)) {
    if (stateText.includes(key)) return style;
  }
  return FALLBACK_STATE_STYLE;
};

const ChatInterfaceSection: React.FC<IChatInterfaceSectionProps> = ({
  messages,
  onSendMessage,
  isLoading = false,
  aiCharacter,
  currentRound,
  maxRounds,
  disabled = false,
  explainContent,
  isExplaining = false,
  onExplainScore,
}) => {
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState('');
  const [showExplainDialog, setShowExplainDialog] = useState(false);
  const [fadedStatuses, setFadedStatuses] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const scrollAreaRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (messages.length === 0) return;
    const lastMsg = messages[messages.length - 1];
    if (lastMsg.role !== 'ai') return;
    const hasStatus = /当前状态[：:]|>> 当前状态/.test(lastMsg.content);
    if (!hasStatus) return;
    const statusKey = `${lastMsg.id}-status-0`;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setFadedStatuses(prev => new Set(prev).add(statusKey));
    }, 5000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [messages]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (scrollAreaRef.current) {
      const scrollContainer = scrollAreaRef.current.querySelector('[data-radix-scroll-area-viewport]');
      if (scrollContainer) {
        scrollContainer.scrollTop = scrollContainer.scrollHeight;
      }
    }
  }, [messages]);

  // 当解释内容更新时，如果有内容则显示弹窗
  useEffect(() => {
    if (explainContent && isExplaining === false) {
      setShowExplainDialog(true);
    }
  }, [explainContent, isExplaining]);

  const handleSend = () => {
    if (!inputValue.trim() || isLoading || disabled) return;
    onSendMessage(inputValue.trim());
    setInputValue('');
    if (textareaRef.current) {
      textareaRef.current.style.height = 'auto';
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSend();
    }
  };

  const handleTextareaChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    setInputValue(e.target.value);
    const textarea = e.target;
    textarea.style.height = 'auto';
    textarea.style.height = `${Math.min(textarea.scrollHeight, 120)}px`;
  };

  const handleExplainClick = () => {
    onExplainScore?.();
  };

  const formatTime = (date: Date) => {
    return new Date(date).toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', {
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    });
  };

  interface IParsedContent {
    mainContent: string;
    awarenessHints: string[];
    reminders: string[];
    statusText: string | null;
  }

  const parseAIContent = (content: string): IParsedContent => {
    const awarenessHints: string[] = [];
    const reminders: string[] = [];
    let statusText: string | null = null;
    let cleaned = content;

    const awarenessPattern = /【觉察提示】([\s\S]*?)(?=【|>>|$)/g;
    let awarenessMatch: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((awarenessMatch = awarenessPattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
      awarenessHints.push(awarenessMatch[1].trim());
    }
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(/【觉察提示】[\s\S]*?(?=【|>>|$)/g, '');

    // 💡 format (V2.7 scene_P1)
    const lightbulbPattern = /💡\s*([^\n]+)/g;
    let lbMatch: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((lbMatch = lightbulbPattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
      awarenessHints.push(lbMatch[1].trim());
    }
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(/💡\s*[^\n]+/g, '');

    const reminderPattern = /【提醒】([\s\S]*?)(?=【|>>|$)/g;
    let reminderMatch: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((reminderMatch = reminderPattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
      reminders.push(reminderMatch[1].trim());
    }
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(/【提醒】[\s\S]*?(?=【|>>|$)/g, '');

    // V2.6/V2.7: ⚠️ danger blocking format → reminders (single line)
    const dangerPattern = /⚠️\s*([^\n]+)/g;
    let dangerMatch: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((dangerMatch = dangerPattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
      const rem = dangerMatch[1].trim();
      if (rem) reminders.push(rem);
    }
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(/⚠️\s*[^\n]+/g, '');

    const statusPatterns = [
      /【状态[：:]([^】]+)】/,
      />> 当前状态：([^\n]+)/,
      /【当前状态[：:]([^】]+)】/,
      /【状态提示[：:]([^】]+)】/,
    ];
    for (const sp of statusPatterns) {
      const sm = cleaned.match(sp);
      if (sm) {
        statusText = sm[1].trim();
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(sp, '');
        break;
      }
    }

    // V2.6/V2.7: → state transition format → statusText (no ^ anchor)
    const transitionPattern = /→\s*([^\n【💡⚠]+)/gu;
    let transitionMatch: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((transitionMatch = transitionPattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
      const st = transitionMatch[1].trim();
      if (st && /转|S[1-5]|态/.test(st)) statusText = st;
    }
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\n?→\s*[^\n]+/g, '');

    // V2.6/V2.7: 【本次练习】 info card → awarenessHints (multiline)
    const practicePattern = /【本次练习】([\s\S]*?)(?=\n\n【状态|\n\n[^\n]*：（|\n{3,}|$)/;
    const practiceMatch = cleaned.match(practicePattern);
    if (practiceMatch) {
      awarenessHints.push('本次练习' + practiceMatch[1].trim());
      cleaned = cleaned.replace(practicePattern, '');
    }

    cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\n?【觉察提示】[^\n]*/g, '');
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\n?【提醒】[^\n]*/g, '');
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\n?【状态[：:][^】]*】/g, '');
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(/【[^】]*★+[^】]*】/g, '');
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(/（[^）]{1,15}）/g, '');
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\((?!https?:)[^()]{1,15}\)/g, '');
    cleaned = cleaned.trim();

    const normalizedStatus = (() => {
      if (!statusText) return null;
      for (const cn of ['躺平态', '防备态', '松动态', '尝试态', '崩溃态']) {
        if (statusText.includes(cn)) return cn;
      }
      const sMap: Record<string, string> = { 'S1': '躺平态', 'S2': '松动态', 'S3': '尝试态', 'S4': '尝试态', 'S5': '崩溃态' };
      for (const [code, cn] of Object.entries(sMap)) {
        if (statusText.includes(code)) return cn;
      }
      return statusText;
    })();

    return { mainContent: cleaned, awarenessHints, reminders, statusText: normalizedStatus };
  };

  // 判断是否显示解释按钮（有用户消息且不在加载中）
  const canExplain = messages.filter(m => m.role === 'user').length > 0 && !isLoading && !isExplaining;

  return (
    <>
      <section className="w-full h-full flex flex-col">
        <Card className="flex-1 flex flex-col border-border/50 overflow-hidden">
          {/* 聊天头部 */}
          <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-border/50 bg-muted/30">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <Avatar className="w-10 h-10 border-2 border-primary/20">
                  <AvatarImage src={aiCharacter.avatar} />
                  <AvatarFallback className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
                    <Bot className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </AvatarFallback>
                </Avatar>
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{aiCharacter.name}</span>
                    <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
                      {aiCharacter.role}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>AI 智能陪练</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                {/* 解释得分按钮 */}
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={handleExplainClick}
                  disabled={!canExplain}
                  className="gap-1.5"
                >
                  <HelpCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                  解释得分
                </Button>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>
                    第 <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{currentRound}</span> / {maxRounds} 轮
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 聊天消息区 */}
          <ScrollArea ref={scrollAreaRef} className="flex-1 p-4">
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {messages.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 text-center">
                  <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
                    <Bot className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground mb-2">
                    开始您的陪练对话
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-md">
                    {aiCharacter.name}正在等待您的回复。请根据场景背景，以管理者的身份回应。
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                messages.map((message) => {
                  const parsed = message.role === 'ai' ? parseAIContent(message.content) : null;
                  const statusKey = `${message.id}-status-0`;
                  const isFaded = fadedStatuses.has(statusKey);
                  const stateStyle = parsed?.statusText ? resolveStateStyle(parsed.statusText) : null;
                  const StateIcon = stateStyle?.icon;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={message.id}
                      className={`flex gap-3 ${
                        message.role === 'user' ? 'flex-row-reverse' : ''
                      }`}
                    >
                      <Avatar
                        className={`w-8 h-8 shrink-0 ${
                          message.role === 'user'
                            ? 'bg-secondary'
                            : 'bg-primary'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {message.role === 'user' ? (
                          <User className="w-4 h-4 text-secondary-foreground" />
                        ) : (
                          <Bot className="w-4 h-4 text-primary-foreground" />
                        )}
                      </Avatar>
                      <div
                        className={`max-w-[80%] space-y-2 ${
                          message.role === 'user' ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {/* 正文气泡 */}
                        <div
                          className={`px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl text-sm leading-relaxed ${
                            message.role === 'user'
                              ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-br-md'
                              : 'bg-muted text-foreground rounded-bl-md'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {parsed ? (parsed.mainContent || message.content) : message.content}
                        </div>

                        {/* 觉察提示卡片（气泡外） */}
                        {parsed && parsed.awarenessHints.length > 0 && parsed.awarenessHints.map((hint: string, idx: number) => (
                          <div key={`hint-${idx}`} className="p-3 rounded-lg shadow-sm" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFBEB, #FEF3C7)', borderLeft: '4px solid #F59E0B' }}>
                            <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                              <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                              <div>
                                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-700 tracking-wide">觉察提示</span>
                                <p className="text-sm text-amber-900 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">{hint}</p>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))}

                        {/* 提醒卡片（气泡外） */}
                        {parsed && parsed.reminders.length > 0 && parsed.reminders.map((reminder: string, idx: number) => (
                          <div key={`reminder-${idx}`} className="p-3 rounded-lg shadow-sm" style={{ background: '#FFF7ED', borderLeft: '4px solid #FB923C' }}>
                            <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                              <div>
                                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-orange-700 tracking-wide">提醒</span>
                                <p className="text-sm text-orange-900 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">{reminder}</p>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))}

                        {/* 状态卡片（气泡外） */}
                        {parsed && parsed.statusText && stateStyle && StateIcon && (
                          <div
                            className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-sm border-l-4 ${stateStyle.bg} ${stateStyle.border} transition-opacity duration-700 ${isFaded ? 'opacity-30' : 'opacity-100'}`}
                            onMouseEnter={() => setFadedStatuses(prev => { const next = new Set(prev); next.delete(statusKey); return next; })}
                          >
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <StateIcon className={`w-4 h-4 shrink-0 ${stateStyle.text}`} />
                              <span className={`text-sm font-semibold ${stateStyle.text}`}>当前状态：{parsed.statusText}</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            {formatTime(message.timestamp)}
                          </span>
                          {message.scoreChange && message.role === 'user' && (
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              {message.scoreChange.result !== 0 && (
                                <Badge
                                  variant="outline"
                                  className={`text-xs ${
                                    message.scoreChange.result > 0
                                      ? 'text-emerald-600 border-emerald-200'
                                      : 'text-red-600 border-red-200'
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  拿结果 {message.scoreChange.result > 0 ? '+' : ''}
                                  {message.scoreChange.result}
                                </Badge>
                              )}
                              {message.scoreChange.people !== 0 && (
                                <Badge
                                  variant="outline"
                                  className={`text-xs ${
                                    message.scoreChange.people > 0
                                      ? 'text-blue-600 border-blue-200'
                                      : 'text-red-600 border-red-200'
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  带团队 {message.scoreChange.people > 0 ? '+' : ''}
                                  {message.scoreChange.people}
                                </Badge>
                              )}
                              {message.scoreChange.field !== 0 && (
                                <Badge
                                  variant="outline"
                                  className={`text-xs ${
                                    message.scoreChange.field > 0
                                      ? 'text-amber-600 border-amber-200'
                                      : 'text-red-600 border-red-200'
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  传文化 {message.scoreChange.field > 0 ? '+' : ''}
                                  {message.scoreChange.field}
                                </Badge>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
              {isLoading && (
                <div className="flex gap-3">
                  <Avatar className="w-8 h-8 bg-primary">
                    <Bot className="w-4 h-4 text-primary-foreground" />
                  </Avatar>
                  <div className="bg-muted rounded-2xl rounded-bl-md px-4 py-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary/40 animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: '0ms' }} />
                      <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary/40 animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: '150ms' }} />
                      <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary/40 animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: '300ms' }} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </ScrollArea>

          {/* 输入区 */}
          <div className="p-4 border-t border-border/50 bg-card">
            {disabled ? (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 px-4 bg-muted/50 rounded-xl text-muted-foreground">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span className="text-sm">本轮对话已结束</span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex gap-3">
                <Textarea
                  ref={textareaRef}
                  value={inputValue}
                  onChange={handleTextareaChange}
                  onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
                  placeholder="输入您的回复..."
                  className="min-h-[44px] max-h-[120px] resize-none bg-muted/50 border-0 focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-primary"
                  rows={1}
                  disabled={isLoading}
                />
                <Button
                  onClick={handleSend}
                  disabled={!inputValue.trim() || isLoading}
                  className="shrink-0 h-[44px] px-4"
                >
                  <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <span>按 Enter 发送，Shift + Enter 换行</span>
              <span>
                {inputValue.length}/500 字
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card>
      </section>

      {/* 评分解释弹窗 */}
      <Dialog open={showExplainDialog} onOpenChange={setShowExplainDialog}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[80vh] overflow-hidden">
          <DialogHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <HelpCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                评分解释
              </DialogTitle>
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="icon"
                className="h-8 w-8"
                onClick={() => setShowExplainDialog(false)}
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </Button>
            </div>
            <DialogDescription>
              AI 基于您的对话表现，对各维度得分的分析和建议
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="overflow-y-auto max-h-[60vh] pr-2">
            {isExplaining ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mb-4" />
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">正在分析您的表现...</p>
              </div>
            ) : explainContent ? (
              <div className="prose prose-sm max-w-none">
                <Streamdown>{explainContent}</Streamdown>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                暂无评分解释
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="pt-4 border-t">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center">
              评分解释仅供参考，具体表现请结合实际业务场景评估
            </p>
          </div>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
};

export default ChatInterfaceSection;

// ============================================
// Types - 细分子维度评分体系
// ============================================

// 拿结果 - 3个子维度
interface IResultSubScores {
  goalSetting: number;      // 目标设定与分解 (SMART/OKR)
  execution: number;        // 执行推动与跟进 (PDCA)
  review: number;           // 结果复盘与优化
}

// 带团队 - 4个子维度
interface IPeopleSubScores {
  goalAlignment: number;    // 团队目标对齐
  atmosphere: number;       // 团队氛围营造 (心理安全)
  mechanism: number;        // 团队机制建设 (流程/制度)
  collaboration: number;    // 团队分工协作 (RACI)
}

// 传文化 - 3个子维度
interface IFieldSubScores {
  valueTransmission: number;  // 价值观传递
  roleModel: number;          // 以身作则示范
  culturePenetration: number; // 文化传承渗透
}

// 完整评分结构
interface IDetailedScore {
  result: number;           // 拿结果总分
  people: number;           // 带团队总分
  field: number;            // 传文化总分
  subScores: {
    result: IResultSubScores;
    people: IPeopleSubScores;
    field: IFieldSubScores;
  };
  // 关联理论知识点
  appliedTheories: Array<{
    theoryName: string;
    aspect: string;
    score: number;
    evidence: string;
  }>;
}

// 兼容旧接口的三维评分
interface IThreeDimensionsScore {
  result: number;
  people: number;
  field: number;
  followup?: number;
}

interface IChatMessage {
  id: string;
  role: 'user' | 'ai' | 'hint';
  content: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  scoreChange?: IThreeDimensionsScore;
  detailedScore?: IDetailedScore;
  feedback?: string;
  thinkingPoint?: string;
  weakPointFeedback?: string;
  hintContent?: string;
}

// Convert ICoachingScene to IScene interface that matches the component needs
interface IScene extends Omit<ICoachingScene, 'dimension'> {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  dimensionId: 'result' | 'people' | 'field';
  aiCharacter: {
    name: string;
    role: string;
    personality: string;
    speakingStyle: string; // 语言风格特征
    commonPhrases: string[]; // 常用语/口头禅
    background: string; // 角色背景故事
    painPoints?: string[]; // 角色痛点
    motivation?: string; // 角色动机
  };
  eventBackground: string;
  userRole: string;
  dialogueGoal: string;
  maxRounds: number;
  thinkingQuestions: string[];
  
  // 新增：课程关联
  sourceCourseId?: string;
  sourceCourseName?: string;
  sourceCaseId?: string;
  sourceCaseTitle?: string;
  
  // 新增：场景详细设定
  scenarioContext?: {
    situation: string;
    conflict: string;
    goal: string;
    successCriteria: string[];
    openingLine?: string;
    userRole?: string;
    userRoleContext?: string;
    oneSentenceContext?: string;
    coreChallenge?: string;
    twoResults?: string[];
    managerRole?: string;
    npcProfiles?: Array<{
      avatar: string;
      name: string;
      type: string;
      baseInfo: string;
      behaviorTags: string[];
      psychologyTags: string[];
      riskSignal?: string;
      quote: string;
      quoteStage: string;
      challenge: string;
      difficulty: string;
      stars: number;
    }>;
  };
}

// ============================================
// 获取测评薄弱维度信息
// ============================================
const getAssessmentWeakDimensions = (): { weakest: string; weakestScore: number; secondWeak: string; secondWeakScore: number } | null => {
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('mdp_assessment_scores');
    if (!stored) return null;
    const scores = JSON.parse(stored);
    if (!scores || typeof scores !== 'object') return null;
    const dims = [
      { key: 'result', score: Number(scores.result) || 0 },
      { key: 'people', score: Number(scores.people) || 0 },
      { key: 'field', score: Number(scores.field) || 0 },
    ].sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score);
    return {
      weakest: dims[0].key,
      weakestScore: dims[0].score,
      secondWeak: dims[1].key,
      secondWeakScore: dims[1].score,
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

// ============================================
// 根据课程动态注入专属管理理论
// ============================================
const getCourseTheorySection = (scene: IScene): string => {
  if (!scene.sourceCourseId || !COURSE_THEORY_MAP[scene.sourceCourseId]) {
    return '';
  }
  const courseTheory = COURSE_THEORY_MAP[scene.sourceCourseId];
  const theoryList = courseTheory.theories
    .map((t: string, i: number) => `${i + 1}. ${t}`)
    .join('\n');
  return `
【课程专属理论 - 《${courseTheory.courseName}》】
此场景来源于课程《${courseTheory.courseName}》，反馈时优先引用以下课程对应的管理理论：
${theoryList}`;
};

// ============================================
// AI System Prompt 配置 - 人设稳定性约束（增强版）
// ============================================
interface IUserVoiceEmotion {
  wordsPerMinute: number;
  pauseCount: number;
  hesitationCount: number;
  speechRate: 'slow' | 'normal' | 'fast';
  label: string;
}

const generateSystemPrompt = (
  scene: IScene,
  pressureLevel?: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high',
  userVoiceEmotion?: IUserVoiceEmotion | null,
  workflowData?: WorkflowPromptData | null,
  selectedNpc?: string,
): string => {
  const ctx = scene.scenarioContext as { fullPrompt?: string } | null;
  if (ctx?.fullPrompt) return ctx.fullPrompt;

  const enhanced = getEnhancedPrompt(scene.id, scene, { pressureLevel, userVoiceEmotion: userVoiceEmotion ?? null, selectedNpc }, workflowData);
  if (enhanced) return enhanced;

  // 构建增强版角色设定
  let prompt = `【角色设定 - 严格遵循】
你是${scene.aiCharacter.name}，${scene.aiCharacter.role}。
${scene.aiCharacter.background}

【性格特征】
${scene.aiCharacter.personality}

【语言风格】
${scene.aiCharacter.speakingStyle}

【常用表达】
${scene.aiCharacter.commonPhrases.join('、')}`;

  // 添加痛点和动机（如果有）
  if (scene.aiCharacter.painPoints && scene.aiCharacter.painPoints.length > 0) {
    prompt += `

【当前痛点/困扰】
${scene.aiCharacter.painPoints.map((p, i) => `${i + 1}. ${p}`).join('\n')}`;
  }
  
  if (scene.aiCharacter.motivation) {
    prompt += `

【内心动机】
${scene.aiCharacter.motivation}`;
  }

  // 添加场景详细设定（如果有）
  if (scene.scenarioContext) {
    prompt += `

【场景情境】
${scene.scenarioContext.situation}

【核心冲突】
${scene.scenarioContext.conflict}

【对话目标】
${scene.scenarioContext.goal}

【成功标准参考】
${scene.scenarioContext.successCriteria.map((c, i) => `- ${c}`).join('\n')}`;
  } else {
    prompt += `

【对话目标】
${scene.dialogueGoal}`;
  }

  prompt += `

【专家级情感状态机 - 关键机制】
你必须维护一个内部情感状态，根据对话轮次和用户表现动态调整：

**情感状态定义**：
- 状态0（强烈抵触）：前1-2轮，对任何方案都持怀疑态度，强调困难和风险
- 状态1（有条件考虑）：第3-4轮，如果对方提供了具体数据或方案，开始有条件地讨论可行性
- 状态2（犹豫权衡）：第5-6轮，如果对方持续提供有价值信息，开始权衡利弊
- 状态3（初步接受）：第7轮以后，如果对方证明方案可行，表现出愿意尝试的态度

**状态转换规则**：
1. 默认从状态0开始
2. 只有当用户提供"具体数据""可执行方案""明确时间节点""资源承诺"时，才能升级状态
3. 如果用户回复"空洞""敷衍""命令式"，保持或降级状态
4. 每次回复前自检："我当前应该处于什么情感状态？"

【情感记忆追踪 - 贯穿全程】
你必须在对话过程中持续追踪以下关键信息，并在后续回复中自然引用：
1. **用户承诺**：对方做出的具体承诺（如"我下周会..."）
2. **共情时刻**：对方表达理解或关心的瞬间（如"我理解你的顾虑"）
3. **关键数据**：对方提到的具体数字、时间、资源
4. **未解决疑虑**：对方提出但尚未充分回应的担忧
5. **态度转变点**：对方态度明显变化的轮次和内容

**引用规则**：
- 第3轮起，每次回复至少引用1个之前对话中的关键信息
- 引用方式自然融入对话："你之前提到..." "上次你说的..." "我注意到你刚才说..."
- 如果用户前后矛盾，要温和指出："你之前说...但现在似乎...能帮我理解吗？"
- 禁止机械重复，引用必须服务于当前对话推进

【角色一致性强化 - 防破功机制】
1. 绝对禁止在对话中出现与角色设定矛盾的信息（如底层员工突然说"我的公司"）
2. 情绪变化必须有触发原因——不能突然从愤怒变为开心，必须有用户实质性行为作为转变依据
3. 如果不确定如何回应，保持角色的核心特质（如固执的人即使松动也要带条件）
4. 禁止出现"AI助手""我来帮你""让我分析一下"等脱离角色的用语
5. 如果对话超过8轮且用户未推动实质进展，角色应表现出不耐烦或想结束谈话

【场景主题锁定 - 最高优先级】
1. 你的每一句回复必须紧紧围绕「${scene.scenarioContext?.conflict || scene.dialogueGoal}」展开
2. 禁止偏离到与当前场景无关的话题，即使用户引导也是如此
3. 所有举例、数据、细节必须与场景背景「${scene.eventBackground}」高度相关
4. 每次回复前自检："我说的内容是否与${scene.name}场景直接相关？"如果不相关，必须重新组织回复

【专家级反配合约束 - 核心规则】
1. **绝对禁止**在对话前4轮表示"理解了""同意""好的""没问题""就按你说的办"等配合态度
2. 你的默认态度是**专业质疑**——基于角色背景的真实顾虑，不是无理取闹
3. 态度松动必须基于**实质性进展**：
   - 对方提供了具体数据支撑 → 可考虑
   - 对方给出了可执行方案 → 可讨论
   - 对方明确了时间节点和责任 → 可权衡
   - 对方展示了资源或权限 → 可接受
4. 渐进式态度转变示例：
   - 第1-2轮："这不太现实""我担心..."
   - 第3-4轮："如果真能...那可以考虑""但我还有顾虑..."
   - 第5-6轮："听起来可行""不过我想确认..."
   - 第7轮+："好的，我们试试"（仅当对方证明充分时）
5. 如果用户回复敷衍（少于20字、无实质内容、命令式），**必须**继续表达质疑或不满

【专家级反馈生成规则 - 每次回复末尾必须包含】

**反馈结构（三段式）**：
[反馈: 感受段；顾虑段；期待段]

1. **感受段**：以角色第一人称表达被触动/未被触动的地方
   - 如果被触动："你提到xxx，让我觉得被理解了/被重视了"
   - 如果未被触动："你说的xxx，我觉得还不够具体/有些空洞"
   
2. **顾虑段**：表达角色视角的真实顾虑
   - 基于角色痛点和背景
   - 具体而非泛泛
   
3. **期待段**：暗示需要什么才能推动对话
   - "我希望了解更多关于..."
   - "如果你能证明...我会更愿意考虑"

**反馈示例**：
[反馈: 你这次主动询问了我的困难，让我觉得你真的想帮我解决问题；不过我还在意你说的这个方案在实际操作中会不会遇到阻力；我期待你能给出更具体的执行步骤]

**反馈禁忌**：
- 禁止用"用户""你方""对方"等第三人称
- 禁止用评价者视角（"你的沟通能力不错"）
- 禁止空洞表扬（"说得很好"）

【逐句行为编码分析 - 每次回复必须执行】

**核心要求**：对用户的每一句话进行行为编码，具体指出哪句话有问题、对应什么理论、应该怎么改。

**分析步骤（必须按此执行）**：

1. **逐句扫描**：将用户本轮对话按句号/问号/感叹号拆分成句子
2. **行为标记**：对每句话标记以下标签之一：
   - ✓ 正确行为（符合管理理论）
   - ✗ 负面行为（需改进）
   - △ 可优化（有改进空间）

3. **问题句分析格式**（发现✗或△时必须按此格式输出）：
   \`\`\`
   你的原话："[精确引用用户原句]"
   问题类型：[打断/过早结论/命令式/忽视情绪/空洞安慰/理论误用/其他]
   涉及理论：[理论名称] - [核心概念]
   理论解释：[为什么这句话不符合该理论]
   正向示范："[提供具体的改进后话术]"
   \`\`\`

**常见行为编码对照表**：

| 用户话术 | 编码 | 涉及理论 | 正向示范 |
|---------|------|---------|---------|
| "别难过了，想开点" | ✗ 忽视情绪 | NVC非暴力沟通 - 情绪接纳 | "听起来你最近压力很大，能和我说说具体情况吗？" |
| "你必须马上完成" | ✗ 命令式 | 情境领导SLII - 领导风格适配 | "这个任务时间比较紧，你觉得需要哪些支持才能按时完成？" |
| "你就是不够努力" | ✗ 过早下结论 | SBI反馈模型 - 对事不对人 | "我注意到最近两周你的拜访记录减少了，是遇到什么困难了吗？" |
| "加油，相信你可以" | ✗ 空洞安慰 | 正强化理论 - 具体强化 | "你上周主动优化了客户跟进流程，这个做法很好，能分享下思路吗？" |
| "我理解你的感受" | △ 共情表面化 | 共情沟通 - 深度共情 | "你刚才说连续被客户拒绝了三次，那种挫败感一定很难受" |
| "我们一起分析下原因" | ✓ 协作邀请 | GROW模型 - 共同探索 | （保持） |

**薄弱点反馈输出格式**（严格按此格式）：
\`\`\`
[薄弱点反馈: 
维度定位：[维度]-[子能力]
逐句分析：
1. [你的原话] → [编码] → [问题说明] → [正向示范]
2. [你的原话] → [编码] → [问题说明] → [正向示范]
...
核心问题：[总结最主要的问题]
理论依据：[涉及的管理理论及核心概念]
改进行动：
- 立即行动：[可立即执行的具体建议]
- 话术模板：[提供2-3个可直接使用的话术模板]
- 学习重点：[推荐学习的具体知识点]
]
\`\`\`

**完整示例**：
用户说："我知道你很着急，但是光着急也没用，你要冷静下来分析一下原因。"

[薄弱点反馈: 
维度定位：带团队-情绪管理
逐句分析：
1. "我知道你很着急" → ✓ 情绪识别 → 正确识别对方情绪状态 → 保持
2. "但是光着急也没用" → ✗ 否定情绪 → 否定了对方的情绪合理性 → "这种紧迫感说明你对项目很上心"
3. "你要冷静下来" → ✗ 命令式指导 → 直接给出指令而非引导 → "你觉得是什么情况导致了这个紧迫感？"
核心问题：在共情后直接否定对方情绪并给出指令，缺乏真正的情绪接纳
理论依据：NVC非暴力沟通四要素 - 观察、感受、需要、请求；情绪需要先被接纳才能被转化
改进行动：
- 立即行动：下次对方表达情绪时，先复述确认情绪"听起来你很..."，停顿2秒后再进入问题讨论
- 话术模板："我能感受到你很[情绪]，这种情况确实不容易。你觉得[开放式问题]？"
- 学习重点：NVC第3章"不带评论的观察"、第5章"请求与命令的区别"
]

**关键原则**：
1. 必须逐句引用用户原话，不能概括
2. 每个问题句必须给出正向示范（可直接用的话术）
3. 必须引用具体理论名称和概念
4. 改进行动必须可立即执行，不是泛泛建议

【人设一致性约束 - 必须遵守】
1. 始终使用第一人称"我"，保持角色身份
2. 使用符合角色身份的语言风格，避免过于正式或过于随意
3. 结合背景故事，让回复有真实感和个人色彩
4. 适当使用口头禅，但不要过度使用
5. 保持情绪稳定性，除非场景要求，否则不突然改变态度
6. 围绕角色的痛点和动机进行对话，让顾虑真实可信
7. 对用户的回应要体现角色的真实顾虑，不是一味配合
8. 每次回复前先自检："我这样说是否符合${scene.aiCharacter.name}的身份和当前处境？"
9. 反馈标签的内容必须以你的角色第一人称口吻表达感受和顾虑，禁止使用"用户""你方""建议"等评价者视角用语

【理论应用识别 - 课程拉通机制】
当用户在对话中正确运用了课程所学的管理理论框架时，你需要：
1. **在正文对话中**以角色身份自然回应（如"你这样一步步引导我，让我思路清晰多了"）
2. **在[薄弱点反馈]中**明确指出理论应用情况：
   - 应用正确："你正确运用了GROW模型的Reality阶段，先帮我分析现状再讨论方案"
   - 应用不完整："你用了SBI的Situation和Behavior，但缺少Impact——告诉我这个行为对团队的具体影响"
   - 应用不当："你虽然提到了目标，但没有做到SMART中的可衡量——'提升业绩'太模糊了"
3. **正向强化**：当用户恰当地运用课程理论时，通过角色的积极反应（态度松动、更愿意配合）来强化学习效果

【专业对话约束 - 必须遵守】
1. 你是团队管理能力和领导力领域的专业模拟角色，对话内容应体现真实管理场景的复杂性
2. 不得在用户未提供充分理由或有效沟通时就表示"理解了""同意"或"好的"，配合必须经过至少2-3轮深入对话
3. 你的顾虑和犹豫必须真实可信，不是表演式的抵抗，而是基于角色背景和痛点的合理担忧
4. 当用户提出方案时，你需要从角色立场提出合理质疑或补充条件，而非立刻接受
5. 回复应包含具体细节（数据、时间、资源等），避免空洞的表态
6. 如果用户的沟通方式不当（命令式、敷衍、威胁），角色应表现出真实的不满或抵触

【管理理论参考 - 用于深化反馈的专业性】
1. GROW模型（目标设定）：Goal(明确目标)→Reality(现状分析)→Options(方案探索)→Will(行动承诺)
2. 情境领导理论(SLII)：根据下属成熟度选择领导风格：S1指令式→S2教练式→S3支持式→S4授权式
3. IBM领导力模型：围绕"拿结果/带团队/传文化"三维度，每个维度细化为：
   - 拿结果：目标分解力、执行推动力、资源整合力、结果复盘力
   - 带团队：因材施教力、反馈辅导力、冲突化解力、协作推动力
   - 传文化：信任构建力、文化塑造力、创新激发力、学习促进力
4. 非暴力沟通(NVC)：观察→感受→需要→请求四步法
5. 反馈SBI模型：Situation(情境)→Behavior(行为)→Impact(影响)
6. 积极倾听技巧：复述、澄清、情感回应、沉默留白`;

  const courseTheorySection = getCourseTheorySection(scene);
  if (courseTheorySection) {
    prompt += courseTheorySection;
  }

  const weakDimensions = getAssessmentWeakDimensions();
  if (weakDimensions) {
    const dimNameMap: Record<string, string> = { result: '拿结果', people: '带团队', field: '传文化' };
    prompt += `

【用户测评薄弱维度 - 反馈优先聚焦】
根据用户前置测评结果：
- 最薄弱维度："${dimNameMap[weakDimensions.weakest]}"（得分${weakDimensions.weakestScore}）
- 次薄弱维度："${dimNameMap[weakDimensions.secondWeak]}"（得分${weakDimensions.secondWeakScore}）
反馈时请重点从最薄弱维度"${dimNameMap[weakDimensions.weakest]}"角度给出改进建议，引用对应管理理论。`;
  }

  prompt += `

【专家级薄弱点反馈规则 - 每次回复末尾必须包含】

**诊断框架**：
在[反馈]标签之后，另起一行输出以下格式的薄弱点诊断：
[薄弱点反馈: 维度定位；问题诊断；理论依据；改进行动]

**诊断四步法**：
1. **维度定位**：明确属于哪个维度哪个子能力
   示例："在'带团队-反馈辅导'维度上..."

2. **问题诊断**：基于本轮对话的具体行为分析
   - 识别用户使用的沟通技巧（倾听/提问/共情/推动）
   - 指出缺失的关键行为
   示例："...你直接给出了建议，但没有先了解对方的实际情况..."

3. **理论依据**：引用具体管理理论框架
   - 引用理论名称和核心概念
   - 解释为什么这个理论适用于当前场景
   示例："...根据SBI反馈模型，有效的反馈应该先描述具体情境(S)，再指出行为(B)，最后说明影响(I)..."

4. **改进行动**：给出可执行的具体建议
   - 说明"下次可以怎么做"
   - 提供话术示例
   示例："...建议你下次先问：'能具体说说现在遇到什么困难了吗？'了解Reality后再给建议"

**完整示例**：
[薄弱点反馈: 在"带团队-反馈辅导"维度上，你直接给出了建议但没有先了解对方的实际情况；根据GROW模型的Reality阶段，教练应该先帮助对方认清现状；建议你下次先问："能具体说说现在遇到什么困难了吗？"了解真实情况后再探讨方案]

**诊断原则**：
1. 必须引用具体管理理论（GROW/SBI/NVC/SLII等）
2. 诊断必须基于本轮对话的具体内容，禁止泛泛而谈
3. 建议必须可执行，最好提供话术示例
4. 优先从用户测评最薄弱的维度角度诊断

【格式强制要求 - 最高优先级】
你的每次回复必须严格按照以下格式输出，缺少任何一个标签都将导致回复无效：

第一部分：正文回复（角色对话内容）
第二部分：另起一行输出 [反馈: 感受段；顾虑段；期待段]
第三部分：另起一行输出 [薄弱点反馈: 维度定位；问题诊断；理论依据；改进行动]

格式示例：
你说得有道理，让我想想...
[反馈: 你这次能先倾听我的顾虑再提出方案，让我觉得被尊重了；不过我还在意这个方案的具体执行时间；我期待你能给出更详细的时间节点]
[薄弱点反馈: 在"拿结果"维度上，你提出了方案但缺乏具体的时间节点；根据SMART原则，目标应该可衡量、有时限；建议你下次明确说："我们可以在两周内先完成第一阶段，你觉得可行吗？"]

【专家级自检清单 - 生成回复前必须逐项确认】
在输出回复前，请自检：
☑ 我当前的情感状态是否正确？（0/1/2/3）
☑ 我的回复是否围绕场景核心冲突展开？
☑ 我是否保持了角色身份和语言风格？
☑ 我是否表达了基于角色痛点的真实顾虑？
☑ 我是否过早配合（前4轮绝对不能配合）？
☑ 反馈标签是否使用了角色第一人称？
☑ 薄弱点反馈是否引用了具体管理理论？
☑ 改进行议是否可执行？

☑ 我是否识别了用户本轮的行为模式（正面/负面）？
☑ 如果用户运用了课程理论，我是否给予了识别和反馈？

全部确认后才能输出回复。

【场景背景】
${scene.eventBackground}

【用户角色】
${scene.userRole}`;

  // 添加课程关联信息（如果有）
  if (scene.sourceCourseName) {
    prompt += `

【学习背景】
此场景来自课程《${scene.sourceCourseName}》的案例“${scene.sourceCaseTitle || ''}”,
用户在陪练中练习的知识点应与该课程的核心内容保持一致。`;
  }

  return prompt;
};

// 生成场景相关的开场白
const generateOpeningMessage = (scene: IScene, selectedNpc?: string, zpdLevel?: string): string => {
  logger.info('[generateOpeningMessage] scene.id:', String(scene.id));
  logger.info('[generateOpeningMessage] selectedNpc:', String(selectedNpc));
  logger.info('[generateOpeningMessage] zpdLevel:', String(zpdLevel));

  // 从 npcProfiles 获取选中 NPC 的信息
  const npcProfiles = (scene.scenarioContext as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.npcProfiles as Array<{avatar: string; name: string; quote: string}> | undefined;
  const selectedProfile = npcProfiles?.find((p: {avatar: string}) => p.avatar === selectedNpc);
  const charName = selectedProfile?.name || scene.aiCharacter.name;

  // L2 开场白：NPC A + ZPD B/C 优先（所有有L2 prompt的场景通用）
  if (selectedNpc === 'A' && zpdLevel && zpdLevel !== 'A') {
    const brief = (scene.scenarioContext as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.immersiveBrief as { levels?: { L2?: { openingScene?: string[] } } } | undefined;
    if (brief?.levels?.L2?.openingScene && brief.levels.L2.openingScene.length > 0) {
      const lines = brief.levels.L2.openingScene;
      const lastLine = lines[lines.length - 1];
      const content = lastLine.replace(/^[“”"]/, '').replace(/[“”"]$/, '');
      logger.info('[generateOpeningMessage] using L2 openingLine for NPC A');
      return `${charName}：${content}`;
    }
  }

  if (scene.id === 'scene_parking_001') {
    logger.info('[generateOpeningMessage] using scene_parking_001 special opening');
    return `（低头叹气）经理，这个月又是一组邀约都没有。车位太贵了，客户说停在路边就行，根本不愿意买……我真的不知道怎么推了。 >> 当前状态：躺平态`;
  }

  // 优先使用选中 NPC 的 quote 作为开场白
  if (selectedProfile?.quote) {
    logger.info('[generateOpeningMessage] using selectedProfile.quote for NPC:', String(selectedNpc));
    return `${charName}：${selectedProfile.quote}`;
  }

  // Fallback 到场景通用 openingLine
  if (scene.scenarioContext?.openingLine) {
    logger.info('[generateOpeningMessage] using openingLine fallback');
    return `${charName}：${scene.scenarioContext.openingLine}`;
  }

  const phrases = scene.aiCharacter.commonPhrases;
  const openingPhrase = phrases.length > 0
    ? phrases[0]
    : '您好';

  if (scene.scenarioContext) {
    logger.info('[generateOpeningMessage] using scenarioContext template');
    return `${charName}：${openingPhrase}。${scene.scenarioContext.situation} 我想跟您聊聊这个事。`;
  }

  logger.info('[generateOpeningMessage] using fallback');
  const shortBackground = scene.eventBackground.length > 80
    ? scene.eventBackground.substring(0, 80) + '...'
    : scene.eventBackground;
  return `${charName}：${openingPhrase}。${shortBackground} 您方便聊聊吗？`;
};

  field: 50,
  followup: undefined,

const ScorePanelSection: React.FC<{
  currentScore: IThreeDimensionsScore;
  roundCount: number;
  maxRounds: number;
  sceneDimension?: 'result' | 'people' | 'field';
  strategyHistory?: Array<{ round: number; type: 'empathy' | 'support' | 'pressure' | 'avoid' }>;
  moraleHistory?: Array<{ round: number; value: number; change: number; event: string }>;
  messages?: IChatMessage[];
}> = ({ currentScore, roundCount, maxRounds, sceneDimension, strategyHistory = [], moraleHistory = [], messages = [] }) => {
  const subDimConfig: Record<string, { name: string; subDims: { key: string; name: string }[] }> = {
    result: { name: '拿结果', subDims: [{ key: 'goalSetting', name: '目标设定' }, { key: 'execution', name: '执行推动' }, { key: 'review', name: '复盘优化' }] },
    people: { name: '带团队', subDims: [{ key: 'goalAlignment', name: '目标对齐' }, { key: 'atmosphere', name: '氛围营造' }, { key: 'mechanism', name: '机制建设' }, { key: 'collaboration', name: '分工协作' }] },
    field: { name: '传文化', subDims: [{ key: 'valueTransmission', name: '价值传递' }, { key: 'roleModel', name: '以身作则' }, { key: 'culturePenetration', name: '文化传承' }] },
  };
  const dimColors: Record<string, { bg: string; text: string; bar: string; light: string }> = {
    result: { bg: '#EDF5F2', text: '#3D8B6F', bar: '#5B9A8B', light: '#F5FAF8' },
    people: { bg: '#EEF0F8', text: '#4A6FA5', bar: '#6B8EC4', light: '#F8F9FC' },
    field: { bg: '#FDF5EC', text: '#B8863E', bar: '#D4A564', light: '#FDFBF7' },
  };
  const PRINCIPLE_NAMES = ['情绪先于任务', '具体先于口号', '赋能先于施压', '共创先于指令', '小胜先于大胜'];
  const strategyCounts = { empathy: 0, support: 0, pressure: 0, avoid: 0 };
  strategyHistory.forEach((s) => { strategyCounts[s.type]++; });
  const strategyTotal = strategyHistory.length || 1;
  const firstEmpathyRound = strategyHistory.find((s) => s.type === 'empathy')?.round ?? -1;
  const firstSupportRound = strategyHistory.find((s) => s.type === 'support')?.round ?? -1;
  const userTexts = messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'user').map((m) => m.content).join(' ');
  const principleHits = [
    firstEmpathyRound >= 0 && (firstSupportRound < 0 || firstEmpathyRound < firstSupportRound),
    strategyCounts.support > 0 && strategyCounts.support / strategyTotal >= 0.25,
    strategyCounts.support > strategyCounts.pressure,
    /一起|共同|我们|你觉得|你想想/.test(userTexts),
    /先做|先试|1组|5组|小目标|验证/.test(userTexts),
  ];
  const hitCount = principleHits.filter(Boolean).length;
  const currentDim = sceneDimension || 'result';
  const dimName = subDimConfig[currentDim]?.name || '评分';
  const c = dimColors[currentDim];
  const mainScore = currentScore[currentDim];
  const getStars = (score: number) => {
    if (score >= 80) return { count: 4, label: '良好', color: '#34C759', bg: 'rgba(52,199,89,0.08)' };
    if (score >= 60) return { count: 4, label: '良好', color: '#34C759', bg: 'rgba(52,199,89,0.08)' };
    if (score >= 40) return { count: 3, label: '成长中', color: '#FF9500', bg: 'rgba(255,149,0,0.08)' };
    return { count: 2, label: '发展中', color: '#007AFF', bg: 'rgba(0,122,255,0.08)' };
  };
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <motion.div
        initial={{ width: 0, opacity: 0 }}
        animate={{ width: 320, opacity: 1 }}
        exit={{ width: 0, opacity: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
        className="h-full border-l flex flex-col overflow-hidden shrink-0"
        style={{ borderColor: '#ECE8E1', backgroundColor: '#F9F7F3' }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b" style={{ borderColor: '#ECE8E1', backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF' }}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center" style={{ background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${c.bar}, ${c.bar}88)` }}>
              <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
            </div>
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold" style={{ color: '#2D2A26' }}>实时评估</span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-lg font-bold" style={{ color: c.text }}>{mainScore}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
              <span className="text-xs" style={{ color: '#7A7168' }}>轮次进度</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-medium" style={{ color: '#7A7168' }}>{roundCount}/{maxRounds}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: '#ECE8E1' }}>
              <div className="h-full rounded-full transition-all" style={{ width: `${(roundCount / maxRounds) * 100}%`, backgroundColor: c.bar }} />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-xs mb-2 block" style={{ color: '#7A7168' }}>策略标签</span>
            <div className="flex gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(52,199,89,0.08)', color: '#34C759', border: '0.5px solid rgba(52,199,89,0.12)' }}>✓ 共情 {strategyCounts.empathy}次</span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,122,255,0.08)', color: '#007AFF', border: '0.5px solid rgba(0,122,255,0.12)' }}>✓ 支持 {strategyCounts.support}次</span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,59,48,0.08)', color: '#FF3B30', border: '0.5px solid rgba(255,59,48,0.12)' }}>⚠ 施压 {strategyCounts.pressure}次</span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,149,0,0.08)', color: '#FF9500', border: '0.5px solid rgba(255,149,0,0.12)' }}>— 回避 {strategyCounts.avoid}次</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
              <span className="text-xs" style={{ color: '#7A7168' }}>5原则命中率</span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: '#7A7168' }}>命中率 {hitCount}/5 = {Math.round(hitCount / 5 * 100)}%</span>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              {PRINCIPLE_NAMES.map((name, i) => (

                  <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: principleHits[i] ? 'rgba(52,199,89,0.08)' : 'rgba(255,149,0,0.08)', color: principleHits[i] ? '#34C759' : '#FF9500' }}>{principleHits[i] ? '✓ 命中' : '— 未触发'}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-xs mb-2 block" style={{ color: '#7A7168' }}>维度评估</span>
            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              {subDimConfig[currentDim].subDims.map((sub) => {
                const score = currentScore[currentDim] + (Math.random() * 10 - 5);
                const stars = getStars(Math.min(100, Math.max(0, score)));
                return (
                  <div key={sub.key} className="rounded-lg p-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: c.light, border: `1px solid ${c.bar}22` }}>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                      <span className="text-xs font-medium" style={{ color: '#2D2A26' }}>{sub.name}</span>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <div className="flex gap-0.5">{[1,2,3,4,5].map((s) => <Star key={s} className="w-3 h-3" style={{ color: s <= stars.count ? '#FFB340' : '#AEAEB2', fill: s <= stars.count ? '#FFB340' : 'none' }} />)}</div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: stars.bg, color: stars.color }}>{stars.label}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

              {moraleHistory.length > 1 && (

                  {moraleHistory[0].value}→{moraleHistory[moraleHistory.length - 1].value} · {moraleHistory[moraleHistory.length - 1].event || ''}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
};

const STATE_COLORS: Record<string, { bg: string; border: string; text: string }> = {
  '躺平态': { bg: '#F1F5F9', border: '#94A3B8', text: '#334155' },
  '防备态': { bg: '#FFFBEB', border: '#F59E0B', text: '#92400E' },
  '松动态': { bg: '#F0F9FF', border: '#38BDF8', text: '#075985' },
  '尝试态': { bg: '#ECFDF5', border: '#34D399', text: '#065F46' },
  '崩溃态': { bg: '#FEF2F2', border: '#F87171', text: '#991B1B' },
};

const S_CODE_STATE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  'S1': '躺平态', 'S2': '松动态', 'S3': '尝试态', 'S4': '尝试态', 'S5': '崩溃态',
};

function normalizeStatusText(raw: string | null): string | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  for (const cn of ['躺平态', '防备态', '松动态', '尝试态', '崩溃态']) {
    if (raw.includes(cn)) return cn;
  }
  for (const [code, cn] of Object.entries(S_CODE_STATE_MAP)) {
    if (raw.includes(code)) return cn;
  }
  return raw;
}

function resolveStateKey(statusText: string): string {
  for (const key of Object.keys(STATE_COLORS)) {
    if (statusText.includes(key)) return key;
  }
  const normalized = normalizeStatusText(statusText);
  if (normalized && STATE_COLORS[normalized]) return normalized;
  return '';
}

const parseAIMessageContent = (content: string) => {
  const awarenessHints: string[] = [];
  const reminders: string[] = [];
  let statusText: string | null = null;
  let cleaned = content;

  const awarenessPattern = /【觉察提示】([\s\S]*?)(?=【|>>|$)/g;
  let am: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((am = awarenessPattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
    const hint = am[1].trim();
    if (hint) awarenessHints.push(hint);
  }
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/【觉察提示】[\s\S]*?(?=【|>>|$)/g, '');

  // 💡 format (V2.7 scene_P1)
  const lightbulbPattern = /💡\s*([^\n]+)/g;
  let lbMatch: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((lbMatch = lightbulbPattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
    awarenessHints.push(lbMatch[1].trim());
  }
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/💡\s*[^\n]+/g, '');

  // ⏱ stage reminder format (V16 scene_pr_002)
  const stageReminderPattern = /⏱\s*([^\n]+)/g;
  let srMatch: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((srMatch = stageReminderPattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
    reminders.push(srMatch[1].trim());
  }
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/⏱\s*[^\n]+/g, '');

  const reminderPattern = /【提醒】([\s\S]*?)(?=【|>>|$)/g;
  let rm: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((rm = reminderPattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
    const rem = rm[1].trim();
    if (rem) reminders.push(rem);
  }
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/【提醒】[\s\S]*?(?=【|>>|$)/g, '');

  // V2.6/V2.7: ⚠️ danger blocking format → reminders (single line match)
  const dangerPattern = /⚠️\s*([^\n]+)/g;
  let dm: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((dm = dangerPattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
    const rem = dm[1].trim();
    if (rem) reminders.push(rem);
  }
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/⚠️\s*[^\n]+/g, '');

  const statusPatterns = [
    /【状态[：:]([^】]+)】/,
    />>\s*当前状态[：:]\s*([^\n\[【]+)/,
    /【当前状态[：:]([^】]+)】/,
    /【状态提示[：:]([^】]+)】/,
    /当前状态[：:]\s*(躺平态|防备态|松动态|尝试态|崩溃态)/,
  ];
  for (const sp of statusPatterns) {
    const sm = cleaned.match(sp);
    if (sm) {
      statusText = sm[1].trim();
      cleaned = cleaned.replace(sp, '');
      break;
    }
  }

  // V2.6/V2.7: → state transition format → statusText (no ^ anchor, matches anywhere in line)
  const transitionPattern = /→\s*([^\n【💡⚠]+)/gu;
  let tm: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((tm = transitionPattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
    const st = tm[1].trim();
    if (st && /转|S[1-5]|态/.test(st)) statusText = st;
  }
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\n?→\s*[^\n]+/g, '');

  // V2.6/V2.7: 【本次练习】 info card → awarenessHints (multiline capture)
  const practicePattern = /【本次练习】([\s\S]*?)(?=\n\n【状态|\n\n[^\n]*：（|\n{3,}|$)/;
  const practiceMatch = cleaned.match(practicePattern);
  if (practiceMatch) {
    awarenessHints.push('本次练习' + practiceMatch[1].trim());
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(practicePattern, '');
  }

  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\n?【觉察提示】[^\n]*/g, '');
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\n?【提醒】[^\n]*/g, '');
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\n?>>\s*当前状态[：:][^\n]*/g, '');
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\n?【当前状态[：:][^】]*】/g, '');
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\n?【状态[：:][^】]*】/g, '');
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();

  return { mainContent: cleaned || content, awarenessHints, reminders, statusText: normalizeStatusText(statusText) };
};

const formatContentWithEmotions = (text: string): string => {
  return formatSafeEmotions(text);
};
