const ChatInterfaceSection: React.FC<{
  messages: IChatMessage[];
  currentScore: IThreeDimensionsScore;
  onSendMessage: (content: string, voiceEmotion?: IUserVoiceEmotion | null) => void;
  isLoading: boolean;
  scene: IScene;
  onEndCoaching: () => void;
  onRestart: () => void;
  sessionId: string;
  sceneId: string;
  onDismissHint?: (id: string) => void;
  selectedNpc?: string;
  isCompleted?: boolean;
}> = ({ messages, currentScore, onSendMessage, isLoading, scene, onEndCoaching, onRestart, sessionId, sceneId, onDismissHint, selectedNpc, isCompleted }) => {
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState('');
  const [messageFeedbacks, setMessageFeedbacks] = useState<Record<string, 'useful' | 'not_useful'>>({});
  const [dismissedHint, setDismissedHint] = useState(false);
  const scrollAreaRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const {
    isListening,
    isSpeaking,
    transcript,
    interimTranscript,
    isSupported: voiceSupported,
    ttsSupported,
    startListening,
    stopListening,
    speak,
    stopSpeaking,
    autoSpeakEnabled,
    toggleAutoSpeak,
    userVoiceEmotion,
  } = useVoice();

  const [currentSpeakingId, setCurrentSpeakingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [backgroundExpanded, setBackgroundExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [isSynthesizing, setIsSynthesizing] = useState(false);
  const [isAudioPlaying, setIsAudioPlaying] = useState(false);
  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
  const prevMessageCountRef = useRef(0);

  const timeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const stopAudioPlayback = useCallback(() => {
    if (timeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
      timeoutRef.current = null;
    }
    if (audioRef.current) {
      audioRef.current.pause();
      audioRef.current.currentTime = 0;
      audioRef.current = null;
    }
    if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    }
    setIsAudioPlaying(false);
    setIsSynthesizing(false);
  }, []);

  const preprocessTextForTTS = (text: string, emotion: 'neutral' | 'sad' | 'worried' | 'hopeful' | 'frustrated' = 'neutral'): string => {
    let cleaned = text
      .replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, '')
      .replace(/`[^`]*`/g, '')
      .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '$1')
      .replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, '$1')
      .replace(/#{1,6}\s+/g, '')
      .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)/g, '$1')
      .replace(/^\s*[-*+]\s+/gm, '')
      .replace(/^\s*\d+\.\s+/gm, '')
      .replace(/【[^】]*】/g, '')
      .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
      .trim();

    switch (emotion) {
      case 'sad':
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(/([。！？])/g, '$1，，');
        break;
      case 'worried':
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(/([，])/g, '$1，');
        break;
      case 'hopeful':
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(/([！])/g, '$1');
        break;
      case 'frustrated':
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(/([。])/g, '$1。。');
        break;
    }

    if (cleaned.length > 2800) {
      cleaned = cleaned.substring(0, 2800) + '...';
    }
    return cleaned;
  };

  const PLUGIN_TTS_ID = 'text_to_speech_timbre_speed_volume_1';

  const NPC_VOICE_MAP: Record<string, Record<string, { voiceType: string; speedRatio: string; volumeRatio: string }>> = {
    scene_P1: {
      A: { voiceType: 'zh_male_chunhou_nansheng_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.92', volumeRatio: '0.95' },
      B: { voiceType: 'zh_male_yuanboxiaoshu_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.88', volumeRatio: '0.82' },
      C: { voiceType: 'zh_male_shaonanyuyanxing_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '1.05', volumeRatio: '0.9' },
      D: { voiceType: 'zh_male_shaonanyuyanxing_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '1.05', volumeRatio: '0.8' },
    },
  };

  const SCENE_VOICE_MAP: Record<string, { voiceType: string; speedRatio: string; volumeRatio: string }> = {
    scene_F2: { voiceType: 'zh_male_chunhou_nansheng_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.95', volumeRatio: '0.9' },
    scene_R1: { voiceType: 'zh_male_shaonanyuyanxing_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.95', volumeRatio: '0.92' },
    scene_R2: { voiceType: 'zh_male_yuanboxiaoshu_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.95', volumeRatio: '0.88' },
    scene_R3: { voiceType: 'zh_male_yuanboxiaoshu_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.95', volumeRatio: '0.9' },
    scene_P2: { voiceType: 'zh_male_chunhou_nansheng_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.92', volumeRatio: '0.92' },
    scene_P3: { voiceType: 'zh_male_chunhou_nansheng_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.95', volumeRatio: '0.9' },
    scene_F1: { voiceType: 'zh_male_yuanboxiaoshu_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.95', volumeRatio: '0.88' },
    scene_F3: { voiceType: 'zh_male_chunhou_nansheng_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.92', volumeRatio: '0.85' },
    scene_gt_P3: { voiceType: 'zh_male_chunhou_nansheng_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.95', volumeRatio: '0.92' },
    scene_gt_F4: { voiceType: 'zh_male_shaonanyuyanxing_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.95', volumeRatio: '0.88' },
    scene_adv_upward_01: { voiceType: 'zh_male_shaonanyuyanxing_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.95', volumeRatio: '0.92' },
    scene_parking_001: { voiceType: 'zh_male_chunhou_nansheng_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.92', volumeRatio: '0.95' },
  };

  const DEFAULT_VOICE = { voiceType: 'zh_male_chunhou_nansheng_mars_bigtts', speedRatio: '0.95', volumeRatio: '0.88' };

  const EMOTION_SPEED_ADJUST: Record<string, { speedDelta: number; volumeDelta: number }> = {
    sad: { speedDelta: -0.08, volumeDelta: -0.1 },
    worried: { speedDelta: 0.05, volumeDelta: -0.05 },
    hopeful: { speedDelta: 0.05, volumeDelta: 0.05 },
    frustrated: { speedDelta: -0.05, volumeDelta: 0.05 },
    neutral: { speedDelta: 0, volumeDelta: 0 },
  };

  const getVoiceForNpc = useCallback((npc: string | undefined, emotion: string) => {
    let base = DEFAULT_VOICE;
    if (npc && NPC_VOICE_MAP[sceneId]?.[npc]) {
      base = NPC_VOICE_MAP[sceneId][npc];
    } else if (SCENE_VOICE_MAP[sceneId]) {
      base = SCENE_VOICE_MAP[sceneId];
    }
    const adjust = EMOTION_SPEED_ADJUST[emotion] || EMOTION_SPEED_ADJUST.neutral;
    const speed = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(2.0, parseFloat(base.speedRatio) + adjust.speedDelta));
    const volume = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(2.0, parseFloat(base.volumeRatio) + adjust.volumeDelta));
    return { voiceType: base.voiceType, speedRatio: speed.toFixed(2), volumeRatio: volume.toFixed(2) };
  }, [sceneId]);

  const resetTTSState = useCallback(() => {
    setIsSynthesizing(false);
    setIsAudioPlaying(false);
  }, []);

  const speakFallback = useCallback((text: string, emotion: string, onEnd?: () => void) => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.speechSynthesis) {
      logger.warn('[speakFallback] Web Speech API not supported');
      resetTTSState();
      onEnd?.();
      return;
    }
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    utterance.lang = 'zh-CN';
    const emotionRate: Record<string, number> = { neutral: 0.92, sad: 0.85, worried: 0.95, hopeful: 0.95, frustrated: 0.88 };
    const emotionPitch: Record<string, number> = { neutral: 0.95, sad: 0.88, worried: 0.98, hopeful: 1.02, frustrated: 0.90 };
    utterance.rate = emotionRate[emotion] || 0.92;
    utterance.pitch = emotionPitch[emotion] || 0.95;
    utterance.volume = 0.95;
    const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
    const zhVoices = voices.filter((v) => v.lang.startsWith('zh'));
    const MALE_KEYWORDS = ['male', '男', 'kangkang', 'yaoming', 'yushu', 'sinji', 'yunxi', 'yunye', 'yunjian', 'yunfeng'];
    const FEMALE_KEYWORDS = ['female', '女', 'ting-ting', 'tingting', 'meijia', 'mei-jia', 'lili', 'xiaoqian', 'shanshan', 'yahui', 'xiaoyu', 'xiaoxiao', 'xiaochen', 'xiaomo', 'xiaohan', 'xiaoxuan', 'xiaoshuang', 'huihui'];
    let maleVoice = zhVoices.find((v) => {
      const n = v.name.toLowerCase();
      return MALE_KEYWORDS.some((kw) => n.includes(kw));
    });
    if (!maleVoice) {
      maleVoice = zhVoices.find((v) => {
        const n = v.name.toLowerCase();
        return !FEMALE_KEYWORDS.some((kw) => n.includes(kw));
      });
    }
    if (maleVoice) {
      logger.info('[speakFallback] Using voice: ' + maleVoice.name);
      utterance.voice = maleVoice;
    } else {
      logger.warn('[speakFallback] No male voice found, lowering pitch. Voices: ' + zhVoices.map((v) => v.name).join(', '));
      utterance.pitch = 0.6;
    }
    utterance.onstart = () => { setIsSynthesizing(false); setIsAudioPlaying(true); };
    utterance.onend = () => { setIsAudioPlaying(false); setIsSynthesizing(false); onEnd?.(); };
    utterance.onerror = () => { setIsAudioPlaying(false); setIsSynthesizing(false); onEnd?.(); };
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
  }, [resetTTSState]);

  const speakWithPlugin = useCallback((text: string, voiceConfig: { voiceType: string; speedRatio: string; volumeRatio: string }, emotion: string = 'neutral', onEnd?: () => void) => {
    if (timeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
      timeoutRef.current = null;
    }
    if (audioRef.current) {
      audioRef.current.pause();
      audioRef.current = null;
    }
    resetTTSState();
    setIsSynthesizing(true);
    const safeVoice = voiceConfig.voiceType || DEFAULT_VOICE.voiceType;
    const safeSpeed = voiceConfig.speedRatio || DEFAULT_VOICE.speedRatio;
    const safeVolume = voiceConfig.volumeRatio || DEFAULT_VOICE.volumeRatio;
    const processedText = preprocessTextForTTS(text, emotion as 'neutral' | 'sad' | 'worried' | 'hopeful' | 'frustrated');
    if (!processedText) {
      logger.warn('[speakWithPlugin] preprocessTextForTTS returned empty');
      resetTTSState();
      onEnd?.();
      return;
    }
    logger.info('[speakWithPlugin] Starting TTS, voice: ' + safeVoice + ', speed: ' + safeSpeed + ', volume: ' + safeVolume + ', text length: ' + processedText.length);

    let timedOut = false;
    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      timedOut = true;
      logger.warn('[speakWithPlugin] Plugin TTS timeout 15s');
      resetTTSState();
      onEnd?.();
    }, 15000);

    const loadAndCall = async () => {
      try {
        const plugin = capabilityClient.load(PLUGIN_TTS_ID);
        const input = {
          peilian: processedText,
          voiceType: safeVoice,
          speedRatio: safeSpeed,
          volumeRatio: safeVolume,
        } satisfies TextToSpeechTimbreSpeedVolumeOneInput;
        const result = await plugin.call('speechSynthesis', input) as TextToSpeechTimbreSpeedVolumeOneOutput;
        if (timedOut) return;

        const audioUrl = result?.audioUrl;
        if (!audioUrl) {
          logger.warn('[speakWithPlugin] Plugin returned no audioUrl, falling back to Web Speech API');
          if (timeoutRef.current) { clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current); timeoutRef.current = null; }
          resetTTSState();
          speakFallback(text, emotion, onEnd);
          return;
        }

        if (timeoutRef.current) { clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current); timeoutRef.current = null; }
        logger.info('[speakWithPlugin] Got audioUrl, playing audio');

        const audio = new Audio(audioUrl);
        audioRef.current = audio;

        audio.onplay = () => {
          setIsSynthesizing(false);
          setIsAudioPlaying(true);
        };
        audio.onended = () => {
          setIsAudioPlaying(false);
          setIsSynthesizing(false);
          audioRef.current = null;
          onEnd?.();
        };
        audio.onerror = () => {
          logger.warn('[speakWithPlugin] Audio playback error');
          resetTTSState();
          audioRef.current = null;
          onEnd?.();
        };

        try {
          await audio.play();
        } catch (playErr) {
          const msg = playErr instanceof Error ? playErr.message : String(playErr);
          logger.warn('[speakWithPlugin] audio.play() failed: ' + msg);
          resetTTSState();
          audioRef.current = null;
          onEnd?.();
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (timedOut) return;
        const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
        logger.warn('[speakWithPlugin] Plugin call failed: ' + errMsg + ', falling back to Web Speech API');
        if (timeoutRef.current) { clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current); timeoutRef.current = null; }
        resetTTSState();
        speakFallback(text, emotion, onEnd);
      }
    };

    loadAndCall();
  }, [resetTTSState, speakFallback]);

  const smartSpeak = useCallback((text: string, emotion: 'neutral' | 'sad' | 'worried' | 'hopeful' | 'frustrated', onEnd?: () => void) => {
    const voiceConfig = getVoiceForNpc(selectedNpc, emotion);
    speakWithPlugin(text, voiceConfig, emotion, onEnd);
  }, [speakWithPlugin, getVoiceForNpc, selectedNpc]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (transcript && !isListening) {
      setInputValue((prev) => (prev + transcript).trim());
    }
  }, [transcript, isListening]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const aiMessages = messages.filter((m: IChatMessage) => m.role === 'ai');
    if (autoSpeakEnabled && aiMessages.length > prevMessageCountRef.current) {
      const latestAi = aiMessages[aiMessages.length - 1];
      if (latestAi && !isSpeaking) {
        setCurrentSpeakingId(latestAi.id);
        const emotion = analyzeEmotion(latestAi.content);
        smartSpeak(latestAi.content, emotion, () => setCurrentSpeakingId(null));
      }
    }
    prevMessageCountRef.current = aiMessages.length;
  }, [messages, autoSpeakEnabled, isSpeaking, smartSpeak]);

  const handleMicClick = () => {
    if (isListening) {
      stopListening();
    } else {
      startListening();
    }
  };

  // 分析文本情感，用于语音朗读时调整语调
  const analyzeEmotion = (text: string): 'neutral' | 'sad' | 'worried' | 'hopeful' | 'frustrated' => {
    const t = text.toLowerCase();
    // 悲伤/无奈情绪
    if (/难过|伤心|哭|累|撑不住|没办法|无助|绝望|失望/.test(t)) return 'sad';
    // 焦虑/担忧情绪
    if (/担心|焦虑|紧张|害怕|压力|发愁|着急|怎么办/.test(t)) return 'worried';
    // 挫败/沮丧情绪
    if (/挫败|沮丧|失败|做不到|不行|太难了|想放弃/.test(t)) return 'frustrated';
    // 希望/积极情绪
    if (/感谢|谢谢|希望|相信|可以|好的|愿意|理解|支持/.test(t)) return 'hopeful';
    return 'neutral';
  };

  const handleSpeakMessage = (messageId: string, content: string) => {
    if ((isSpeaking || isSynthesizing || isAudioPlaying) && currentSpeakingId === messageId) {
      stopSpeaking();
      stopAudioPlayback();
      setCurrentSpeakingId(null);
    } else {
      setCurrentSpeakingId(messageId);
      const emotion = analyzeEmotion(content);
      smartSpeak(content, emotion, () => setCurrentSpeakingId(null));
    }
  };

  const userMessageCount = messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'user').length;
  const hintThresholds = [3, 6, 9];
  const MANAGEMENT_THEORY_HINTS = [
    '提示：试试用GROW模型引导对话 (Goal→Reality→Options→Will)',
    '提示：运用SBI反馈模型描述具体情境、行为和影响',
    '提示：尝试非暴力沟通NVC四步法：观察→感受→需要→请求',
  ];
  const currentHintIndex = hintThresholds.findIndex((t) => userMessageCount >= t && userMessageCount < t + 3);
  const showHint = !dismissedHint && currentHintIndex >= 0 && currentHintIndex < MANAGEMENT_THEORY_HINTS.length;

  useEffect(() => {
    setDismissedHint(false);
  }, [currentHintIndex]);

  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [messages]);

  const handleSend = () => {
    if (!inputValue.trim() || isLoading) return;
    onSendMessage(inputValue.trim(), userVoiceEmotion);
    setInputValue('');
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSend();
    }
  };

  const handleFeedback = async (messageId: string, feedbackType: 'useful' | 'not_useful') => {
    try {
      await submitFeedback({
        sessionId,
        sceneId,
        messageId,
        feedbackType,
      });
      setMessageFeedbacks(prev => ({ ...prev, [messageId]: feedbackType }));
      toast.success('感谢反馈');
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to submit feedback: ' + String(error));
      toast.error('反馈提交失败，请重试');
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card className="h-full flex flex-col border-0 shadow-sm" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #F7FAF5 0%, #FEFBF6 50%, #FFF9F2 100%)', border: '1px solid #ECE8E1' }}>
      {/* 苹果风格紧凑头部 - 只显示核心信息 */}
      <div className="shrink-0" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #F7F4EF 0%, #FDFCF9 100%)', borderBottom: '1px solid #ECE8E1' }}>
        {/* 主标题行：维度 + 场景名 + 展开按钮 */}
        <div className="px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: '#EDF5F2', color: '#5B9A8B' }}>
              {DIMENSION_NAMES[scene.dimensionId]}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs font-medium truncate" style={{ color: '#2D2A26' }}>{scene.name}</span>
          </div>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            className="h-6 px-2 text-[10px] gap-1 shrink-0"
            onClick={() => setBackgroundExpanded(!backgroundExpanded)}
            style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }}
          >
            {backgroundExpanded ? '收起' : '详情'}
            {backgroundExpanded ? <ChevronUp className="w-3 h-3" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3 h-3" />}
          </Button>
        </div>
        
        {/* 展开后的详情面板 */}
        {backgroundExpanded && (
          <div className="px-3 pb-3 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-200">
            {/* 场景卡片 */}
            <div className="rounded-lg p-2.5 mb-2" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)', border: '1px solid #ECE8E1' }}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
                <BookOpen className="w-3 h-3" style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }} />
                <span className="text-[10px] font-medium" style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }}>场景</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#4A4540' }}>{scene.scenarioContext?.situation || scene.eventBackground}</p>
              {scene.scenarioContext?.conflict && (
                <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed mt-1.5" style={{ color: '#8B6B3A' }}>
                  <span style={{ color: '#B8863E' }}>冲突：</span>{scene.scenarioContext.conflict}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* 角色双栏 */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-2">
              {/* 我的角色 */}
              <div className="rounded-lg p-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(91,154,139,0.06)', border: '1px solid rgba(91,154,139,0.15)' }}>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
                  <UserCircle className="w-3 h-3" style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }} />
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-medium" style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }}>我</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: '#2D2A26' }}>{scene.scenarioContext?.userRole || '管理者'}</p>
                {scene.scenarioContext?.userRoleContext && (
                  <p className="text-[10px] leading-relaxed mt-0.5" style={{ color: '#5A554F' }}>{scene.scenarioContext.userRoleContext}</p>
                )}
              </div>
              
              {/* 陪练对象 */}
              <div className="rounded-lg p-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(122,106,90,0.06)', border: '1px solid rgba(122,106,90,0.15)' }}>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
                  <UserCircle className="w-3 h-3" style={{ color: '#7A6A5A' }} />
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-medium" style={{ color: '#7A6A5A' }}>陪练对象</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: '#2D2A26' }}>{(() => { const npcProfiles = (scene.scenarioContext as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.npcProfiles as Array<{avatar: string; name: string}> | undefined; const selectedProfile = npcProfiles?.find((p: {avatar: string}) => p.avatar === selectedNpc); return selectedProfile?.name || scene.aiCharacter.name; })()}</p>
                <p className="text-[10px] leading-relaxed mt-0.5 line-clamp-2" style={{ color: '#5A554F' }}>{scene.aiCharacter.role} · {scene.aiCharacter.background.slice(0, 40)}...</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* 目标 */}
            <div className="rounded-lg p-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(212,165,100,0.06)', border: '1px solid rgba(212,165,100,0.15)' }}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
                <Target className="w-3 h-3" style={{ color: '#D4A564' }} />
                <span className="text-[10px] font-medium" style={{ color: '#D4A564' }}>目标</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#4A4540' }}>{scene.dialogueGoal}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <CardContent className="flex-1 p-0 overflow-hidden" style={{ minHeight: '200px' }}>
        {/* V16 Stage Clock for scene_pr_002 */}
        {sceneId === 'scene_pr_002' && (
          <div className="px-4 pt-2 pb-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              {(['开场', '诊断', '规划', '收尾'] as const).map((stage, idx) => {
                const userMsgCount = messages.filter(m => m.role === 'user').length;
                const stageRanges = [3, 6, 9];
                const currentStage = userMsgCount <= stageRanges[0] ? 0 : userMsgCount <= stageRanges[1] ? 1 : userMsgCount <= stageRanges[2] ? 2 : 3;
                const isActive = idx === currentStage;
                const isPast = idx < currentStage;
                return (
                  <React.Fragment key={stage}>
                    <div className={`flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[10px] font-medium transition-all ${isActive ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 ring-1 ring-blue-200' : isPast ? 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-400' : 'text-gray-300'}`}>
                      {isPast && <span className="text-[8px]">✓</span>}
                      {stage}
                    </div>
                    {idx < 3 && <div className={`w-3 h-px ${isPast ? 'bg-gray-300' : 'bg-gray-200'}`} />}
                  </React.Fragment>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        <ScrollArea className="h-full px-4 py-4" ref={scrollAreaRef}>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
              {messages.map((message, msgIdx) => (
                <motion.div
                  key={message.id}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.35, ease: [0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94] }}
                  className={`flex ${message.role === 'user' ? 'justify-end' : message.role === 'hint' ? 'justify-center' : 'justify-start'}`}
                >
                  {message.role === 'hint' ? (
                    message.id.startsWith('pr_whisper_') ? (
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-2 mx-auto max-w-[85%] rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(239,246,255,0.5)', border: '1px solid rgba(147,197,253,0.2)' }}>
                        <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" style={{ color: '#3B82F6' }} />
                        <span className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#3B82F6' }}>{message.content}</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : message.id.startsWith('hint_weak_') ? (
                      <div className="max-w-[80%]">
                        <WeakHintCard
                          theoryName={message.content}
                          briefDescription={message.hintContent || ''}
                          fullDescription={HINT_THEORY_MAP[message.content]}
                          onDismiss={() => onDismissHint?.(message.id)}
                        />
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="max-w-[80%] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 border" style={{ backgroundColor: '#EEF6F3', borderColor: '#B8DDD2' }}>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
                          <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }} />
                          <span className="text-xs font-medium" style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }}>知识点提示 · {message.content}</span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#2D2A26' }}>{message.hintContent}</p>
                      </div>
                    )
                  ) : message.role === 'ai' ? (
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 max-w-[85%]">
                      <div className="shrink-0 flex flex-col items-center" style={{ width: '52px', minWidth: '52px' }}>
                        <img
                          src={NPC_AVATAR_MAP[scene.id]?.[selectedNpc || ''] || AI_AVATAR_MAP[scene.id] || DEFAULT_AVATAR}
                          alt={(() => { const npcProfiles = (scene.scenarioContext as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.npcProfiles as Array<{avatar: string; name: string}> | undefined; const selectedProfile = npcProfiles?.find((p: {avatar: string}) => p.avatar === selectedNpc); return selectedProfile?.name || scene.aiCharacter.name; })()}
                          className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full object-cover"
                          style={{ border: '2px solid #FFFFFF', boxShadow: '0 1px 4px rgba(91,154,139,0.12)' }}
                          onError={(e) => {
                            const target = e.target as HTMLImageElement;
                            target.style.display = 'none';
                            const parent = target.parentElement;
                            if (parent) {
                              const fallback = document.createElement('div');
                              fallback.className = 'w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center';
                              fallback.style.cssText = 'background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5B9A8B,#7BB5A6);border:2px solid #FFFFFF;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(91,154,139,0.12)';
                              const npcProfiles = (scene.scenarioContext as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.npcProfiles as Array<{avatar: string; name: string}> | undefined;
                              const selectedProfile = npcProfiles?.find((p: {avatar: string}) => p.avatar === selectedNpc);
                              const fallbackName = selectedProfile?.name || scene.aiCharacter.name;
                              const spanEl = document.createElement('span');
                              spanEl.className = 'text-sm font-bold text-white';
                              spanEl.textContent = fallbackName[0] ?? '';
                              fallback.appendChild(spanEl);
                              parent.insertBefore(fallback, target);
                            }
                          }}
                        />
                        <span className="text-[10px] mt-1 text-center leading-tight break-words w-full px-0.5" style={{ color: '#7A7168' }}>{(() => { const npcProfiles = (scene.scenarioContext as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.npcProfiles as Array<{avatar: string; name: string}> | undefined; const selectedProfile = npcProfiles?.find((p: {avatar: string}) => p.avatar === selectedNpc); return selectedProfile?.name || scene.aiCharacter.name; })()}</span>
                        <span className="text-[9px] text-center leading-tight break-words w-full px-0.5 mt-0.5" style={{ color: '#9B9590' }}>{scene.aiCharacter.role}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      {(() => {
                        const parsedMsg = parseAIMessageContent(message.content);
                        return (
                      <div className="rounded-[18px] rounded-bl-[6px] px-3.5 py-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', border: '1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }}>
                        <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#2D2A26' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: formatSafeEmotions(parsedMsg.mainContent) }} />
                        {parsedMsg.awarenessHints.map((hint: string, hidx: number) => (
                          <div key={`ah-${hidx}`} className="flex items-start gap-2 mt-3 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(239,246,255,0.5)', border: '1px solid rgba(147,197,253,0.2)' }}>
                            <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" style={{ color: '#3B82F6' }} />
                            <span className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#3B82F6' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: formatSafeBold(hint) }} />
                          </div>
                        ))}
                        {parsedMsg.reminders.map((rem: string, ridx: number) => (
                          <div key={`rem-${ridx}`} className="flex items-start gap-2 mt-3 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,247,237,0.5)', border: '1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.2)' }}>
                            <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" style={{ color: '#D97706' }} />
                            <span className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#92400E' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: formatSafeBold(rem) }} />
                          </div>
                        ))}
                        {parsedMsg.statusText && (() => {
                          const sk = resolveStateKey(parsedMsg.statusText!);
                          const colors = STATE_COLORS[sk] || { bg: '#F9FAFB', border: '#9CA3AF', text: '#374151' };
                          const IconComp = STATE_ICONS[sk] || AlertCircle;
                          return (
                            <div className="mt-3 p-2.5 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderLeft: `4px solid ${colors.border}`, boxShadow: '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)' }}>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <IconComp className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" style={{ color: colors.text }} />
                                <span className="text-[13px] font-semibold" style={{ color: colors.text }}>当前状态：{parsedMsg.statusText}</span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })()}
                        {message.feedback && !hasEnhancedPrompt(scene.id) && (
                          <div className="mt-2 p-2 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: '#EDF5F2', border: '1px solid #C8E0D8' }}>
                            <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                              <MessageSquare className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0 mt-0.5" style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }} />
                              <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#3D7A6A' }}>{message.feedback}</p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {message.weakPointFeedback && !hasEnhancedPrompt(scene.id) && (
                          <div className="mt-2 rounded-lg overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: '#FDF5EC', border: '1px solid #E8D5B5' }}>
                            {/* 反馈头部 */}
                            <div className="px-2.5 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(212,165,100,0.15)' }}>
                              <Lightbulb className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" style={{ color: '#D4A564' }} />
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-medium" style={{ color: '#8B6B3A' }}>薄弱点反馈</span>
                            </div>
                            {/* 反馈内容 - 解析结构化内容 */}
                            <div className="px-2.5 py-2 space-y-2">
                              {(() => {
                                const content = message.weakPointFeedback || '';
                                // 提取维度定位
                                const dimensionMatch = content.match(/维度定位[：:]\s*([^\n]+)/);
                                // 提取核心问题
                                const coreIssueMatch = content.match(/核心问题[：:]\s*([^\n]+)/);
                                // 提取理论依据
                                const theoryMatch = content.match(/理论依据[：:]\s*([^\n]+(?:\n(?![\-\d]|改进行动).*)*)/);
                                // 提取改进行动
                                const actionMatch = content.match(/改进行动[：:]\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=\n\n|$)/);
                                // 提取逐句分析
                                const sentenceAnalysis = content.match(/逐句分析[：:]\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=核心问题|$)/);
                                
                                return (
                                  <>
                                    {/* 维度定位 */}
                                    {dimensionMatch && (
                                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                        <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: '#D4A564', color: '#FFFFFF' }}>
                                          {dimensionMatch[1].trim()}
                                        </span>
                                      </div>
                                    )}
                                    {/* 核心问题 */}
                                    {coreIssueMatch && (
                                      <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                                        <span className="text-[10px] font-medium shrink-0" style={{ color: '#B8863E' }}>核心问题：</span>
                                        <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#5A4A3A' }}>{coreIssueMatch[1].trim()}</p>
                                      </div>
                                    )}
                                    {/* 逐句分析 - 折叠展示 */}
                                    {sentenceAnalysis && sentenceAnalysis[1].trim() && sentenceAnalysis[1].trim() !== '未生成详细分析' && (
                                      <div className="pt-1">
                                        <details className="text-[10px]">
                                          <summary className="cursor-pointer font-medium" style={{ color: '#7A6A5A' }}>查看逐句分析</summary>
                                          <div className="mt-1.5 pl-2 space-y-1" style={{ borderLeft: '2px solid #E8D5B5' }}>
                                            {sentenceAnalysis[1].trim().split('\n').filter(line => line.trim()).map((line, idx) => (
                                              <p key={idx} className="text-[10px] leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#6A5A4A' }}>{line.trim()}</p>
                                            ))}
                                          </div>
                                        </details>
                                      </div>
                                    )}
                                    {/* 理论依据 */}
                                    {theoryMatch && (
                                      <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5 pt-1" style={{ borderTop: '1px dashed #E8D5B5' }}>
                                        <span className="text-[10px] font-medium shrink-0" style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }}>理论依据：</span>
                                        <p className="text-[10px] leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#5A6A5A' }}>{theoryMatch[1].trim()}</p>
                                      </div>
                                    )}
                                    {/* 改进行动 */}
                                    {actionMatch && (
                                      <div className="pt-1.5" style={{ borderTop: '1px dashed #E8D5B5' }}>
                                        <span className="text-[10px] font-medium" style={{ color: '#8B6B3A' }}>改进行动：</span>
                                        <div className="mt-1 space-y-1">
                                          {actionMatch[1].trim().split('\n').filter(line => line.trim().startsWith('-')).map((line, idx) => {
                                            const cleanLine = line.trim().replace(/^-\s*/, '');
                                            // 检查是否是话术模板
                                            const isTemplate = cleanLine.includes('话术') || cleanLine.includes('示例');
                                            return (
                                              <div key={idx} className={`text-[10px] leading-relaxed ${isTemplate ? 'pl-2 py-1 rounded' : ''}`} style={{ 
                                                color: isTemplate ? '#4A5A4A' : '#5A554F',
                                                backgroundColor: isTemplate ? 'rgba(91,154,139,0.1)' : 'transparent'
                                              }}>
                                                {cleanLine}
                                              </div>
                                            );
                                          })}
                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                    )}
                                    {/* 原始内容兜底展示 */}
                                    {!dimensionMatch && !coreIssueMatch && (
                                      <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#8B6B3A' }}>{content}</p>
                                    )}
                                  </>
                                );
                              })()}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                          <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: '#B0AAA3' }}>
                            {message.timestamp.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                          </span>
                          {ttsSupported && (
                            <Button
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="icon"
                              className={`h-6 w-6 p-0 ${
                                currentSpeakingId === message.id
                                  ? 'text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50'
                                  : 'text-muted-foreground/40 hover:text-muted-foreground'
                              }`}
                              onClick={() => handleSpeakMessage(message.id, message.content)}
                            >
                              {currentSpeakingId === message.id && isSynthesizing ? (
                                <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
                              ) : currentSpeakingId === message.id && (isAudioPlaying || isSpeaking) ? (
                                <VolumeX className="w-3 h-3" />
                              ) : (
                                <Volume2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                              )}
                            </Button>
                          )}
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 ml-1">
                            <Button
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="icon"
                              className={`h-6 w-6 p-0 ${
                                messageFeedbacks[message.id] === 'useful'
                                  ? 'text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100'
                                  : 'text-muted-foreground/40 hover:text-muted-foreground'
                              }`}
                              disabled={!!messageFeedbacks[message.id]}
                              onClick={() => handleFeedback(message.id, 'useful')}
                            >
                              <ThumbsUp className="w-3 h-3" />
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="icon"
                              className={`h-6 w-6 p-0 ${
                                messageFeedbacks[message.id] === 'not_useful'
                                  ? 'text-red-500 bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100'
                                  : 'text-muted-foreground/40 hover:text-muted-foreground'
                              }`}
                              disabled={!!messageFeedbacks[message.id]}
                              onClick={() => handleFeedback(message.id, 'not_useful')}
                            >
                              <ThumbsDown className="w-3 h-3" />
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        {message.thinkingPoint && (
                          <div className="mt-2 p-2.5 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: '#FDF5EC', border: '1px solid #E8D5B5' }}>
                            <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                              <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" style={{ color: '#D4A564' }} />
                              <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#8B6B3A' }}>{message.thinkingPoint}</p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                        );
                      })()}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 max-w-[85%] flex-row-reverse">
                      <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #5B9A8B, #7BB5A6)', boxShadow: '0 1px 4px rgba(91,154,139,0.15)' }}>
                        <UserCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-[18px] rounded-br-[6px] px-3.5 py-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C1917' }}>
                        <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#FFFFFF' }}>{message.content}</p>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end mt-1">
                          <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: '#9B9590' }}>
                            {message.timestamp.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </motion.div>
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>
            {isLoading && (
              <motion.div
                initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                className="flex justify-start"
              >
                  <div className="rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: '#F4F1EC' }}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ backgroundColor: '#5B9A8B', animationDelay: '0ms' }} />
                      <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ backgroundColor: '#5B9A8B', animationDelay: '150ms' }} />
                      <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ backgroundColor: '#5B9A8B', animationDelay: '300ms' }} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}
            <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
          </div>
        </ScrollArea>
      </CardContent>

      <CardContent className="pt-0 pb-3 px-4" style={{ borderTop: '1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05)', backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', backdropFilter: 'blur(16px)', WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(16px)' }}>
        {showHint && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: '#FDF5EC', border: '1px solid #E8D5B5' }}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Lightbulb className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" style={{ color: '#D4A564' }} />
              <span className="text-xs" style={{ color: '#8B6B3A' }}>{MANAGEMENT_THEORY_HINTS[currentHintIndex]}</span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setDismissedHint(true)}
              className="shrink-0 p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-black/5"
              style={{ color: '#B8863E' }}
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        {isListening && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: '#FEF2F2', border: '1px solid #FECACA' }}>
            <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center">
              <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full animate-pulse" style={{ backgroundColor: '#EF4444' }} />
              <div className="absolute w-5 h-5 rounded-full animate-ping opacity-30" style={{ backgroundColor: '#EF4444' }} />
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs font-medium" style={{ color: '#DC2626' }}>正在录音...</span>
            {interimTranscript && (
              <span className="text-xs flex-1 truncate" style={{ color: '#991B1B' }}>{interimTranscript}</span>
            )}
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              className="h-6 text-xs gap-1"
              onClick={stopListening}
              style={{ color: '#DC2626' }}
            >
              <Square className="w-3 h-3" />
              停止
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
        {isCompleted ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 pt-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(236,253,245,0.5)', border: '1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.15)' }}>
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" style={{ color: '#10B981' }} />
              <span className="text-xs" style={{ color: '#065F46' }}>对话已完成，请查看反馈报告</span>
            </div>
            <Button
              onClick={onEndCoaching}
              className="w-full h-10 rounded-[14px] text-sm font-semibold gap-2"
              style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C1917', color: '#FFFFFF' }}
            >
              查看反馈报告
              <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex items-end gap-2.5 pt-2">
              <textarea
                placeholder={isListening ? '正在听您说话...' : '输入你的回应...'}
                value={inputValue}
                onChange={(e) => setInputValue(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
                disabled={isLoading || isListening}
                rows={2}
                className="flex-1 min-h-[44px] max-h-[120px] resize-none rounded-[14px] border px-4 py-3 text-sm focus:outline-none"
                style={{ borderColor: isListening ? '#FECACA' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)', backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)', color: '#1C1917', boxShadow: 'none', transition: 'border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease', lineHeight: '1.5' }}
                onFocus={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = '#5B9A8B'; e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 0 0 3px rgba(91,154,139,0.08)'; }}
                onBlur={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)'; e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = 'none'; }}
              />
              {voiceSupported && (
                <Button
                  size="icon"
                  onClick={handleMicClick}
                  disabled={isLoading}
                  className={`shrink-0 h-10 w-10 rounded-full ${isListening ? 'animate-pulse' : ''}`}
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: isListening ? '#EF4444' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.04)',
                    color: isListening ? '#FFFFFF' : '#78716C',
                    border: 'none',
                  }}
                >
                  <Mic className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Button>
              )}
              <Button
                size="icon"
                onClick={handleSend}
                disabled={!inputValue.trim() || isLoading}
                className="shrink-0 h-10 w-10 rounded-full transition-colors duration-200"
                style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C1917' }}
              >
                <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
              </Button>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-1">
              <p className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: '#9B9590' }}>
                Enter 发送 · Shift+Enter 换行{voiceSupported ? ' · 点击麦克风语音输入' : ''}{ttsSupported ? ' · 点击喇叭朗读' : ''}
              </p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {ttsSupported && (
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={toggleAutoSpeak}
                    className="text-xs h-6 gap-1"
                    style={{ color: autoSpeakEnabled ? '#5B9A8B' : '#7A7168', backgroundColor: autoSpeakEnabled ? '#EDF5F2' : 'transparent' }}
                  >
                    {autoSpeakEnabled ? <Volume2 className="w-3 h-3" /> : <VolumeX className="w-3 h-3" />}
                    {autoSpeakEnabled ? '自动朗读' : '语音朗读'}
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onRestart} className="text-xs h-6 gap-1" style={{ color: '#7A7168' }}>
                  <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
                  重新开始
                </Button>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={onEndCoaching}
                  className="text-xs h-6 gap-1 rounded-lg"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: '#E8E3DC', color: '#6B6560', border: 'none' }}
                >
                  <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                  结束陪练
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

// ============================================
// Score Explanation Dialog
// ============================================
const ScoreExplanationDialog: React.FC<{
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  explanation: string;
  isLoading: boolean;
}> = ({ open, onOpenChange, explanation, isLoading }) => {
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[80vh] overflow-hidden">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
            评分解释
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            AI基于您的对话表现生成的评分分析
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="mt-4 overflow-y-auto max-h-[60vh]">
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="w-3 h-3 bg-primary rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: '0ms' }} />
                <div className="w-3 h-3 bg-primary rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: '150ms' }} />
                <div className="w-3 h-3 bg-primary rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: '300ms' }} />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">正在分析您的对话表现...</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="prose prose-sm max-w-none">
              <Streamdown>{explanation}</Streamdown>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
};
