// ============================================
// Main Coaching Chat Page
// ============================================
const CoachingChatPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { sceneId } = useParams<{ sceneId: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  
  const [currentScene, setCurrentScene] = useState<IScene | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'preparation' | 'door' | 'coaching' | 'summary'>('preparation');
  const [sessionStartTime, setSessionStartTime] = useState<Date | null>(null);
  const [sessionId, setSessionId] = useState<string>('');


  // 根据API返回的ICoachingScene转换为IScene
  const convertApiSceneToIScene = (apiScene: ICoachingScene): IScene => {
    return {
      ...apiScene,
      dimensionId: apiScene.dimension,
      dialogueGoal: apiScene.scenarioContext?.goal || apiScene.description,
      thinkingQuestions: [],
      eventBackground: apiScene.scenarioContext?.situation || apiScene.description,
      userRole: apiScene.scenarioContext?.userRole || '管理者',
      aiCharacter: apiScene.aiCharacter || {
        name: apiScene.aiRole,
        role: apiScene.aiRole,
        personality: '专业且热情',
        speakingStyle: '直接且真诚',
        commonPhrases: ['好的', '明白了', '我觉得'],
        background: '经验丰富的职场人士',
      },
      // 显式传递scenarioContext确保openingLine不丢失
      scenarioContext: apiScene.scenarioContext,
    };
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchScene = async () => {
      if (!sceneId) {
        toast.error('场景ID不存在，请返回陪练列表重新选择');
        navigate('/coaching');
        return;
      }

      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const apiScene = await getSceneById(sceneId);
        logger.info('[fetchScene] apiScene:', String(apiScene));
        logger.info('[fetchScene] apiScene.scenarioContext:', String(apiScene?.scenarioContext));
        if (!apiScene) {
          toast.error('场景不存在，请返回陪练列表重新选择');
          navigate('/coaching');
          return;
        }
        const convertedScene = convertApiSceneToIScene(apiScene);
        logger.info('[fetchScene] convertedScene:', String(convertedScene));
        logger.info('[fetchScene] convertedScene.scenarioContext:', String(convertedScene.scenarioContext));
        setCurrentScene(convertedScene);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Failed to fetch scene:', String(error));
        toast.error('加载场景失败，请刷新页面重试');
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchScene();
  }, [sceneId, navigate]);

  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<IChatMessage[]>([]);
  const { initialize: wfInit, processUserMessage: wfProcess, analyzeUserMessage: wfAnalyze, getRound: wfGetRound, extractPromise: wfExtract, addToHistory: wfHistory, getPromptInjection: wfGetInjection, getMoraleHistory: wfGetMoraleHistory, getPromiseList: wfGetPromiseList, getStrategyHistory: wfGetStrategyHistory, applyAIMeta: wfApplyAIMeta, incrementRound: wfIncrementRound, getConsecutiveAvoidCount: wfGetConsecutiveAvoid, getHintFrequency: wfGetHintFrequency, getConsecutiveEmotionalCount: wfGetConsecutiveEmotional, updateEmotionalCounter: wfUpdateEmotional, mergePromiseFromFrontend: wfMergePromise, reset: wfReset, primaryVariable: wfValue, variableName: wfVarName } = useWorkflowState();

  const [currentScore, setCurrentScore] = useState<IThreeDimensionsScore>(initialScore);
  const [detailedScore, setDetailedScore] = useState<IDetailedScore | undefined>(undefined);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [roundCount, setRoundCount] = useState(1);
  const [isCompleted, setIsCompleted] = useState(false);
  const lastVoiceEmotionRef = useRef<IUserVoiceEmotion | null>(null);
  const prPreviousStateRef = useRef<string>('trying');
  const prOpenQuestionCountRef = useRef(0);
  const lastResponseTimeRef = useRef<number>(Date.now());
  const [showExplanationDialog, setShowExplanationDialog] = useState(false);
  const [explanationContent, setExplanationContent] = useState('');
  const [isGeneratingExplanation, setIsGeneratingExplanation] = useState(false);
  const [knowledgeDialogOpen, setKnowledgeDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [courseKnowledge, setCourseKnowledge] = useState<{ theoryCards: Array<{ title: string; category: string; content: string; tag?: string }>; practiceCards: Array<{ title: string; category: string; content: string; tag?: string }>; totalCards: number; relevantTheories: string[] } | null>(null);
  const [knowledgeLoading, setKnowledgeLoading] = useState(false);
  const [prevSession, setPrevSession] = useState<ICoachingSession | null>(null);
  const [showHistoryDialog, setShowHistoryDialog] = useState(false);

  // 意图识别与对话状态管理
  interface IDialogueState {
    stage: 'opening' | 'exploration' | 'solution' | 'commitment' | 'closing';
    userIntent: 'concern' | 'resistance' | 'cooperate' | 'question' | 'feedback';
    emotionLevel: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
    turnCount: number;
  }

  const [dialogueState, setDialogueState] = useState<IDialogueState>({
    stage: 'opening',
    userIntent: 'concern',
    emotionLevel: 'medium',
    turnCount: 0,
  });

  // System Prompt 缓存
  const [promptOptimization, setPromptOptimization] = useState('');
  const [pressureLevel, setPressureLevel] = useState<'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | undefined>(undefined);
  const [zpdLevel, setZpdLevel] = useState<'A' | 'B' | 'C' | undefined>(undefined);
  const [selectedNpc, setSelectedNpc] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sceneId) return;
    getPromptOptimization(sceneId)
      .then((res) => setPromptOptimization(res.optimization || ''))
      .catch(() => setPromptOptimization(''));
    getSceneDifficulty(sceneId)
      .then((res) => setPressureLevel(res?.pressureLevel || undefined))
      .catch(() => setPressureLevel(undefined));
  }, [sceneId]);

  // 自动保存：对话进行中每轮消息后保存到后端
  useEffect(() => {
    const autoSave = async () => {
      if (!sessionId || sessionId.startsWith('session_')) return;
      if (phase !== 'coaching') return;
      if (messages.length === 0) return;
      try {
        await updateCoachingSession(sessionId, {
          messages: messages.map((m: IChatMessage) => ({
            id: m.id,
            role: m.role as 'user' | 'ai',
            content: m.content,
            timestamp: m.timestamp instanceof Date ? m.timestamp.toISOString() : String(m.timestamp),
            scoreChange: m.scoreChange,
          })),
          scoreResult: currentScore.result,
          scorePeople: currentScore.people,
          scoreField: currentScore.field,
          roundCount: roundCount,
          status: 'active',
        });
      } catch (err) {
        logger.error('自动保存会话失败', String(err));
      }
    };
    autoSave();
  }, [messages, sessionId, phase, currentScore, roundCount]);

  const systemPrompt = useCallback(() => {
    if (!currentScene) return '';
    const workflowData = wfGetInjection();
    let base = generateSystemPrompt(currentScene, pressureLevel, lastVoiceEmotionRef.current, workflowData, selectedNpc);
    const isL2 = selectedNpc === 'A' && (zpdLevel === 'B' || zpdLevel === 'C');
    if (zpdLevel && !isL2) {
      const ZPD_INSTRUCTIONS: Record<string, string> = {
        'A': '用户已选择经验水平：A（新手）。请使用 40:60 配方（40%觉察镜子+60%行为复盘），觉察镜子使用【直接指出模式】："你做了[具体行为]，这导致[具体后果]。更好的做法是[具体替代行为]——因为[理论解释]。"',
        'B': '用户已选择经验水平：B（中等）。请使用 50:50 配方，觉察镜子使用【提问引导模式】："你注意到[可观察的事实]了吗？你觉得[引导性问题]？"',
        'C': '用户已选择经验水平：C（高手）。请使用 70:30 配方（70%觉察镜子+30%行为复盘），觉察镜子使用【视角扩展模式】："从[理论视角]来看，你做的[具体行为]意味着[深层洞察]。如果换成[另一视角]，你觉得会怎样？"',
      };
      base = `【ZPD自适应指令】${ZPD_INSTRUCTIONS[zpdLevel]}\n\n${base}`;
    }
    if (promptOptimization) {
      return `${base}\n\n${promptOptimization}`;
    }
    return base;
  }, [currentScene, promptOptimization, pressureLevel, zpdLevel, selectedNpc, wfGetInjection]);

  // 分析用户意图
  const analyzeUserIntent = useCallback((message: string): IDialogueState['userIntent'] => {
    const lowerMsg = message.toLowerCase();
    if (lowerMsg.includes('担心') || lowerMsg.includes('害怕') || lowerMsg.includes('压力') || lowerMsg.includes('焦虑')) {
      return 'concern';
    }
    if (lowerMsg.includes('但是') || lowerMsg.includes('可是') || lowerMsg.includes('不过') || lowerMsg.includes('问题')) {
      return 'resistance';
    }
    if (lowerMsg.includes('好的') || lowerMsg.includes('明白') || lowerMsg.includes('谢谢') || lowerMsg.includes('可以')) {
      return 'cooperate';
    }
    if (lowerMsg.includes('怎么') || lowerMsg.includes('如何') || lowerMsg.includes('什么') || lowerMsg.includes('？')) {
      return 'question';
    }
    return 'feedback';
  }, []);

  const callAIForReply = useCallback(async (prompt: string, fullHistory: string): Promise<string> => {
    const MAX_PROMPT_LEN = 24000;
    const MAX_HISTORY_LEN = 6000;
    const safePrompt = prompt.length > MAX_PROMPT_LEN
      ? prompt.slice(0, MAX_PROMPT_LEN) + '\n\n[以上为完整角色设定，请基于已读内容继续对话]'
      : prompt;
    const safeHistory = fullHistory.length > MAX_HISTORY_LEN
      ? fullHistory.slice(fullHistory.length - MAX_HISTORY_LEN)
      : fullHistory;

    const doCall = async (): Promise<string> => {
      const plugin = capabilityClient.load('mdp_coach_ai_conversation_reply_1');
      const stream = plugin.callStream('textGenerate', {
        system_prompt: safePrompt,
        user_message_history: safeHistory,
      });
      let reply = '';
      for await (const chunk of stream as AsyncIterable<{ content?: string; response?: string }>) {
        const c = chunk as { content?: string; response?: string };
        if (c.content) { reply += c.content; } else if (c.response) { reply += c.response; }
      }
      return reply;
    };

    try {
      return await doCall();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const errObj = err as { name?: string; message?: string };
      if (errObj?.name === 'CapabilityNotFoundError') {
        logger.error('Plugin config missing: mdp_coach_ai_conversation_reply_1');
        return '';
      }
      const errMsg = errObj?.message || String(err);
      logger.error(`AI call failed (prompt=${safePrompt.length}, history=${safeHistory.length}): ${errMsg}`);
      try {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000));
        return await doCall();
      } catch (retryErr) {
        const retryMsg = (retryErr as { message?: string })?.message || String(retryErr);
        logger.error(`AI call retry failed: ${retryMsg}`);
        return '';
      }
    }
  }, []);

  // 智能AI回复生成 - 真实AI调用
  const simulateAIResponse = useCallback(async (userMessage: string): Promise<{ reply: string; newScore: IThreeDimensionsScore; detailedScore: IDetailedScore; feedback: string; weakPointFeedback: string; aiMeta: IAIResponseMeta | null }> => {
    if (!currentScene) {
      throw new Error('Scene not loaded');
    }

    // Analyze workflow state BEFORE generating prompt (read-only, no variable update)
    const responseTimeMs = Date.now() - lastResponseTimeRef.current;
    const analysis = wfAnalyze(userMessage, lastVoiceEmotionRef.current, responseTimeMs);
    lastResponseTimeRef.current = Date.now();
    const currentRound = wfGetRound();
    wfExtract(userMessage, currentRound);
    wfHistory('user', userMessage);

    const prompt = systemPrompt();
    const sceneIsEnhanced = hasEnhancedPrompt(currentScene.id);
    const currentTurn = `用户: ${userMessage}`;
    const dialogMessages = messages.filter((m: IChatMessage) => m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'ai');
    const recentMessages = dialogMessages.slice(-20);
    const historyStr = recentMessages
      .map((m: IChatMessage) => `${m.role === 'user' ? '用户' : currentScene.aiCharacter.name}: ${m.content}`)
      .join('\n');
    const fullHistory = historyStr ? `${historyStr}\n${currentTurn}` : currentTurn;

    let fullReply = await callAIForReply(prompt, fullHistory);
    if (!fullReply) {
      const phrases = currentScene.aiCharacter.commonPhrases || [];
      const fallbackLines = [
        `${phrases[0] || '嗯...'}，`,
        phrases[1] || '我再想想吧',
        phrases.length > 2 ? `，${phrases[2]}` : '',
      ];
      fullReply = fallbackLines.join('');
    }

    let reply = fullReply;
    let feedback = '';
    let weakPointFeedback = '';
    
    // 增强反馈解析 - 支持多行结构化内容
    // 匹配 [反馈: ...] 标签，支持多行内容直到 [薄弱点反馈 或结尾
    const feedbackMatch = fullReply.match(/\[反馈[:：]\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=\[薄弱点反馈|$)\]/);
    if (feedbackMatch) {
      feedback = feedbackMatch[1].trim();
      reply = fullReply.replace(/\[反馈[:：]\s*[\s\S]*?\](?=\n|$)/, '').trim();
    }
    
    // 匹配 [薄弱点反馈: ...] 标签，支持多行详细分析
    const weakPointMatch = reply.match(/\[薄弱点反馈[:：]\s*([\s\S]*?)\]/);
    if (weakPointMatch) {
      weakPointFeedback = weakPointMatch[1].trim();
      reply = reply.replace(/\[薄弱点反馈[:：]\s*[\s\S]*?\]/, '').trim();
    }

    const { meta: aiMeta, strategy: parseStrategy } = parseMeta(fullReply);
    let effectiveMeta: IAIResponseMeta | null = aiMeta;

    if (!effectiveMeta) {
      const retryHistory = `${fullHistory}\n${currentScene.aiCharacter.name}: ${fullReply}\n系统: 请输出本轮隐藏元数据JSON`;
      const retryReply = await callAIForReply(
        '请输出本轮的隐藏元数据JSON，格式为[META]{"morale_delta":数字,"strategy":"empathy|support|pressure|avoid","promise":"承诺内容或null","emotion":"情绪","hint_triggered":"知识点或null"}',
        retryHistory,
      );
      if (retryReply) {
        const { meta: retryMeta } = parseMeta(retryReply);
        if (retryMeta) effectiveMeta = retryMeta;
      }
    }

    if (effectiveMeta) {
      const actualRound = wfIncrementRound();
      const { delta: correctedDelta, source: correctionSource } = correctMoraleDelta(userMessage, effectiveMeta);
      const correctedMeta: IAIResponseMeta = { ...effectiveMeta, morale_delta: correctedDelta };
      if (correctionSource !== 'ai_meta') {
        logger.info(`Rule engine corrected morale_delta: ${correctedDelta} (${correctionSource})`);
      }
      wfApplyAIMeta(correctedMeta, actualRound);
    } else {
      wfProcess(userMessage, lastVoiceEmotionRef.current, responseTimeMs);
    }

    const frontendPromises = extractFrontendPromises(userMessage, currentScene?.scenarioContext ? undefined : undefined);
    const merged = mergePromises(effectiveMeta?.promise ?? null, frontendPromises);
    const promiseRound = effectiveMeta ? wfGetRound() : currentRound;
    if (merged.length > (effectiveMeta?.promise ? 1 : 0)) {
      wfMergePromise(frontendPromises, promiseRound);
    }

    if (!effectiveMeta?.hint_triggered) {
      const ruleHint = matchKnowledgeHint(userMessage, null);
      if (ruleHint) effectiveMeta = effectiveMeta ? { ...effectiveMeta, hint_triggered: ruleHint } : { morale_delta: 0, strategy: 'avoid', promise: null, emotion: 'neutral', hint_triggered: ruleHint };
    }

    reply = stripMetaFromReply(reply);
    const responseMeta = effectiveMeta;

    // Add AI reply to workflow history
    wfHistory('assistant', reply);

    // Fallback: generate structured feedback if AI didn't include tags
    // 对于国际顶尖版增强场景，不生成 fallback 反馈（完全依赖AI隐式表达）
    const isEnhancedScene = currentScene && hasEnhancedPrompt(currentScene.id);
    if (!feedback && !isEnhancedScene) {
      const userMsg = userMessage;
      if (userMsg.length > 10) {
        feedback = `你愿意和我沟通这件事让我觉得被重视了；不过我还在意你说的方案什么时候能落地`;
      } else {
        feedback = `你愿意回应我，让我觉得还有希望；不过我还在意更多具体细节`;
      }
    }
    if (!weakPointFeedback && !isEnhancedScene) {
      const weakDims = getAssessmentWeakDimensions();
      const dimNameMap: Record<string, string> = { result: '拿结果', people: '带团队', field: '传文化' };
      const focusDim = weakDims ? dimNameMap[weakDims.weakest] : '拿结果';
      // 生成更具体的结构化反馈
      weakPointFeedback = `维度定位：${focusDim}-沟通技巧
逐句分析：未生成详细分析
核心问题：缺乏针对性的沟通技巧应用
理论依据：建议学习GROW模型或SBI反馈模型，提升结构化沟通能力
改进行动：
- 立即行动：在下次沟通中先确认对方情绪，再进入问题讨论
- 话术模板："我能理解你的感受，能具体说说情况吗？"
- 学习重点：积极倾听技巧和开放式提问`;
    }

    // scene_parking_001: 前端兜底补充AI遗漏的结构化标签
    if (currentScene.id === 'scene_parking_001') {
      const actualRound = effectiveMeta ? wfGetRound() : currentRound + 1;
      const isMilestoneRound = actualRound % 3 === 0;
      const hasHint = reply.includes('【觉察提示】');
      const hasStatus = reply.includes('>> 当前状态') || reply.includes('【当前状态');
      const stateMap: Record<string, string> = { lying_flat: '躺平态', defensive: '防备态', loosening: '松动态', trying: '尝试态', collapse: '崩溃态' };
      const currentStateName = stateMap[effectiveMeta?.state || 'lying_flat'] || '躺平态';
      const appendParts: string[] = [];
      if (!hasHint && isMilestoneRound) {
        const hintTemplates = [
          '你已经用了好几次类似的鼓励方式——你觉得小王现在需要的到底是鼓励，还是别的什么？',
          '你一直在推动小王行动——但在行动之前，他的情绪是否已经被充分接住？',
          '小王的沉默让你不太舒服——你觉得这种沉默背后，他在想什么？',
          '你给了小王一个方向——你觉得这是他真正想要的，还是他觉得你在安排任务？',
          '你注意到了吗？每次你给方法时，小王的反应和给口号时完全不同——这说明了什么？',
          '这已经是你第二次强调同一个点了——小王似乎没有接住，你觉得是表达方式的问题，还是他还没准备好？',
        ];
        const templateIdx = Math.floor(actualRound / 3) - 1;
        appendParts.push(`【觉察提示】${hintTemplates[templateIdx % hintTemplates.length]}`);
      }
      if (!hasStatus && isMilestoneRound) {
        appendParts.push(`>> 当前状态：${currentStateName}`);
      }
      if (appendParts.length > 0) {
        reply = reply.trimEnd() + '\n' + appendParts.join('\n');
      }
    }

    // 增强场景完全跳过评分，保持隐式反馈设计
    if (isEnhancedScene) {
      const emptyDetailed: IDetailedScore = { result: 0, people: 0, field: 0, subScores: { result: { goalSetting: 0, execution: 0, review: 0 }, people: { goalAlignment: 0, atmosphere: 0, mechanism: 0, collaboration: 0 }, field: { valueTransmission: 0, roleModel: 0, culturePenetration: 0 } }, appliedTheories: [] };
      return { reply, newScore: currentScore, detailedScore: emptyDetailed, feedback: '', weakPointFeedback: '', aiMeta };
    }

    // ============================================
    // 专家级智能评分 - 细分子维度评分体系
    // ============================================
    const analyzeDetailedBehavior = (msg: string): IDetailedScore => {
      const msgLength = msg.length;
      const appliedTheories: IDetailedScore['appliedTheories'] = [];
      
      // 辅助函数：计算单个子维度得分
      const calculateSubDimensionScore = (
        config: typeof RESULT_SUB_DIMENSIONS.goalSetting,
        dimensionKey: string
      ): { score: number; theories: string[] } => {
        let score = 0;
        const detectedTheories: string[] = [];
        
        // 正向模式匹配
        config.positivePatterns.forEach(({ pattern, score: s, theory }) => {
          if (pattern.test(msg)) {
            score += s;
            if (!detectedTheories.includes(theory)) {
              detectedTheories.push(theory);
            }
            // 记录应用的理论
            const evidence = msg.match(pattern)?.[0] || '';
            appliedTheories.push({
              theoryName: theory,
              aspect: dimensionKey,
              score: s,
              evidence: evidence,
            });
          }
        });
        
        // 负向模式匹配
        config.negativePatterns.forEach(({ pattern, score: s }) => {
          if (pattern.test(msg)) {
            score += s; // s已经是负数
          }
        });
        
        return { score: Math.max(0, Math.min(10, score)), theories: detectedTheories };
      };
      
      // 计算拿结果子维度得分
      const resultSubScores = {
        goalSetting: calculateSubDimensionScore(RESULT_SUB_DIMENSIONS.goalSetting, '拿结果-目标设定'),
        execution: calculateSubDimensionScore(RESULT_SUB_DIMENSIONS.execution, '拿结果-执行推动'),
        review: calculateSubDimensionScore(RESULT_SUB_DIMENSIONS.review, '拿结果-复盘优化'),
      };
      
      // 计算带团队子维度得分
      const peopleSubScores = {
        goalAlignment: calculateSubDimensionScore(PEOPLE_SUB_DIMENSIONS.goalAlignment, '带团队-目标对齐'),
        atmosphere: calculateSubDimensionScore(PEOPLE_SUB_DIMENSIONS.atmosphere, '带团队-氛围营造'),
        mechanism: calculateSubDimensionScore(PEOPLE_SUB_DIMENSIONS.mechanism, '带团队-机制建设'),
        collaboration: calculateSubDimensionScore(PEOPLE_SUB_DIMENSIONS.collaboration, '带团队-分工协作'),
      };
      
      // 计算传文化子维度得分
      const fieldSubScores = {
        valueTransmission: calculateSubDimensionScore(FIELD_SUB_DIMENSIONS.valueTransmission, '传文化-价值传递'),
        roleModel: calculateSubDimensionScore(FIELD_SUB_DIMENSIONS.roleModel, '传文化-以身作则'),
        culturePenetration: calculateSubDimensionScore(FIELD_SUB_DIMENSIONS.culturePenetration, '传文化-文化传承'),
      };
      
      // 长度奖励（简洁>冗长）
      const lengthBonus = msgLength > 20 && msgLength < 200 ? 1 : msgLength >= 200 ? 0.5 : 0;
      
      // 计算总分（子维度平均分 + 长度奖励）
      const resultTotal = Math.round(
        (resultSubScores.goalSetting.score + resultSubScores.execution.score + resultSubScores.review.score) / 3 + lengthBonus
      );
      const peopleTotal = Math.round(
        (peopleSubScores.goalAlignment.score + peopleSubScores.atmosphere.score + peopleSubScores.mechanism.score + peopleSubScores.collaboration.score) / 4 + lengthBonus
      );
      const fieldTotal = Math.round(
        (fieldSubScores.valueTransmission.score + fieldSubScores.roleModel.score + fieldSubScores.culturePenetration.score) / 3 + lengthBonus
      );
      
      return {
        result: Math.max(0, Math.min(10, resultTotal)),
        people: Math.max(0, Math.min(10, peopleTotal)),
        field: Math.max(0, Math.min(10, fieldTotal)),
        subScores: {
          result: {
            goalSetting: resultSubScores.goalSetting.score,
            execution: resultSubScores.execution.score,
            review: resultSubScores.review.score,
          },
          people: {
            goalAlignment: peopleSubScores.goalAlignment.score,
            atmosphere: peopleSubScores.atmosphere.score,
            mechanism: peopleSubScores.mechanism.score,
            collaboration: peopleSubScores.collaboration.score,
          },
          field: {
            valueTransmission: fieldSubScores.valueTransmission.score,
            roleModel: fieldSubScores.roleModel.score,
            culturePenetration: fieldSubScores.culturePenetration.score,
          },
        },
        appliedTheories,
      };
    };
    
    const detailedScore = analyzeDetailedBehavior(userMessage);
    
    // 渐进式评分（前期变化大，后期变化小，模拟学习曲线）
    const roundCount = messages.filter(m => m.role === 'user').length;
    const decayFactor = Math.max(0.3, 1 - roundCount * 0.1); // 随轮次递减
    
    // 计算新总分
    const roundScore = {
      result: Math.min(100, Math.max(0, currentScore.result + Math.round(detailedScore.result * decayFactor * 1.5))),
      people: Math.min(100, Math.max(0, currentScore.people + Math.round(detailedScore.people * decayFactor * 1.5))),
      field: Math.min(100, Math.max(0, currentScore.field + Math.round(detailedScore.field * decayFactor * 1.5))),
    };
    
    // 生成细分子维度反馈
    const generateDetailedFeedback = (): string => {
      const { subScores, appliedTheories } = detailedScore;
      
      // 找出得分最低和最高的子维度
      const allSubDimensions = [
        { name: '目标设定', score: subScores.result.goalSetting, theory: 'SMART/OKR' },
        { name: '执行推动', score: subScores.result.execution, theory: 'PDCA' },
        { name: '复盘优化', score: subScores.result.review, theory: '复盘方法论' },
        { name: '目标对齐', score: subScores.people.goalAlignment, theory: '目标共识' },
        { name: '氛围营造', score: subScores.people.atmosphere, theory: '心理安全感' },
        { name: '机制建设', score: subScores.people.mechanism, theory: 'RACI' },
        { name: '分工协作', score: subScores.people.collaboration, theory: '角色分工' },
        { name: '价值传递', score: subScores.field.valueTransmission, theory: '企业文化' },
        { name: '以身作则', score: subScores.field.roleModel, theory: '领导力榜样' },
        { name: '文化传承', score: subScores.field.culturePenetration, theory: '文化仪式' },
      ];
      
      const weakest = allSubDimensions.sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score)[0];
      const strongest = allSubDimensions.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)[0];
      
      // 生成理论应用反馈
      let theoryFeedback = '';
      if (appliedTheories.length > 0) {
        const theoryNames = [...new Set(appliedTheories.map(t => t.theoryName))];
        theoryFeedback = `你运用了：${theoryNames.slice(0, 3).join('、')}。`;
      }
      
      return `[薄弱点反馈: 
维度定位：${weakest.name}（${weakest.theory}）
逐句分析：${appliedTheories.length > 0 ? appliedTheories.map(t => `检测到${t.theoryName}应用（+${t.score}分）`).join('；') : '未检测到明显的理论应用'}
核心问题：${weakest.score < 3 ? `${weakest.name}方面需要加强，建议学习${weakest.theory}` : '整体表现良好，建议继续保持'}
理论依据：${weakest.theory}强调${weakest.name}在管理实践中的重要性
改进行动：
- 立即行动：在下次对话中关注${weakest.name}相关技巧
- 话术模板：参考${weakest.theory}的具体应用方法
- 学习重点：${weakest.theory}的核心理念和实践要点
]`;
    };
    
    // 更新薄弱点反馈为细粒度版本
    if (!weakPointFeedback || weakPointFeedback.includes('未生成详细分析')) {
      weakPointFeedback = generateDetailedFeedback();
    }

    return { reply, newScore: roundScore, detailedScore, feedback, weakPointFeedback, aiMeta };
  }, [messages, currentScore, systemPrompt, currentScene]);

  // 生成评分解释
  const generateScoreExplanation = useCallback(async (): Promise<string> => {
    if (!currentScene) return '';
    
    // 模拟AI生成评分解释
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
    
    const userMessages = messages.filter(m => m.role === 'user').map(m => m.content);
    const latestMessages = userMessages.slice(-3);
    const aiMessages = messages.filter((m: IChatMessage) => m.role === 'ai');
    
    const explanations = [
      `## 您的对话表现分析

### 拿结果维度（当前 ${currentScore.result} 分）

**优点**：
- 在对话中展现了目标导向的思维，能够聚焦核心问题
- 提出了具体的解决方案，而不是停留在抱怨层面

**改进空间**：
- 可以更多地关注时间节点和里程碑设定
- 建议在提出方案时同时考虑资源需求

### 带团队维度（当前 ${currentScore.people} 分）

**优点**：
- 展现了倾听的意愿，能够理解对方的顾虑
- 使用了鼓励性的语言，有助于建立信任

**改进空间**：
- 可以更多地使用提问引导，而非直接给建议
- 建议关注对方的情绪变化，适时给予认可

### 传文化维度（当前 ${currentScore.field} 分）

**优点**：
- 保持了开放和尊重的态度
- 创造了安全的沟通环境

**改进空间**：
- 可以在对话初期更多地建立情感连接
- 建议在结束时总结共识，强化团队感

---

### AI陪练反馈

AI角色"${currentScene.aiCharacter.name}"在本轮对话中保持了稳定的角色表现，语言风格、性格特征与角色设定一致。`,

      `## 本轮对话评分解读

基于您的最近回复："${latestMessages[latestMessages.length - 1] || '...'}"

### 综合表现

您在本次对话中展现了**管理者应有的专业素养**：

1. **目标导向** ✅
   - 能够围绕核心目标展开讨论
   - 得分：${currentScore.result}/100

2. **以人为本** ✅
   - 关注对方感受，建立信任关系
   - 得分：${currentScore.people}/100

3. **氛围营造** ✅
   - 保持积极开放的沟通态度
   - 得分：${currentScore.field}/100

### AI角色表现分析

AI角色${currentScene.aiCharacter.name}保持了**稳定的角色表现**：

- 语言风格：${currentScene.aiCharacter.speakingStyle.substring(0, 20)}...
- 性格特征：${currentScene.aiCharacter.personality.substring(0, 20)}...
- 角色背景：${currentScene.aiCharacter.background.substring(0, 30)}...

### 具体建议

- 在回应对方顾虑时，可以先给予情感认同，再转向解决方案
- 尝试使用"GROW"模型：Goal（目标）→ Reality（现状）→ Options（选择）→ Will（意愿）
- 多使用开放式提问，引导对方自己找到答案`,

      `## AI评分助手分析

### 维度得分说明

| 维度 | 得分 | 评价 |
|------|------|------|
| 拿结果 | ${currentScore.result} | ${currentScore.result >= 70 ? '优秀' : currentScore.result >= 50 ? '良好' : '待提升'} |
| 带团队 | ${currentScore.people} | ${currentScore.people >= 70 ? '优秀' : currentScore.people >= 50 ? '良好' : '待提升'} |
| 传文化 | ${currentScore.field} | ${currentScore.field >= 70 ? '优秀' : currentScore.field >= 50 ? '良好' : '待提升'} |

### AI角色表现评估

AI陪练角色"${currentScene.aiCharacter.name}"(${currentScene.aiCharacter.role})在本轮对话中保持了角色一致性。

**人设特征保持**：
- ✅ 第一人称使用
- ✅ 符合${currentScene.aiCharacter.name}的语言风格
- ✅ 保持了"${currentScene.aiCharacter.commonPhrases[0]}"等角色特征

### 您的对话亮点

${latestMessages.map((msg, i) => `${i + 1}. "${msg.substring(0, 30)}..."`).join('\n')}

**分析**：
- 您的回复体现了**积极主动**的管理风格
- 能够平衡**任务目标**和**人际关系**
- 建议继续保持这种**教练式**的沟通方式

### 下一步建议

1. 继续深入探索对方的真实顾虑
2. 在适当的时候提出明确的行动建议
3. 记得在对话结束时确认双方达成的共识`,
    ];
    
    return explanations[Math.floor(Math.random() * explanations.length)];
  }, [messages, currentScore, currentScene]);

  // 处理解释得分
  const handleExplainScore = useCallback(async () => {
    if (roundCount < 2) {
      toast.info('请先进行至少一轮对话后再查看评分解释');
      return;
    }
    
    setShowExplanationDialog(true);
    setIsGeneratingExplanation(true);
    setExplanationContent('');
    
    try {
      const explanation = await generateScoreExplanation();
      setExplanationContent(explanation);
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('生成评分解释失败:', String(error));
      toast.error('生成评分解释失败，请稍后重试');
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingExplanation(false);
    }
  }, [roundCount, generateScoreExplanation]);

  const handleSendMessage = async (content: string, voiceEmotion?: IUserVoiceEmotion | null) => {
    lastVoiceEmotionRef.current = voiceEmotion || null;
    if (!currentScene) return;
    
    // 添加用户消息
    const userMessage: IChatMessage = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      role: 'user',
      content,
      timestamp: new Date(),
    };
    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMessage]);
    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      const { reply, newScore, detailedScore: newDetailedScore, feedback, weakPointFeedback, aiMeta: responseMeta } = await simulateAIResponse(content);
      
      // 保存详细评分
      setDetailedScore(newDetailedScore);

      const deviationPatterns = [
        { pattern: /你不[用要]|算了吧|无所谓|随便/i, tip: '作为管理者，回避问题可能让下属感到不被重视。试着直面问题、表达清晰的态度。' },
        { pattern: /这是你的问题|你自己看着办|跟我没关/i, tip: '推卸责任不利于建立团队信任。试着承担管理者应有的引导和协调责任。' },
        { pattern: /闭嘴|别说了|你懂什么/i, tip: '攻击性沟通会破坏对话氛围。尝试用"我理解你的感受"来开启对话。' },
        { pattern: /我不[想愿能]管|管不了/i, tip: '管理者需要面对问题而非回避。思考一下：这个问题的核心挑战是什么？你可以提供什么支持？' },
      ];
      let thinkingPoint: string | undefined;
      for (const dp of deviationPatterns) {
        if (dp.pattern.test(content)) {
          thinkingPoint = dp.tip;
          break;
        }
      }

      // 添加AI回复
      const isEnhanced = currentScene ? hasEnhancedPrompt(currentScene.id) : false;
      const aiMessage: IChatMessage = {
        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),
        role: 'ai',
        content: reply,
        timestamp: new Date(),
        scoreChange: isEnhanced ? undefined : newScore,
        feedback: isEnhanced ? undefined : feedback,
        thinkingPoint,
        weakPointFeedback: isEnhanced ? undefined : weakPointFeedback,
      };

      setMessages((prev) => {
        const newMessages = [...prev, aiMessage];

        if (currentScene.id.startsWith('scene_pr_') && responseMeta?.state) {
          const currentState = responseMeta.state;
          const prevState = prPreviousStateRef.current;
          if (currentState !== prevState) {
            const whisperTexts: Record<string, string> = {
              'defensive': prevState === 'trying' ? '别让她猜——给她事例' : '坦诚比画饼更能挽回信任',
              'loosening': '接住感受——先共情再继续',
              'trying': prevState === 'defensive' ? '她准备好了——给她一个具体方向' : '',
              'lying_flat': '信任严重受损——每句话都可能被解读为否定',
            };
            const whisperText = whisperTexts[currentState] || '';
            if (whisperText) {
              newMessages.push({
                id: `pr_whisper_${Date.now()}`,
                role: 'hint',
                content: whisperText,
                hintContent: whisperText,
                timestamp: new Date(),
              });
            }
          }
          prPreviousStateRef.current = currentState;
          wfUpdateEmotional(currentState, content);
          const isQuestion = /你觉得|怎么看|从哪开始|有什么想法|说说看|谈谈/i.test(content);
          if (isQuestion) prOpenQuestionCountRef.current++;
          else prOpenQuestionCountRef.current = 0;
          if (prOpenQuestionCountRef.current >= 3) {
            newMessages.push({
              id: `pr_whisper_q_${Date.now()}`,
              role: 'hint',
              content: '试试给她一个具体动作——不是问题',
              hintContent: '试试给她一个具体动作——不是问题',
              timestamp: new Date(),
            });
            prOpenQuestionCountRef.current = 0;
          }
        }

        if (currentScene.id === 'scene_pr_002') {
          const userMsgCount = newMessages.filter((m: IChatMessage) => m.role === 'user').length;
          const stageReminders: Record<number, string> = {
            4: '⏱ 前10分钟到了。现在进入诊断阶段——听她的想法，帮她理解差距。',
            7: '⏱ 还剩15分钟。需要从讨论过去转向规划未来——共创改进方案。',
            10: '⏱ 最后几分钟。需要形成具体约定——不是随时找我，是下周三下午3点。',
          };
          const reminderText = stageReminders[userMsgCount];
          if (reminderText) {
            const aiHasReminder = newMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => m.role === 'ai' && m.content.includes('⏱'));
            if (!aiHasReminder) {
              newMessages.push({
                id: `pr_whisper_stage_${Date.now()}`,
                role: 'hint',
                content: reminderText,
                hintContent: reminderText,
                timestamp: new Date(),
              });
            }
          }
          if (wfGetConsecutiveEmotional() >= 2) {
            newMessages.push({
              id: `pr_whisper_listen_${Date.now()}`,
              role: 'hint',
              content: '她在表达感受——先听完。不要急着给方案。',
              hintContent: '她在表达感受——先听完。不要急着给方案。',
              timestamp: new Date(),
            });
          }
        }

        const shouldShowHint = wfGetHintFrequency() >= 1 || roundCount % 2 === 1;
        if (shouldShowHint && responseMeta?.hint_triggered) {
          const hintName = responseMeta.hint_triggered;
          const hintDesc = HINT_THEORY_MAP[hintName] || `尝试运用「${hintName}」框架来改进你的沟通策略`;
          newMessages.push({
            id: `hint_${Date.now()}`,
            role: 'hint',
            content: hintName,
            hintContent: hintDesc,
            timestamp: new Date(),
          });
        } else if (shouldShowHint && wfGetConsecutiveAvoid() >= 3) {
          newMessages.push({
            id: `hint_weak_${Date.now()}`,
            role: 'hint',
            content: 'GROW模型',
            hintContent: '通过 Goal→Reality→Options→Will 四步引导对方自己找到解决方案',
            timestamp: new Date(),
          });
        }
        return newMessages;
      });
      if (!isEnhanced) setCurrentScore(newScore);
      const newRound = roundCount + 1;
      setRoundCount(newRound);

      if (newRound >= (currentScene?.maxRounds || 8)) {
        setIsCompleted(true);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('AI响应失败:', String(error));
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // HINT_THEORY_MAP is now defined at module level for shared access

  const handleStartCoaching = async (options?: { zpdLevel?: 'A' | 'B' | 'C'; selectedNpc?: string }) => {
    if (!currentScene) return;
    if (options?.zpdLevel) setZpdLevel(options.zpdLevel);
    if (options?.selectedNpc) setSelectedNpc(options.selectedNpc);
    if (currentScene.sourceCourseId) {
      setKnowledgeLoading(true);
      setKnowledgeDialogOpen(true);
      try {
        const knowledge = await getCourseKnowledge(currentScene.sourceCourseId);
        setCourseKnowledge(knowledge);
      } catch (_e) {
        setCourseKnowledge(null);
      } finally {
        setKnowledgeLoading(false);
      }
    } else {
      handleConfirmStartCoaching();
    }
  };

  const startFreshSession = async () => {
    if (!currentScene) return;
    const isPr = currentScene.id.startsWith('scene_pr_');
    if (isPr) {
      setPhase('door');
      return;
    }
    setSessionStartTime(new Date());
    const opening = generateOpeningMessage(currentScene, selectedNpc, zpdLevel);
    const openingMsg: IChatMessage = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      role: 'ai',
      content: opening,
      timestamp: new Date(),
    };
    setMessages([openingMsg]);
    setCurrentScore(initialScore);
    setRoundCount(1);
    setExplanationContent('');
    setDialogueState({
      stage: 'opening',
      userIntent: 'concern',
      emotionLevel: 'medium',
      turnCount: 0,
    });
    try {
      const session = await createCoachingSession(currentScene.id);
      setSessionId(session.id);
      wfInit(currentScene.id, session.id, zpdLevel === 'C' ? 'hard' : 'normal');
      wfHistory('assistant', opening);
    } catch (err) {
      const fallbackId = `session_${Date.now()}`;
      setSessionId(fallbackId);
      wfInit(currentScene.id, fallbackId, zpdLevel === 'C' ? 'hard' : 'normal');
      wfHistory('assistant', opening);
      logger.error('创建后端会话失败，使用本地ID', String(err));
    }
  };

  const restoreFromHistory = (session: ICoachingSession) => {
    if (!currentScene) return;
    const historyMessages: IChatMessage[] = (session.messages || []).map((m) => ({
      id: m.id,
      role: m.role as 'user' | 'ai',
      content: m.content,
      timestamp: m.timestamp ? new Date(m.timestamp) : new Date(),
      scoreChange: m.scoreChange ? { result: m.scoreChange.result, people: m.scoreChange.people, field: m.scoreChange.field } : undefined,
    }));
    if (historyMessages.length === 0) {
      startFreshSession();
      return;
    }
    setPhase('coaching');
    setSessionStartTime(new Date());
    setSessionId(session.id);
    setMessages(historyMessages);
    setCurrentScore({
      result: session.scoreResult || initialScore.result,
      people: session.scorePeople || initialScore.people,
      field: session.scoreField || initialScore.field,
      followup: initialScore.followup,
    });
    setRoundCount(session.roundCount || 1);
    wfInit(currentScene.id, session.id, zpdLevel === 'C' ? 'hard' : 'normal');
    historyMessages.forEach((m: IChatMessage) => {
      if (m.role === 'user') wfHistory('user', m.content);
      else if (m.role === 'ai') wfHistory('assistant', m.content);
    });
    setExplanationContent('');
    setDialogueState({
      stage: 'exploration',
      userIntent: 'feedback',
      emotionLevel: 'medium',
      turnCount: historyMessages.filter((m: IChatMessage) => m.role === 'user').length,
    });
    toast.success('已恢复上次对话记录，可以继续聊天');
  };

  const handleConfirmStartCoaching = async () => {
    if (!currentScene) return;
    try {
      const prev = await getLatestSessionByScene(currentScene.id);
      // 支持恢复 active（进行中）或 completed（已完成）的会话
      if (prev) {
        setPrevSession(prev);
        setShowHistoryDialog(true);
        setPhase('coaching');
        return;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('查询历史会话失败，直接开始新对话', String(err));
    }
    startFreshSession();
  };

  const [reviewAnalysis, setReviewAnalysis] = useState<IReviewAnalysisResult | null>(null);
  const [reviewLoading, setReviewLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleEndCoaching = async () => {
    setReviewLoading(true);
    // V16 Practice tracking
    try {
      const tracking = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mdp_practice_tracking') || '{}');
      const sceneKey = currentScene?.id || sceneId;
      if (!tracking[sceneKey]) tracking[sceneKey] = { count: 0, dates: [] };
      tracking[sceneKey].count += 1;
      tracking[sceneKey].dates.push(new Date().toISOString());
      tracking[sceneKey].lastDate = new Date().toISOString();
      localStorage.setItem('mdp_practice_tracking', JSON.stringify(tracking));
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    setPhase('summary');
    const sortedMessages = messages
      .filter((m: IChatMessage) => m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'ai');
    // 结束陪练时标记为 completed（消息已通过 auto-save 实时保存）
    try {
      if (sessionId && !sessionId.startsWith('session_')) {
        await updateCoachingSession(sessionId, {
          status: 'completed',
          completedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('标记会话完成状态失败', String(err));
    }
    try {
      const result = await callReviewAnalysis({
        sceneId: currentScene!.id,
        sceneName: currentScene!.name,
        dimension: currentScene!.dimensionId,
        messages: sortedMessages.map((m: IChatMessage) => ({ role: m.role as 'user' | 'ai', content: m.content })),
        moraleHistory: wfGetMoraleHistory(),
        strategyHistory: wfGetStrategyHistory(),
        promiseList: wfGetPromiseList(),
      });
      setReviewAnalysis(result);
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('AI复盘分析失败，降级为模板模式', err);
    } finally {
      setReviewLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const [selfRatedPrinciples, setSelfRatedPrinciples] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [escalationOpen, setEscalationOpen] = useState(false);
  const [escalationConcern, setEscalationConcern] = useState('');
  const [escalationSubmitting, setEscalationSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const handleEscalation = async () => {
    if (!escalationConcern.trim()) {
      toast.error('请描述你的困惑或需要指导的内容');
      return;
    }
    try {
      setEscalationSubmitting(true);
      await createEscalation({
        sceneId: sceneId || '',
        sceneName: currentScene?.name,
        escalationReason: 'need_guidance',
        userConcern: escalationConcern,
      });
      toast.success('已提交导师指导请求，导师将尽快回复你');
      setEscalationOpen(false);
      setEscalationConcern('');
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('提交导师指导请求失败', err);
      toast.error('提交失败，请重试');
    } finally {
      setEscalationSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRestart = () => {
    setPhase('preparation');
    setMessages([]);
    setCurrentScore(initialScore);
    setRoundCount(1);
    setExplanationContent('');
    setSessionStartTime(null);
    wfReset();
  };

  if (loading || !currentScene) {
    return <SceneLoadingSkeleton />;
  }

  // Preparation Phase
  if (phase === 'preparation') {
    return (
      <>
        <CoachingPreparation scene={currentScene} onStart={handleStartCoaching} onSelfAssessment={setSelfRatedPrinciples} />
        <KnowledgeCardDialog
          open={knowledgeDialogOpen}
          onClose={() => setKnowledgeDialogOpen(false)}
          onStart={handleConfirmStartCoaching}
          knowledge={courseKnowledge}
          loading={knowledgeLoading}
          courseName={currentScene.sourceCourseName}
        />
      </>
    );
  }

  if (phase === 'door') {
    return (
      <DoorTransition
        sceneId={currentScene.id}
        onComplete={() => {
          setPhase('coaching');
          setSessionStartTime(new Date());
          const opening = generateOpeningMessage(currentScene, selectedNpc, zpdLevel);
          const openingMsg: IChatMessage = {
            id: Date.now().toString(),
            role: 'ai',
            content: opening,
            timestamp: new Date(),
          };
          setMessages([openingMsg]);
          setCurrentScore(initialScore);
          setRoundCount(1);
          setExplanationContent('');
          setDialogueState({ stage: 'opening', userIntent: 'concern', emotionLevel: 'medium', turnCount: 0 });
          prPreviousStateRef.current = 'trying';
          prOpenQuestionCountRef.current = 0;
          (async () => {
            try {
              const session = await createCoachingSession(currentScene.id);
              setSessionId(session.id);
              wfInit(currentScene.id, session.id, zpdLevel === 'C' ? 'hard' : 'normal');
              wfHistory('assistant', opening);
            } catch (err) {
              const fallbackId = `session_${Date.now()}`;
              setSessionId(fallbackId);
              wfInit(currentScene.id, fallbackId, zpdLevel === 'C' ? 'hard' : 'normal');
              wfHistory('assistant', opening);
              logger.error('创建后端会话失败，使用本地ID', String(err));
            }
          })();
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  // Summary Phase
  if (phase === 'summary') {
    return (
      <CoachingSummary
        sceneId={currentScene.id}
        sceneName={currentScene.name}
        dimensionId={currentScene.dimensionId}
        messages={messages.filter(m => m.role !== 'hint')}
        initialScore={initialScore}
        finalScore={currentScore}
        roundCount={roundCount}
        maxRounds={currentScene.maxRounds}
        thinkingQuestions={currentScene.thinkingQuestions}
        sourceCourseId={currentScene.sourceCourseId}
        sourceCourseName={currentScene.sourceCourseName}
        isEnhancedScene={hasEnhancedPrompt(currentScene.id)}
        moraleHistory={wfGetMoraleHistory()}
        promiseList={wfGetPromiseList()}
        strategyHistory={wfGetStrategyHistory()}
        aiReviewAnalysis={reviewAnalysis}
        reviewLoading={reviewLoading}
        selfRatedPrinciples={selfRatedPrinciples}
        onRestart={handleRestart}
        onRequestMentor={() => setEscalationOpen(true)}
      />
    );
  }

  // Coaching Phase
  return (
    <>
    <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: '#FAFBF8' }}>
      {/* V3 Header */}
      <section className="w-full flex items-center gap-3.5 px-5 shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', backdropFilter: 'blur(16px)', WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(16px)', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05)', paddingTop: '12px', paddingBottom: '12px' }}>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => navigate('/coaching')} className="rounded-full h-8 w-8 shrink-0 hover:bg-black/5">
          <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: '#1C1917' }} />
        </Button>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #5B9A8B, #7BB5A6)' }}>
            <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white">{(() => { const np = (currentScene.scenarioContext as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.npcProfiles as Array<{avatar: string; name: string}> | undefined; const sp = np?.find((p: {avatar: string}) => p.avatar === selectedNpc); return (sp?.name || currentScene.aiCharacter.name)[0]; })()}</span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold" style={{ color: '#1C1917' }}>{(() => { const np = (currentScene.scenarioContext as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.npcProfiles as Array<{avatar: string; name: string}> | undefined; const sp = np?.find((p: {avatar: string}) => p.avatar === selectedNpc); return sp?.name || currentScene.aiCharacter.name; })()}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 ml-auto px-3 py-1 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.03)' }}>
          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: wfValue > 55 ? '#16A34A' : wfValue < 35 ? '#DC2626' : '#D97706' }} />
          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: '#78716C' }}>{wfValue > 55 ? '在听你说话' : wfValue < 35 ? '情绪在起伏' : '有些犹豫'}</span>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: '#A8A29E' }}>第 {roundCount} 轮</span>

      </section>

      {/* Main Content */}
      <section className="w-full flex-1 flex min-h-0 p-3">
        {/* Chat Interface - centered */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 max-w-[720px] mx-auto">
          <ChatInterfaceSection
            messages={messages}
            currentScore={currentScore}
            onSendMessage={handleSendMessage}
            isLoading={isLoading}
            scene={currentScene}
            onEndCoaching={handleEndCoaching}
            onRestart={handleRestart}
            sessionId={sessionId}
            sceneId={sceneId || ''}
            selectedNpc={selectedNpc}
            onDismissHint={(id: string) => setMessages(prev => prev.filter(m => m.id !== id))}
            isCompleted={isCompleted}
          />
        </div>

        {/* V3 Context Side Panel */}
        {currentScene.scenarioContext && (
          <div className="hidden lg:flex w-[240px] shrink-0 flex-col gap-3 overflow-y-auto p-3" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)', backdropFilter: 'blur(16px)', WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(16px)', borderLeft: '1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }}>
            <div className="rounded-xl p-3" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)', border: '1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04)' }}>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5" style={{ color: '#A8A29E' }}>{(() => { const np = (currentScene.scenarioContext as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.npcProfiles as Array<{avatar: string; name: string}> | undefined; const sp = np?.find((p: {avatar: string}) => p.avatar === selectedNpc); return sp?.name || currentScene.aiCharacter.name; })()}现在</div>
              <div className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#44403C' }}>{wfValue > 55 ? '情绪稳定，在认真听你说话。继续用事实引导。' : wfValue < 35 ? '情绪在低谷，需要被理解和具体方向。' : '有些犹豫，在判断你是否真的理解他的处境。'}</div>
            </div>
            {currentScene.dialogueGoal && (
              <div className="rounded-xl p-3" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)', border: '1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04)' }}>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5" style={{ color: '#A8A29E' }}>你要做到的</div>
                <div className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#44403C' }}>{currentScene.dialogueGoal}</div>
              </div>

              const sp = np?.find((p: {avatar: string}) => p.avatar === selectedNpc);
              const risk = sp?.riskSignal || currentScene.scenarioContext?.conflict;
              if (!risk) return null;
              return (
                <div className="rounded-xl p-3" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)', border: '1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04)' }}>
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5" style={{ color: '#DC2626' }}>注意</div>
                  <div className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#DC2626' }}>{risk}</div>
                </div>
              );
            })()}
          </div>
        )}

      </section>

      {/* Footer Tips */}
      <section className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-4 text-[11px] shrink-0 py-2 flex-wrap" style={{ backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderTop: '1px solid #ECE8E1', color: '#7A7168' }}>
        {['建立信任', '说明目的', '鼓励表达', '认真倾听', '积极结束'].map((name, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: '#AEAEB2' }} />
            <span>{name}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </section>

      {/* Mentor Escalation Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={escalationOpen} onOpenChange={setEscalationOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-sm">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="text-base" style={{ color: '#2D2A26' }}>请求导师指导</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription className="text-xs" style={{ color: '#7A7168' }}>
              描述你在陪练中遇到的困惑，导师将为你提供专业指导
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="text-xs font-medium mb-1 block" style={{ color: '#2D2A26' }}>你的困惑或需要指导的内容</label>
              <textarea
                value={escalationConcern}
                onChange={(e) => setEscalationConcern(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="描述你在练习中遇到的问题，或希望导师给予指导的方面..."
                className="w-full rounded-lg border text-sm p-3 min-h-[80px] resize-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-2"
                style={{ borderColor: '#ECE8E1', color: '#2D2A26', backgroundColor: '#F5F2ED' }}
              />
            </div>
            <Button
              onClick={handleEscalation}
              disabled={escalationSubmitting}
              className="w-full rounded-lg text-sm"
              style={{ backgroundColor: '#5B9A8B' }}
            >
              {escalationSubmitting ? '提交中...' : '提交请求'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>



      {/* Score Explanation Dialog */}
      <ScoreExplanationDialog
        open={showExplanationDialog}
        onOpenChange={setShowExplanationDialog}
        explanation={explanationContent}
        isLoading={isGeneratingExplanation}
      />

    </div>
    <Dialog open={showHistoryDialog} onOpenChange={setShowHistoryDialog}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <RotateCcw className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }} />
            {prevSession && prevSession.messages.length > 0 ? '发现上次对话记录' : '开始新的陪练'}
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {prevSession && prevSession.messages.length > 0
              ? '检测到您在该场景有过未完成的对话，是否继续上次的聊天？'
              : '检测到您在该场景有未完成的会话，是否重新开始陪练？'}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        {prevSession && (
          <div className="space-y-3 mt-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: '#F5F2ED' }}>
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium" style={{ color: '#2D2A26' }}>
                  {prevSession.messages.length > 0
                    ? `已完成 ${prevSession.roundCount || Math.ceil(prevSession.messages.length / 2)} 轮对话`
                    : '新会话'}
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs mt-0.5" style={{ color: '#7A7168' }}>
                  {prevSession.completedAt
                    ? `上次时间：${new Date(prevSession.completedAt).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}`
                    : prevSession.messages.length > 0
                      ? `共 ${prevSession.messages.length} 条消息`
                      : `创建于 ${new Date(prevSession.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}`}
                </p>
              </div>

            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                className="flex-1 rounded-lg"
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowHistoryDialog(false);
                  setPrevSession(null);
                  startFreshSession();
                }}
              >
                {prevSession.messages.length > 0 ? '重新开始' : '取消'}
              </Button>
              <Button
                className="flex-1 rounded-lg"
                style={{ backgroundColor: '#5B9A8B' }}
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowHistoryDialog(false);
                  restoreFromHistory(prevSession);
                  setPrevSession(null);
                }}
              >
                {prevSession.messages.length > 0 ? '继续上次对话' : '开始陪练'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
    </>
  );
};

export default CoachingChatPage;

import type { IReviewAnalysisResult } from '@shared/api.interface';

interface MsgLike {
  id: string;
  role: 'user' | 'ai' | 'hint';
  content: string;
  scoreChange?: { result: number; people: number; field: number };
}

interface StratEntry { round: number; type: string }

export const scoreLabels = [
  { key: 'result', label: '用事实说话', color: '#3B82F6' },
  { key: 'people', label: '接住了对方的情绪', color: '#10B981' },
  { key: 'field', label: '帮他看到下一步', color: '#F59E0B' },
  { key: 'followup', label: '形成了具体的约定', color: '#8B5CF6' },
];

export const prScoreLabels = [
  { key: 'factAnchor', label: '事实锚定', color: '#3B82F6' },
  { key: 'emotionCatch', label: '接住情绪', color: '#10B981' },
  { key: 'directionGive', label: '赋能方向', color: '#F59E0B' },
  { key: 'commitmentForm', label: '形成约定', color: '#EF4444' },
  { key: 'initiativeCapture', label: '抓住主动', color: '#8B5CF6' },
];

export const generateRevealText = (
  aiReview: IReviewAnalysisResult | null | undefined,
  roundCount: number
): string => {
  if (aiReview?.overallSummary) return aiReview.overallSummary;
  return `这场面谈持续了${roundCount}轮对话。你在过程中展现了管理者的思考与关注，但也有些地方可以做得更好。下面是一些你可能还没意识到的细节。`;
};

export const findKeyMoment = (
  msgs: MsgLike[]
): { content: string; analysis: string } | null => {
  const withScore = msgs.filter(
    (m) => m.role === 'user' && m.scoreChange &&
      (Math.abs(m.scoreChange.result) + Math.abs(m.scoreChange.people) + Math.abs(m.scoreChange.field)) > 0
  );
  if (withScore.length === 0) return null;
  const best = withScore.reduce((prev, cur) => {
    const p = Math.abs(prev.scoreChange!.result) + Math.abs(prev.scoreChange!.people) + Math.abs(prev.scoreChange!.field);
    const c = Math.abs(cur.scoreChange!.result) + Math.abs(cur.scoreChange!.people) + Math.abs(cur.scoreChange!.field);
    return c > p ? cur : prev;
  });
  const sc = best.scoreChange!;
  const total = sc.result + sc.people + sc.field;
  const analysis = total > 0
    ? '这句话让对话有了明显的正向转变，对方的信任感提升了。'
    : '这句话让对话出现了转折，对方的反应变得微妙。回想一下，当时是否可以多问一句？';
  return { content: best.content, analysis };
};

export const generateFork = (
  aiReview: IReviewAnalysisResult | null | undefined,
  msgs: MsgLike[]
): { actual: string; alternative: string } | null => {
  if (aiReview?.turningPoints && aiReview.turningPoints.length > 0) {
    const tp = aiReview.turningPoints[0];
    return { actual: tp.userQuote, alternative: tp.betterResponse };
  }
  const neg = msgs.filter(
    (m) => m.role === 'user' && m.scoreChange &&
      (m.scoreChange.result + m.scoreChange.people + m.scoreChange.field) < 0
  );
  if (neg.length === 0) return null;
  return {
    actual: neg[0].content,
    alternative: '可以试试先问一句"你现在最大的顾虑是什么？"，给对方一个表达真实想法的机会。',
  };
};

export const generatePattern = (
  aiReview: IReviewAnalysisResult | null | undefined,
  strategyHistory: StratEntry[] | undefined
): string => {
  if (aiReview?.personalizedTips && aiReview.personalizedTips.length > 1) {
    return aiReview.personalizedTips.slice(1).join(' ');
  }
  if (!strategyHistory || strategyHistory.length === 0) return '';
  const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
  strategyHistory.forEach((s) => { counts[s.type] = (counts[s.type] || 0) + 1; });
  const total = strategyHistory.length;
  const dominant = Object.entries(counts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0];
  if (!dominant) return '';
  const pct = Math.round((dominant[1] / total) * 100);
  const typeMap: Record<string, string> = {
    empathy: '共情倾听', support: '资源支持', pressure: '目标施压', avoid: '回避冲突',
  };
  const label = typeMap[dominant[0]] || dominant[0];
  if (pct > 50) {
    return `你在${pct}%的对话中使用了"${label}"策略。单一策略容易形成惯性，尝试在不同阶段切换方式，可能会有意想不到的效果。`;
  }
  return '你的策略分布相对均衡，这说明你在有意识地调整沟通方式。继续保持这种灵活性。';
};

      { type: 'upgrade', round: 5, quote: '我觉得你有时候面对压力会慢半拍——但我相信你能调整过来。', note: '你点出了“慢半拍”——方向对的。“我相信你能调整”不是方法，是期望。', altText: '“我注意到三个流失客户都在价格谈判最后阶段流失。下次谈判前，先跟我预演一遍。试三次，肌肉记忆就有了。”', methodBox: '绩效面谈有一个经典的失败模式叫“诊断无处方”——管理者指出了问题，但没有给出改进的具体路径。有效的绩效面谈要求每个负向反馈必须配一个可执行的发展动作。' },
      { type: 'upgrade', round: 8, quote: '你回去好好调整，有什么需要随时找我。', note: '“随时找我”等于“没时间”——她不知道什么时候合适，所以不会来。', altText: '“我们定两件事。下周三下午你带三个流失客户复盘来找我。我已经把下周三3点锁在日历上了。”', methodBox: '绩效面谈的第一杀手不是“谈得不好”——是“谈完之后什么都没变”。有效面谈的收尾铁律是：下属走出会议室时，应该能回答三个问题——“我现在的绩效是什么等级？为什么？我接下来要做的第一件事是什么？”' },
    ],
    fork: { round: 5, actual: '“我相信你能调整” → 她点头，笔记本没再翻开', alternative: '“我们拆一下——上次缩是什么时候？怎么弹回来的？” → 她自己找规律' },
    practiceExercise: '当高绩效下属说“我知道我有这个问题”——不要停在“我相信你能改”。追问：“你上次出现这个问题是什么时候？当时你是怎么反应过来的？”',
    bridgeText: '你的团队里有像小张这样的人吗——业绩不错、态度积极、但有一个自己也知道却不知道怎么改的短板？这周你做一件事：下次一对一，拿一个具体的项目案例，问她：“你回想一下——有没有哪个时刻你觉得卡住了？当时你是怎么反应过来的？”这个动作只需要你比她多问一层。',
    keyFindings: [
      { type: 'good', text: '开场用数据，她翻开了笔记本' },
      { type: 'warn', text: '诊断无处方——停在“我相信你”' },
      { type: 'warn', text: '收尾无约定——“随时找我”=没时间' },
      { type: 'pattern', text: '模式：对高绩效者用信任替代方向' },
    ],
    commitmentProposal: '当高绩效下属说“我知道我有这个问题”——追问：“上次出现是什么时候？怎么反应过来的？”',
  },
};

const dimensionConfig = {
  result: { name: '拿结果', icon: Target, color: 'text-emerald-600', bg: 'bg-emerald-50', bar: 'bg-emerald-500' },
  people: { name: '带团队', icon: Users, color: 'text-blue-600', bg: 'bg-blue-50', bar: 'bg-blue-500' },
  field: { name: '传文化', icon: Heart, color: 'text-amber-600', bg: 'bg-amber-50', bar: 'bg-amber-500' },
};

const ScoreChangeIcon: React.FC<{ change: number }> = ({ change }) => {
  if (change > 0) return <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />;
  if (change < 0) return <TrendingDown className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />;
  return <Minus className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" />;
};

const CoachingSummary: React.FC<CoachingSummaryProps> = ({
  sceneId,
  sceneName,
  dimensionId,
  messages,
  initialScore,
  finalScore,
  roundCount,
  maxRounds,
  thinkingQuestions,
  sourceCourseId,
  sourceCourseName,
  isEnhancedScene = false,
  moraleHistory,
  promiseList,
  strategyHistory,
  aiReviewAnalysis,
  reviewLoading,
  selfRatedPrinciples,
  onRestart,
  onRequestMentor,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dimension = dimensionConfig[dimensionId as keyof typeof dimensionConfig] ?? { name: '未知', icon: Target, color: 'bg-stone-50/70 text-stone-700', badge: 'bg-stone-500', gradient: 'from-stone-400 to-stone-500', bar: 'bg-stone-400' };
  const DimensionIcon = dimension.icon;

  const [actionPlan, setActionPlan] = useState('');
  const [actionPlanCommitted, setActionPlanCommitted] = useState(false);
  const [committedDate, setCommittedDate] = useState<string>('');
  const [courseCards, setCourseCards] = useState<IKnowledgeCard[]>([]);
  const hasShownPointsToastRef = useRef(false);
  const [earnedPoints, setEarnedPoints] = useState<number>(0);


  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasShownPointsToastRef.current) {
      hasShownPointsToastRef.current = true;
      awardPoints('coaching_complete', 40, '完成AI陪练', sceneId).then((result) => {
        const pts = result?.totalPoints ? 40 : 40;
        setEarnedPoints(pts);
        toast.success(`完成AI陪练获得${pts}积分！`);
      });
    }
  }, [sceneId]);

  const handleExportPDF = () => {
    const doc = new jsPDF();

    if (isEnhancedScene) {
      doc.setFontSize(16);
      doc.text(`${sceneName} - Report`, 20, 20);
      doc.setFontSize(11);
      doc.text(`Date: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}`, 20, 32);
      doc.text(`Rounds: ${roundCount} / ${maxRounds}`, 20, 40);

      let y = 55;
      if (moraleHistory && moraleHistory.length > 1) {
        doc.setFontSize(14);
        doc.text('Morale Curve', 20, y);
        doc.setFontSize(10);
        y += 8;
        moraleHistory.forEach((m: IMoraleHistoryEntry) => {
          const changeStr = m.change > 0 ? `+${m.change}` : `${m.change}`;
          const line = `Round ${m.round}: Morale ${m.value} (${changeStr}) - ${m.event}`;
          doc.text(line, 20, y);
          y += 6;
          if (y > 270) { doc.addPage(); y = 20; }
        });
      }

      if (strategyHistory && strategyHistory.length > 0) {
        y += 8;
        doc.setFontSize(14);
        doc.text('Strategy Distribution', 20, y);
        doc.setFontSize(10);
        y += 8;
        const sc: Record<string, number> = { empathy: 0, support: 0, pressure: 0, avoid: 0 };
        strategyHistory.forEach((s: IStrategyEntry) => { sc[s.type]++; });
        const total = strategyHistory.length;
        const labelMap: Record<string, string> = { empathy: 'Empathy', support: 'Support', pressure: 'Pressure', avoid: 'Avoid' };
        const expertMap: Record<string, number> = { empathy: 40, support: 40, pressure: 20, avoid: 0 };
        Object.keys(sc).forEach((key) => {
          const pct = total > 0 ? Math.round((sc[key] / total) * 100) : 0;
          doc.text(`${labelMap[key]}: ${sc[key]}x (${pct}%) vs Expert: ${expertMap[key]}%`, 20, y);
          y += 6;
        });
      }

      const validPromises = promiseList?.filter((p: IPromiseEntry) => p.content && typeof p.content === 'string' && p.content.trim().length > 0 && p.content.trim() !== 'null' && p.content.trim() !== 'undefined') || [];
      if (validPromises.length > 0) {
        y += 8;
        doc.setFontSize(14);
        doc.text('Commitment Check', 20, y);
        doc.setFontSize(10);
        y += 8;
        validPromises.forEach((p: IPromiseEntry) => {
          const status = p.fulfilled ? 'Fulfilled' : 'Pending';
          const roundLabel = p.round > 0 ? p.round : '?';
          doc.text(`Round ${roundLabel}: "${p.content.slice(0, 60)}" - ${status}`, 20, y);
          y += 6;
          if (y > 270) { doc.addPage(); y = 20; }
        });
      }

      if (y > 240) { doc.addPage(); y = 20; }
      y += 8;
      doc.setFontSize(14);
      doc.text('Action Plan', 20, y);

      doc.save(`coaching-report-${Date.now()}.pdf`);
      toast.success('Report exported');
      return;
    }

    doc.setFontSize(18);
    doc.text('AI Coaching Report', 20, 20);
    doc.setFontSize(12);
    doc.text(`Scene: ${sceneName}`, 20, 35);
    doc.text(`Date: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}`, 20, 45);
    doc.text(`Rounds: ${roundCount} / ${maxRounds}`, 20, 55);
    doc.setFontSize(14);
    doc.text('Scores', 20, 70);
    doc.setFontSize(11);
    doc.text(`Management Understanding (Result): ${finalScore.result}`, 20, 82);
    doc.text(`Communication Skills (People): ${finalScore.people}`, 20, 92);
    doc.text(`Goal Achievement (Field): ${finalScore.field}`, 20, 102);
    doc.text(`Average: ${avgFinal}`, 20, 112);
    doc.setFontSize(14);
    doc.text('Key Feedback', 20, 128);
    doc.setFontSize(10);
    let y = 138;
    getImprovementTips().slice(0, 5).forEach((tip: string) => {
      const lines = doc.splitTextToSize(tip, 170);
      doc.text(lines, 20, y);
      y += lines.length * 5 + 3;
    });
    if (keyMoments.length > 0) {
      y += 5;
      doc.setFontSize(14);
      doc.text('Key Dialogue Moments', 20, y);
      y += 10;
      doc.setFontSize(10);
      keyMoments.slice(0, 3).forEach((msg) => {
        const lines = doc.splitTextToSize(msg.content.slice(0, 200), 170);
        doc.text(lines, 20, y);
        y += lines.length * 5 + 3;
      });
    }
    doc.save(`coaching-report-${Date.now()}.pdf`);
    toast.success('报告已导出');
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sourceCourseId) return;
    getCourseById(sourceCourseId).then((course) => {
      if (course?.knowledgeCards) {
        const priority: Record<string, number> = { theory: 0, concept: 1, practice: 2, case: 3 };
        const sorted = [...course.knowledgeCards].sort(
          (a, b) => (priority[a.category] ?? 9) - (priority[b.category] ?? 9)
        );
        setCourseCards(sorted.slice(0, 6));
      }
    }).catch(() => {});
  }, [sourceCourseId]);

  const weakDimKeys: string[] = [];
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('mdp_assessment_scores');
    if (stored) {
      const scores = JSON.parse(stored);
      if (scores && typeof scores === 'object') {
        const dims = [
          { key: 'result', score: Number(scores.result) || 0 },
          { key: 'people', score: Number(scores.people) || 0 },
          { key: 'field', score: Number(scores.field) || 0 },
        ].sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score);
        weakDimKeys.push(dims[0].key, dims[1].key);
      }
    }
  } catch {}
  const isWeakDimension = dimensionId && weakDimKeys.includes(dimensionId);

  const scoreChanges = {
    result: finalScore.result - initialScore.result,
    people: finalScore.people - initialScore.people,
    field: finalScore.field - initialScore.field,
  };

  const totalChange = scoreChanges.result + scoreChanges.people + scoreChanges.field;
  const avgFinal = Math.round((finalScore.result + finalScore.people + finalScore.field) / 3);

  const getPerformanceLabel = (score: number): { label: string; color: string } => {
    if (score >= 80) return { label: '优秀', color: 'text-emerald-600' };
    if (score >= 60) return { label: '良好', color: 'text-blue-600' };
    if (score >= 40) return { label: '待提升', color: 'text-amber-600' };
    return { label: '需加强', color: 'text-red-600' };
  };

  const performance = getPerformanceLabel(avgFinal);

  const getImprovementTips = (): string[] => {
    const tips: string[] = [];
    const dimTipMap: Record<string, Record<string, string>> = {
      result: {
        negative: '在目标设定与执行追踪方面可以更明确，建议多用SMART原则设定目标，并用OKR方法拆解关键结果',
        positive: '拿结果维度表现不错，可进一步强化目标复盘习惯，用PDCA循环持续改进',
      },
      people: {
        negative: '团队沟通中可以尝试更多开放式提问，运用GROW模型引导下属自主思考，而非直接给答案',
        positive: '带团队维度表现良好，可进一步运用情境领导理论(SLII)因人而异地调整管理风格',
      },
      field: {
        negative: '团队氛围建设需要更多关注，建议用非暴力沟通(NVC)四步法建立更深层的信任与连接',
        positive: '传文化维度表现不错，可通过乔哈里视窗扩大公开区，进一步深化团队沟通质量',
      },
    };

    let weakDims: string[] = [];
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem('mdp_assessment_scores');
      if (stored) {
        const scores = JSON.parse(stored);
        if (scores && typeof scores === 'object') {
          const dims = [
            { key: 'result', score: Number(scores.result) || 0 },
            { key: 'people', score: Number(scores.people) || 0 },
            { key: 'field', score: Number(scores.field) || 0 },
          ].sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score);
          weakDims = [dims[0].key, dims[1].key];
        }
      }
    } catch {}

    const allDims = weakDims.length > 0 ? [...weakDims, Object.keys(dimTipMap).find(d => !weakDims.includes(d))!] : ['result', 'people', 'field'];
    allDims.forEach(dim => {
      const change = scoreChanges[dim as keyof typeof scoreChanges];
      const tipSet = dimTipMap[dim];
      if (!tipSet) return;
      tips.push(change < 0 ? tipSet.negative : tipSet.positive);
    });

    if (totalChange >= 10) tips.push('整体表现出色，沟通策略有效，建议继续保持这种互动方式');
    if (totalChange < -5) tips.push('建议在对话中更聚焦于核心目标，避免被对方的情绪带偏方向');
    if (tips.length === 0) tips.push('表现稳定，可以在某些细节上继续精进');
    return tips;
  };

  const actionPlanPlaceholder = isWeakDimension
    ? `例如（针对${dimensionConfig[dimensionId as keyof typeof dimensionConfig]?.name ?? '未知'}维度薄弱项）：
1. 结合《${sourceCourseName || '课程'}》的核心理论，制定具体的改进计划
2. 在日常管理中刻意练习相关技巧，每周至少一次
3. 定期复盘改进效果，记录进步和待提升之处`
    : `例如：
1. 下周开始，每周与团队成员进行一次15分钟的一对一沟通
2. 在设定目标时，使用SMART原则确保目标清晰可衡量
3. 遇到抵触情绪时，先倾听再回应，使用开放式提问...`;

  const handleSaveActionPlan = async () => {
    if (!actionPlan.trim()) {
      toast.warning('请先填写行动计划');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const result = await commitActionPlan({
        sceneId: sceneId,
        sceneName: sceneName,
        actionPlan: actionPlan.trim(),
      });
      setActionPlanCommitted(true);
      const followUpDate = new Date();
      followUpDate.setDate(followUpDate.getDate() + (result.followUpDays || 7));
      setCommittedDate(followUpDate.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN'));
      toast.success('行动计划已保存，7天后将收到追踪提醒');
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('保存失败，请重试');
    }
  };

  const aiMessages = messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'ai');
  const keyMoments = messages.filter((m) => m.scoreChange && (
    (m.scoreChange.result !== 0) || (m.scoreChange.people !== 0) || (m.scoreChange.field !== 0)
  )).slice(-3);

  const tips = aiReviewAnalysis?.personalizedTips && aiReviewAnalysis.personalizedTips.length > 0
    ? aiReviewAnalysis.personalizedTips
    : getImprovementTips();

  const finalActionPlanPlaceholder = aiReviewAnalysis?.actionPlanSuggestion || actionPlanPlaceholder;

  const revealText = generateRevealText(aiReviewAnalysis, roundCount);
  const keyMoment = findKeyMoment(messages);
  const fork = generateFork(aiReviewAnalysis, messages);
  const patternText = generatePattern(aiReviewAnalysis, strategyHistory);
  const insightText = aiReviewAnalysis?.personalizedTips?.[0] || '';
  const nextStepText = aiReviewAnalysis?.actionPlanSuggestion
    || (aiReviewAnalysis?.personalizedTips && aiReviewAnalysis.personalizedTips.length > 1
      ? aiReviewAnalysis.personalizedTips[aiReviewAnalysis.personalizedTips.length - 1]
      : tips[tips.length - 1] || '下次面谈时，尝试在开场先问一个开放式问题，让对方感受到被倾听。');
  const v3Scores = { result: finalScore.result, people: finalScore.people, field: finalScore.field, followup: finalScore.followup || 0 };

  const V3Label: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => (
    <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-stone-400 mb-2.5">{children}</p>
  );

  const isPrScene = sceneId.startsWith('scene_pr_');
  if (isPrScene) {
    const prDimensions = calculatePRDimensions(
      messages.filter((m: IChatMessage) => m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'ai'),
      aiReviewAnalysis,
      finalScore,
    );
    const prTemplate = PR_FEEDBACK_TEMPLATES[sceneId];

    let dynamicStructureCompliance = prTemplate?.structureCompliance;
    let dynamicStageClockSummary = prTemplate?.stageClockSummary;
    let learningCurveData: { currentScores: number[]; previousScores: number[]; dimensionNames: string[]; practiceCount: number } | undefined;
    let prPrincipleScores: Array<{ name: string; score: number; verdict: string }> | undefined;
    let prLearningRecommendation: string | undefined;
    if (sceneId === 'scene_pr_002') {
      const userMessages = messages.filter((m: IChatMessage) => m.role === 'user');
      const total = userMessages.length || 1;
      const openingCount = Math.min(userMessages.length, 3);
      const diagnosisCount = Math.max(0, Math.min(userMessages.length, 6) - 3);
      const planningCount = Math.max(0, Math.min(userMessages.length, 9) - 6);
      const closingCount = Math.max(0, userMessages.length - 9);
      const pct = (n: number) => Math.round((n / total) * 100);
      const op = pct(openingCount);
      const dg = pct(diagnosisCount);
      const pl = pct(planningCount);
      const cl = pct(closingCount);
      dynamicStructureCompliance = `面谈结构遵守度：开场占${op}%、诊断占${dg}%、规划占${pl}%、收尾占${cl}%。C级理想结构：诊断40%+规划40%。`;
      const weakStage = dg < 25 ? '诊断阶段' : pl < 25 ? '规划阶段' : cl < 10 ? '收尾阶段' : '';
      dynamicStageClockSummary = weakStage
        ? `${weakStage}占比不足——下一次面谈，在诊断阶段结束后用不超过2轮切换到规划，收尾必须形成带时间的约定。`
        : '结构均衡，四个阶段都有覆盖。走出这间会议室后，今天的信任归零——下一次面谈从新开始。';

      // V18 五原则评分
      const userTexts = messages.filter((m: IChatMessage) => m.role === 'user').map((m: IChatMessage) => m.content);

      const trustScore = 55
        + (userTexts.some((t: string) => /我理解|你的感受|不容易/.test(t)) ? 8 : 0)
        + (!userTexts.some((t: string) => /不够努力|态度问题|你看人家|横向比较/.test(t)) ? 10 : -25)
        + (userTexts.some((t: string) => /上次没|我的问题|我应该/.test(t)) ? 8 : 0);
      const purposeScore = 50
        + (userTexts.some((t: string) => /C级|等级|评估/.test(t)) ? 10 : 0)
        + (userTexts.some((t: string) => /返工|数据|细节错误|补位/.test(t)) ? 12 : 0)
        + (userTexts.some((t: string) => /今天分|先回顾/.test(t)) ? 5 : 0)
        - (userTexts.some((t: string) => /加油|相信你(?!.*具体)/.test(t)) ? 5 : 0);
      const encourageScore = 50
        + (userTexts.some((t: string) => /你觉得|你怎么看|先说说|你的想法/.test(t)) ? 8 : 0)
        - (!userTexts.some((t: string) => /你觉得|你怎么看|先说说/.test(t)) ? 5 : 0);
      const listenScore = 50
        + (userTexts.some((t: string) => /我理解|我知道|你的感受|听到了/.test(t)) ? 10 : 0)
        + (userTexts.some((t: string) => /努力但方向|不是不认真|有效努力/.test(t)) ? 10 : 0);
      const endScore = 45
        + (userTexts.some((t: string) => /下周三|每月|每周|具体日期|日程/.test(t)) ? 12 : 0)
        + (userTexts.some((t: string) => /我会|我帮你|一起|支持/.test(t)) ? 5 : 0);

      const clamp = (v: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v));
      prPrincipleScores = [
        { name: '建立信任', score: clamp(trustScore), verdict: trustScore >= 70 ? '建立了良好信任基础' : trustScore >= 50 ? '信任基础尚可，仍有提升空间' : '信任受到较大挑战' },
        { name: '说明目的', score: clamp(purposeScore), verdict: purposeScore >= 70 ? '清晰传达了评估依据' : purposeScore >= 50 ? '有说明但不够充分' : '目的说明不足' },
        { name: '鼓励表达', score: clamp(encourageScore), verdict: encourageScore >= 70 ? '有效引导了对方表达' : encourageScore >= 50 ? '有一定引导但空间不足' : '未充分引导对方表达' },
        { name: '认真倾听', score: clamp(listenScore), verdict: listenScore >= 70 ? '展现了良好的倾听能力' : listenScore >= 50 ? '有倾听但情绪回应不足' : '倾听能力需要加强' },
        { name: '积极结束', score: clamp(endScore), verdict: endScore >= 70 ? '形成了具体的跟进约定' : endScore >= 50 ? '有收尾但不够具体' : '收尾过于模糊' },
      ];

      const weakest = prPrincipleScores.reduce((min, p) => p.score < min.score ? p : min, prPrincipleScores[0]);
      const theoryMap: Record<string, string> = {
        '建立信任': '心理安全是坦诚对话的前提',
        '说明目的': '用事实而非判断来支撑结论',
        '鼓励表达': '让对方先说，才能了解真实想法',
        '认真倾听': '接住情绪才能推进理性讨论',
        '积极结束': '具体约定是改变发生的起点',
      };

      const seedInitial = { result: 50, people: 45, field: 48 };
      const hasPrevious = initialScore.result !== seedInitial.result || initialScore.people !== seedInitial.people || initialScore.field !== seedInitial.field;
      if (hasPrevious) {

          currentScores: [finalScore.result, finalScore.people, finalScore.field],
          previousScores: [initialScore.result, initialScore.people, initialScore.field],

    // Merge AI results with template fallback
    const prMethodBox = aiReviewAnalysis?.prMethodBox || prTemplate?.methodBox || '';
    const prVerdictText = aiReviewAnalysis?.prVerdict || prTemplate?.verdict || '';
    const prPatternName = aiReviewAnalysis?.prPatternName || prTemplate?.patternName || '';
    const prPatternText = aiReviewAnalysis?.prPatternText || prTemplate?.patternText || '';
    const prReflect = prTemplate?.reflect || '';
    const prPatternBox = prTemplate?.patternBox || '';

    const prCommitmentProposal = aiReviewAnalysis?.prCommitmentProposal || prTemplate?.commitmentProposal || '';

    // Build findings: AI prBehaviorFindings > template findings > dynamic fallback
    const aiFindings = aiReviewAnalysis?.prBehaviorFindings;

    const prFindings: Array<{ type: 'keep' | 'upgrade'; round: number; quote: string; note: string; alternative?: string; reflect?: string; methodBox?: string }> = [];
    if (aiFindings && aiFindings.length > 0) {

          type: f.type,
          round: f.round,
          quote: f.quote,

    const prNarrative = aiReviewAnalysis?.overallSummary || generateRevealText(aiReviewAnalysis, roundCount);

    // Build fork: AI prFork > template fork > dynamic fallback
    const aiFork = aiReviewAnalysis?.prFork;
    const templateFork = prTemplate?.fork;
    let prFork: { round: number; actualPath: string; altPath: string } | undefined;
    if (aiFork) {
      prFork = { round: aiFork.round, actualPath: aiFork.actual, altPath: aiFork.alternative };
    } else if (templateFork) {
      prFork = { round: templateFork.round, actualPath: templateFork.actual, altPath: templateFork.alternative };

      prFork = km ? { round: Math.min(roundCount, 5), actualPath: km.content, altPath: '\u5982\u679C\u5F53\u65F6\u6362\u4E00\u79CD\u8868\u8FBE\u65B9\u5F0F\u2014\u2014\u8BA9\u5BF9\u65B9\u81EA\u5DF1\u627E\u89C4\u5F8B' } : undefined;

    const aiKeyFindings = aiReviewAnalysis?.prKeyFindings;
    const templateKeyFindings = prTemplate?.keyFindings;

    if (aiKeyFindings && aiKeyFindings.length > 0) {
      const iconMap: Record<string, string> = { good: '\u2705', warn: '\u26A0\uFE0F', pattern: '\uD83D\uDD04' };
      prKeyFindings = aiKeyFindings.map((kf: { type: string; text: string }) => ({ icon: iconMap[kf.type] || '\u2705', text: kf.text }));
    } else if (templateKeyFindings && templateKeyFindings.length > 0) {

      <style jsx>{`
        .v3-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);border-radius:20px;padding:28px 24px;margin-bottom:16px;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.03)}
        .v3-insight{background:rgba(239,246,255,.5);border:1px solid rgba(147,197,253,.2);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 18px}
        .v3-fork{background:rgba(254,243,199,.3);border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,.15);border-radius:14px;padding:16px}
        .v3-fork-a{background:rgba(254,226,226,.4);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.08);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px}
        .v3-fork-b{background:rgba(209,250,229,.4);border:1px solid rgba(16,185,129,.08);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px}
        .v3-pat{background:rgba(243,232,255,.4);border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,.2);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 18px}
        .v3-bar{width:60px;height:4px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.06);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden}
        .v3-done{background:rgba(209,250,229,.4);border:1px solid rgba(16,185,129,.15);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px}

      {reviewLoading && (

          <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-50 to-teal-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-2xl p-6 text-center">
            <div className="animate-pulse flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
              <FlaskConical className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 animate-spin" />
