import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { SCENE_VARIABLE_CONFIG, type SceneVariableConfig, type WorkflowPromptData } from './workflow-config';
import type { IAIResponseMeta, AIStrategyType } from '@shared/api.interface';

interface IVoiceEmotion {
  label: string;
  wordsPerMinute: number;
  pauseCount: number;
  hesitationCount: number;
  speechRate: 'fast' | 'normal' | 'slow';
}

const WF_STORAGE_KEYS = {
  morale: 'wf_morale',
  promises: 'wf_promises',
  strategies: 'wf_strategies',
  value: 'wf_value',
} as const;

interface IMoraleHistoryEntry {
  round: number;
  value: number;
  change: number;
  event: string;
}

interface IStrategyEntry {
  round: number;
  type: 'empathy' | 'support' | 'pressure' | 'avoid';
}

interface IPromiseEntry {
  content: string;
  round: number;
  fulfilled: boolean;
}

const EMPATHY_PATTERN = /我理解|别着急|家里还好吗|需要帮忙吗|关心|辛苦|不容易|不着急|孩子|住院|还好吗|知道你有压力|理解你的|尊重|信任|不是你的错|一起找方法|我理解你忙/;
const SUPPORT_PATTERN = /我帮你|申请折扣|协调|资源|工具|折扣|优惠|方案|话术|组合|名单|梳理|帮你|协助|支持|争取|一起|陪你|一起学|一起想|一起排|一起商量|一起找|折中|局部优化|分期|试点|分阶段|关键区域|优先级|资源池/;
const PRESSURE_PATTERN = /怎么总是|拖延|不行|没用|算了|再这样下去|保不了你|我不管|你行你来|怎么回事|你怎么|怪你|不可能|太贵|你不懂|必须按我的|没法谈|业绩太差|能力不行|不想干|找你们领导|一直这样|改不了|你们不懂|按规范|不关我事|都必须给|公司规定|别人都可以|你不懂业务/;

const computeTextFeatures = (msg: string, responseTimeMs: number) => ({
  exclamationCount: Math.min((msg.match(/！/g) || []).length, 3),
  hasHesitation: /可能|也许|不知道|唉|哎/.test(msg),
  negationCount: (msg.match(/不|没|无/g) || []).length,
  positiveCount: (msg.match(/好|行|可以|嗯|对/g) || []).length,
  isShortMessage: msg.length < 5,
  isSlowResponse: responseTimeMs > 10000,
});

const VOICE_FACTOR_MAP: Record<string, number> = {
  agitated: 1.3,
  hesitant: 1.2,
  anxious: 1.25,
  tired: 1.15,
};

const computeEmotionFactor = (
  features: ReturnType<typeof computeTextFeatures>,
  voiceLabel?: string,
): number => {
  let factor = 1.0;
  if (features.exclamationCount >= 2) factor *= 1.2;
  if (features.hasHesitation) factor *= 1.15;
  if (features.negationCount >= 2) factor *= 1.1;
  if (features.isShortMessage) factor *= 1.1;
  if (features.positiveCount >= 2) factor *= 0.9;
  if (features.isSlowResponse) factor *= 1.05;
  if (voiceLabel) {
    const vf = VOICE_FACTOR_MAP[voiceLabel];
    if (vf) factor *= vf;
  }
  return Math.min(1.8, Math.max(0.6, factor));
};

const describeEmotion = (factor: number): string => {
  if (factor >= 1.3) return '用户情绪激动，语气强烈，需要安抚';
  if (factor >= 1.1) return '用户有些犹豫或焦虑，需要耐心引导';
  if (factor <= 0.9) return '用户态度积极正面，可以加快节奏';
  return '用户情绪平稳';
};

const classifyStrategy = (msg: string): 'empathy' | 'support' | 'pressure' | 'avoid' => {
  if (EMPATHY_PATTERN.test(msg)) return 'empathy';
  if (SUPPORT_PATTERN.test(msg)) return 'support';
  if (PRESSURE_PATTERN.test(msg)) return 'pressure';
  return 'avoid';
};

const describeEvent = (change: number, msg: string): string => {
  if (change > 0) {
    if (EMPATHY_PATTERN.test(msg)) return '共情关怀';
    if (SUPPORT_PATTERN.test(msg)) return '提供支持';
    return '正向互动';
  }
  if (change < 0) {
    if (PRESSURE_PATTERN.test(msg)) return '施压批评';
    return '负向互动';
  }
  return '中性对话';
};

export const useWorkflowState = () => {
  const cfgRef = useRef<SceneVariableConfig | null>(null);
  const valRef = useRef(0);
  const histRef = useRef<Array<{ role: string; content: string }>>([]);
  const promRef = useRef<IPromiseEntry[]>([]);
  const dirRef = useRef<'up' | 'down' | null>(null);
  const consRef = useRef(0);
  const lastMsgRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const moraleHistoryRef = useRef<IMoraleHistoryEntry[]>([]);
  const strategyHistoryRef = useRef<IStrategyEntry[]>([]);
  const lastFactorRef = useRef(1.0);
  const roundRef = useRef(0);
  const sessionIdRef = useRef<string>('');
  const consecutiveAvoidRef = useRef(0);
  const lastStateRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const hintFrequencyRef = useRef(1.0);
  const consecutiveEmotionalRef = useRef(0);

  const [primaryVariable, setPrimaryVariable] = useState(0);
  const [variableName, setVariableName] = useState('');

  const saveToStorage = useCallback(() => {
    const sid = sessionIdRef.current;
    if (!sid) return;
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem(`${WF_STORAGE_KEYS.morale}_${sid}`, JSON.stringify(moraleHistoryRef.current));
      sessionStorage.setItem(`${WF_STORAGE_KEYS.promises}_${sid}`, JSON.stringify(promRef.current));
      sessionStorage.setItem(`${WF_STORAGE_KEYS.strategies}_${sid}`, JSON.stringify(strategyHistoryRef.current));
      sessionStorage.setItem(`${WF_STORAGE_KEYS.value}_${sid}`, String(valRef.current));
    } catch (e) {
      /* sessionStorage quota exceeded or unavailable, ignore */
    }
  }, []);

  const initialize = useCallback((sceneId: string, sessionId?: string, difficultyLevel?: string) => {
    const c = SCENE_VARIABLE_CONFIG[sceneId];
    if (!c) { cfgRef.current = null; return; }
    cfgRef.current = c;
    const effectiveInitialValue = difficultyLevel && c.difficultyLevels?.[difficultyLevel]?.initialValue
      ? c.difficultyLevels[difficultyLevel].initialValue
      : c.initialValue;
    hintFrequencyRef.current = difficultyLevel && c.difficultyLevels?.[difficultyLevel]?.hintFrequency
      ? c.difficultyLevels[difficultyLevel].hintFrequency
      : 1.0;
    if (sessionId) {
      sessionIdRef.current = sessionId;
      try {
        const savedMorale = sessionStorage.getItem(`${WF_STORAGE_KEYS.morale}_${sessionId}`);
        const savedPromises = sessionStorage.getItem(`${WF_STORAGE_KEYS.promises}_${sessionId}`);
        const savedStrategies = sessionStorage.getItem(`${WF_STORAGE_KEYS.strategies}_${sessionId}`);
        const savedValue = sessionStorage.getItem(`${WF_STORAGE_KEYS.value}_${sessionId}`);
        const parsedMorale = savedMorale ? JSON.parse(savedMorale) : null;
        const parsedValue = savedValue ? parseInt(savedValue, 10) : NaN;
        if (Array.isArray(parsedMorale) && isFinite(parsedValue)) {
          moraleHistoryRef.current = parsedMorale;
          const parsedPromises = savedPromises ? JSON.parse(savedPromises) : [];
          promRef.current = Array.isArray(parsedPromises) ? parsedPromises : [];
          const parsedStrategies = savedStrategies ? JSON.parse(savedStrategies) : [];
          strategyHistoryRef.current = Array.isArray(parsedStrategies) ? parsedStrategies : [];
           valRef.current = parsedValue || effectiveInitialValue;
          dirRef.current = null;
          consRef.current = 0;
          lastMsgRef.current = null;
          lastFactorRef.current = 1.0;
          roundRef.current = moraleHistoryRef.current.length > 1 ? moraleHistoryRef.current.length - 1 : 0;
          histRef.current = [];
          setPrimaryVariable(valRef.current);
          setVariableName(c.variableName);
          return;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        /* restore failed, fall through to default init */
      }
    }
    valRef.current = effectiveInitialValue;
    histRef.current = [];
    promRef.current = [];
    dirRef.current = null;
    consRef.current = 0;
    lastMsgRef.current = null;
    moraleHistoryRef.current = [{ round: 0, value: effectiveInitialValue, change: 0, event: '初始状态' }];
    strategyHistoryRef.current = [];
    consecutiveAvoidRef.current = 0;
    consecutiveEmotionalRef.current = 0;
    lastFactorRef.current = 1.0;
    lastStateRef.current = null;
    roundRef.current = 0;
    setPrimaryVariable(effectiveInitialValue);
    setVariableName(c.variableName);
  }, []);

  const processUserMessage = useCallback((msg: string, voiceEmotion?: IVoiceEmotion | null, responseTimeMs?: number) => {
    const c = cfgRef.current;
    if (!c) return;
    roundRef.current++;
    const currentRound = roundRef.current;

    const strategy = classifyStrategy(msg);
    strategyHistoryRef.current.push({ round: currentRound, type: strategy });

    let baseChange = 0;
    for (const rule of c.rules) {
      if (rule.patterns.some((p: RegExp) => p.test(msg))) { baseChange = rule.change; break; }
    }

    if (baseChange < 0 && c.negativePatterns && lastMsgRef.current) {
      const lastNegative = c.negativePatterns.some((p: RegExp) => p.test(lastMsgRef.current!));
      if (lastNegative) baseChange -= 3;
    }

    const features = computeTextFeatures(msg, responseTimeMs ?? 0);
    const voiceLabel = voiceEmotion?.label;
    const factor = computeEmotionFactor(features, voiceLabel);
    lastFactorRef.current = factor;

    let finalChange = Math.round(baseChange * factor);
    finalChange = Math.min(12, Math.max(-12, finalChange));

    const dir: 'up' | 'down' = finalChange > 0 ? 'up' : finalChange < 0 ? 'down' : (dirRef.current ?? 'up');
    if (finalChange !== 0 && dir === dirRef.current) {
      consRef.current++;
      finalChange = Math.round(finalChange * (consRef.current === 2 ? 0.7 : 0.5));
    } else if (finalChange !== 0) {
      dirRef.current = dir;
      consRef.current = 1;
    }

    valRef.current = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, valRef.current + finalChange));
    setPrimaryVariable(valRef.current);

    let event = describeEvent(finalChange, msg);
    if (finalChange === 0) event = '平稳';
    if (/申请折扣|协调|资源|工具|折扣|优惠|方案|话术/.test(msg) && finalChange >= 0) event = '资源支持';
    moraleHistoryRef.current.push({ round: currentRound, value: valRef.current, change: finalChange, event });

    saveToStorage();
    lastMsgRef.current = msg;
  }, [saveToStorage]);

  const analyzeUserMessage = useCallback((msg: string, voiceEmotion?: IVoiceEmotion | null, responseTimeMs?: number) => {
    const c = cfgRef.current;
    if (!c) return { strategy: 'avoid' as const, factor: 1.0, baseChange: 0, textFeatures: null as ReturnType<typeof computeTextFeatures> | null };
    const strategy = classifyStrategy(msg);
    const features = computeTextFeatures(msg, responseTimeMs ?? 0);
    const voiceLabel = voiceEmotion?.label;
    const factor = computeEmotionFactor(features, voiceLabel);
    let baseChange = 0;
    for (const rule of c.rules) {
      if (rule.patterns.some((p: RegExp) => p.test(msg))) { baseChange = rule.change; break; }
    }
    return { strategy, factor, baseChange, textFeatures: features };
  }, []);

  const getRound = useCallback((): number => {
    return roundRef.current;
  }, []);

  const incrementRound = useCallback((): number => {
    roundRef.current++;
    return roundRef.current;
  }, []);

  const extractPromise = useCallback((msg: string, round: number) => {
    const c = cfgRef.current;
    if (!c) return;
    const m = msg.match(c.promisePattern);
    if (m) {
      promRef.current.push({ content: m[1], round, fulfilled: false });
      saveToStorage();
    }
  }, [saveToStorage]);

  const checkPromiseFulfillment = useCallback((msg: string) => {
    const actionWords = /完成|做了|约了|打了|整理了|联系了|拜访了|提交了|落实/;
    if (!actionWords.test(msg)) return;
    for (const p of promRef.current) {
      if (p.fulfilled) continue;
      const contentKeywords = p.content.slice(0, 10);
      if (msg.includes(contentKeywords) && actionWords.test(msg)) {
        p.fulfilled = true;
        saveToStorage();
        break;
      }
    }
  }, [saveToStorage]);

  const addToHistory = useCallback((role: string, content: string) => {
    histRef.current.push({ role, content });
    if (histRef.current.length > 10) histRef.current = histRef.current.slice(-10);
    if (role === 'user') checkPromiseFulfillment(content);
  }, [checkPromiseFulfillment]);

  const getPromptInjection = useCallback((): WorkflowPromptData | null => {
    const c = cfgRef.current;
    if (!c) return null;
    const h = histRef.current;
    const p = promRef.current;
    return {
      variableName: c.variableName,
      variableValue: valRef.current,
      history: h.length > 0
        ? h.map((m: { role: string; content: string }) => `${m.role === 'user' ? '用户' : 'AI'}: ${m.content}`).join('\n')
        : '（对话刚开始）',
      promiseList: p.length > 0
        ? p.map((pr: IPromiseEntry) => `- [第${pr.round}轮] ${pr.content}${pr.fulfilled ? '（已兑现）' : '（待确认）'}`).join('\n')
        : '（暂无承诺）',
      emotionDescription: describeEmotion(lastFactorRef.current),
    };
  }, []);

  const getMoraleHistory = useCallback((): IMoraleHistoryEntry[] => {
    return [...moraleHistoryRef.current];
  }, []);

  const getPromiseList = useCallback((): IPromiseEntry[] => {
    return [...promRef.current];
  }, []);

  const getStrategyHistory = useCallback((): IStrategyEntry[] => {
    return [...strategyHistoryRef.current];
  }, []);

  const applyAIMeta = useCallback((meta: IAIResponseMeta, round: number) => {
    const c = cfgRef.current;
    if (!c) return;
    let rawDelta = Math.min(12, Math.max(-12, meta.morale_delta));
    if (c.inverseSemantics) {
      rawDelta = -rawDelta;
    }
    valRef.current = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, valRef.current + rawDelta));
    setPrimaryVariable(valRef.current);
    moraleHistoryRef.current.push({
      round,
      value: valRef.current,
      change: rawDelta,
      event: meta.state ? `AI判定: ${meta.strategy}(${meta.state})` : `AI判定: ${meta.strategy}`,
    });
    strategyHistoryRef.current.push({ round, type: meta.strategy });
    if (meta.state) {
      lastStateRef.current = meta.state;
    }
    if (meta.strategy === 'avoid') {
      consecutiveAvoidRef.current++;
    } else {
      consecutiveAvoidRef.current = 0;
    }
    const promiseContent = typeof meta.promise === 'string' ? meta.promise.trim() : '';
    if (promiseContent && promiseContent !== 'null' && promiseContent !== 'undefined' && promiseContent.length > 2) {
      const effectiveRound = round > 0 ? round : roundRef.current || 1;
      const isDup = promRef.current.some((p: IPromiseEntry) => {
        if (p.content.includes(promiseContent) || promiseContent.includes(p.content)) return true;
        const setA = new Set(p.content.split(''));
        const setB = new Set(promiseContent.split(''));
        const inter = new Set([...setA].filter((c: string) => setB.has(c)));
        const union = new Set([...setA, ...setB]);
        return union.size > 0 && inter.size / union.size > 0.8;
      });
      if (!isDup) {
        promRef.current.push({ content: promiseContent, round: effectiveRound, fulfilled: false });
      }
    }
    saveToStorage();
  }, [saveToStorage]);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    cfgRef.current = null;
    valRef.current = 0;
    histRef.current = [];
    promRef.current = [];
    dirRef.current = null;
    consRef.current = 0;
    lastMsgRef.current = null;
    moraleHistoryRef.current = [];
    strategyHistoryRef.current = [];
    lastFactorRef.current = 1.0;
    roundRef.current = 0;
    consecutiveAvoidRef.current = 0;
    consecutiveEmotionalRef.current = 0;
    lastStateRef.current = null;
    if (sessionIdRef.current) {
      const sid = sessionIdRef.current;
      Object.values(WF_STORAGE_KEYS).forEach((key: string) => {
        try { sessionStorage.removeItem(`${key}_${sid}`); } catch (_e) { /* ignore */ }
      });
      sessionIdRef.current = '';
    }
    setPrimaryVariable(0);
    setVariableName('');
  }, []);

  const getConsecutiveAvoidCount = useCallback((): number => {
    return consecutiveAvoidRef.current;
  }, []);

  const getHintFrequency = useCallback((): number => {
    return hintFrequencyRef.current;
  }, []);

  const getConsecutiveEmotionalCount = useCallback((): number => {
    return consecutiveEmotionalRef.current;
  }, []);

  const updateEmotionalCounter = useCallback((currentState: string | undefined, userMsg: string) => {
    if (!currentState) return;
    const isEmotionalState = currentState === 'defensive' || currentState === 'loosening';
    const hasEmpathy = EMPATHY_PATTERN.test(userMsg);
    if (isEmotionalState && !hasEmpathy) {
      consecutiveEmotionalRef.current++;
    } else {
      consecutiveEmotionalRef.current = 0;
    }
  }, []);

  const mergePromiseFromFrontend = useCallback((contents: string[], round: number) => {
    const validContents = contents.filter(
      (c: string) => c && typeof c === 'string' && c.trim().length > 2 && c.trim() !== 'null' && c.trim() !== 'undefined'
    );
    const effectiveRound = round > 0 ? round : roundRef.current || 1;
    for (const rawContent of validContents) {
      const content = rawContent.trim();
      const isDuplicate = promRef.current.some((p: IPromiseEntry) => {
        if (p.content.includes(content) || content.includes(p.content)) return true;
        const setA = new Set(p.content.split(''));
        const setB = new Set(content.split(''));
        const intersection = new Set([...setA].filter((c: string) => setB.has(c)));
        const union = new Set([...setA, ...setB]);
        return union.size === 0 ? false : intersection.size / union.size > 0.8;
      });
      if (!isDuplicate) {
        promRef.current.push({ content, round: effectiveRound, fulfilled: false });
      }
    }
    saveToStorage();
  }, [saveToStorage]);

  return {
    initialize,
    processUserMessage,
    extractPromise,
    addToHistory,
    getPromptInjection,
    getMoraleHistory,
    getPromiseList,
    getStrategyHistory,
    applyAIMeta,
    analyzeUserMessage,
    getRound,
    incrementRound,
    getConsecutiveAvoidCount,
    getHintFrequency,
    getConsecutiveEmotionalCount,
    updateEmotionalCounter,
    mergePromiseFromFrontend,
    reset,
    primaryVariable,
    variableName,
  };
};

  '小胜先于大胜': '小赢理论——小胜创造动能大目标制造焦虑',
  '建立信任': 'Edmondson心理安全理论——信任是坦诚对话的基础',
  '说明目的': '目标设置理论——清晰目的+事实支撑优于模糊安慰',
  '鼓励表达': '积极倾听技术——让对方先说，不打断，给表达空间',
  '认真倾听': '共情沟通——接住情绪，听完再回应，不跳过感受',
  '积极结束': '闭环管理——具体时间+方式+信心表达，形成可执行约定',
};

const V21BehaviorReview: React.FC<V21BehaviorReviewProps> = ({
  messages, moraleHistory, strategyHistory,
  sceneName, aiReviewAnalysis, selfRatedPrinciples,
  courseCards, sourceCourseName, sourceCourseId, isWeakDimension,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const strategyCounts = { empathy: 0, support: 0, pressure: 0, avoid: 0 };
  strategyHistory.forEach((s: IStrategyEntry) => { strategyCounts[s.type]++; });
  const strategyTotal = strategyHistory.length || 1;

  const userMessages = messages.filter((m: IChatMessage) => m.role === 'user');

  const stateEntries = messages
    .map((m: IChatMessage, idx: number) => ({ msg: m, round: Math.floor(idx / 2) + 1 }))
    .filter(({ msg }) => msg.role === 'ai')
    .map(({ msg, round }) => {
      const match = msg.content.match(/【状态提示[：:]([^】]+)】/);
      return match ? { round, state: match[1].trim() } : null;
    })
    .filter(Boolean) as Array<{ round: number; state: string }>;

  const transitionAnchors = messages
    .filter((m: IChatMessage) => m.role === 'ai')
    .map((m: IChatMessage) => {
      const matches = [...m.content.matchAll(/（([^→]+)→([^|｜]+)[|｜]\s*R(\d+)\s*([^）]+)）/g)];
      return matches.map((match) => ({
        fromState: match[1].trim(),
        toState: match[2].trim(),
        round: parseInt(match[3]),
        trigger: match[4].trim(),
      }));
    })
    .flat();

  const STATE_ORDER = ['崩溃态', '防备态', '躺平态', '松动态', '尝试态'];
  const getBestTurningPoint = (): { fromState: string; toState: string; round: number; trigger: string } | null => {
    if (transitionAnchors.length === 0) return null;
    let best = transitionAnchors[0];
    for (const t of transitionAnchors) {
      const fromIdx = STATE_ORDER.indexOf(t.fromState);
      const toIdx = STATE_ORDER.indexOf(t.toState);
      const bestFromIdx = STATE_ORDER.indexOf(best.fromState);
      const bestToIdx = STATE_ORDER.indexOf(best.toState);
      if (toIdx - fromIdx > bestToIdx - bestFromIdx) best = t;
    }
    return best;
  };
  const turningPoint = getBestTurningPoint();

  const firstEmpathyRound = strategyHistory.findIndex((s: IStrategyEntry) => s.type === 'empathy');
  const firstSupportRound = strategyHistory.findIndex((s: IStrategyEntry) => s.type === 'support');
  const hasSmallGoal = userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /先做|先试|1组|5组|小目标|验证/.test(m.content));
  const hasCollab = userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /一起|共同|我们|你觉得|你想想/.test(m.content));

  const isPR002 = sceneName.includes('绩效面谈') || sceneName.includes('自评与绩效落差');

  const principles = isPR002 ? [
    {
      name: '建立信任',
      hit: !userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /不够努力|态度问题|你看人家|别人怎么|再不|如果还是/.test(m.content)),
      basis: userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /不够努力|态度问题/.test(m.content))
        ? '检测到否定努力行为'
        : userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /你看人家|别人怎么|横向比较/.test(m.content))
          ? '检测到横向比较'
          : '未检测到破坏信任行为',
    },
    {
      name: '说明目的',
      hit: userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /(C级|等级|评估|结果).*(返工|数据|具体|错误|补位|次)/.test(m.content))
        || userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /(返工率|细节错误|补位|数据).*(C级|等级|评估)/.test(m.content)),
      basis: userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /返工率|细节错误|补位|数据|%/.test(m.content))
        ? '使用了具体数据支撑评估'
        : '未使用具体数据解释评估依据',
    },
    {
      name: '鼓励表达',
      hit: userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /你觉得|你怎么看|你的想法|先说说|你认为/.test(m.content)),
      basis: userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /你觉得|你怎么看|你的想法|先说说/.test(m.content))
        ? '引导了对方自评表达'
        : '未引导对方先表达自评',
    },
    {
      name: '认真倾听',
      hit: userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /我理解|我知道|你的感受|不容易|听到了|感受到/.test(m.content)),
      basis: userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /我理解|我知道|你的感受|不容易/.test(m.content))
        ? '接住了对方的情绪感受'
        : '未检测到共情回应',
    },
    {
      name: '积极结束',
      hit: userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /(下周三|每月|每周|具体日期|日程|定个时间).*(对|看|聊|检查)/.test(m.content))
        || userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /(对|看|聊|检查).*(下周三|每月|每周|具体日期)/.test(m.content))
        || userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /我会|我帮你|一起|支持你/.test(m.content)),
      basis: userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /下周三|每月|每周|具体日期|日程/.test(m.content))
        ? '约定了具体跟进时间'
        : userMessages.some((m: IChatMessage) => /我会|我帮你|一起/.test(m.content))
          ? '表达了支持但未约定具体时间'
          : '未形成具体跟进约定',
    },
  ] : [
    { name: '情绪先于任务', hit: firstEmpathyRound >= 0 && (firstSupportRound < 0 || firstEmpathyRound < firstSupportRound), basis: firstEmpathyRound >= 0 ? `第${firstEmpathyRound + 1}轮开始共情` : '未检测到共情行为' },
    { name: '具体先于口号', hit: strategyCounts.support > 0 && strategyCounts.support / strategyTotal >= 0.25, basis: `资源支持${strategyCounts.support}次（占比${Math.round(strategyCounts.support / strategyTotal * 100)}%）` },
    { name: '赋能先于施压', hit: strategyCounts.support > strategyCounts.pressure, basis: `支持${strategyCounts.support}次 vs 施压${strategyCounts.pressure}次` },
    { name: '共创先于指令', hit: hasCollab, basis: hasCollab ? '检测到协作语言' : '未检测到协作语言' },
    { name: '小胜先于大胜', hit: hasSmallGoal, basis: hasSmallGoal ? '检测到小目标设定' : '未检测到小目标' },
  ];
  const hitCount = principles.filter(p => p.hit).length;
  const hitRate = Math.round(hitCount / 5 * 100);

  const positiveRounds = moraleHistory.filter((e: IMoraleHistoryEntry) => e.change > 0 && e.round > 0).slice(0, 2);
  const negativeRounds = moraleHistory.filter((e: IMoraleHistoryEntry) => e.change < 0 && e.round > 0).slice(0, 2);

  const getDoneRight = () => {
    if (positiveRounds.length === 0) return null;
    return positiveRounds.map((r: IMoraleHistoryEntry) => {
      const userMsg = userMessages[r.round - 1];
      const quote = userMsg ? userMsg.content.slice(0, 60) : r.event;
      const strategy = strategyHistory.find((s: IStrategyEntry) => s.round === r.round);
      const ruleMap: Record<string, string> = { empathy: 'P1：先识别并回应情绪', support: 'R2：提供具体资源支持', pressure: 'R6：施压（需审视）', avoid: '—' };
      return { round: r.round, quote, rule: strategy ? ruleMap[strategy.type] || '—' : '—', change: r.change };
    });
  };

  const getDoBetter = () => {
    if (negativeRounds.length === 0) return null;
    return negativeRounds.map((r: IMoraleHistoryEntry) => {
      const userMsg = userMessages[r.round - 1];
      const quote = userMsg ? userMsg.content.slice(0, 60) : r.event;
      const strategy = strategyHistory.find((s: IStrategyEntry) => s.round === r.round);
      const ruleMap: Record<string, string> = { pressure: 'P4/P5：施压/威胁导致防御升级', avoid: 'R5：回避让对方感到被忽视', empathy: '—', support: '—' };
      return { round: r.round, quote, rule: strategy ? ruleMap[strategy.type] || '—' : '—', change: r.change };
    });
  };




  const aiTurningPoints = aiReviewAnalysis?.turningPoints && aiReviewAnalysis.turningPoints.length > 0
    ? aiReviewAnalysis.turningPoints : null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 2.1 状态转换路径（V2.2升级） */}
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.15 }}>
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-6">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-blue-100 flex items-center justify-center text-sm">🔄</span>
            小王的状态转换路径
          </h3>
          {transitionAnchors.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                {transitionAnchors.map((t, i) => {
                  const fromKey = Object.entries(STATE_LABELS).find(([, v]) => v === t.fromState)?.[0] || 'lying_flat';
                  const toKey = Object.entries(STATE_LABELS).find(([, v]) => v === t.toState)?.[0] || 'lying_flat';
                  return (
                    <React.Fragment key={i}>
                      {i === 0 && (
                        <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full font-medium" style={{ backgroundColor: `${STATE_COLORS[fromKey]}15`, color: STATE_COLORS[fromKey] }}>
                          {t.fromState}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 max-w-[200px] text-center leading-tight">
                        →<br />R{t.round} {t.trigger}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full font-medium" style={{ backgroundColor: `${STATE_COLORS[toKey]}15`, color: STATE_COLORS[toKey] }}>
                        {t.toState}
                      </span>
                    </React.Fragment>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
              {turningPoint && (
                <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 border border-blue-100 text-xs text-blue-800 leading-relaxed">
                  <strong>关键转折点：</strong>R{turningPoint.round}——{turningPoint.trigger}。
                  如果没有这个行为，后续的转变不会发生。
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : stateEntries.length > 0 ? (
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: `${STATE_COLORS.lying_flat}20`, color: STATE_COLORS.lying_flat }}>初始：躺平态</span>
                {stateEntries.map((entry: { round: number; state: string }, i: number) => {
                  const stateKey = Object.entries(STATE_LABELS).find(([, v]) => v === entry.state)?.[0] || 'lying_flat';
                  return (
                    <React.Fragment key={i}>
                      <span className="text-gray-300">→</span>
                      <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: `${STATE_COLORS[stateKey] || '#9CA3AF'}20`, color: STATE_COLORS[stateKey] || '#9CA3AF' }}>
                        第{entry.round}轮：{entry.state}
                      </span>
                    </React.Fragment>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">暂无状态数据（状态提示每3轮显示一次）</p>
          )}
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-2">💡 理想路径：躺平态 → 松动态 → 尝试态。进入崩溃态说明施压过度。</p>
        </div>
      </motion.div>

      {/* 2.2 你做对了什么 */}
      {getDoneRight() && (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.2 }}>
          <div className="bg-[#ffffff] rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-[#f5f6f7] p-6">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-emerald-800 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
              <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
              你做对了什么
            </h3>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {getDoneRight()!.map((item: { round: number; quote: string; rule: string; change: number }, i: number) => (
                <div key={i} className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-primary-foreground border border-[#f5f6f7]">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium bg-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">第{item.round}轮</span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-emerald-600">士气+{item.change}</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-700 mb-1">你说：&ldquo;{item.quote}{item.quote.length >= 60 ? '...' : ''}&rdquo;</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-emerald-700 font-medium">触发规则：{item.rule}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}

      {/* 2.3 你可以做得更好 */}
      {getDoBetter() && (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.25 }}>
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-[#dee0e3] p-6">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-amber-800 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
              <TrendingDown className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />
              你可以做得更好的地方
            </h3>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {getDoBetter()!.map((item: { round: number; quote: string; rule: string; change: number }, i: number) => (
                <div key={i} className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-background border border-[#f2f3f5]">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium bg-amber-200 text-amber-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">第{item.round}轮</span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-amber-600">士气{item.change}</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-700 mb-1">你说：&ldquo;{item.quote}{item.quote.length >= 60 ? '...' : ''}&rdquo;</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-amber-700 font-medium">触发规则：{item.rule}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}

      {/* 课程知识点回顾 */}
      {courseCards.length > 0 && sourceCourseName && (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.28 }}>
          <Card className="border-l-4 border-l-blue-500">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-lg">
                <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
                课程知识点回顾 —《{sourceCourseName}》
                {isWeakDimension && (
                  <Badge className="text-xs bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 border-amber-200">薄弱维度重点</Badge>
                )}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-3">
              {courseCards.map((card, index) => {
                const iconMap: Record<string, typeof FlaskConical> = {
                  theory: FlaskConical,
                  concept: Lightbulb,
                  practice: CheckCircle,
                  case: BookOpen,
                };
                const colorMap: Record<string, string> = {
                  theory: 'text-purple-600 bg-purple-50',
                  concept: 'text-blue-600 bg-blue-50',
                  practice: 'text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50',
                  case: 'text-amber-600 bg-amber-50',
                };
                const labelMap: Record<string, string> = {
                  theory: '理论',
                  concept: '概念',
                  practice: '实操',
                  case: '案例',
                };
                const Icon = iconMap[card.category] || Lightbulb;
                const color = colorMap[card.category] || colorMap.concept;
                return (
                  <div key={index} className="flex items-start gap-3">
                    <div className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-lg ${color} flex items-center justify-center shrink-0`}>
                      <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-0.5">
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{card.title}</span>
                        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0">
                          {labelMap[card.category] || card.category}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">{card.content}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
              {sourceCourseId && (
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  className="mt-2 text-primary"
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/courses/${sourceCourseId}`)}
                >
                  <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                  深入学习请前往课程 →
                </Button>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      )}

      {/* 2.4 5原则评分 + 自评对照 */}
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.3 }}>
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-6">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 flex items-center justify-center text-sm">🎯</span>
              5原则命中率
            </h3>
            <span className={`text-lg font-bold ${hitRate >= 60 ? 'text-emerald-600' : hitRate >= 40 ? 'text-amber-600' : 'text-red-600'}`}>
              {hitCount}/5 ({hitRate}%)
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2.5">
            {principles.map((p, i) => {
              const selfRating = selfRatedPrinciples[i];
              const selfHit = selfRating !== undefined ? selfRating >= 4 : undefined;
              const mismatch = selfHit !== undefined && selfHit !== p.hit;
              return (
                <div key={i} className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 rounded-xl ${p.hit ? 'bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200' : 'bg-red-50 border border-red-200'}`}>
                  <span className={`text-base ${p.hit ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-red-500'}`}>{p.hit ? '✅' : '❌'}</span>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className={`text-sm font-medium ${p.hit ? 'text-emerald-800' : 'text-red-800'}`}>{p.name}</span>
                      {mismatch && <span className="text-[10px] bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">自评有差距</span>}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">{p.basis}</p>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">{PRINCIPLE_THEORY[p.name]}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 mt-3">
            <div className="h-2 rounded-full transition-all" style={{ width: `${hitRate}%`, backgroundColor: hitRate >= 60 ? '#10B981' : hitRate >= 40 ? '#F59E0B' : '#EF4444' }} />
          </div>
          {selfRatedPrinciples.length > 0 && (
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2 italic">和你刚才自评的一致吗？哪里有差距？觉察差距本身就是进步。</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </motion.div>

      {/* 关键对话改进 */}
      {(aiTurningPoints || (positiveRounds.length + negativeRounds.length > 0)) && (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.5 }}>
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-6">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-blue-100 flex items-center justify-center text-sm">💬</span>
              行为替代（如果重来）
            </h3>
            {aiTurningPoints ? (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {aiTurningPoints.map((tp, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className={`border-l-4 ${tp.impact === 'positive' ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50/30' : 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/30'} p-3 rounded-xl`}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                      <span className={`text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${tp.impact === 'positive' ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700' : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700'}`}>
                        第{tp.round}轮 · {tp.impact === 'positive' ? '正向' : '可改进'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">你说：&ldquo;{tp.userQuote}&rdquo;</p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-700 mb-1">{tp.analysis}</p>
                    <div className="bg-white p-2 rounded-lg border border-emerald-200">
                      <span className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700">更优回应：</span>
                      <p className="text-sm text-emerald-800 mt-0.5">{tp.betterResponse}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {[...negativeRounds.slice(0, 2)].map((r: IMoraleHistoryEntry, i: number) => {
                  const userMsg = userMessages[r.round - 1];
                  const quote = userMsg ? userMsg.content.slice(0, 80) : r.event;
                  return (
                    <div key={i} className="border-l-4 border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/30 p-3 rounded-xl">
                      <span className="text-xs font-medium bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">第{r.round}轮 · 士气{r.change}</span>
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-2">你说：&ldquo;{quote}&rdquo;</p>
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">AI反应：（小王沉默，低下头不说话）</p>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}


    </div>
  );
};

export default V21BehaviorReview;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { commitActionPlan } from '@/api/practice';
import {
  Lightbulb,
  ChevronRight,
  ArrowRight,
  Eye,
  BarChart3,
  Rocket,
  Star,
} from 'lucide-react';
import V21BehaviorReview from './V21BehaviorReview';
import type { IKnowledgeCard, IReviewAnalysisResult } from '@shared/api.interface';

interface IMoraleHistoryEntry { round: number; value: number; change: number; event: string; }
interface IStrategyEntry { round: number; type: 'empathy' | 'support' | 'pressure' | 'avoid'; }
interface IChatMessage { id: string; role: 'user' | 'ai' | 'hint'; content: string; timestamp: Date; }

interface V21FeedbackSectionProps {
  sceneId: string;
  sceneName: string;
  messages: IChatMessage[];
  moraleHistory: IMoraleHistoryEntry[];
  strategyHistory: IStrategyEntry[];
  maxRounds: number;
  roundCount: number;
  sourceCourseId?: string;
  sourceCourseName?: string;
  aiReviewAnalysis?: IReviewAnalysisResult | null;
  onRestart: () => void;
  courseCards: IKnowledgeCard[];
  isWeakDimension?: boolean;
}

const KP_MAP: Record<string, { kp: string; course: string; practice: string; dimension: string }> = {
  'KP-01': { kp: '情绪觉察', course: '《情商管理》"情感的自我意识"', practice: '情绪标签法：每天花1分钟给自己的情绪命名', dimension: '自我意识' },
  'KP-02': { kp: '情绪控制', course: '《情商管理》"情感的自我控制"', practice: '6秒暂停：感到冲动时默数6秒再回应', dimension: '自我管理' },
  'KP-03': { kp: '同理心', course: '《情商管理》"同理心"', practice: '复述感受：回应前先说"我听到你说的是…"', dimension: '社会意识' },
  'KP-04': { kp: '影响力', course: '《情商管理》"影响力"', practice: '共赢框架：提建议时用"对你来说…对我们来说…"', dimension: '关系管理' },
  'KP-05': { kp: '情绪柔道', course: '《情商管理》"情绪柔道"', practice: '4步法：接纳→命名→转化→行动', dimension: '综合实践' },
  'KP-06': { kp: '现实校准力', course: '《情商管理》"影响力"', practice: '区分理由和借口：用提问引导而非直接判定', dimension: '赋能发展' },
  'KP-07': { kp: '闭环跟进力', course: '《情商管理》"情绪柔道"', practice: '跟进机制设计：每次谈话结束时明确下次check-in时间', dimension: '闭环跟进' },
};

const KP_RULE_MAP: Record<string, { rules: string; behavior: string }> = {
  'KP-01': { rules: 'R5/F4/F5', behavior: '回避了具体困难或市场客观问题' },
  'KP-02': { rules: 'R6/P5', behavior: '施压逼承诺或用权威威胁' },
  'KP-03': { rules: 'P1/P6', behavior: '未识别情绪或连续输出不倾听' },
  'KP-04': { rules: 'R1/R2/R3/F2/F3', behavior: '给方向/共创/拆解目标/激活资源' },
  'KP-05': { rules: 'P4+P5连续', behavior: '连续否定感受并用权威施压' },
  'KP-06': { rules: 'R3/E2/F4', behavior: '引导区分理由和借口或批评对方尝试' },
  'KP-07': { rules: 'F2/F3/F6', behavior: '给具体反馈、明确跟进机制、表达支持' },
};

const STRATEGY_TO_KP: Record<string, string[]> = {
  pressure: ['KP-02', 'KP-05'],
  avoid: ['KP-01', 'KP-03'],
  empathy: ['KP-04'],
  support: ['KP-04'],
};

const V21FeedbackSection: React.FC<V21FeedbackSectionProps> = ({
  sceneId, sceneName, messages, moraleHistory, strategyHistory,
  maxRounds, roundCount,
  sourceCourseId, sourceCourseName, aiReviewAnalysis, onRestart,
  courseCards, isWeakDimension,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [selfRatedPrinciples, setSelfRatedPrinciples] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [selfAssessStep, setSelfAssessStep] = useState(0);
  const [actionPlan, setActionPlan] = useState('');
  const [actionPlanCommitted, setActionPlanCommitted] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'l1' | 'l2' | 'l3'>('l1');
  const l2Unlocked = selfRatedPrinciples.filter((v: number | undefined) => v !== undefined).length >= 3;

  const strategyCounts = { empathy: 0, support: 0, pressure: 0, avoid: 0 };
  strategyHistory.forEach((s: IStrategyEntry) => { strategyCounts[s.type]++; });
  const strategyTotal = strategyHistory.length || 1;

  const userMessages = messages.filter((m: IChatMessage) => m.role === 'user');

  const repeatedBehaviors: Array<{ behavior: string; rounds: number[]; pattern: string }> = [];
  if (strategyCounts.pressure >= 2) {
    const rounds = strategyHistory.filter((s: IStrategyEntry) => s.type === 'pressure').map((s: IStrategyEntry) => s.round);
    repeatedBehaviors.push({ behavior: '施压/催促', rounds, pattern: '你在多轮中反复使用了施压策略' });
  }
  if (strategyCounts.avoid >= 2) {
    const rounds = strategyHistory.filter((s: IStrategyEntry) => s.type === 'avoid').map((s: IStrategyEntry) => s.round);
    repeatedBehaviors.push({ behavior: '回避/转移话题', rounds, pattern: '你在多轮中选择了回避对方的困难' });
  }
  if (strategyCounts.empathy >= 3) {
    const rounds = strategyHistory.filter((s: IStrategyEntry) => s.type === 'empathy').map((s: IStrategyEntry) => s.round);
    repeatedBehaviors.push({ behavior: '共情但未推进', rounds, pattern: '你多次共情但可能缺少后续行动推进' });
  }

  const dominatedStrategy = Object.entries(strategyCounts).sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a)[0];
  const dominatedLabel: Record<string, string> = { empathy: '共情', support: '资源支持', pressure: '施压', avoid: '回避' };

  const weakKPs: string[] = [];
  if (strategyCounts.pressure > strategyTotal * 0.2) weakKPs.push(...STRATEGY_TO_KP.pressure);
  if (strategyCounts.avoid > strategyTotal * 0.1) weakKPs.push(...STRATEGY_TO_KP.avoid);
  if (strategyCounts.empathy < strategyTotal * 0.25) weakKPs.push(...STRATEGY_TO_KP.empathy);
  const uniqueKPs = [...new Set(weakKPs)];

  const PRINCIPLE_NAMES = sceneId === 'scene_P1' ? ['安全先于评判', '倾听先于诊断', '共创先于指令', '发展先于惩罚', '跟进先于放手'] : ['情绪先于任务', '具体先于口号', '赋能先于施压', '共创先于指令', '小胜先于大胜'];

  const handleSelfRate = (index: number, value: number) => {
    setSelfRatedPrinciples((prev: number[]) => {
      const next = [...prev];
      next[index] = value;
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleSaveActionPlan = async () => {
    if (!actionPlan.trim()) {
      toast.warning('请先写下你的行动实验');
      return;
    }
    try {
      await commitActionPlan({ sceneId, sceneName, actionPlan: actionPlan.trim() });
      setActionPlanCommitted(true);
      toast.success('行动实验已保存，7天后将收到追踪提醒');
    } catch {
      toast.error('保存失败，请重试');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Tab Bar */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 p-1 rounded-xl flex gap-1" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(245,242,237,0.95)', backdropFilter: 'blur(8px)' }}>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('l1')}
          className={`flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all ${activeTab === 'l1' ? 'bg-white shadow-sm' : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'}`}
        >
          <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline-block mr-1.5" />觉察镜子
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => l2Unlocked && setActiveTab('l2')}
          disabled={!l2Unlocked}
          className={`flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all ${activeTab === 'l2' ? 'bg-white shadow-sm' : l2Unlocked ? 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700' : 'text-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed'}`}
        >
          <BarChart3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline-block mr-1.5" />行为复盘{!l2Unlocked && ' 🔒'}
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => l2Unlocked && setActiveTab('l3')}
          disabled={!l2Unlocked}
          className={`flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all ${activeTab === 'l3' ? 'bg-white shadow-sm' : l2Unlocked ? 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700' : 'text-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed'}`}
        >
          <Rocket className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline-block mr-1.5" />下一步{!l2Unlocked && ' 🔒'}
        </button>
      </div>
      <div style={{ height: 2, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)', borderRadius: 1 }}>
        <div style={{ height: '100%', width: activeTab === 'l1' ? '33%' : activeTab === 'l2' ? '66%' : '100%', backgroundColor: '#007AFF', borderRadius: 1, transition: 'width 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)' }} />
      </div>
      {!l2Unlocked && (
        <p className="text-xs text-center text-gray-400">完成上方自评（≥3条）解锁行为复盘和下一步</p>
      )}

      {/* ========== 第一层：觉察镜子 ========== */}
      {activeTab === 'l1' && <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.05 }}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-400 to-purple-500 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Eye className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800">第一层：觉察镜子</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">建构主义通道 · 引发自我觉察</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* 1.1 关键觉察点 */}
          {repeatedBehaviors.length > 0 && (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-indigo-100 p-5">
              <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-indigo-800 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500" />
                关键觉察点
              </h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {repeatedBehaviors.map((item, i) => {
                  const moraleAtRounds = item.rounds.map((r: number) => {
                    const entry = moraleHistory.find((e: IMoraleHistoryEntry) => e.round === r);
                    return entry ? entry.change : 0;
                  });
                  return (
                    <div key={i} className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50/50 border border-indigo-100">
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-700 mb-1.5">
                        我注意到你在第{item.rounds.join('、')}轮都采用了<strong>{item.behavior}</strong>的策略。
                        小王的反应分别是士气变化 {moraleAtRounds.map((c: number) => c > 0 ? `+${c}` : `${c}`).join(', ')}。
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-sm text-indigo-700 font-medium italic">
                        你发现了什么规律？
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 1.2 自评邀请 */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-indigo-100 p-5">
            <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-indigo-800 mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-lg">🪞</span>
              自评邀请
            </h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-3">
              对照5原则，你觉得自己做到了几条？先想一想，再看后面的评分。
            </p>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {PRINCIPLE_NAMES.map((name, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-xs text-gray-600 w-24 shrink-0">{name}</span>
                  <div className="flex gap-0.5">
                    {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((v) => (
                      <button
                        key={v}
                        onClick={() => handleSelfRate(i, v)}
                        className="p-0.5 transition-all hover:scale-110"
                      >
                        <Star
                          className={`w-5 h-5 ${
                            selfRatedPrinciples[i] >= v
                              ? 'text-amber-400 fill-amber-400'
                              : 'text-gray-300'
                          }`}
                        />
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  {selfRatedPrinciples[i] !== undefined && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                      {selfRatedPrinciples[i] >= 4 ? '你觉得做到了' : '你觉得没做到'}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {selfRatedPrinciples.filter((v: number | undefined) => v !== undefined).length >= 3 && (
              <p className="text-xs text-indigo-600 mt-3 italic">
                你觉得你的管理行为对士气的影响是正向还是负向？继续往下看答案。
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* 1.3 视角扩展 */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-indigo-100 p-5">
            <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-indigo-800 mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-lg">🔭</span>
              视角扩展
            </h3>
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50/50 border border-indigo-100">
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-700">
                如果站在小王的角度，他此刻最需要的可能不是
                <strong>{dominatedLabel[dominatedStrategy[0]] || '解决方案'}</strong>，
                而是<strong>被理解和被支持</strong>。
                当一个人感到被看见时，他才有可能打开心扉去尝试新的做法。
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-indigo-700 font-medium italic mt-2">
                这个视角对你有什么启发？
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-emerald-100 p-5">
            <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-emerald-800 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-lg">⚡</span>
              快速摘要
            </h3>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-100">
                <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span>✓</span> 做对了
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-700 leading-relaxed">
                  {strategyCounts.empathy > 0 && <div>• 先共情再追问 ({strategyCounts.empathy}次共情)</div>}
                  {strategyCounts.support > 0 && <div>• 提供支持而非指令 ({strategyCounts.support}次)</div>}
                  {strategyCounts.empathy === 0 && strategyCounts.support === 0 && <div className="text-gray-400 text-xs">暂无明显正向行为</div>}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-[#f5f6f7]">
                <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-amber-700 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span>⚠</span> 可以更好
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-700 leading-relaxed">
                  {strategyCounts.pressure > 0 && <div>• 施压策略 ({strategyCounts.pressure}次)</div>}
                  {strategyCounts.avoid > 0 && <div>• 回避话题 ({strategyCounts.avoid}次)</div>}
                  {strategyCounts.pressure === 0 && strategyCounts.avoid === 0 && <div className="text-gray-400 text-xs">整体表现良好</div>}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex justify-center mt-5">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('l2')}
            disabled={!l2Unlocked}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition-all"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: l2Unlocked ? '#007AFF' : '#D1D5DB',
              color: l2Unlocked ? '#FFFFFF' : '#9CA3AF',
              cursor: l2Unlocked ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed',
            }}
          >
            进入行为复盘 →
          </button>
        </div>
      </motion.div>}

      {/* ========== 第二层：行为复盘 ========== */}
      {activeTab === 'l2' && <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.1 }}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-400 to-teal-500 flex items-center justify-center">
            <BarChart3 className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800">第二层：行为复盘</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">行为主义通道 · 量化评估数据</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <V21BehaviorReview
          messages={messages}
          moraleHistory={moraleHistory}
          strategyHistory={strategyHistory}
          sceneName={sceneName}
          aiReviewAnalysis={aiReviewAnalysis}
          selfRatedPrinciples={selfRatedPrinciples}
          courseCards={courseCards}
          sourceCourseName={sourceCourseName}
          sourceCourseId={sourceCourseId}
          isWeakDimension={isWeakDimension}
        />
        <div className="flex justify-center mt-5">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('l3')}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition-all"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: '#007AFF',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            查看下一步行动 →
          </button>
        </div>
      </motion.div>}

      {/* ========== 第三层：下一步 ========== */}
      {activeTab === 'l3' && <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.15 }}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-400 to-orange-500 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Rocket className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800">第三层：下一步</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">行动实验 + 学习推荐</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
           {/* 3.1 薄弱KP定位（V2.2升级：完整桥接链路） */}
          {uniqueKPs.length > 0 && (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-[#f5f6f7] p-5">
              <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-amber-800 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-lg">🎯</span>
                薄弱知识点定位
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-3">每个知识点展示完整的"规则→知识点→课程"链路，让你理解"为什么推荐这门课"</p>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {uniqueKPs.map((kpId) => {
                  const kpInfo = KP_MAP[kpId];
                  const ruleInfo = KP_RULE_MAP[kpId];
                  if (!kpInfo) return null;
                  return (
                    <div key={kpId} className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[transparent] border border-[#f5f6f7]">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold bg-amber-200 text-amber-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">{kpId}</span>
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-800">{kpInfo.kp}</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">({kpInfo.dimension})</span>
                      </div>
                      {ruleInfo && (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-2 flex-wrap">
                          <span className="text-[10px] bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-blue-200 font-medium">
                            ← {ruleInfo.rules}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">{ruleInfo.behavior}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">推荐课程：{kpInfo.course}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-amber-700 font-medium">微练习：{kpInfo.practice}</p>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 3.2 课程推荐（V2.2升级：链路可视化） */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-[#f5f6f7] p-5">
            <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-amber-800 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-lg">📚</span>
              推荐学习路径
            </h3>
            {aiReviewAnalysis?.courseRecommendations && aiReviewAnalysis.courseRecommendations.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {aiReviewAnalysis.courseRecommendations.map((c, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-3">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-1.5">
                      <span className="font-medium text-gray-800 text-sm">{c.name}</span>
                      <button onClick={() => navigate('/courses')} className="text-emerald-600 text-xs hover:underline shrink-0">去学习 →</button>
                    </div>
                    {'weaknessPoint' in c && (c as { weaknessPoint?: string }).weaknessPoint && (
                      <span className="inline-block text-[10px] bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-blue-200 font-medium mb-1.5">
                        ← {(c as { weaknessPoint: string }).weaknessPoint}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-600">{c.reason || (c as { desc?: string }).desc}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {uniqueKPs.length > 0 ? uniqueKPs.map((kpId) => {
                  const kpInfo = KP_MAP[kpId];
                  const ruleInfo = KP_RULE_MAP[kpId];
                  if (!kpInfo) return null;
                  return (
                    <div key={kpId} className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-3">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-1.5">
                        <span className="font-medium text-gray-800 text-sm">{kpInfo.course}</span>
                        <button onClick={() => navigate(sourceCourseId ? `/courses/${sourceCourseId}` : '/courses')} className="text-emerald-600 text-xs hover:underline shrink-0">去学习 →</button>
                      </div>
                      {ruleInfo && (
                        <span className="inline-block text-[10px] bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-blue-200 font-medium mb-1.5">
                          ← {kpId} ← {ruleInfo.rules}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-600">微练习：{kpInfo.practice}</p>
                    </div>
                  );
                }) : (
                  <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-3">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-1.5">
                      <span className="font-medium text-gray-800 text-sm">{sourceCourseName || '情商管理'}</span>
                      <button onClick={() => navigate(sourceCourseId ? `/courses/${sourceCourseId}` : '/courses')} className="text-emerald-600 text-xs hover:underline shrink-0">去学习 →</button>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-600">本次表现良好，建议深入学习课程全部内容以巩固优势。</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* 3.3 行动实验设计（V2.2升级：关联知识点） */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-[#f5f6f7] p-5">
            <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-amber-800 mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-lg">🧪</span>
              行动实验设计
            </h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-3">
              基于你的反思和评分，下次遇到类似场景，你准备做什么不同的事？
              试着设计一个具体的第一步——你怎么知道自己做对了？
            </p>
            {!actionPlanCommitted ? (
              <>
                <textarea
                  value={actionPlan}
                  onChange={(e) => setActionPlan(e.target.value)}
                  rows={4}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-3 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-200 focus:border-amber-400 resize-none"
                  placeholder="例如：下次和小王对话时，我会先花2分钟了解他的感受，再说&#34;我理解你的压力&#34;，然后一起列一个最小的行动清单。如果小王开始主动说话，说明我做对了。"
                />
                {uniqueKPs.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-2 p-2 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 border border-blue-100">
                    <span className="text-xs text-blue-700">
                      💡 实验关联：{uniqueKPs[0]} {KP_MAP[uniqueKPs[0]]?.kp || ''} → {KP_RULE_MAP[uniqueKPs[0]]?.rules || ''} 的替代方案
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 ml-2">
                      我练这个实验→改善这个行为→提升这个知识点→下次量规评分会变
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="flex justify-end mt-3">
                  <button
                    onClick={handleSaveActionPlan}
                    className="px-5 py-2 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition"
                  >
                    保存行动实验（7天追踪提醒）
                  </button>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : (
              <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200">
                <p className="text-sm text-emerald-800 font-medium mb-1">✅ 行动实验已保存</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-700">{actionPlan}</p>
                {uniqueKPs.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-2 p-2 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 border border-blue-100">
                    <span className="text-xs text-blue-700">
                      💡 实验关联：{uniqueKPs[0]} {KP_MAP[uniqueKPs[0]]?.kp || ''} → {KP_RULE_MAP[uniqueKPs[0]]?.rules || ''} 的替代方案
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-2">系统将在7天后提醒您回顾执行情况。</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Scene P1 专属：反思填空 + 再练习按钮 */}
          {sceneId === 'scene_P1' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-[#f5f6f7] p-5">
                <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-lg">✏️</span>
                  反思（请填写）
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs text-gray-600 mb-1.5 font-medium">
                      1. 下次遇到类似场景，你准备做的1件不同的事是：
                    </label>
                    <textarea
                      className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-3 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 focus:border-blue-400 resize-none"
                      rows={3}
                      placeholder="比如：先承认上次没跟进，再问他的近况..."
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const key = `reflection_p1_thing_${Date.now()}`;
                        localStorage.setItem('reflection_p1_thing', e.target.value);
                      }}
                      defaultValue={localStorage.getItem('reflection_p1_thing') || ''}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs text-gray-600 mb-1.5 font-medium">
                      2. 你怎么知道自己做对了？（可观察的指标）
                    </label>
                    <textarea
                      className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-3 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 focus:border-blue-400 resize-none"
                      rows={3}
                      placeholder="比如：如果NPC-张在第3轮内不再说'你又问这个'，说明我破了话术循环..."
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        localStorage.setItem('reflection_p1_indicator', e.target.value);
                      }}
                      defaultValue={localStorage.getItem('reflection_p1_indicator') || ''}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3 p-4 rounded-xl bg-white border border-[#f5f6f7]">
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={onRestart}
                    className="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-900 hover:bg-black text-white text-sm font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all"
                  >
                    再练一次（同场景）
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => navigate(sourceCourseId ? `/courses/${sourceCourseId}` : '/courses')}
                    className="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-200 text-gray-800 text-sm font-medium rounded-xl hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all"
                  >
                    学习推荐课程
                  </button>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400">建议在 3-7 天内再练习，技能窗口期有限</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </motion.div>}
    </div>
  );
};

export default V21FeedbackSection;

===FILE:./client/src/pages/CoachingChatPage/voice-emotion-analyzer.ts===
export interface AudioEmotionResult {
  label: 'agitated' | 'hesitant' | 'confident' | 'tired' | 'neutral';
  avgVolume: number;
  avgPitch: number;
  volumeVariation: number;
  pitchVariation: number;
  durationMs: number;
}

export class VoiceEmotionAnalyzer {
  private audioContext: AudioContext | null = null;
  private analyser: AnalyserNode | null = null;
  private source: MediaStreamAudioSourceNode | null = null;
  private intervalId: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private volumeSamples: number[] = [];
  private pitchSamples: number[] = [];
  private startTime = 0;

  async start(stream: MediaStream): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.audioContext = new AudioContext();
      this.analyser = this.audioContext.createAnalyser();
      this.analyser.fftSize = 256;
      this.source = this.audioContext.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
      this.source.connect(this.analyser);

      this.volumeSamples = [];
      this.pitchSamples = [];
      this.startTime = Date.now();

      const bufferLength = this.analyser.frequencyBinCount;
      const timeData = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);
      const freqData = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

      this.intervalId = setInterval(() => {
        if (!this.analyser) return;
        this.analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(timeData);
        this.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(freqData);

        let sumSquares = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < timeData.length; i++) {
          const val = (timeData[i] - 128) / 128;
          sumSquares += val * val;
        }
        const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSquares / timeData.length);
        this.volumeSamples.push(rms);

        let maxIdx = 0;
        let maxVal = 0;
        for (let i = 1; i < freqData.length; i++) {
          if (freqData[i] > maxVal) {
            maxVal = freqData[i];
            maxIdx = i;
          }
        }
        if (maxVal > 30) {
          const freq = maxIdx * (this.audioContext!.sampleRate / this.analyser!.fftSize);
          if (freq > 50 && freq < 1000) {
            this.pitchSamples.push(freq);
          }
        }
      }, 100);
    } catch (_e) {
      /* AudioContext not available */
    }
  }

  stop(): AudioEmotionResult | null {
    if (this.intervalId) {
      clearInterval(this.intervalId);
      this.intervalId = null;
    }
    if (this.source) {
      this.source.disconnect();
      this.source = null;
    }
    if (this.audioContext) {
      this.audioContext.close().catch(() => {});
      this.audioContext = null;
    }
    this.analyser = null;

    if (this.volumeSamples.length < 3) return null;

    const durationMs = Date.now() - this.startTime;
    const avgVolume = this.volumeSamples.reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0) / this.volumeSamples.length;

    let volumeVarSum = 0;
    for (const s of this.volumeSamples) {
      volumeVarSum += (s - avgVolume) * (s - avgVolume);
    }
    const volumeVariation = Math.sqrt(volumeVarSum / this.volumeSamples.length);

    const avgPitch = this.pitchSamples.length > 0
      ? this.pitchSamples.reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0) / this.pitchSamples.length
      : 0;

    let pitchVarSum = 0;
    for (const p of this.pitchSamples) {
      pitchVarSum += (p - avgPitch) * (p - avgPitch);
    }
    const pitchVariation = this.pitchSamples.length > 0
      ? Math.sqrt(pitchVarSum / this.pitchSamples.length)
      : 0;

    let label: AudioEmotionResult['label'] = 'neutral';
    if (avgVolume > 0.3 && volumeVariation > 0.1) {
      label = 'agitated';
    } else if (avgVolume > 0.15 && volumeVariation < 0.05) {
      label = 'confident';
    } else if (avgVolume < 0.1 && volumeVariation > 0.03) {
      label = 'hesitant';
    } else if (avgVolume < 0.08 && pitchVariation < 20 && !(volumeVariation > 0.03)) {
      label = 'tired';
    }

    return { label, avgVolume, avgPitch, volumeVariation, pitchVariation, durationMs };
  }
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Lightbulb, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, X } from 'lucide-react';

interface WeakHintCardProps {
  theoryName: string;
  briefDescription: string;
  fullDescription?: string;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
}

const WeakHintCard: React.FC<WeakHintCardProps> = ({
  theoryName,
  briefDescription,
  fullDescription,
  onDismiss,
}) => {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!onDismiss) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => onDismiss(), 10000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [onDismiss]);

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10, transition: { duration: 0.3 } }}
        className="mx-3 my-2 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm"
        style={{ backgroundColor: '#FDF6EC', border: '1px solid #F5E6C8' }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3">
          <div className="shrink-0 w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center" style={{ backgroundColor: '#FEF3C7' }}>
            <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: '#D97706' }} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <p className="text-xs font-medium" style={{ color: '#92400E' }}>管理理论引导</p>
              {onDismiss && (
                <button
                  onClick={onDismiss}
                  className="shrink-0 w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-colors hover:bg-amber-100"
                >
                  <X className="w-3 h-3" style={{ color: '#D97706' }} />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold mt-0.5" style={{ color: '#78350F' }}>{theoryName}</p>
            <p className="text-xs mt-1" style={{ color: '#92400E' }}>{briefDescription}</p>
            {fullDescription && (
              <>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-xs mt-1.5 font-medium transition-colors"
                  style={{ color: '#D97706' }}
                >
                  {expanded ? '收起' : '了解更多'}
                  {expanded ? <ChevronUp className="w-3 h-3" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3 h-3" />}
                </button>
                {expanded && (
                  <p className="text-xs mt-1.5 leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#78350F' }}>
                    {fullDescription}
                  </p>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
};

export default WeakHintCard;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { X, ExternalLink, BookOpen, AlertTriangle, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
interface XiaoLvPanelProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  sceneName: string;
  dimensionId: string;
}

const XIAOLV_URL = 'https://wenapp.gtcloud.cn/ai/xiaoLv/index';

const DIMENSION_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  result: '拿结果',
  people: '带团队',
  field: '传文化',
};

const XiaoLvPanel: React.FC<XiaoLvPanelProps> = ({ open, onClose, sceneName, dimensionId }) => {
  const [iframeError, setIframeError] = useState(false);
  const [iframeLoading, setIframeLoading] = useState(true);

  const sceneHint = `当前场景：${sceneName}（${DIMENSION_LABELS[dimensionId] || dimensionId}），你可以向小绿同学询问相关的最佳实践和管理方法论`;

  const handleOpenNewTab = () => {
    window.open(XIAOLV_URL, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  };

  const handleRetry = () => {
    setIframeError(false);
    setIframeLoading(true);
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ width: 0, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ width: 400, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ width: 0, opacity: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
          className="h-full border-l flex flex-col overflow-hidden shrink-0"
          style={{ borderColor: '#ECE8E1', backgroundColor: '#F9F7F3' }}
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b" style={{ borderColor: '#ECE8E1', backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF' }}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
              <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #5B9A8B, #7BB5A6)' }}>
                <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold truncate" style={{ color: '#2D2A26' }}>小绿同学</h3>
                <p className="text-xs truncate" style={{ color: '#7A7168' }}>最佳实践助手</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="icon"
                className="h-7 w-7"
                onClick={handleOpenNewTab}
                title="新窗口打开"
              >
                <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="icon"
                className="h-7 w-7"
                onClick={onClose}
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Scene Hint */}
          <div className="px-4 py-2.5 border-b" style={{ backgroundColor: '#FDF5EC', borderColor: '#E8D5B5' }}>
            <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#8B6B3A' }}>{sceneHint}</p>
          </div>

          {/* Content */}
          <div className="flex-1 relative min-h-0">
            {iframeError ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full px-6 text-center gap-4">
                <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-amber-100 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-7 h-7 text-amber-600" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-1">无法嵌入小绿同学</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">当前环境不支持内嵌显示，请在新窗口中打开使用</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={handleRetry}
                    className="gap-1.5"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    重试
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={handleOpenNewTab}
                    className="gap-1.5"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: '#5B9A8B' }}
                  >
                    <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    新窗口打开
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                {iframeLoading && (
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-background/80 z-10">
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 rounded-full animate-spin" style={{ borderColor: '#5B9A8B', borderTopColor: 'transparent' }} />
                      <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: '#7A7168' }}>正在连接小绿同学...</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
                <iframe
                  src={XIAOLV_URL}
                  className="w-full h-full border-0"
                  title="小绿同学"
                  sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-popups"
                  onLoad={() => setIframeLoading(false)}
                  onError={() => {
                    setIframeError(true);
                    setIframeLoading(false);
                  }}
                />
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
};

export default XiaoLvPanel;
