  scene: ICoachingScene;
  onStart: (sceneId: string) => void;
  recommended?: boolean;
  weakDimension?: boolean;
}> = ({ scene, onStart, recommended = false, weakDimension = false }) => {
  const dimension = dimensionConfig[scene.dimension as keyof typeof dimensionConfig];
  const difficulty = difficultyConfig[scene.difficulty as keyof typeof difficultyConfig];

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
      whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      viewport={{ once: true }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
    >
      <Card
        className="overflow-hidden cursor-pointer hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 h-full border-stone-200"
        onClick={() => onStart(scene.id)}
      >
        <div className="h-28 bg-stone-100 relative">
          <img
            src={SCENE_COVER_MAP[scene.id] || DEFAULT_COVER}
            alt={scene.name}
            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
            loading="lazy"
          />
          {recommended && (
            <Badge className="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-teal-500 text-white border-0">
              必选
            </Badge>
          )}
          {weakDimension && !recommended && (
            <Badge className="absolute top-2 left-2 bg-orange-400 text-white border-0 text-xs">
              针对薄弱项
            </Badge>
          )}
        </div>
        <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-stone-400">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Target className="w-3 h-3" />
              {dimension.name}
            </span>
            <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-stone-300" />
            <span>{difficulty.label}</span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <h4 className="font-medium text-stone-700 text-sm leading-tight mb-1.5">{scene.name}</h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 leading-relaxed line-clamp-2">{scene.description}</p>
          </div>
          <Button className="w-full gap-1.5 bg-[#5B9A8B] hover:bg-[#4A8A7B]" size="sm" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onStart(scene.id); }}>
            <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            开始陪练
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

const LoadingSkeleton: React.FC<{ count?: number }> = ({ count = 6 }) => {
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
      {Array.from({ length: count }).map((_, i) => (
        <Card key={i} className="h-full overflow-hidden">
          <Skeleton className="h-32 w-full" />
          <div className="p-4 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Skeleton className="h-5 w-14 rounded" />
              <Skeleton className="h-5 w-14 rounded" />
            </div>
            <Skeleton className="h-4 w-3/4" />
            <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full" />
            <Skeleton className="h-8 w-full rounded" />
          </div>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================
// Learning Path Types
// ============================================
interface ILearningPathScene {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  dimension: string;
  difficulty: string;
  completed: boolean;
}

interface ILearningPhase {
  phase: number;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  scenes: ILearningPathScene[];
}

interface ILearningPath {
  completedCount: number;
  totalCount: number;
  avgScores: { result: number; people: number; field: number };
  weakestDimension: string;
  phases: ILearningPhase[];
}

// ============================================
// Learning Path Section
// ============================================
const PHASE_COLORS = [
  { border: 'border-l-emerald-400', bg: 'bg-emerald-50', accent: 'text-emerald-700', badge: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700' },
  { border: 'border-l-teal-400', bg: 'bg-teal-50', accent: 'text-teal-700', badge: 'bg-teal-100 text-teal-700' },
  { border: 'border-l-amber-400', bg: 'bg-amber-50', accent: 'text-amber-700', badge: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700' },
];

const LearningPathSection: React.FC<{
  data: ILearningPath | null;
  loading: boolean;
  onSceneClick: (sceneId: string) => void;
}> = ({ data, loading, onSceneClick }) => {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <section className="w-full py-10" style={{ backgroundColor: '#F5F2ED' }}>
        <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-12">
          <div className="mb-6">
            <Skeleton className="h-6 w-48 mb-2" />
            <Skeleton className="h-4 w-64" />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {[1, 2, 3].map(i => (
              <Card key={i} className="p-4">
                <Skeleton className="h-5 w-32 mb-3" />
                <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full mb-4" />
                <Skeleton className="h-16 w-full" />
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  if (!data || data.phases.length === 0) return null;

  const progressPercent = data.totalCount > 0
    ? Math.round((data.completedCount / data.totalCount) * 100)
    : 0;

  return (
    <section className="w-full py-10" style={{ backgroundColor: '#F5F2ED' }}>
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-12">
        {/* Header */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
          className="mb-6"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <Compass className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }} />
            <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-stone-700">我的学习路径</h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-stone-400">
            已完成 {data.completedCount}/{data.totalCount} 个场景 · 总进度 {progressPercent}%
          </p>
          {/* Progress bar */}
          <div className="mt-3 h-2 w-full max-w-xs rounded-full bg-stone-200 overflow-hidden">
            <motion.div
              initial={{ width: 0 }}
              animate={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.8, delay: 0.2 }}
              className="h-full rounded-full"
              style={{ backgroundColor: '#5B9A8B' }}
            />
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Phase cards - 阶梯式布局 */}
        <div className="relative">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 md:gap-6">
            {data.phases.map((phase, idx) => {
              const colors = PHASE_COLORS[idx] || PHASE_COLORS[0];
              const completedInPhase = phase.scenes.filter(s => s.completed).length;
              const progressPercent = phase.scenes.length > 0 
                ? Math.round((completedInPhase / phase.scenes.length) * 100) 
                : 0;
              
              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={phase.phase}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.15 * idx }}
                  className={`${idx === 0 ? 'md:mt-8' : idx === 1 ? 'md:mt-4' : ''}`}
                >
                  <Card className={`overflow-hidden border-0 shadow-sm ${colors.bg}`}>
                    {/* 顶部进度条 */}
                    <div className="h-1 w-full bg-stone-200">
                      <div 
                        className="h-full transition-all duration-500"
                        style={{ 
                          width: `${progressPercent}%`,
                          backgroundColor: idx === 0 ? '#10b981' : idx === 1 ? '#14b8a6' : '#f59e0b'
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                    
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      {/* Phase header - 简化 */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <div className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-medium text-white ${
                            idx === 0 ? 'bg-emerald-500' : idx === 1 ? 'bg-teal-500' : 'bg-amber-500'
                          }`}>
                            {phase.phase}
                          </div>
                          <h3 className={`font-medium text-sm ${colors.accent}`}>
                            {phase.name}
                          </h3>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500">
                          {completedInPhase}/{phase.scenes.length}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Scene list - 极简版 */}
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        {phase.scenes.slice(0, 3).map((scene) => {
                          const isWeak = scene.dimension === data.weakestDimension;
                          return (
                            <div
                              key={scene.id}
                              onClick={() => onSceneClick(scene.id)}
                              className={`flex items-center gap-2 py-1.5 px-2 rounded cursor-pointer transition-colors text-xs ${
                                scene.completed
                                  ? 'bg-white/50 opacity-60'
                                  : 'bg-white/80 hover:bg-white'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {scene.completed ? (
                                <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-500 flex-shrink-0" />
                              ) : (
                                <div className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full border border-stone-300 flex-shrink-0" />
                              )}
                              <span className={`flex-1 truncate ${scene.completed ? 'text-stone-400 line-through' : 'text-stone-600'}`}>
                                {scene.name}
                              </span>
                              {isWeak && (
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-500 flex-shrink-0">薄弱</span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                        {phase.scenes.length > 3 && (
                          <p className="text-[10px] text-stone-400 text-center py-1">
                            +{phase.scenes.length - 3} 个场景
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

// ============================================
// Recommended Section (推荐必选)
// ============================================
const RecommendedSection: React.FC<{
  onStart: (sceneId: string) => void;
  scenes: ICoachingScene[];
  loading: boolean;
  weakDimensions?: string[];
}> = ({ onStart, scenes, loading, weakDimensions = [] }) => {
  // Show first 6 scenes as recommended (mix from both sources)
  const recommendedScenes = scenes.slice(0, 6);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <section className="w-full py-10">
        <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-12">
          <div className="mb-6">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-stone-700 mb-1">推荐必选</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-stone-400">针对您的测评短板，精选6个场景</p>
          </div>
          <LoadingSkeleton count={6} />
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  if (scenes.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <section className="w-full py-10">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-12">
        <div className="mb-6">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-stone-700 mb-1">推荐必选</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-stone-400">针对您的测评短板，精选6个场景</p>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {scenes.map((scene) => (
            <SceneCard
              key={scene.id}
              scene={scene}
              onStart={onStart}
              recommended
              weakDimension={weakDimensions.includes(scene.dimension)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

const ExtendedPracticeSection: React.FC<{

}> = ({ onStart, scenes, loading, weakDimensions = [] }) => {

  const filteredScenes = activeDimension === 'all'

  if (loading) {

            <p className="text-sm text-stone-400">更多场景助您全面提升</p>
          </div>
          <LoadingSkeleton count={6} />
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section className="w-full py-10 bg-stone-50">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-12">
        <div className="mb-6">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-stone-700 mb-1">延伸练习</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-stone-400">更多场景助您全面提升</p>
        </div>

        <Tabs value={activeDimension} onValueChange={setActiveDimension} className="w-full">

            <TabsTrigger value="all" className="rounded-md text-sm">全部</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="result" className="gap-1 rounded-md text-sm">
              <Target className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">拿结果</span>
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="people" className="gap-1 rounded-md text-sm">
              <Users className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">带团队</span>
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="field" className="gap-1 rounded-md text-sm">
              <Heart className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">传文化</span>
            </TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>

          <TabsContent value={activeDimension} className="mt-0">
            {filteredScenes.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                {filteredScenes.map((scene) => (
                  <SceneCard
                    key={scene.id}
                    scene={scene}
                    onStart={onStart}
                    weakDimension={weakDimensions.includes(scene.dimension)}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-12 text-stone-400">
                <AlertCircle className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
                <p>暂无该维度场景</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

// ============================================
// Main Page Component
// ============================================
const CoachingPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [allScenes, setAllScenes] = useState<ICoachingScene[]>([]);
  const [weakDimensions, setWeakDimensions] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchData = async () => {
      try {
        const scenes = await getAllScenes();
        setAllScenes(scenes);
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Failed to fetch scenes:', String(error));
        toast.error('加载陪练场景失败，请刷新页面重试');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchData();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem('mdp_assessment_scores');
      if (stored) {
        const scores = JSON.parse(stored);
        if (scores && typeof scores === 'object') {
          const dims = [
            { key: 'result', score: Number(scores.result) || 0 },
            { key: 'people', score: Number(scores.people) || 0 },
            { key: 'field', score: Number(scores.field) || 0 },
          ].sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score);
          setWeakDimensions([dims[0].key, dims[1].key]);
        }
      }
    } catch {}
  }, []);

  const handleStartCoaching = (sceneId: string) => {
    if (sceneId === 'scene_pr_002') {
      navigate('/coaching/pr2-prepare');
      return;
    }
    navigate(`/coaching/${sceneId}`);
  };

  // Sort scenes: weak dimension scenes first
  const sortScenesByWeakDimension = (scenes: ICoachingScene[]): ICoachingScene[] => {
    if (weakDimensions.length === 0) return scenes;
    return [...scenes].sort((a, b) => {
      const aIsWeak = weakDimensions.includes(a.dimension) ? 0 : 1;
      const bIsWeak = weakDimensions.includes(b.dimension) ? 0 : 1;
      return aIsWeak - bIsWeak;
    });
  };

  const allCombinedScenes = sortScenesByWeakDimension(allScenes);
  const isLoading = loading;

  // 分离推荐场景和延伸练习场景，避免重复
  const recommendedScenes = allCombinedScenes.slice(0, 6);
  const recommendedSceneIds = new Set(recommendedScenes.map(s => s.id));
  const extendedScenes = allCombinedScenes.filter(s => !recommendedSceneIds.has(s.id));


  const [learningPath, setLearningPath] = useState<ILearningPath | null>(null);
  const [learningPathLoading, setLearningPathLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadPath = async () => {
      try {
        const pathData = await fetchLearningPath();
        if (pathData) {
          setLearningPath(pathData as ILearningPath);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Failed to load learning path:', String(error));
      } finally {
        setLearningPathLoading(false);
      }
    };
    loadPath();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      <HeroSection />
      <LearningPathSection
        data={learningPath}
        loading={learningPathLoading}
        onSceneClick={handleStartCoaching}
      />
      <RecommendedSection
        onStart={handleStartCoaching}
        scenes={recommendedScenes}
        loading={isLoading}
        weakDimensions={weakDimensions}
      />
      <TeamMotivationSection />
      <ExtendedPracticeSection
        onStart={handleStartCoaching}
        scenes={extendedScenes}
        loading={isLoading}
        weakDimensions={weakDimensions}
      />

    </div>
  );
};

export default CoachingPage;

                    <div className="flex-1 p-4">

                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
                            <DimIcon className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: dim.color }} />

                            </p>
                          )}
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px]" style={{ color: '#9C958C' }}>

                            <span>{session.roundCount || Math.ceil(msgCount / 2)} 轮</span>

                            </span>

                            <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }}>结果</span>
                            <span className="text-xs font-semibold" style={{ color: '#5B9A8B' }}>{session.scoreResult}</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: '#4A6FA5' }}>团队</span>
                            <span className="text-xs font-semibold" style={{ color: '#4A6FA5' }}>{session.scorePeople}</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: '#D4A564' }}>文化</span>
                            <span className="text-xs font-semibold" style={{ color: '#D4A564' }}>{session.scoreField}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0 mt-1" style={{ color: '#C4BDB3' }} />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <SessionDetailDialog
        open={dialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}
        session={selectedSession}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default MyCoachingHistory;

===FILE:./client/src/pages/coaching/pr2-chat/PR2ChatPage.tsx===
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Send, Eye, AlertCircle, User } from 'lucide-react';
import { logger } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/logger';
import { sendPR2Message, endPR2Session } from '@client/src/api/coaching-pr2';
import type {
  PR2Phase, PR2NpcMood, PR2PrincipleScores, PR2AntiPatterns,
  PR2SendMessageResponse,
} from '@shared/coaching-pr2';
import PR2SidePanel from './PR2SidePanel';

interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  role: 'user' | 'ai' | 'scene' | 'whisper';
  content: string;
  whisperType?: 'hint' | 'warn' | null;
}

interface ParsedNpcMessage {
  actions: string[];
  speech: string;
}

const parseNpcMessage = (content: string): ParsedNpcMessage => {
  const actions: string[] = [];
  const actionRegex = /（[^）]+）/g;
  let match;
  while ((match = actionRegex.exec(content)) !== null) {
    actions.push(match[0].slice(1, -1));
  }
  const speech = content.replace(actionRegex, '').trim().replace(/\n\s*\n/g, '\n');
  return { actions, speech };
};

const PHASE_LABELS: Record<PR2Phase, string> = {
  ATMOSPHERE: '营造氛围', SELF_ASSESS: '引导自评',
  RATING_GIVEN: '绩效反馈', DIAGNOSIS: '绩效诊断', GOAL_SETTING: '下阶段目标',
};

const INITIAL_SCORES: PR2PrincipleScores = {
  trust: 55, purpose: 50, encourage: 50, listen: 50, end: 45,
};

const INITIAL_ANTI_PATTERNS: PR2AntiPatterns = {
  goingThroughMotions: 0, onlyCriticism: 0, feelingsNoFacts: 0,
  emptyPlatitudes: 0, onlyPastNoFuture: 0,
};

const MOOD_DESC: Record<PR2NpcMood, string> = {
  RELAXED: '放松', CURIOUS: '好奇', SHOCKED: '震惊',
  EMOTIONAL: '情绪化', PROCESSING: '思考中', CONSTRUCTIVE: '建设性', SHUTDOWN: '关闭',
};

const PRINCIPLE_NAMES: Record<keyof PR2PrincipleScores, string> = {
  trust: '信任', purpose: '目的', encourage: '鼓励', listen: '倾听', end: '结束',
};

const FROSTED = 'bg-white/55 backdrop-blur-[24px] border border-white/40';
const FROSTED_INPUT = 'bg-white/75 backdrop-blur-[16px]';

const NPC_AVATAR_URL = '/spark/app/app_4k9rsyph7an84/runtime/api/v1/storage/object/bucket_aadkd3ry5kkki_static/static%2Faadkj5uvdc6fs_ve_miaoda';

const PR2ChatPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { sessionId } = useParams<{ sessionId: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState('');
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [ending, setEnding] = useState(false);
  const [round, setRound] = useState(0);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<PR2Phase>('ATMOSPHERE');
  const [npcMood, setNpcMood] = useState<PR2NpcMood>('RELAXED');
  const [scores, setScores] = useState<PR2PrincipleScores>(INITIAL_SCORES);
  const [antiPatterns] = useState<PR2AntiPatterns>(INITIAL_ANTI_PATTERNS);
  const [phaseTransition, setPhaseTransition] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sessionId) return;
    setMessages([
      { id: 'opening', role: 'scene', content: '下午3点 · 小会议室' },
      { id: 'opening_npc', role: 'ai', content: '（她推门进来，脸上带着笑，在你对面坐下。她今天心情不错——昨天刚交了三个方案，主管还夸她进步大。）' },
      { id: 'opening_hint', role: 'whisper', content: '先聊两句让她放松。不用急着说等级——这场对话不是审判。', whisperType: 'hint' },
    ]);
    setLoaded(true);
  }, [sessionId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (scrollRef.current) scrollRef.current.scrollTop = scrollRef.current.scrollHeight;
  }, [messages]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = textareaRef.current;
    if (el) {
      el.style.height = 'auto';
      el.style.height = `${Math.min(el.scrollHeight, 120)}px`;
    }
  }, [inputValue]);

  const handleSend = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!inputValue.trim() || sending || !sessionId) return;
    const userMsg: ChatMessage = { id: `u_${Date.now()}`, role: 'user', content: inputValue.trim() };
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setInputValue('');
    setSending(true);
    try {
      const resp: PR2SendMessageResponse = await sendPR2Message({ sessionId, message: userMsg.content });
      if (resp.phase !== phase) {
        setPhaseTransition(PHASE_LABELS[resp.phase]);
        setTimeout(() => setPhaseTransition(null), 3000);
      }
      const newMsgs: ChatMessage[] = [{ id: `a_${Date.now()}`, role: 'ai', content: resp.npcReply }];
      if (resp.whisper) {
        newMsgs.push({ id: `w_${Date.now()}`, role: 'whisper', content: resp.whisper, whisperType: resp.whisperType });
      }
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, ...newMsgs]);
      setRound(resp.round);
      setPhase(resp.phase);
      setNpcMood(resp.npcMood);
      setScores(resp.principlesScores);
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('Failed to send PR2 message', String(err));
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, { id: `e_${Date.now()}`, role: 'ai', content: '（网络问题，请重试）' }]);
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  }, [inputValue, sending, sessionId, phase]);

  const handleEnd = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!sessionId || ending) return;
    setEnding(true);
    try {
      const resp = await endPR2Session(sessionId);
      navigate(`/coaching/pr2-feedback/${resp.sessionId}`);
    } catch (err) { logger.error('Failed to end session', String(err)); }
    finally { setEnding(false); }
  }, [sessionId, ending, navigate]);

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); handleSend(); }
  };

  if (!loaded) {
    return <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-full text-stone-400 text-sm">加载中...</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="pr2-root">
      <div className="pr2-ambient pr2-ambient-1" />
      <div className="pr2-ambient pr2-ambient-2" />
      <div className="flex gap-3 max-w-[960px] w-full h-[92vh] max-h-[780px] relative z-10">
        {/* Chat Area */}
        <div className={`flex-1 flex flex-col rounded-[18px] overflow-hidden ${FROSTED}`}>
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-black/[.04]">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <img
                src={NPC_AVATAR_URL}
                alt="管理者B"
                className="w-[34px] h-[34px] rounded-full object-cover shrink-0"
              />
              <div>
                <span className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-stone-700">管理者B</span>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-stone-400 mt-px leading-tight">2022届通用胜任力 · 25岁</div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-black/[.03]">
                    <span className="w-[5px] h-[5px] rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-stone-400">{MOOD_DESC[npcMood]}</span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-stone-300">·</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-stone-400">第{round}轮</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-black/[.04] text-stone-500 font-medium">
              {PHASE_LABELS[phase]}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Phase transition */}
          <AnimatePresence>
            {phaseTransition && (
              <motion.div
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
                className="text-center py-1.5 text-[11px] text-teal-600 bg-teal-600/[.06] border-b border-teal-600/10"
              >
                进入新阶段：{phaseTransition}
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>

          {/* Messages */}
          <div ref={scrollRef} className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3 flex flex-col gap-2.5">
            <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
              {messages.map((msg: ChatMessage) => {
                if (msg.role === 'scene') {
                  return (
                    <motion.div key={msg.id} initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                      className="text-center text-[12px] text-stone-400 py-2 italic">
                      {msg.content}
                    </motion.div>
                  );
                }
                if (msg.role === 'whisper') {
                  const isWarn = msg.whisperType === 'warn';
                  return (
                    <motion.div key={msg.id} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                      className={`flex items-start gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-[12px] leading-relaxed mx-2 ${
                        isWarn ? 'bg-amber-100/25 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200/30'
                               : 'bg-blue-50/35 text-blue-500 border border-blue-200/20'}`}>
                      {isWarn ? <AlertCircle size={12} className="shrink-0 mt-0.5" /> : <Eye size={12} className="shrink-0 mt-0.5" />}
                      <span>{msg.content}</span>
                    </motion.div>
                  );
                }
                const isUser = msg.role === 'user';
                return (
                  <motion.div key={msg.id} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    className={`flex items-end gap-1.5 max-w-[80%] ${isUser ? 'self-end flex-row-reverse' : 'self-start'}`}>
                    {!isUser && (
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-center shrink-0 self-end">
                        <img
                          src={NPC_AVATAR_URL}
                          alt="管理者B"
                          className="w-[26px] h-[26px] rounded-full object-cover"
                        />
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-stone-500 mt-0.5 whitespace-nowrap">管理者B</span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div className={`px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed break-words ${
                      isUser ? 'bg-[#1C1917] text-white rounded-[18px_18px_4px_18px]'
                             : 'bg-white text-stone-900 border border-black/[.04] rounded-[18px_18px_18px_4px]'}`}>
                      {isUser ? msg.content : (() => {
                        const { actions, speech } = parseNpcMessage(msg.content);
                        return (
                          <>
                            {actions.length > 0 && (
                              <div className="text-[11px] text-stone-400 italic mb-1.5 leading-snug">
                                {actions.map((a: string, i: number) => (
                                  <span key={i}>{i > 0 ? ' ' : ''}{a}</span>
                                ))}
                              </div>
                            )}
                            {speech && <div>{speech}</div>}
                          </>
                        );
                      })()}
                    </div>
                    {isUser && (
                      <div className="w-[26px] h-[26px] rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-600 to-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                        <User size={12} className="text-white" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </motion.div>
                );
              })}
            </AnimatePresence>
            {sending && (
              <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} className="flex items-end gap-1.5 self-start">
                <img
                  src={NPC_AVATAR_URL}
                  alt="管理者B"
                  className="w-[26px] h-[26px] rounded-full object-cover shrink-0"
                />
                <div className="bg-white border border-black/[.04] rounded-[18px_18px_18px_4px] px-4 py-3 flex gap-1">
                  <span className="typing-dot" /><span className="typing-dot" /><span className="typing-dot" />
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Input */}
          <div className={`px-3.5 py-2.5 border-t border-black/[.04] ${FROSTED_INPUT}`}>
            <div className="flex items-end gap-2 bg-white/80 border border-black/[.06] rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-1.5">
              <textarea ref={textareaRef} value={inputValue} onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => setInputValue(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={handleKeyDown} placeholder="说点什么..." rows={1} disabled={sending}
                className="flex-1 resize-none border-none outline-none bg-transparent text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-stone-900 max-h-[120px] overflow-y-auto placeholder:text-stone-400 font-[inherit]" />
              <button onClick={handleSend} disabled={!inputValue.trim() || sending}
                className="w-[34px] h-[34px] rounded-full bg-[#1C1917] text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border-none cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:opacity-85 transition-opacity">
                <Send size={16} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-center gap-3 mt-1.5">
              {(['trust', 'purpose', 'encourage', 'listen', 'end'] as const).map((k: keyof PR2PrincipleScores) => (
                <span key={k} className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span className="w-[5px] h-[5px] rounded-full"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: scores[k] >= 50 ? '#10B981' : scores[k] >= 30 ? '#F59E0B' : '#EF4444' }} />
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-stone-400">{PRINCIPLE_NAMES[k]}</span>
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Side Panel */}
        <div className="side-panel-wrapper">
          <PR2SidePanel npcMood={npcMood} moodDescription={MOOD_DESC[npcMood]}
            phase={phase} phaseLabel={PHASE_LABELS[phase]} phaseDescription=""
            scores={scores} antiPatterns={antiPatterns} onEndSession={handleEnd} ending={ending} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <style jsx>{`
        .pr2-root {
          min-height: 100%;
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;

function formatDate(isoStr: string): string {
  const d = new Date(isoStr);
  const month = d.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = d.getDate();
  const hours = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const minutes = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${month}月${day}日 ${hours}:${minutes}`;
}

function ScoreBar({ label, score, color }: { label: string; score: number; color: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="score-bar-row">
      <span className="score-bar-label">{label}</span>
      <div className="score-bar-track">
        <div className="score-bar-fill" style={{ width: `${score}%`, background: color }} />
      </div>
      <span className="score-bar-value">{score}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function SessionItem({
  session,
  currentAvg,
}: {
  session: PR2PastSession;
  currentAvg: number;
}) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const diff = currentAvg - session.avgScore;
  const keys = Object.keys(PRINCIPLE_LABELS) as (keyof PR2PrincipleScores)[];

  const userMessages = session.messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'user');
  const aiMessages = session.messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'ai');

  return (
    <div className="session-item">
      <button className="session-header" onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}>
        <div className="session-header-left">
          <span className="session-date">{formatDate(session.completedAt)}</span>
          <span className="session-avg">均分 {session.avgScore}</span>
          {diff !== 0 && (
            <span className={diff > 0 ? 'session-diff-up' : 'session-diff-down'}>
              {diff > 0 ? `↑+${diff}` : `↓${diff}`}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="session-header-right">
          <MessageCircle size={13} className="session-msg-icon" />
          <span className="session-msg-count">{userMessages.length}轮</span>
          {expanded ? <ChevronUp size={14} /> : <ChevronDown size={14} />}
        </div>
      </button>

      {expanded && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.25 }}
          className="session-body"
        >
          <div className="session-scores">
            {keys.map((key) => (
              <ScoreBar
                key={key}
                label={PRINCIPLE_LABELS[key]}
                score={session.principlesScores[key]}
                color={PRINCIPLE_COLORS[key]}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="session-conversation">
            <div className="conversation-title">对话记录</div>
            <div className="conversation-list">
              {session.messages
                .filter((m) => m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'ai')
                .slice(0, 20)
                .map((msg, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className={`msg-bubble ${msg.role === 'user' ? 'msg-user' : 'msg-ai'}`}>
                    <span className="msg-role">{msg.role === 'user' ? '你' : '管理者B'}</span>
                    <span className="msg-text">{msg.content}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              {session.messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'ai').length > 20 && (
                <div className="msg-more">仅显示前20条对话</div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ConversationHistoryCard({ currentAvgScore }: { currentAvgScore: number }) {
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<PR2PastSession[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const load = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await getPR2PastSessions();
        if (!cancelled) setSessions(result.sessions);
      } catch (err) {
        logger.error('加载历史会话失败', String(err));
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    load();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  return (
    <motion.section
      {...FADE_UP}
      transition={{ ...FADE_UP.transition, delay: 0.35 }}
      className={CARD_CLASS}
    >
      <div className="section-num">对话记录</div>
      <div className="section-title">历往练习回顾</div>
      <div className="section-sub">回顾每一次练习的对话和分数，见证你的成长轨迹。</div>

      {loading && <div className="history-loading">加载中...</div>}

      {!loading && sessions.length === 0 && (
        <div className="history-empty">
          <MessageCircle size={20} className="history-empty-icon" />
          <p>这是你的第一次练习</p>
          <p className="history-empty-hint">完成后这里会显示历史记录，方便你对比分数变化。</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {!loading && sessions.length > 0 && (
        <div className="history-list">
          {sessions.map((session) => (
            <SessionItem key={session.sessionId} session={session} currentAvg={currentAvgScore} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </motion.section>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { logger } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/logger';
import type {
  PR2FeedbackData,
  PR2VerdictComparison,
  PR2BehaviorFinding,
  PR2CourseRecommendation,
  PR2AntiPatterns,
} from '@shared/coaching-pr2';
import { savePR2Commit } from '@/api/coaching-pr2';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { UniversalLink } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/components/UniversalLink';

const CARD_CLASS =
  'rounded-[18px] bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-[20px] border border-white/50 p-[22px_20px] shadow-[0_3px_16px_rgba(0_0_0_.03)]';
const FADE_UP = { initial: { opacity: 0, y: 24 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, transition: { duration: 0.5 } };

const PRINCIPLE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  trust: '建立信任',
  purpose: '说明目的',
  encourage: '鼓励表达',
  listen: '认真倾听',
  end: '积极结束',
};

const PRINCIPLE_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  trust: '#3B82F6',
  purpose: '#10B981',
  encourage: '#F59E0B',
  listen: '#EF4444',
  end: '#8B5CF6',
};

const RADAR_POINTS = [
  { x: 100, y: 22 },
  { x: 172, y: 72 },
  { x: 145, y: 162 },
  { x: 55, y: 162 },
  { x: 28, y: 72 },
];

const RADAR_ANGLES_DEG = [-90, 18, 126, 234, 306];
const RADAR_CENTER = { x: 100, y: 100 };
const RADAR_RADIUS = 78;

function computeRadarPolygon(scores: number[]): Array<{ x: number; y: number }> {
  return RADAR_ANGLES_DEG.map((angle, i) => {
    const ratio = (scores[i] ?? 0) / 100;
    const rad = (angle * Math.PI) / 180;
    return {
      x: RADAR_CENTER.x + RADAR_RADIUS * ratio * Math.cos(rad),
      y: RADAR_CENTER.y + RADAR_RADIUS * ratio * Math.sin(rad),
    };
  });
}

function getPrincipleDesc(key: string, score: number): string {
  const descs: Record<string, [number, string, string]> = {
    trust: [70, '她走出门时还信你', '有信任波动的时刻'],
    purpose: [70, '她知道为什么是C', '目的可以更清楚'],
    encourage: [70, '她说了不少', '给她更多说的空间'],
    listen: [70, '接住了情绪', '先听完再讲道理'],
    end: [70, '有具体的跟进', '差一个她能抓住的东西'],
  };
  const entry = descs[key];
  return entry ? (score >= entry[0] ? entry[1] : entry[2]) : '';
}

// ===== ① Overall Assessment Card (Radar + Verdict + Self-Comparison + Structure) =====
export function OverallCard({ data }: { data: PR2FeedbackData }) {
  const scores = data.overall.principlesScores;
  const keys = ['trust', 'purpose', 'encourage', 'listen', 'end'] as const;
  const scoreValues = keys.map((k) => scores[k]);
  const polygon = computeRadarPolygon(scoreValues);
  const polygonPoints = polygon.map((p) => `${p.x.toFixed(1)},${p.y.toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');

  const avg = scoreValues.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / 5;

  return (
    <motion.section {...FADE_UP} className={CARD_CLASS}>
      <div className="section-num">① 整体评估</div>
      <div className="section-title">你的面谈画像</div>
      <div className="section-sub">五条原则，五个分数。评估的是你的面谈行为，不是她的业务方案。</div>

      <div className="radar-area">
        <svg width="180" height="180" viewBox="0 0 200 200">
          <polygon
            points={RADAR_POINTS.map((p) => `${p.x},${p.y}`).join(' ')}
            fill="none"
            stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.08)"
            strokeWidth="1"
          />
          <polygon
            points="100,50 154,78 134,137 66,137 46,78"
            fill="none"
            stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.04)"
            strokeWidth="0.8"
          />
          {RADAR_POINTS.map((p, i) => (
            <line
              key={i}
              x1="100"
              y1="100"
              x2={String(p.x)}
              y2={String(p.y)}
              stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.04)"
              strokeWidth="0.4"
            />
          ))}
          <polygon points={polygonPoints} fill="rgba(59,130,246,.1)" stroke="#3B82F6" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          {polygon.map((p, i) => (
            <circle key={i} cx={p.x.toFixed(1)} cy={p.y.toFixed(1)} r="3.5" fill={PRINCIPLE_COLORS[keys[i]]} />
          ))}
        </svg>
        <div className="radar-labels">
          {keys.map((key, i) => (
            <div key={key}>
              <div className="radar-row">
                <span className="radar-dot" style={{ background: PRINCIPLE_COLORS[key] }} />
                <span className="radar-name">{`①②③④⑤`[i]}{PRINCIPLE_LABELS[key]}</span>
                <span className="radar-score">{scoreValues[i]}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="radar-desc">{getPrincipleDesc(key, scoreValues[i])}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {data.overall.verdict && (
        <div className="verdict-box">
          <div className="v-main">{data.overall.verdict}</div>
          <div
            className="v-tag"
            style={{
              background: avg >= 65 ? 'rgba(16,185,129,.06)' : 'rgba(220,38,38,.06)',
              color: avg >= 65 ? '#065F46' : '#DC2626',
            }}
          >
            {avg >= 65 ? '整体表现良好' : '仍有提升空间'}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {data.overall.selfComparison.length > 0 && <SelfComparisonMini comparisons={data.overall.selfComparison} />}

      {data.overall.structureAnalysis && <div className="structure-line">{data.overall.structureAnalysis}</div>}
    </motion.section>
  );
}

function SelfComparisonMini({ comparisons }: { comparisons: PR2VerdictComparison[] }) {
  const valid = comparisons.filter((c) => c.selfScore !== null);
  if (valid.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="compare-mini">
      {valid.map((c: PR2VerdictComparison) => (
        <span key={c.principle}>
          {c.principle}：自评<strong>{c.selfScore}</strong> → 实际<strong>{c.actualScore}</strong>{' '}
          <span className={Math.abs(c.gap) <= 5 ? 'gap-ok' : 'gap-red'}>
            {c.gap > 0 ? `+${c.gap}` : c.gap}
          </span>
        </span>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function BehaviorReviewCard({
  findings,

  consolidatedInsight?: string;

      <div>
        {findings.map((f: PR2BehaviorFinding, i: number) => (
          <div key={i} className={`finding${i > 0 ? ' finding-gap' : ''}`}>
            <div className="fd-head">
              <span
                className="fd-badge"
                style={{
                  background: f.type === 'good' ? 'rgba(59,130,246,.08)' : 'rgba(245,158,11,.08)',
                  color: f.type === 'good' ? '#3B82F6' : '#D97706',
                }}
              >
                {f.type === 'good' ? '✓ 做得好' : '△ 可改进'}
              </span>
              {f.principleLabel && <span className="fd-principle">{f.principleLabel}</span>}
            </div>

            <div className="fd-quote">"{f.quote}"</div>

            <div className="fd-note">{f.note}</div>

            {f.alternative && <div className="fd-alt">💡 {f.alternative}</div>}

            {f.forkActual && f.forkAlternative && (
              <div className="fork-box">
                <div className="fork-label">岔路口</div>
                <div className="fork-path fork-actual">
                  <strong>你实际说的：</strong>{f.forkActual}
                </div>
                <div className="fork-path fork-alt">
                  <strong>可以试试：</strong>{f.forkAlternative}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </motion.section>
  );
}

// ===== ④ Commitment Card =====
export function CommitmentCard({
  sessionId,
  weakestLabel,
}: {
  sessionId: string;
  weakestLabel?: string;
}) {
  const [commitText, setCommitText] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!commitText.trim()) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await savePR2Commit({ sessionId, commitContent: commitText.trim() });
      setSaved(true);
      toast.success('行动承诺已保存');
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('保存承诺失败', String(err));
      toast.error('保存失败，请重试');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <motion.section {...FADE_UP} transition={{ ...FADE_UP.transition, delay: 0.3 }} className={CARD_CLASS}>
      <div className="section-num">④ 行动承诺</div>
      <div className="section-title">下次带进练习的一件事</div>
      <div className="section-sub">不是"下次注意"——是一个具体的、你下次就会试的行为。</div>

      <div className="commit-box">
        <p className="commit-hint">
          <strong>🧪 基于你最需要加强的原则——{weakestLabel ?? '积极结束'}</strong>，系统建议你下次专门练习这一个行为。
        </p>

        <input
          className="one-field-input"
          placeholder="下次，当[什么场景]，我会[做什么]。做对的信号是[看到什么]。"
          value={commitText}
          onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setCommitText(e.target.value)}
          disabled={saved}
        />

        <div className="loop-flow">
          <span className="loop-step">📝 这次承诺</span>
          <span className="loop-arrow">→</span>
          <span className="loop-step">🔁 下次练习验证</span>
          <span className="loop-arrow">→</span>
          <span className="loop-step">📊 对比变化</span>
          <span className="loop-arrow">→</span>
          <span className="loop-step">✅ 带回真实团队</span>
        </div>
        <p className="commit-footer">下次回到平台时，系统会调出你这次的承诺——对比你上次说了什么，这次说了什么。这就是闭环。</p>

        <button className="btn-save" onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving || saved || !commitText.trim()}>
          {saving ? '保存中...' : saved ? '已保存 ✓' : '确认 → 带回下次练习'}
        </button>
      </div>
    </motion.section>
  );
}

// ===== ⑤ Learning Recommendations =====
export function LearningCard({ data }: { data: PR2FeedbackData }) {
  const { weakestPrinciple, courses } = data.recommendation;
  if (!weakestPrinciple && courses.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <motion.section {...FADE_UP} transition={{ ...FADE_UP.transition, delay: 0.4 }} className={CARD_CLASS}>
      <div className="section-num">⑤ 学习推荐</div>
      <div className="section-title">薄弱点 · 推荐课程</div>
      <div className="section-sub">基于你最需要加强的原则——先学再练，对比更明显。</div>

      {weakestPrinciple && (
        <div className="weakness-card">
          你最需要加强的原则是<strong>{weakestPrinciple}</strong>。以下课程可以帮助你建立相关的认知框架和实操方法。
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="course-list">
        {courses.map((c: PR2CourseRecommendation) => (
          <UniversalLink key={c.id} to={c.url} className="course-link">
            <span className="course-icon">📖</span>
            <span>{c.name}</span>
            <span className="course-arrow">→</span>
          </UniversalLink>
        ))}
      </div>

      <p className="course-hint">建议在下次练习前花15分钟过一遍课程。</p>
    </motion.section>
  );
}

// ===== Sidebar Components =====
export function KeyFindingsCard({ findings }: { findings: PR2BehaviorFinding[] }) {
  const goodCount = findings.filter((f) => f.type === 'good').length;
  const improveCount = findings.filter((f) => f.type === 'improve').length;

  return (
    <div className={CARD_CLASS + ' key-card'}>
      <div className="key-title">📌 关键发现</div>
      <div className="key-summary">
        <span>亮点 {goodCount}</span>
        <span>待改进 {improveCount}</span>
      </div>
      {findings.slice(0, 4).map((f: PR2BehaviorFinding, i: number) => (
        <div key={i} className={`key-item${i > 0 ? ' key-item-gap' : ''}`}>
          <span
            className="key-dot"
            style={{ background: f.type === 'good' ? '#3B82F6' : '#F59E0B' }}
          />
          <span>{f.note}</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function AntiPatternCard({ antiPatterns }: { antiPatterns: PR2AntiPatterns | null }) {
  if (!antiPatterns) return null;

  const LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
    goingThroughMotions: '走过场',
    onlyCriticism: '只有批评',
    feelingsNoFacts: '感受多事实少',
    emptyPlatitudes: '空洞鼓励',
    onlyPastNoFuture: '只谈过去',
  };

  const entries = Object.entries(antiPatterns).filter(([, v]: [string, number]) => v > 0);
  if (entries.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className={CARD_CLASS + ' key-card key-card-warn'}>
      <div className="key-title key-title-warn">⚠️ 需警惕的模式</div>
      <div className="antipattern-list">
        {entries.map(([key, count]: [string, number]) => (
          <div key={key} className="antipattern-item">
            <span>{LABELS[key] ?? key}</span>
            <span className="antipattern-count">{count}次</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ActionButtons() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  return (
    <>
      <div className="side-btn-row">
        <button className="btn-side btn-side-dark" onClick={() => navigate('/coaching/pr2-prepare')}>
          再练一次
        </button>
        <button className="btn-side btn-side-light" onClick={() => navigate('/coaching')}>
          换场景
        </button>
      </div>
      <p className="footer-text">建议 3-7 天内回来 · 带着这次的承诺</p>
    </>
  );
}

export function FeedbackLoading() {
  return (
    <div className="feedback-loading">
      <motion.div
        animate={{ rotate: 360 }}
        transition={{ duration: 2, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' }}
        className="loading-spinner"
      />
      <p className="loading-text">正在分析你的面谈表现...</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { logger } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/logger';
import {
  getPR2History,
  initPR2Session,
} from '@client/src/api/coaching-pr2';
import type {
  PR2Difficulty,
  PR2SelfAssessment,
  PR2HistoryData,
} from '@shared/coaching-pr2';

const PRINCIPLES: Array<{
  key: keyof PR2SelfAssessment;
  label: string;
}> = [
  { key: 'trust', label: '建立信任' },
  { key: 'purpose', label: '说明目的' },
  { key: 'encourage', label: '鼓励说话' },
  { key: 'listen', label: '认真倾听' },
  { key: 'end', label: '积极结束' },
];

const DIFFICULTY_OPTIONS: Array<{
  value: PR2Difficulty;
  label: string;
}> = [
  { value: 'easy', label: '新手' },
  { value: 'normal', label: '中等' },
  { value: 'hard', label: '高手' },
];

const PR2PreparePage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<PR2HistoryData | null>(null);
  const [scores, setScores] = useState<PR2SelfAssessment>({});
  const [difficulty, setDifficulty] = useState<PR2Difficulty>('normal');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    getPR2History()
      .then((data: PR2HistoryData) => setHistory(data))
      .catch((err: unknown) => logger.error('加载历史记录失败', String(err)));
  }, []);

  const handleScoreChange = useCallback(
    (key: keyof PR2SelfAssessment, val: number) => {
      setScores((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: Math.min(10, Math.max(1, val)) }));
    },
    [],
  );

  const handleStart = useCallback(async () => {
    if (loading) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await initPR2Session({
        selfAssessment: scores,
        difficulty,
      });
      sessionStorage.setItem(
        `pr2_bridge_${res.sessionId}`,
        JSON.stringify({ bridgeMessage: res.bridgeMessage, bridgeHint: res.bridgeHint }),
      );
      navigate(`/coaching/pr2-transition/${res.sessionId}`);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      logger.error('初始化会话失败', String(err));
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [loading, scores, difficulty, navigate]);

  return (
    <div className="pr2-prepare-root">
      <div className="amb amb-1" />
      <div className="amb amb-2" />

      <motion.div
        className="card"
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: 'easeOut' }}
      >
        <div className="npc-header">
          <img
            className="npc-avatar-img"
            src="/spark/app/app_4k9rsyph7an84/runtime/api/v1/storage/object/bucket_aadkd3ry5kkki_static/static%2Faadkj5uvdc6fs_ve_miaoda"
            alt="管理者B"
          />
          <div className="npc-info">
            <div className="npc-name">管理者B</div>
            <div className="npc-subtitle">2022届通用胜任力 · 25岁 · 你带了她两年</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="meta-line">半年度绩效面谈 · 下午3:00 · 小会议室 · 30分钟</div>

        <h1 className="main-title">
          她以为自己是B。<br />但绩效结果是个C。
        </h1>

        <div className="section-tag">情境背景</div>
        <motion.p
          className="story"
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ delay: 0.2, duration: 0.4 }}
        >
          管理者B是2022届通用胜任力，25岁，你带了她两年。性格外向，对工作很上心，同事们都挺喜欢她。
        </motion.p>
        <div className="badge-row">
          <span className="data-badge badge-neutral">交付 <strong>14</strong> 个方案</span>
          <span className="data-badge badge-neutral">加班时长 <strong>全组前三</strong></span>
          <span className="data-badge badge-good">同事评价好</span>
        </div>
        <motion.p
          className="story"
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ delay: 0.25, duration: 0.4 }}
        >
          光看这些，你会觉得这是个又努力又受欢迎的好员工。
        </motion.p>

        <div className="section-tag">核心矛盾</div>
        <motion.p
          className="story"
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}

import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

const AVATAR_URL = '/spark/app/app_4k9rsyph7an84/runtime/api/v1/storage/object/bucket_aadkd3ry5kkki_static/static%2Faadkj5uvdc6fs_ve_miaoda';

const PR2TransitionPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { sessionId } = useParams<{ sessionId: string }>();
  const [doorOpened, setDoorOpened] = useState(false);
  const [bridgeMsg, setBridgeMsg] = useState('');
  const [bridgeHint, setBridgeHint] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sessionId) return;
    const key = `pr2_bridge_${sessionId}`;
    try {
      const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(key);
      if (raw) {
        const data = JSON.parse(raw);
        setBridgeMsg(data.bridgeMessage || '');
        setBridgeHint(data.bridgeHint || '');
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }, [sessionId]);

  const handleDoorKnock = useCallback(() => {
    if (doorOpened) return;
    setDoorOpened(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (sessionId) navigate(`/coaching/pr2-chat/${sessionId}`);
    }, 800);
  }, [sessionId, navigate, doorOpened]);

  const handleSkip = useCallback(() => {
    if (sessionId) navigate(`/coaching/pr2-chat/${sessionId}`);
  }, [sessionId, navigate]);

  return (
    <div className="transition-root">
      <div className="amb amb-1" />
      <div className="amb amb-2" />

      <motion.div
        className="avatar-section"
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ delay: 0.2, duration: 0.5 }}
      >
        <img className="avatar-img" src={AVATAR_URL} alt="管理者B" />
        <div className="avatar-name text-center">管理者B</div>
      </motion.div>

      <motion.div
        className="msg-section"
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ delay: 0.5, duration: 0.4 }}
      >
        {bridgeMsg && <p className="msg-text">{bridgeMsg}</p>}
        {bridgeHint && <p className="msg-hint">{bridgeHint}</p>}
      </motion.div>

      <motion.div
        className="door-section"
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ delay: 0.8, duration: 0.5 }}
      >
        <div
          className={`door${doorOpened ? ' door-opened' : ''}`}
          onClick={handleDoorKnock}
          role="button"
          tabIndex={0}
        >
          <div className="door-frame">
            <div className="door-panel">
              <div className="door-handle" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="door-label">
            {doorOpened ? '推门进入...' : '敲门进入'}
          </div>
        </div>

        <p className="skip-link" onClick={handleSkip}>
          跳过，直接开始
        </p>
      </motion.div>

      <style jsx>{`

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { ArrowLeft, Loader2, Target, BookOpen, AlertTriangle, Lightbulb, Send } from 'lucide-react';
import { logger } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/logger';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import ReactECharts from 'echarts-for-react';
import type { EChartsOption } from 'echarts';
import { generateTeamMotivationFeedback } from '@client/src/api/team-motivation';
import type {
  TMFeedbackReport,
  TMFeedbackTheoryLens,
  TMFeedbackIndustryCalibration,
  TMFeedbackExpertBenchmark,
  TMWeaknessItem,
  TMRecommendedCourse,
  TMSessionScores,
} from '@shared/coaching-team-motivation';
import { Button } from '@client/src/components/ui/button';
import { axiosForBackend } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/utils/getAxiosForBackend';

const fadeInUp = {
  initial: { opacity: 0, y: 20 },
  animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
  transition: { duration: 0.5 },
};

const TeamMotivationFeedbackPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { sessionId } = useParams<{ sessionId: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [report, setReport] = useState<TMFeedbackReport | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [commitText, setCommitText] = useState('');
  const [committing, setCommitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sessionId) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    generateTeamMotivationFeedback({ sessionId })
      .then((data: TMFeedbackReport) => {
        if (!cancelled) setReport(data);
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        logger.error('生成反馈报告失败', String(err));
        if (!cancelled) setError('报告生成失败，请重试');
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [sessionId]);

  const handleSubmitCommit = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!commitText.trim() || committing) return;
    setCommitting(true);
    try {
      await axiosForBackend({
        url: '/api/practice/commit',
        method: 'POST',
        data: { commitContent: commitText.trim(), sessionId },
      });
      toast.success('行动承诺已保存');
      setCommitText('');
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('提交行动承诺失败', String(err));
      toast.error('提交失败，请重试');
    } finally {
      setCommitting(false);
    }
  }, [commitText, committing, sessionId]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-[#F8F6F2] via-[#F5F0E8] to-[#EDE8E0]">
        <Loader2 className="size-8 animate-spin text-stone-400 mb-4" />
        <p className="text-sm text-stone-500">正在生成反馈报告...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !report) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-[#F8F6F2] via-[#F5F0E8] to-[#EDE8E0]">
        <div className="text-center">
          <p className="text-stone-500 mb-4">{error ?? '报告加载失败'}</p>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => navigate('/coaching')}>
            <ArrowLeft className="size-4" />
            返回陪练列表
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const scores = report.scores;
  const totalScore = scores
    ? Math.round(
        (scores.pNodeAccuracy + scores.dMatchScore + scores.decisionConsistency) / 3,
      )
    : 0;

  const radarOption: EChartsOption = scores?.subScores
    ? {
        tooltip: { trigger: 'item' },
        radar: {
          indicator: Object.keys(scores.subScores).map((key) => ({
            name: key,
          })),
          radius: '65%',
          axisName: { color: '#78716c', fontSize: 11 },
          splitArea: { areaStyle: { color: ['rgba(245,240,232,0.3)', 'rgba(245,240,232,0.15)'] } },
        },
        series: [
          {
            type: 'radar',
            data: [
              {
                value: Object.values(scores.subScores),
                name: '能力评分',
                areaStyle: { color: 'rgba(13,148,136,0.15)' },
                lineStyle: { color: '#0d9488', width: 2 },
                itemStyle: { color: '#0d9488' },
              },
            ],
          },
        ],
      }
    : {};

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-[#F8F6F2] via-[#F5F0E8] to-[#EDE8E0] relative overflow-hidden">

          </p>
          <textarea

const ScoreCard: React.FC<{
  label: string;
  value: number;
  accent: string;
  suffix?: string;
}> = ({ label, value, accent, suffix }) => {
  const colorMap: Record<string, string> = {
    stone: 'text-stone-800',
    teal: 'text-teal-700',
    amber: 'text-amber-700',
    blue: 'text-blue-700',
  };
  return (
    <div className="text-center">
      <p className={`text-2xl font-bold ${colorMap[accent] ?? 'text-stone-700'}`}>
        {value}
        {suffix && <span className="text-sm font-normal">{suffix}</span>}
      </p>
      <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mt-0.5">{label}</p>
    </div>
  );
};

const SectionCard: React.FC<{
  title: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}> = ({ title, icon, children }) => (
  <motion.div
    {...fadeInUp}
    className="rounded-2xl bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/60 shadow-lg p-6 mb-6"
  >
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
      {icon}
      <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-stone-700">{title}</h2>
    </div>
    {children}
  </motion.div>
);

const FeedbackItem: React.FC<{
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  content: string;
}> = ({ title, subtitle, content }) => (
  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-white/70 border border-stone-200/50">
    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-stone-700 mb-0.5">{title}</p>
    {subtitle && (
      <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mb-1.5">{subtitle}</p>
    )}
    <p className="text-xs text-stone-600 leading-relaxed">{content}</p>
  </div>
);

export default TeamMotivationFeedbackPage;
