import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { ArrowLeft, Loader2, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, CheckCircle2, XCircle, MessageSquare } from 'lucide-react';
import { logger } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/logger';
import { submitTeamMotivationOption } from '@client/src/api/team-motivation';
import { streamEnhancedDialogue } from '@client/src/utils/tm-dialogue-enhance';
import type {
  TMCurrentDecisionPoint,
  TMInitSessionResponse,
} from '@shared/coaching-team-motivation';
import { Button } from '@client/src/components/ui/button';

interface ChatMessage {
  role: 'npc' | 'system' | 'user';
  content: string;
  characterName?: string;
}

interface PlayState {
  messages: ChatMessage[];
  currentDecisionPoint: TMCurrentDecisionPoint | null;
  isProcessing: boolean;
  decisionIndex: number;
  totalDecisions: number;
  isCompleted: boolean;
  lastConsequence: string;
  lastExplanation: string;
  lastIsCorrect: boolean;
}

const TeamMotivationPlayPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { sessionId } = useParams<{ sessionId: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [showExplanation, setShowExplanation] = useState(false);
  const [isStreaming, setIsStreaming] = useState(false);

  const [state, setState] = useState<PlayState>({
    messages: [],
    currentDecisionPoint: null,
    isProcessing: false,
    decisionIndex: 0,
    totalDecisions: 3,
    isCompleted: false,
    lastConsequence: '',
    lastExplanation: '',
    lastIsCorrect: false,
  });

  const [sessionMeta, setSessionMeta] = useState<{
    openingCharacter: string;
    openingLine: string;
    sceneTitle?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sessionId) return;
    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(`tm_session_${sessionId}`);
    if (!raw) {
      logger.error('未找到会话数据');
      navigate('/coaching');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const parsed: Pick<TMInitSessionResponse, 'openingCharacter' | 'openingLine' | 'currentDecisionPoint'> = JSON.parse(raw);
      setSessionMeta({
        openingCharacter: parsed.openingCharacter,
        openingLine: parsed.openingLine,
      });
      setState((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        messages: [
          { role: 'system', content: '场景开始' },
          {
            role: 'npc',
            content: parsed.openingLine,
            characterName: parsed.openingCharacter,
          },
        ],
        currentDecisionPoint: parsed.currentDecisionPoint,
        totalDecisions: 3,
      }));
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('解析会话数据失败', String(err));
      navigate('/coaching');
    }
  }, [sessionId, navigate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (scrollRef.current) {
      scrollRef.current.scrollTop = scrollRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [state.messages, isStreaming]);

  const handleSelectOption = useCallback(
    async (optionId: string, optionText: string) => {
      if (!sessionId || state.isProcessing || !state.currentDecisionPoint) return;

      setState((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        isProcessing: true,
        messages: [
          ...prev.messages,
          { role: 'user', content: optionText },
        ],
      }));

      try {
        const res = await submitTeamMotivationOption(sessionId, {
          decisionPointId: state.currentDecisionPoint.id,
          optionId,
        });

        setIsStreaming(true);
        let enhancedContent = '';
        const triggerCtx = state.currentDecisionPoint.triggerContext;
        const charName = sessionMeta?.openingCharacter ?? 'NPC';

        try {
          await streamEnhancedDialogue(
            {
              dVector: {},
              emotionState: res.isCorrect ? 'positive' : 'negative',
              triggerContext: triggerCtx,
              characterName: charName,
            },
            (text: string) => {
              enhancedContent += text;
            },
            () => {},
            () => {},
          );
        } catch {
          enhancedContent = '';
        }
        setIsStreaming(false);

        const npcMessage = enhancedContent || res.consequence;

        setState((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          messages: [
            ...prev.messages,
            {
              role: 'npc',
              content: npcMessage,
              characterName: charName,
            },
          ],
          lastConsequence: res.consequence,
          lastExplanation: res.causalExplanation,
          lastIsCorrect: res.isCorrect,
          isCompleted: res.isCompleted,
          currentDecisionPoint: res.nextDecisionPoint ?? null,
          decisionIndex: res.nextDecisionPoint
            ? prev.decisionIndex + 1
            : prev.decisionIndex,
          isProcessing: false,
        }));
        setShowExplanation(false);
      } catch (err) {
        logger.error('提交选项失败', String(err));
        setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, isProcessing: false }));
      }
    },
    [sessionId, state.isProcessing, state.currentDecisionPoint, sessionMeta],
  );

  const handleFinish = useCallback(() => {
    if (sessionId) {
      navigate(`/coaching/team-motivation/feedback/${sessionId}`);
    }
  }, [sessionId, navigate]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-[#F8F6F2] via-[#F5F0E8] to-[#EDE8E0] flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-72 h-72 bg-teal-100/20 rounded-full blur-3xl -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/3" />

      <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-stone-200/50 bg-white/40 backdrop-blur-sm">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            className="p-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-stone-100 transition-colors text-stone-500"
            onClick={() => navigate('/coaching')}
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="size-4" />
          </button>
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-stone-700">
              {sessionMeta?.openingCharacter ?? '团队激励'}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-stone-400">
              {sessionMeta?.sceneTitle ?? '决策对话'}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-stone-500">
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-stone-100 border border-stone-200">
            决策点 {Math.min(state.decisionIndex + 1, state.totalDecisions)}/{state.totalDecisions}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div
        ref={scrollRef}
        className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 md:px-0 py-6"
      >
        <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto space-y-4">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {state.messages.map((msg, idx) => (
              <motion.div
                key={idx}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.35 }}
                className={
                  msg.role === 'user'
                    ? 'flex justify-end'
                    : msg.role === 'system'
                      ? 'flex justify-center'
                      : 'flex justify-start'
                }
              >
                {msg.role === 'system' ? (
                  <span className="text-xs text-stone-400 bg-stone-100/80 px-3 py-1 rounded-full">
                    {msg.content}
                  </span>
                ) : msg.role === 'npc' ? (
                  <div className="max-w-[85%]">
                    {msg.characterName && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-stone-400 mb-1 ml-1">
                        {msg.characterName}
                      </p>
                    )}
                    <div className="bg-white border border-stone-200/60 rounded-2xl rounded-bl-md px-4 py-3 shadow-sm">
                      <p className="text-sm text-stone-700 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">
                        {msg.content}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="max-w-[75%]">
                    <div className="bg-stone-800 text-white rounded-2xl rounded-br-md px-4 py-3 shadow-sm">
                      <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed">{msg.content}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </motion.div>
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>

          {isStreaming && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
              className="flex justify-start"
            >
              <div className="bg-white border border-stone-200/60 rounded-2xl rounded-bl-md px-4 py-3 shadow-sm">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-stone-400 rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: '0ms' }} />
                  <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-stone-400 rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: '150ms' }} />
                  <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-stone-400 rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: '300ms' }} />
                </div>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}

          {state.lastConsequence && !state.isProcessing && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              className="max-w-2xl"
            >
              <div
                className={`rounded-xl border p-3 ${
                  state.lastIsCorrect
                    ? 'bg-teal-50/60 border-teal-200'
                    : 'bg-amber-50/60 border-amber-200'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                  {state.lastIsCorrect ? (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="size-4 text-teal-600 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                  ) : (
                    <XCircle className="size-4 text-amber-600 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                  )}
                  <div className="text-xs leading-relaxed">
                    <p
                      className={`font-medium mb-1 ${
                        state.lastIsCorrect ? 'text-teal-700' : 'text-amber-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {state.lastIsCorrect ? '决策正确' : '可以做得更好'}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-stone-600">{state.lastConsequence}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {state.lastExplanation && (
                <div className="mt-2">
                  <button
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-700 transition-colors"
                    onClick={() => setShowExplanation(!showExplanation)}
                  >
                    <MessageSquare className="size-3" />
                    为什么
                    {showExplanation ? (
                      <ChevronUp className="size-3" />
                    ) : (
                      <ChevronDown className="size-3" />
                    )}
                  </button>
                  <AnimatePresence>
                    {showExplanation && (
                      <motion.div
                        initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                        exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                        className="overflow-hidden"
                      >
                        <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 leading-relaxed mt-2 pl-5 border-l-2 border-stone-200">
                          {state.lastExplanation}
                        </p>
                      </motion.div>
                    )}
                  </AnimatePresence>
                </div>
              )}
            </motion.div>
          )}

          {state.currentDecisionPoint && !state.isProcessing && !state.isCompleted && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.4, delay: 0.2 }}
              className="mt-4"
            >
              {state.currentDecisionPoint.triggerContext && (
                <div className="mb-3 text-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-stone-400 bg-stone-100/80 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg inline-block">
                    {state.currentDecisionPoint.triggerContext}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-stone-700 mb-3 text-center">
                {state.currentDecisionPoint.question}
              </p>
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                {state.currentDecisionPoint.options.map(
                  (opt: { id: string; text: string }, optIdx: number) => (
                    <motion.button
                      key={opt.id}
                      whileHover={{ scale: 1.01 }}
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.99 }}
                      className="w-full text-left p-4 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white hover:border-teal-300 hover:bg-teal-50/30 transition-all shadow-sm group"
                      onClick={() => handleSelectOption(opt.id, opt.text)}
                      disabled={state.isProcessing}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                        <span className="shrink-0 w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-stone-100 text-stone-500 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-medium group-hover:bg-teal-100 group-hover:text-teal-700 transition-colors">
                          {String.fromCharCode(65 + optIdx)}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-sm text-stone-700 leading-relaxed">
                          {opt.text}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </motion.button>
                  ),
                )}
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}

          {state.isCompleted && !state.isProcessing && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              className="mt-8 text-center"
            >
              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-teal-600 mb-4">
                <CheckCircle2 className="size-5" />
                <span className="text-sm font-medium">所有决策点已完成</span>

                  查看反馈报告
                </Button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

  );
};

  tm_tg003: '\u201c这个团队的问题不是一天两天了，谁来都一样。\u201d',
};

function renderRichText(text: string): React.ReactNode[] {
  const parts: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  const regex = /(<strong>.*?<\/strong>|<br\s*\/?>)/g;
  let lastIndex = 0;
  let match = regex.exec(text);
  let i = 0;

  while (match) {
    if (match.index > lastIndex) {
      parts.push(text.slice(lastIndex, match.index));
    }
    if (match[0].startsWith('<br')) {
      parts.push(<br key={`br-${i}`} />);
    } else {
      const content = match[0].replace(/<\/?strong>/g, '');
      parts.push(<strong key={`s-${i}`}>{content}</strong>);
    }
    lastIndex = match.index + match[0].length;
    match = regex.exec(text);
    i++;
  }

  if (lastIndex < text.length) {
    parts.push(text.slice(lastIndex));
  }
  return parts;
}

const ReviewListSection: React.FC<{
  items: IReviewItem[];
  onReview: (item: IReviewItem) => void;
}> = ({ items, onReview }) => {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('all');

  const filtered = items.filter(item => {
    const matchesSearch = item.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
                         item.submittedBy.includes(searchQuery);
    const matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'all' || item.status === statusFilter;
    return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
  });

  return (
    <Card className="border-0 shadow-sm">
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <CardTitle className="text-lg">审核列表</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>共 {filtered.length} 条记录</CardDescription>
          </div>
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              placeholder="搜索内容..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-9 w-48"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-4">
          {['all', 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'].map((s) => (
            <Button
              key={s}
              variant={statusFilter === s ? 'default' : 'outline'}
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter(s)}
            >
              {s === 'all' ? '全部状态' : statusConfig[s as keyof typeof statusConfig].name}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {filtered.map((item) => {
            const status = statusConfig[item.status];
            const StatusIcon = status.icon;

            return (
              <motion.div
                key={item.id}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                className="p-4 rounded-lg border border-border/50 hover:bg-accent/30 transition-colors"
              >
                <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-muted flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-muted-foreground" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                      <p className="font-medium text-foreground">{item.title}</p>
                      <Badge className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-700">学员案例</Badge>
                      <Badge className={`${status.color} gap-1`}>
                        <StatusIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {status.name}
                      </Badge>
                      {item.isConverted && (
                        <Badge className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 gap-1">
                          <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3" />
                          已生成场景
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {item.content && (
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1 line-clamp-2">{item.content}</p>
                    )}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-2">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <User className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {item.submittedBy}
                      </span>
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Calendar className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {item.submittedAt}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {item.adminNotes && (
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-2 bg-muted p-2 rounded">
                        <span className="font-medium">审核意见:</span> {item.adminNotes}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  {item.status === 'pending' && (
                    <Button size="sm" onClick={() => onReview(item)}>
                      <Eye className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                      审核
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}

          {filtered.length === 0 && (
            <div className="text-center py-12">
              <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">暂无审核记录</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

const ContentReviewPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [reviewDialogOpen, setReviewDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedItem, setSelectedItem] = useState<IReviewItem | null>(null);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<IReviewItem[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCases();
  }, []);

  const loadCases = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const cases = await getUserCases();
      const mapped: IReviewItem[] = cases.map((c: IUserCase) => ({
        id: c.id,
        title: c.sceneName || '未命名案例',
        content: c.backgroundDesc || undefined,
        responseDesc: c.responseDesc || undefined,
        submittedBy: c.userId,
        submittedAt: typeof c.createdAt === 'string'
          ? new Date(c.createdAt).toLocaleString('zh-CN')
          : String(c.createdAt),
        status: (c.reviewStatus as 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected') || 'pending',
        adminNotes: c.adminNotes || undefined,
        isConverted: c.isConverted || false,
      }));
      setItems(mapped);
    } catch (_e) {
      toast.error('加载案例列表失败');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleReview = (item: IReviewItem) => {
    setSelectedItem(item);
    setReviewDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleApprove = async (comment: string) => {
    if (!selectedItem) return;
    try {
      await reviewUserCase(selectedItem.id, { status: 'approved', adminNotes: comment || undefined });
      setItems(prev => prev.map(item =>
        item.id === selectedItem.id
          ? { ...item, status: 'approved' as const, adminNotes: comment || undefined, isConverted: true }
          : item
      ));
      toast.success('审核通过，陪练场景已自动生成');
    } catch (_e) {
      toast.error('审核操作失败');
    }
  };

  const handleReject = async (comment: string) => {
    if (!selectedItem) return;
    try {
      await reviewUserCase(selectedItem.id, { status: 'rejected', adminNotes: comment });
      setItems(prev => prev.map(item =>
        item.id === selectedItem.id
          ? { ...item, status: 'rejected' as const, adminNotes: comment }
          : item
      ));
      toast.success('已驳回');
    } catch (_e) {
      toast.error('审核操作失败');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full flex items-center justify-center py-24">
        <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-primary" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full space-y-6">
      <section className="w-full">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">学员案例审核</h1>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">
              审核学员提交的真实管理案例，通过后自动生成AI陪练场景
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <StatsSection items={items} />
      <ReviewListSection items={items} onReview={handleReview} />

      <ReviewDialog
        item={selectedItem}
        open={reviewDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setReviewDialogOpen}
        onApprove={handleApprove}
        onReject={handleReject}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default ContentReviewPage;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

interface IQuizQuestion {
  id: string;
  question: string;
  options: string[];
  correctIndex: number;
  explanation: string;
}

interface ICaseStudy {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  content: string;
  keyTakeaways: string[];
  relatedCoachingSceneId?: string; // 关联的陪练场景ID
  relatedCoachingSceneName?: string; // 关联的陪练场景名称
}

interface ICourseContent {
  knowledgePoints: string[];
  caseStudies: ICaseStudy[];
  quiz: IQuizQuestion[];
}

interface ICourseContentSectionProps {
  content: ICourseContent;
  onComplete?: () => void;
  onStartCoaching?: (sceneId: string) => void; // 开始陪练的回调
}

const CourseContentSection: React.FC<ICourseContentSectionProps> = ({
  content,
  onComplete,
  onStartCoaching,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('knowledge');
  const [quizAnswers, setQuizAnswers] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [showResults, setShowResults] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [currentCaseIndex, setCurrentCaseIndex] = useState(0);

  const handleQuizAnswer = (questionId: string, optionIndex: number) => {
    setQuizAnswers(prev => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: optionIndex }));
  };

  const handleCheckAnswer = (questionId: string) => {
    setShowResults(prev => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: true }));
  };

  const handleResetQuiz = (questionId: string) => {
    setQuizAnswers(prev => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: -1 }));
    setShowResults(prev => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: false }));
  };

  const correctCount = content.quiz.filter(
    q => quizAnswers[q.id] === q.correctIndex && showResults[q.id]
  ).length;

  const quizProgress = (Object.keys(showResults).length / content.quiz.length) * 100;

  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab} className="w-full">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3 mb-6">
          <TabsTrigger value="knowledge" className="gap-2">
            <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4" />
            知识点
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="cases" className="gap-2">
            <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
            实战案例
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="ml-1 text-xs">
              {content.caseStudies.length}
            </Badge>
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="quiz" className="gap-2">
            <HelpCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
            自测练习
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="ml-1 text-xs">
              {content.quiz.length}
            </Badge>
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        {/* 知识点内容 */}
        <TabsContent value="knowledge" className="mt-0">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
                  <Lightbulb className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                </div>
                <CardTitle>核心知识点</CardTitle>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {content.knowledgePoints.map((point, index) => (
                  <div
                    key={index}
                    className="flex items-start gap-4 p-4 rounded-xl bg-muted/50 border border-border/50"
                  >
                    <div className="flex-shrink-0 w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-semibold text-primary">
                      {index + 1}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-foreground leading-relaxed pt-1">{point}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        {/* 实战案例内容 */}
        <TabsContent value="cases" className="mt-0">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
                    <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                  </div>
                  <CardTitle>实战案例</CardTitle>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    disabled={currentCaseIndex === 0}
                    onClick={() => setCurrentCaseIndex(prev => prev - 1)}
                  >
                    上一个
                  </Button>
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {currentCaseIndex + 1} / {content.caseStudies.length}
                  </span>
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    disabled={currentCaseIndex === content.caseStudies.length - 1}
                    onClick={() => setCurrentCaseIndex(prev => prev + 1)}
                  >
                    下一个
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="space-y-6">
                {content.caseStudies[currentCaseIndex] && (
                  <>
                    <div>
                      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground mb-4">
                        {content.caseStudies[currentCaseIndex].title}
                      </h3>
                      <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-muted/30 border border-border/50">
                        <p className="text-foreground leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">
                          {content.caseStudies[currentCaseIndex].content}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4" />
                        关键启示
                      </h4>
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        {content.caseStudies[currentCaseIndex].keyTakeaways.map((takeaway, index) => (
                          <div
                            key={index}
                            className="flex items-start gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg bg-primary/5 border border-primary/10"
                          >
                            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-primary mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                            <span className="text-sm text-foreground">{takeaway}</span>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* 进入陪练入口 */}
                    {content.caseStudies[currentCaseIndex].relatedCoachingSceneId && onStartCoaching && (
                      <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-50 to-orange-50 border border-amber-200">
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                          <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 text-white">
                            <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5" />
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex-1">
                            <h4 className="font-semibold text-foreground mb-1">
                              进入此场景陪练
                            </h4>
                            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-3">
                              基于本案例的"{content.caseStudies[currentCaseIndex].relatedCoachingSceneName}"陪练场景，
                              与AI角色进行实战对话练习，巩固所学知识。
                            </p>
                            <Button
                              onClick={() => onStartCoaching(content.caseStudies[currentCaseIndex].relatedCoachingSceneId!)}
                              className="gap-2"
                            >
                              <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                              开始陪练
                              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        {/* 自测练习内容 */}
        <TabsContent value="quiz" className="mt-0">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
                    <HelpCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                  </div>
                  <CardTitle>自测练习</CardTitle>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    已完成 {Object.keys(showResults).length} / {content.quiz.length} 题
                  </div>
                  {Object.keys(showResults).length === content.quiz.length && (
                    <Badge className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
                      得分: {correctCount}/{content.quiz.length}
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <Progress value={quizProgress} className="h-2 mt-2" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="space-y-6">
                {content.quiz.map((question, index) => {
                  const selectedAnswer = quizAnswers[question.id];
                  const hasResult = showResults[question.id];
                  const isCorrect = selectedAnswer === question.correctIndex;

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={question.id}
                      className="p-4 rounded-xl border border-border/50 bg-card"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-3 mb-4">
                        <div className="flex-shrink-0 w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-semibold text-primary">
                          {index + 1}
                        </div>
                        <h4 className="text-foreground font-medium leading-relaxed">
                          {question.question}
                        </h4>
                      </div>

                      <RadioGroup
                        value={selectedAnswer?.toString()}
                        onValueChange={(value) => handleQuizAnswer(question.id, parseInt(value))}
                        disabled={hasResult}
                        className="space-y-2 ml-10"
                      >
                        {question.options.map((option, optionIndex) => {
                          const isSelected = selectedAnswer === optionIndex;
                          const isCorrectOption = optionIndex === question.correctIndex;
                          let optionClass = 'border-border/50 bg-muted/30';

                          if (hasResult) {
                            if (isCorrectOption) {
                              optionClass = 'border-green-500 bg-green-50';
                            } else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) {
                              optionClass = 'border-red-500 bg-red-50';
                            }
                          } else if (isSelected) {
                            optionClass = 'border-primary bg-primary/5';
                          }

                          return (
                            <div
                              key={optionIndex}
                              className={`flex items-center space-x-3 p-3 rounded-lg border transition-all ${optionClass}`}
                            >
                              <RadioGroupItem
                                value={optionIndex.toString()}
                                id={`q${question.id}-opt${optionIndex}`}
                                disabled={hasResult}
                              />
                              <Label
                                htmlFor={`q${question.id}-opt${optionIndex}`}
                                className="flex-1 cursor-pointer text-sm"
                              >
                                {option}
                              </Label>
                              {hasResult && isCorrectOption && (
                                <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-500" />
                              )}
                              {hasResult && isSelected && !isCorrect && (
                                <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />
                              )}
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </RadioGroup>

                      {!hasResult ? (
                        <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
                          <Button
                            onClick={() => handleCheckAnswer(question.id)}
                            disabled={selectedAnswer === undefined}
                            size="sm"
                          >
                            提交答案
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="mt-4 p-4 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                          <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4 text-primary mt-0.5" />
                            <div>
                              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-1">
                                解析
                              </p>
                              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                {question.explanation}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-3 flex justify-end">
                            <Button
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="sm"
                              onClick={() => handleResetQuiz(question.id)}
                              className="gap-1"
                            >
                              <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
                              重新作答
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}

                {Object.keys(showResults).length === content.quiz.length && (
                  <div className="p-6 rounded-xl bg-primary/5 border border-primary/20 text-center">
                    <h4 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground mb-2">
                      测试完成！
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-4">
                      您答对了 {correctCount} 题，共 {content.quiz.length} 题
                      {correctCount === content.quiz.length && ' 🎉 完美！'}
                      {correctCount >= content.quiz.length * 0.8 && correctCount < content.quiz.length && ' 👍 优秀！'}
                      {correctCount >= content.quiz.length * 0.6 && correctCount < content.quiz.length * 0.8 && ' 💪 不错！'}
                      {correctCount < content.quiz.length * 0.6 && ' 📚 建议复习知识点'}
                    </p>
                    <div className="flex justify-center gap-3">
                      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setActiveTab('knowledge')}>
                        复习知识点
                      </Button>
                      <Button onClick={onComplete}>
                        完成课程
                        <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-1" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </section>
  );
};

export default CourseContentSection;

        <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
          <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
          {caseStudy.title}
        </CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
          {caseStudy.content}
        </p>
        {caseStudy.keyTakeaways.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">关键启示：</p>
            <ul className="space-y-1.5">
              {caseStudy.keyTakeaways.map((takeaway: string, idx: number) => (
                <li
                  key={idx}
                  className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground"
                >
                  <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-primary shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  {takeaway}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

const CourseDetailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { courseId } = useParams<{ courseId: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [course, setCourse] = useState<ICourseDetail | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('learn');
  const [quizDialogOpen, setQuizDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [courseCompleted, setCourseCompleted] = useState(false);
  const [cardFilter, setCardFilter] = useState<CardFilter>('all');

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadCourse = async () => {
      if (!courseId) {
        setCourse(null);
        setIsLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      setIsLoading(true);
      try {
        const data = await getCourseById(courseId);
        setCourse(data);
      } catch (err) {
        logger.error('Failed to load course', JSON.stringify(err));
        toast.error('加载课程失败');
        setCourse(null);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };
    loadCourse();
  }, [courseId]);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full min-h-[60vh] flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">
          <RefreshCw className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-primary mx-auto mb-4" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">加载课程中...</p>

                <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                {course.duration}分钟
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mb-3">
              {course.title}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
              {course.description}
            </p>

      </section>

            <TabsTrigger value="quiz" className="gap-2">
              <CheckSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">知识测验</span>
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="cards" className="gap-2">
              <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">学习卡片</span>
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="cases" className="gap-2">
              <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />

              )}

          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>

              <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-white shrink-0">
                  <Sparkles className="w-6 h-6" />
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground mb-1">
                    推荐陪练场景
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">
                    基于您的课程学习，推荐您进行以下场景陪练
                  </p>
                  <Button
                    className="gap-2"
                    onClick={() => navigate('/coaching')}
                  >
                    <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                    前往陪练
                  </Button>
                </div>

            </CardContent>

        courseId={courseId || ''}
        courseTitle={course?.title || ''}

      />

  );
};

===FILE:./client/src/pages/CourseDetailPage/CourseQuizDialog.tsx===
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from '@/components/ui/radio-group';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { CheckCircle, XCircle, ChevronRight, ChevronLeft, Trophy, RotateCcw, Sparkles, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { axiosForBackend } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/utils/getAxiosForBackend';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { awardPoints } from '@/api/gamification';

interface IQuizQuestion {
  id: string;
  questionType: string;
  questionText: string;
  options: string[] | null;
  correctIndex: number | null;
  explanation: string | null;
  scenarioPrompt: string | null;
  sortOrder: number;
}

interface IQuizResult {
  choiceScore: number;
  choiceTotal: number;
  scenarioScore: number;
  scenarioTotal: number;
  totalScore: number;
  passed: boolean;
  scenarioFeedback: Array<{ questionId: string; answer: string; aiScore: number; aiFeedback: string }>;
}

interface ICourseQuizDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  courseId: string;
  courseTitle: string;
  onComplete: () => void;
}

const CourseQuizDialog: React.FC<ICourseQuizDialogProps> = ({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  courseId,
  courseTitle,
  onComplete,
}) => {
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<IQuizQuestion[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState<'loading' | 'quiz' | 'result'>('loading');
  const [currentQuestionIndex, setCurrentQuestionIndex] = useState(0);
  const [choiceAnswers, setChoiceAnswers] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [scenarioAnswers, setScenarioAnswers] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [answeredChoices, setAnsweredChoices] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [result, setResult] = useState<IQuizResult | null>(null);

  const loadQuestions = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await axiosForBackend({ url: `/api/courses/${courseId}/questions`, method: 'GET' });
      const data = res.data as IQuizQuestion[];
      if (data.length === 0) {
        toast.error('该课程暂无测试题目');
        onOpenChange(false);
        return;
      }
      setQuestions(data);
      setCurrentStep('quiz');
      setCurrentQuestionIndex(0);
      setChoiceAnswers({});
      setScenarioAnswers({});
      setAnsweredChoices(new Set());
      setResult(null);
    } catch {
      toast.error('加载题目失败');
      onOpenChange(false);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const choiceQuestions = questions.filter((q: IQuizQuestion) => q.questionType === 'choice');
  const scenarioQuestions = questions.filter((q: IQuizQuestion) => q.questionType === 'scenario');
  const allQuestionsOrdered = [...choiceQuestions, ...scenarioQuestions];
  const currentQuestion = allQuestionsOrdered[currentQuestionIndex];
  const isChoice = currentQuestion?.questionType === 'choice';
  const isAnswered = isChoice ? answeredChoices.has(currentQuestion.id) : false;

  const handleChoiceSelect = (questionId: string, optionIndex: number) => {
    if (answeredChoices.has(questionId)) return;
    setChoiceAnswers((prev: Record<string, number>) => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: optionIndex }));
    setAnsweredChoices((prev: Set<string>) => new Set([...prev, questionId]));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    const unansweredChoice = choiceQuestions.filter((q: IQuizQuestion) => choiceAnswers[q.id] === undefined);
    const unansweredScenario = scenarioQuestions.filter((q: IQuizQuestion) => !scenarioAnswers[q.id]?.trim());
    if (unansweredChoice.length > 0 || unansweredScenario.length > 0) {
      toast.error('请完成所有题目');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await axiosForBackend({
        url: `/api/courses/${courseId}/quiz`,
        method: 'POST',
        data: {
          choiceAnswers: choiceQuestions.map((q: IQuizQuestion) => ({
            questionId: q.id,
            selectedOption: choiceAnswers[q.id],
          })),
          scenarioAnswers: scenarioQuestions.map((q: IQuizQuestion) => ({
            questionId: q.id,
            answer: scenarioAnswers[q.id] || '',
          })),
        },
      });
      setResult(res.data as IQuizResult);
      setCurrentStep('result');

      const quizResult = res.data as IQuizResult;
      if (quizResult.passed) {
        const isPerfect = quizResult.totalScore === 100;
        if (isPerfect) {
          awardPoints('quiz_perfect', 10, '测验满分', courseId);
          toast.success('🎯 满分！额外获得10积分！');
        }
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error('提交测验失败');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRetry = () => {
    setCurrentStep('quiz');
    setCurrentQuestionIndex(0);
    setChoiceAnswers({});
    setScenarioAnswers({});
    setAnsweredChoices(new Set());
    setResult(null);
  };

  const isLastQuestion = currentQuestionIndex === allQuestionsOrdered.length - 1;

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(v) => { if (!loading) onOpenChange(v); }}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto">
        {currentStep === 'loading' && (
          <>
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>课程测验 - {courseTitle}</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription>完成云大学学习后，通过测验即可标记课程完成</DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="py-8 text-center">
              <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-4">
                测验包含 {8} 道选择题和 {2} 道情景题
              </p>
              <Button onClick={loadQuestions} disabled={loading}>
                开始测验
              </Button>
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {currentStep === 'quiz' && currentQuestion && (
          <>
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>
                {isChoice ? '选择题' : '情景题'} ({currentQuestionIndex + 1}/{allQuestionsOrdered.length})
              </DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription>
                {isChoice ? '选择正确答案，选完即判对错' : '请根据情景描述给出你的处理方式'}
              </DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              <Progress value={((currentQuestionIndex + 1) / allQuestionsOrdered.length) * 100} className="h-2" />

              <div className="p-4 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                <p className="font-medium leading-relaxed">{currentQuestion.questionText}</p>
              </div>

              {isChoice && currentQuestion.options && (
                <RadioGroup
                  value={String(choiceAnswers[currentQuestion.id] ?? '')}
                  onValueChange={(val: string) => handleChoiceSelect(currentQuestion.id, Number(val))}
                >
                  {currentQuestion.options.map((option: string, idx: number) => {
                    const selected = choiceAnswers[currentQuestion.id] === idx;
                    const isCorrect = idx === currentQuestion.correctIndex;
                    const showResult = answeredChoices.has(currentQuestion.id);

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={idx}
                        className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg border-2 transition-all ${
                          showResult && isCorrect
                            ? 'border-green-500 bg-green-50'
                            : showResult && selected && !isCorrect
                              ? 'border-red-500 bg-red-50'
                              : selected
                                ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5'
                                : 'border-border hover:border-primary/30'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <RadioGroupItem value={String(idx)} id={`q${currentQuestion.id}-${idx}`} disabled={showResult} />
                        <Label htmlFor={`q${currentQuestion.id}-${idx}`} className="flex-1 cursor-pointer">
                          {option}
                        </Label>
                        {showResult && isCorrect && <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600 shrink-0" />}
                        {showResult && selected && !isCorrect && <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 shrink-0" />}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </RadioGroup>
              )}

              {isChoice && answeredChoices.has(currentQuestion.id) && currentQuestion.explanation && (
                <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200">
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                    <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <p className="text-sm text-amber-800">{currentQuestion.explanation}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {!isChoice && (
                <Textarea
                  placeholder="请描述你会如何处理这个情景..."
                  value={scenarioAnswers[currentQuestion.id] || ''}
                  onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) =>
                    setScenarioAnswers((prev: Record<string, string>) => ({ ...prev, [currentQuestion.id]: e.target.value }))
                  }
                  rows={5}
                  className="resize-none"
                />
              )}

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-4">
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={() => setCurrentQuestionIndex(Math.max(0, currentQuestionIndex - 1))}
                  disabled={currentQuestionIndex === 0}
                >
                  <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                  上一题
                </Button>

                {isLastQuestion ? (
                  <Button onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={loading}>
                    提交测验
                  </Button>
                ) : (
                  <Button onClick={() => setCurrentQuestionIndex(currentQuestionIndex + 1)}>
                    下一题
                    <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-1" />
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {currentStep === 'result' && result && (
          <>
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>测验结果</DialogTitle>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="py-6 text-center space-y-6">
              <div className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center w-24 h-24 rounded-full ${result.passed ? 'bg-green-100' : 'bg-red-100'}`}>
                {result.passed ? (
                  <Trophy className="w-12 h-12 text-green-600" />
                ) : (
                  <AlertCircle className="w-12 h-12 text-red-600" />
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <p className={`text-4xl font-bold ${result.passed ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-red-600'}`}>
                  {result.totalScore}分
                </p>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                  {result.passed ? '恭喜通过！' : '未通过，建议重新学习后再次测试'}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 max-w-sm mx-auto">
                <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">选择题</p>
                  <p className="font-bold">{result.choiceScore}/{result.choiceTotal}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">情景题</p>
                  <p className="font-bold">{result.scenarioScore}/{result.scenarioTotal}</p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {result.scenarioFeedback.length > 0 && (
                <div className="text-left space-y-3">
                  <p className="font-medium text-sm">情景题反馈：</p>
                  {result.scenarioFeedback.map((fb: { questionId: string; aiScore: number; aiFeedback: string }, idx: number) => (
                    <div key={fb.questionId} className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">情景题 {idx + 1}</Badge>
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium">得分: {fb.aiScore}/10</span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-sm text-amber-800">{fb.aiFeedback}</p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
                {!result.passed && (
                  <Button variant="outline" onClick={handleRetry}>
                    <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                    重新测试
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button onClick={() => {
                  if (result.passed) {
                     awardPoints('quiz_pass', 20, '通过知识测验', courseId);
                    toast.success('🎉 通过测验获得20积分！');
                  }
                  onComplete();
                  onOpenChange(false);
                }}>
                  {result.passed ? '完成课程' : '返回课程'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
};

export default CourseQuizDialog;

// ============================================
// Types
// ============================================
type DimensionType = 'result' | 'people' | 'field' | 'all';

interface ICourseView {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  dimension: Exclude<DimensionType, 'all'>;
  duration: number;
  knowledgePoints: string[];
}

// Map API course to view model
function mapApiCourseToView(apiCourse: IApiCourse): ICourseView {
  return {
    id: apiCourse.id,
    title: apiCourse.title,
    description: apiCourse.description,
    dimension: apiCourse.dimensionId,
    duration: apiCourse.duration,
    knowledgePoints: apiCourse.knowledgePoints,
  };
}

const SmartRecommendation: React.FC<{ courses: ICourseView[] }> = ({
  courses,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const assessmentResult = React.useMemo(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem('mdp_assessment_scores');
      if (stored) {
        const scores = JSON.parse(stored);
        if (scores && typeof scores === 'object') {
          return {
            result: Number(scores.result) || 72,
            people: Number(scores.people) || 65,
            field: Number(scores.field) || 58,
            completedAt: '',
          };
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore parse errors
    }
    return { result: 72, people: 65, field: 58, completedAt: '' };
  }, []);

  // 找出最低分的维度
  const scores = [
    { dimension: 'result' as const, score: assessmentResult.result },
    { dimension: 'people' as const, score: assessmentResult.people },
    { dimension: 'field' as const, score: assessmentResult.field },
  ];
  const weakestDimension = scores.reduce((min, current) =>
    current.score < min.score ? current : min,
  );

  // 推荐该维度的核心课程（前5门）
  const recommendedCourses = useMemo(() => {
    return courses
      .filter((course) => course.dimension === weakestDimension.dimension)
      .slice(0, 5);
  }, [courses, weakestDimension.dimension]);

  const config = dimensionConfig[weakestDimension.dimension];
  const Icon = config.icon;

  const handleCourseClick = (courseId: string) => {
    navigate(`/courses/${courseId}`);
  };

  return (
    <Card className="border-border/50 overflow-hidden mb-8">
      <div className={`h-1 bg-gradient-to-r ${config.gradient}`} />
      <CardContent className="p-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-start gap-6">
          {/* 左侧：推荐说明 */}
          <div className="flex-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
              <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
              <Badge className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
                智能推荐
              </Badge>
              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                根据您的测评结果，为您推荐
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-4">
              <div
                className={`p-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br ${config.gradient}`}
              >
                <Icon className="w-6 h-6 text-white" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {config.name}维度强化课程
                </h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  您的{config.name}维度得分{' '}
                  <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                    {weakestDimension.score}分
                  </span>
                  ，建议优先学习以下课程提升该维度能力
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 三维度得分对比 */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              {scores.map((s) => (
                <div
                  key={s.dimension}
                  className={`p-3 rounded-lg border ${
                    s.dimension === weakestDimension.dimension
                      ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5'
                      : 'border-border bg-muted/30'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                    {s.dimension === 'result' ? (
                      <Target className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                    ) : s.dimension === 'people' ? (
                      <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
                    ) : (
                      <Heart className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" />
                    )}
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {dimensionConfig[s.dimension].name}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                    <span
                      className={`text-lg font-bold ${
                        s.dimension === weakestDimension.dimension
                          ? 'text-primary'
                          : 'text-foreground'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {s.score}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">分</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 右侧：推荐课程列表 */}
          <div className="flex-1 md:border-l md:border-border md:pl-6">
            <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-3">
              推荐课程 ({recommendedCourses.length}门)
            </h4>
            {recommendedCourses.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {recommendedCourses.map((course, index) => (
                  <div
                    key={course.id}
                    onClick={() => handleCourseClick(course.id)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg border border-border/50 hover:border-primary/30 hover:bg-muted/30 cursor-pointer transition-all group"
                  >
                    <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded bg-muted text-muted-foreground text-xs flex items-center justify-center font-medium">
                      {index + 1}
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors truncate">
                        {course.title}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">
                        {course.duration}分钟 ·{' '}
                        {course.knowledgePoints.length}知识点
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors" />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-4">
                暂无该维度的课程数据
              </p>
            )}
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"

              onClick={() => navigate('/courses')}
            >
              查看全部{config.name}课程

const CourseCard: React.FC<{ course: ICourseView }> = ({ course }) => {

            >

                key={idx}

                {point}

            ))}
            {course.knowledgePoints.length > 2 && (
              <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                +{course.knowledgePoints.length - 2}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-3 border-t border-border/50">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                {course.duration}分钟
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <BookOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

// ============================================
// Main Component

const CourseListSection: React.FC = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<DimensionType>('all');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [courses, setCourses] = useState<ICourseView[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoading(true);
    getAllCourses()
      .then((apiCourses: IApiCourse[]) => {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setCourses(apiCourses.map(mapApiCourseToView));
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setCourses([]);
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const filteredCourses = useMemo(() => {
    return courses.filter((course) => {
      const matchesTab = activeTab === 'all' || course.dimension === activeTab;
      const matchesSearch =
        searchQuery === '' ||
        course.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
        course.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
        course.knowledgePoints.some((kp) =>
          kp.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()),
        );
      return matchesTab && matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [courses, activeTab, searchQuery]);

  const courseCounts = useMemo(() => {
    return {
      all: courses.length,
      result: courses.filter((c) => c.dimension === 'result').length,
      people: courses.filter((c) => c.dimension === 'people').length,
      field: courses.filter((c) => c.dimension === 'field').length,
    };
  }, [courses]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <section className="w-full flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
          <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 text-primary animate-spin" />
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">加载课程中...</p>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      {/* 智能推荐模块 */}
      <SmartRecommendation courses={courses} />

      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            <BookOpen className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
            全部课程
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            共{courseCounts.all}门中基层管理微课，每门15分钟
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="relative w-full md:w-72">
          <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input
            placeholder="搜索课程..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            className="pl-10"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <Tabs
        value={activeTab}
        onValueChange={(v) => setActiveTab(v as DimensionType)}
        className="w-full"
      >
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4 mb-6">
          <TabsTrigger value="all" className="gap-2">
            全部
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
              {courseCounts.all}
            </Badge>
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="result" className="gap-2">
            <Target className="w-4 h-4" />
            拿结果
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
              {courseCounts.result}
            </Badge>
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="people" className="gap-2">
            <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
            带团队
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
              {courseCounts.people}
            </Badge>
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="field" className="gap-2">
            <Heart className="w-4 h-4" />
            传文化
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
              {courseCounts.field}
            </Badge>
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value={activeTab} className="mt-0">
          {filteredCourses.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {filteredCourses.map((course) => (
                <CourseCard key={course.id} course={course} />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-12">
              <BookOpen className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">没有找到相关课程</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>

      {/* Progress Overview */}
      <Card className="border-border/50 mt-8">
        <CardContent className="p-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center gap-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-primary/10">
                <TrendingUp className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-foreground">学习进度概览</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  共{courses.length}门课程，持续学习中
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1">
              <Progress value={0} className="h-2" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm">
              <div className="text-center">
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-600">0</p>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">已完成</p>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center">
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">0</p>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">学习中</p>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center">
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-amber-600">
                  {courses.length}
                </p>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">待学习</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </section>
  );
};

interface DisplayCourse {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  dimension: 'result' | 'people' | 'field';
  duration: number;
  progress: number;
  completed: boolean;
  knowledgePoints: number;
  caseStudies: number;
  hasQuiz: boolean;
  recommended: boolean;
  tags: string[];
  coverImage: string;
}

const RECOMMENDED_PER_DIMENSION = 2;

function mapApiCourse(apiCourse: ApiCourse, isRecommended: boolean): DisplayCourse {
  const dimension = apiCourse.dimensionId;
  return {
    id: apiCourse.id,
    title: apiCourse.title,
    description: apiCourse.description,
    dimension: dimension,
    duration: apiCourse.duration,
    progress: 0,
    completed: false,
    knowledgePoints: apiCourse.knowledgePoints.length,
    caseStudies: 0,
    hasQuiz: true,
    recommended: isRecommended,
    tags: apiCourse.knowledgePoints.slice(0, 3),
    coverImage: getCourseCoverImage(apiCourse.title, dimension),
  };
}
