// 获取课程封面图，优先使用课程专属封面，否则使用维度默认封面
function getCourseCoverImage(courseTitle: string, dimension: 'result' | 'people' | 'field'): string {
  return courseCoverImages[courseTitle] || dimensionConfig[dimension].coverImage;
}

const CoursesPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [courses, setCourses] = useState<DisplayCourse[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  
  const dimensionParam = searchParams.get('dimension') as 'result' | 'people' | 'field' | null;
  const showAllParam = searchParams.get('showAll') === '1';
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'result' | 'people' | 'field'>(dimensionParam || 'result');
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (dimensionParam && ['result', 'people', 'field'].includes(dimensionParam)) {
      setActiveTab(dimensionParam);
    }
  }, [dimensionParam]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchCourses = async () => {
      try {
        const apiCourses: ApiCourse[] = await getAllCourses();
        const dimCounts: Record<string, number> = {
          result: 0,
          people: 0,
          field: 0,
        };
        const mapped = apiCourses.map((c: ApiCourse): DisplayCourse => {
          const dim = c.dimensionId;
          dimCounts[dim] = (dimCounts[dim] || 0) + 1;
          const isRecommended = dimCounts[dim] <= RECOMMENDED_PER_DIMENSION;
          return mapApiCourse(c, isRecommended);
        });
        setCourses(mapped);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        logger.error('Failed to load courses', JSON.stringify(err));
        toast.error('加载课程失败，请稍后重试');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchCourses();
  }, []);
  
  // 当 URL 中有 dimension 参数时，自动滚动到自主拓展区域
  useEffect(() => {
    if (dimensionParam && ['result', 'people', 'field'].includes(dimensionParam)) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById('self-explore-section')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      }, 300);
    }
  }, [dimensionParam, loading]);

  const recommendedIds = useMemo(
    () => new Set(courses.filter((c: DisplayCourse) => c.recommended).map((c: DisplayCourse) => c.id)),
    [courses],
  );

  const filteredBySearch = (courseList: DisplayCourse[]) =>
    searchQuery
      ? courseList.filter(
          (c: DisplayCourse) =>
            c.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
            c.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()),
        )
      : courseList;

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = courses.length;
    const completed = courses.filter((c: DisplayCourse) => c.completed).length;
    const inProgress = courses.filter(
      (c: DisplayCourse) => c.progress > 0 && !c.completed,
    ).length;
    return { total, completed, inProgress };
  }, [courses]);

  const handleCourseClick = (courseId: string) => {
    navigate(`/courses/${courseId}`);
  };

  const scrollToSelfExplore = () => {
    document.getElementById('self-explore-section')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  };

  const renderDimensionPath = (dim: 'result' | 'people' | 'field') => {
    const config = dimensionConfig[dim];
    const Icon = config.icon;
    const dimCourses = courses.filter((c: DisplayCourse) => c.dimension === dim);
    const displayed = filteredBySearch(dimCourses);
    const recommendedCourses = displayed.filter((c: DisplayCourse) => recommendedIds.has(c.id));
    const completedCount = dimCourses.filter((c: DisplayCourse) => c.completed).length;

    if (loading) {
      return (
        <>
          <motion.section
            key={dim}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{
              duration: 0.5,
              delay: dim === 'result' ? 0 : dim === 'people' ? 0.15 : 0.3,
            }}
            className="w-full"
          >
          <Card className="overflow-hidden border-slate-200">
            <div className="px-5 py-4" style={{ background: config.headerGradient }}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="p-2 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: config.iconBg }}>
                  <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold" style={{ color: config.titleColor }}>{config.name}</h2>
                  <Skeleton className="h-4 w-32 mt-1" style={{ backgroundColor: config.accentLight }} />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
              <CardContent className="p-4">
                <div className="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
                  {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_: unknown, i: number) => (
                    <div key={i} className="shrink-0 w-52">
                      <Skeleton className="h-36 w-full rounded-xl" />
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </motion.section>
        </>
      );
    }

    return (
      <motion.section
        key={dim}
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{
          duration: 0.5,
          delay: dim === 'result' ? 0 : dim === 'people' ? 0.15 : 0.3,
        }}
        className="w-full"
      >
        <Card className="overflow-hidden border-slate-200">
          <div className="px-5 py-4" style={{ background: config.headerGradient }}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="p-2 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: config.iconBg }}>
                  <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold" style={{ color: config.titleColor }}>{config.name}</h2>
                  <p className="text-sm" style={{ color: config.subtitleColor }}>
                    {completedCount}/{dimCourses.length} 门完成
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="text-right text-sm" style={{ color: config.subtitleColor }}>
                  <span>进度</span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-24">
                  <Progress
                    value={
                      dimCourses.length > 0
                        ? (completedCount / dimCourses.length) * 100
                        : 0
                    }
                    className="h-2"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: config.accentLight }}
                  />
                </div>
                <span className="font-medium text-sm" style={{ color: config.titleColor }}>
                  {dimCourses.length > 0
                    ? Math.round((completedCount / dimCourses.length) * 100)
                    : 0}
                  %
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <CardContent className="p-4">
            {/* 推荐挑战区 */}
            {recommendedCourses.length > 0 && (
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">推荐挑战</span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">针对测评短板</span>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  {recommendedCourses.map((course: DisplayCourse) => (
                    <motion.div
                      key={course.id}
                      whileHover={{ scale: 1.01 }}
                      className="cursor-pointer group"
                      onClick={() => handleCourseClick(course.id)}
                    >
                      {/* PPT风格横向卡片 */}
                      <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 hover:shadow-xl transition-all bg-white h-32">
                        {/* 左侧配图区域 - 矩形展示 */}
                        <div className="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-32 bg-slate-100">
                          <img
                            src={course.coverImage}
                            alt={course.title}
                            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                          />
                          {/* 推荐标签 */}
                          <Badge 
                            className="absolute top-2 left-2 text-white border-0 text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0 shadow-sm" 
                            style={{ backgroundColor: config.barColor }}
                          >
                            推荐
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        
                        {/* 右侧文字区域 */}
                        <div className="ml-32 h-full p-3.5 flex flex-col justify-between">
                          {/* 课程标题 */}
                          <div>
                            <h4 
                              className="text-base font-bold mb-1"
                              style={{ color: config.barColor }}
                            >
                              {course.title}
                            </h4>
                            {/* 装饰线 */}
                            <div className="flex items-center mb-1.5">
                              <div className="h-[2px] w-8" style={{ backgroundColor: config.barColor }} />
                              <div 
                                className="w-0 h-0 ml-0.5"
                                style={{ 
                                  borderLeft: '3px solid transparent',
                                  borderRight: '3px solid transparent',
                                  borderTop: `3px solid ${config.barColor}`,
                                  transform: 'rotate(-90deg)'
                                }}
                              />
                            </div>
                            {/* 描述 */}
                            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                              {course.description}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          
                          {/* 底部信息 */}
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] text-slate-400 pt-1">
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
                              <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                              {course.duration}分钟
                            </span>
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
                              <FileText className="w-3 h-3" />
                              {course.knowledgePoints}知识点
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </motion.div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </motion.section>
    );
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full space-y-6">
        <section className="w-full">
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
          >
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Compass className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
                  学习地图
                </h1>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                  基于测评结果的个性化学习路径，推荐课程直通挑战

                <p className="text-sm text-amber-600 flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                  <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4" />
                  学如逆水行舟，不进则退。选择一门课程，开启今天的学习之旅！
                </p>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="relative">
                  <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                  <Input
                    placeholder="搜索课程..."
                    value={searchQuery}
                    onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) =>
                      setSearchQuery(e.target.value)
                    }
                    className="pl-9 w-full md:w-56"
                    disabled
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                  <div className="text-center">
                    <Skeleton className="h-7 w-8" />
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">已完成</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-px h-8 bg-border" />
                  <div className="text-center">
                    <Skeleton className="h-7 w-8" />
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">学习中</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-px h-8 bg-border" />
                  <div className="text-center">
                    <Skeleton className="h-7 w-8" />
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">总课程</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </section>

        {(['result', 'people', 'field'] as const).map(renderDimensionPath)}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full space-y-6">
      <motion.section
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
      >
        <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl px-6 py-5 mb-6" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #047857 0%, #10b981 60%, #34d399 100%)' }}>
          <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-40 h-40 rounded-full bg-white/[0.06] blur-[60px]" />
          <div className="relative flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-white/15 flex items-center justify-center backdrop-blur-sm">
                <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">课程中心</h1>
                <p className="text-xs text-white/70">基于测评结果推荐个性化学习路径</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="relative max-w-xs">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-white/50" />
              <Input
                placeholder="搜索课程..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) =>
                  setSearchQuery(e.target.value)
                }
                className="pl-9 pr-4 rounded-full bg-white/15 border-white/20 text-white placeholder:text-white/50 focus:bg-white/20 focus:border-white/30"
                disabled={loading}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.section>

      {/* Dimension Map Paths */}
      {(['result', 'people', 'field'] as const).map(renderDimensionPath)}

      {/* 自主拓展 - 菜单式+图片卡片 */}
      <section id="self-explore-section" className="w-full">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ delay: 0.5 }}
        >
          <Card className="overflow-hidden border-primary/20">
            <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-primary/10 to-primary/5 px-5 py-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/15">
                  <Compass className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">推荐学习</h2>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">精选课程，系统提升</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              {courses.filter((c: DisplayCourse) => !recommendedIds.has(c.id)).length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">暂无推荐课程</p>
              ) : (
                <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={(v: string) => {
                  setActiveTab(v as 'result' | 'people' | 'field');
                  // 切换Tab时清除showAll和dimension参数
                  const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
                  next.delete('showAll');
                  setSearchParams(next, { replace: true });
                }} className="w-full">
                  <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3 mb-6">
                    <TabsTrigger value="result" className="gap-2">
                      <Target className="w-4 h-4" />
                      拿结果
                    </TabsTrigger>
                    <TabsTrigger value="people" className="gap-2">
                      <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
                      带团队
                    </TabsTrigger>
                    <TabsTrigger value="field" className="gap-2">
                      <Heart className="w-4 h-4" />
                      传文化
                    </TabsTrigger>
                  </TabsList>
                  {(['result', 'people', 'field'] as const).map((dim: 'result' | 'people' | 'field') => {
                    const config = dimensionConfig[dim];
                    const dimSelfExplore = courses.filter(
                      (c: DisplayCourse) => c.dimension === dim && !recommendedIds.has(c.id)
                    );
                    // 当前维度且有showAll参数时显示全部，否则最多显示3个
                    const isShowAll = showAllParam && activeTab === dim;
                    const displayed = searchQuery
                      ? dimSelfExplore.filter(
                          (c: DisplayCourse) =>
                            c.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
                            c.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()),
                        )
                      : isShowAll
                        ? dimSelfExplore
                        : dimSelfExplore.slice(0, 3);
                    if (displayed.length === 0) return null;
                    // 使用课程专属封面图
                    return (
                      <TabsContent key={dim} value={dim} className="mt-0">
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                          {displayed.map((course: DisplayCourse, index: number) => (
                            <motion.div
                              key={course.id}
                              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
                              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                              transition={{ delay: index * 0.1 }}
                              whileHover={{ scale: 1.01 }}
                              className="cursor-pointer group"
                              onClick={() => handleCourseClick(course.id)}
                            >
                              {/* PPT风格横向卡片 */}
                              <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 hover:shadow-xl transition-all bg-white h-32">
                                {/* 左侧配图区域 - 矩形展示 */}
                                <div className="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-32 bg-slate-100">
                                  <img
                                    src={course.coverImage}
                                    alt={course.title}
                                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                                  />
                                  {/* 维度标签 */}
                                  <Badge 
                                    className="absolute top-2 left-2 text-white border-0 text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0 shadow-sm" 
                                    style={{ backgroundColor: config.barColor }}
                                  >
                                    {config.name}
                                  </Badge>
                                </div>
                                
                                {/* 右侧文字区域 */}
                                <div className="ml-32 h-full p-3.5 flex flex-col justify-between">
                                  {/* 课程标题 */}
                                  <div>
                                    <h4 
                                      className="text-base font-bold mb-1"
                                      style={{ color: config.barColor }}
                                    >
                                      {course.title}
                                    </h4>
                                    {/* 装饰线 */}
                                    <div className="flex items-center mb-1.5">
                                      <div className="h-[2px] w-8" style={{ backgroundColor: config.barColor }} />
                                      <div 
                                        className="w-0 h-0 ml-0.5"
                                        style={{ 
                                          borderLeft: '3px solid transparent',
                                          borderRight: '3px solid transparent',
                                          borderTop: `3px solid ${config.barColor}`,
                                          transform: 'rotate(-90deg)'
                                        }}
                                      />
                                    </div>
                                    {/* 描述 */}
                                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                                      {course.description}
                                    </p>
                                  </div>
                                  
                                  {/* 底部信息 */}
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] text-slate-400 pt-1">
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
                                      <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                                      {course.duration}分钟
                                    </span>
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
                                      <FileText className="w-3 h-3" />
                                      {course.knowledgePoints}知识点
                                    </span>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </motion.div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                        {dimSelfExplore.length > 3 && !isShowAll && (
                          <div className="text-center mt-4">
                            <Button 
                              variant="outline" 
                              size="sm" 
                              className="gap-1"
                              onClick={() => {
                                const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
                                next.set('dimension', dim);
                                next.set('showAll', '1');
                                setSearchParams(next);
                                setActiveTab(dim);
                              }}
                            >
                              查看全部 {dimSelfExplore.length} 门课程
                              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </TabsContent>
                    );
                  })}
                </Tabs>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      </section>

      {/* Bottom Stats */}
      <section className="w-full">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          <Card>
            <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
                <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">总课程</p>
                <p className="text-xl font-bold">{stats.total}</p>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-green-100">
                <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">已完成</p>
                <p className="text-xl font-bold">{stats.completed}</p>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-blue-100">
                <Play className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">学习中</p>
                <p className="text-xl font-bold">{stats.inProgress}</p>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-100">
                <Award className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">推荐课程</p>
                <p className="text-xl font-bold">{recommendedIds.size}</p>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CoursesPage;

// ============================================
// Upload Dialog
// ============================================
const UploadDialog: React.FC<{
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}> = ({ open, onOpenChange }) => {
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState<IUploadProgress | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleFileSelect = (file: File) => {
    if (!file.name.match(/\.(ppt|pptx)$/i)) {
      toast.error('请上传 PPT 或 PPTX 格式的课件');
      return;
    }

    setUploadProgress({
      fileName: file.name,
      progress: 0,
      status: 'uploading',
    });

    let progress = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      progress += 8;
      setUploadProgress(prev => prev ? { ...prev, progress } : null);

      if (progress >= 100) {
        clearInterval(interval);
        setUploadProgress(prev => prev ? { ...prev, status: 'processing' } : null);
        
        setTimeout(() => {
          setUploadProgress(prev => prev ? { ...prev, status: 'completed' } : null);
          toast.success('课件上传成功，正在提取大纲...');
          
          setTimeout(() => {
            setUploadProgress(null);
            onOpenChange(false);
          }, 1500);
        }, 2000);
      }
    }, 100);
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragging(false);
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
    if (file) handleFileSelect(file);
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Upload className="w-5 h-5" />
            上传课件
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            支持 PPT, PPTX 格式，系统将自动提取幻灯片大纲
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {!uploadProgress ? (
            <div
              className={`border-2 border-dashed rounded-xl p-8 text-center transition-colors ${
                isDragging ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5' : 'border-border'
              }`}
              onDrop={handleDrop}
              onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setIsDragging(true); }}
              onDragLeave={() => setIsDragging(false)}
              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            >
              <input
                ref={fileInputRef}
                type="file"
                accept=".ppt,.pptx"
                className="hidden"
                onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && handleFileSelect(e.target.files[0])}
              />
              <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
                <Presentation className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-foreground font-medium mb-2">
                点击或拖拽课件文件到此处
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                支持 .ppt, .pptx 格式
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="p-6 border rounded-xl space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <Presentation className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="font-medium truncate">{uploadProgress.fileName}</p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {uploadProgress.status === 'uploading' && '上传中...'}
                    {uploadProgress.status === 'processing' && '提取幻灯片中...'}
                    {uploadProgress.status === 'completed' && '处理完成'}
                  </p>
                </div>
                {uploadProgress.status === 'completed' ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />
                ) : (
                  <X className="w-5 h-5 text-muted-foreground cursor-pointer" 
                     onClick={() => setUploadProgress(null)} />
                )}
              </div>
              <Progress value={uploadProgress.progress} className="h-2" />
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="bg-muted rounded-lg p-4">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium mb-2">上传说明：</p>
            <ul className="text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-1">
              <li>• 系统将自动提取幻灯片缩略图和标题</li>
              <li>• 支持在线预览课件内容</li>
              <li>• 可手动关联到对应课程</li>
              <li>• 支持批量上传多个课件</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
};

const CoursewareListSection: React.FC<{
  coursewares: ICourseware[];
  onSelect: (cw: ICourseware) => void;
}> = ({ coursewares, onSelect }) => {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [dimensionFilter, setDimensionFilter] = useState<string>('all');

  const filtered = coursewares.filter(cw => {
    const matchesSearch = cw.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
                         cw.instructor.includes(searchQuery);
    const matchesDimension = dimensionFilter === 'all' || cw.dimension === dimensionFilter;
    return matchesSearch && matchesDimension;
  });

  return (
    <Card className="border-0 shadow-sm">
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <CardTitle className="text-lg">课件列表</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>共 {filtered.length} 个课件</CardDescription>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input
                placeholder="搜索课件..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="pl-9 w-48"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-4">
          <Button
            variant={dimensionFilter === 'all' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setDimensionFilter('all')}
          >
            全部
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={dimensionFilter === 'result' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setDimensionFilter('result')}
          >
            拿结果
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={dimensionFilter === 'people' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setDimensionFilter('people')}
          >
            带团队
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={dimensionFilter === 'field' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setDimensionFilter('field')}
          >
            传文化
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {filtered.map((cw) => {
            const dimension = dimensionConfig[cw.dimension];
            const DimensionIcon = dimension.icon;
            const status = statusConfig[cw.status];
            const StatusIcon = status.icon;

            return (
              <motion.div
                key={cw.id}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                className="p-4 rounded-lg border border-border/50 hover:bg-accent/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                onClick={() => onSelect(cw)}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-primary/20 to-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <Presentation className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <p className="font-medium text-foreground truncate">{cw.title}</p>
                      {cw.courseId && (
                        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs gap-1">
                          <Link2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                          已映射
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {cw.duration}分钟
                      </span>
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <BookOpen className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {cw.slides.length}页
                      </span>
                      <span>{cw.instructor}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Badge className={`${dimension.color} gap-1`}>
                      <DimensionIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                      {dimension.name}
                    </Badge>
                    <Badge className={`${status.color} gap-1`}>
                      <StatusIcon className={`w-3 h-3 ${cw.status === 'processing' ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                      {status.name}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}

          {filtered.length === 0 && (
            <div className="text-center py-12">
              <Presentation className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">暂无匹配的课件</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

const CoursewareManagePage: React.FC = () => {
  const [uploadDialogOpen, setUploadDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleSelect = (cw: ICourseware) => {
    setSelectedCourseware(cw);
    setDetailDialogOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full space-y-6">
      <section className="w-full">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">课件管理中心</h1>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">
              上传PPT课件，自动提取大纲并管理课程映射关系
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button onClick={() => setUploadDialogOpen(true)} className="gap-2">
            <Upload className="w-4 h-4" />
            上传课件
          </Button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <StatsSection coursewares={mockCoursewares} />
      <CoursewareListSection coursewares={mockCoursewares} onSelect={handleSelect} />
      <UploadDialog open={uploadDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setUploadDialogOpen} />
      <CoursewareDetailDialog
        courseware={selectedCourseware}
        open={detailDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setDetailDialogOpen}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

const RadarChartSection: React.FC<{
  currentScore: IThreeDimensionsScore;
  initialScore: IThreeDimensionsScore;
  hasData: boolean;
}> = ({ currentScore, initialScore, hasData }) => {
  const radarOption = {
    color: ['#1A7B6E', '#B8DDD6'],
    radar: {
      indicator: [
        { name: '拿结果', max: 100 },
        { name: '带团队', max: 100 },
        { name: '传文化', max: 100 },
      ],
      radius: '65%',
      center: ['50%', '50%'],
      splitNumber: 4,
      axisName: {
        color: '#0B3B3F',
        fontSize: 14,
        fontWeight: 'bold',
      },
      splitLine: {
        lineStyle: {
          color: 'rgba(26, 123, 110, 0.2)',
        },
      },
      splitArea: {
        areaStyle: {
          color: ['rgba(26, 123, 110, 0.05)', 'rgba(26, 123, 110, 0.1)'],
        },
      },
      axisLine: {
        lineStyle: {
          color: 'rgba(26, 123, 110, 0.3)',
        },
      },
    },
    series: [
      {
        name: '能力对比',
        type: 'radar',
        data: [
          {
            value: [currentScore.result, currentScore.people, currentScore.field],
            name: '当前能力',
            areaStyle: {
              color: 'rgba(26, 123, 110, 0.3)',
            },
            lineStyle: {
              width: 3,
            },
            label: {
              show: true,
              formatter: (params: any) => {
                const val = params.value;
                const dimIdx = params.dimensionIndex;
                const dimNames = ['result', 'people', 'field'];
                const dimName = dimNames[dimIdx] || '';
                const diff = currentScore[dimName as keyof IThreeDimensionsScore] - initialScore[dimName as keyof IThreeDimensionsScore];
                const sign = diff > 0 ? '+' : '';
                if (diff !== 0) {
                  return `${val}(${sign}${diff})`;
                }
                return `${val}`;
              },
              fontSize: 12,
              color: '#1A7B6E',
              fontWeight: 'bold',
            },
          },
          {
            value: [initialScore.result, initialScore.people, initialScore.field],
            name: '初始能力',
            lineStyle: {
              type: 'dashed',
              width: 2,
            },
            label: {
              show: true,
              formatter: '{c}',
              fontSize: 11,
              color: '#B8DDD6',
            },
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
    legend: {
      bottom: 10,
      data: ['当前能力', '初始能力'],
      textStyle: {
        color: '#0B3B3F',
      },
    },
  };

  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      <Card className="border-border/50">
        <CardHeader className="pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
                <Target className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
              </div>
              <CardTitle className="text-lg">三维度能力雷达图</CardTitle>
            </div>
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
              成长对比
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {!hasData ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-10">
              <Image src={EMPTY_STATE_ILLUSTRATIONS.hourglass} width={120} height={120} alt="数据积累中" className="mb-4 object-contain" />
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">数据积累中</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/60">完成至少1次AI陪练后展示能力雷达图</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <ReactECharts option={radarOption} style={{ height: '320px' }} />
              
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mt-4">
                {Object.entries(dimensionConfig).map(([key, config]) => {
                  const score = currentScore[key as keyof IThreeDimensionsScore];
                  const initial = initialScore[key as keyof IThreeDimensionsScore];
                  const growth = score - initial;
                  return (
                    <div key={key} className="text-center p-3 rounded-xl bg-muted/50">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
                        <config.icon className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: config.color }} />
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">{config.name}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{score}</div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-xs">
                        {growth > 0 ? (
                          <>
                            <TrendingUp className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-500" />
                            <span className="text-emerald-600 font-medium">+{growth}</span>
                          </>
                        ) : growth < 0 ? (
                          <span className="text-red-500 font-medium">{growth}</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">0</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </section>
  );
};

// ============================================
// 历史趋势图区块
// ============================================
const TrendChartSection: React.FC<{
  scoreHistory: IScoreHistoryPoint[];
}> = ({ scoreHistory }) => {
  const hasHistory = scoreHistory.length > 0;
  const allValues = scoreHistory.flatMap((h) => [h.result, h.people, h.field]);
  const minVal = allValues.length > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(...allValues) - 10) : 0;
  const maxVal = allValues.length > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.max(...allValues) + 10) : 100;

  const trendOption = {
    color: ['#1A7B6E', '#0B3B3F', '#2C5A5A'],
    tooltip: {
      trigger: 'axis',
    },
    legend: {
      data: ['拿结果', '带团队', '传文化'],
      bottom: 0,
    },
    grid: {
      left: '3%',
      right: '4%',
      bottom: '15%',
      top: '10%',
      containLabel: true,
    },
    xAxis: {
      type: 'category',
      boundaryGap: false,
      data: scoreHistory.map((h) => h.date.slice(5)),
      axisLine: {
        lineStyle: {
          color: '#E8F0F0',
        },
      },
      axisLabel: {
        color: '#60858b',
      },
    },
    yAxis: {
      type: 'value',
      min: minVal,
      max: maxVal,
      axisLine: {
        show: false,
      },
      splitLine: {
        lineStyle: {
          color: '#E8F0F0',
        },
      },
      axisLabel: {
        color: '#60858b',
      },
    },
    series: [
      {
        name: '拿结果',
        type: 'line',
        smooth: true,
        data: scoreHistory.map((h) => h.result),
        areaStyle: {
          color: 'rgba(26, 123, 110, 0.1)',
        },
      },
      {
        name: '带团队',
        type: 'line',
        smooth: true,
        data: scoreHistory.map((h) => h.people),
        areaStyle: {
          color: 'rgba(11, 59, 63, 0.1)',
        },
      },
      {
        name: '传文化',
        type: 'line',
        smooth: true,
        data: scoreHistory.map((h) => h.field),
        areaStyle: {
          color: 'rgba(44, 90, 90, 0.1)',
        },
      },
    ],
  };

  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      <Card className="border-border/50">
        <CardHeader className="pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
              <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <CardTitle className="text-lg">能力成长趋势</CardTitle>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {hasHistory ? (
            <ReactECharts option={trendOption} style={{ height: '280px' }} />
          ) : (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-10">
              <Image src={EMPTY_STATE_ILLUSTRATIONS.hourglass} width={120} height={120} alt="数据积累中" className="mb-4 object-contain" />
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">数据积累中</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/60">完成更多AI陪练后展示成长趋势</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </section>
  );
};

const ActionPlanSection: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const getStatusIcon = (status: IActionPlan['status']) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed':
        return <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />;
      case 'in_progress':
        return <Circle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />;
      default:
        return <Circle className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />;
    }
  };

  const getStatusText = (status: IActionPlan['status']) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed':
        return '已完成';
      case 'in_progress':
        return '进行中';
      default:
        return '待开始';
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      <Card className="border-border/50">
        <CardHeader className="pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
                <Award className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
              </div>
              <CardTitle className="text-lg">行动计划承诺</CardTitle>
            </div>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => navigate('/action-plan')}>
              查看全部
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-1" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-3">
          {mockActionPlans.map((plan) => (

// ============================================
// 360度反馈区块
// ============================================
const relationLabels: Record<PeerRelation, string> = {
  superior: '上级评价',
  peer: '平级评价',
  subordinate: '下属评价',
};

const relationColors: Record<PeerRelation, string> = {
  superior: 'text-emerald-600',
  peer: 'text-blue-600',
  subordinate: 'text-amber-600',
};

const PeerReviewSection: React.FC = () => {
  const userInfo = useCurrentUserProfile();
  const userId = userInfo?.user_id;
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<IPeerReviewSummary | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [shareUrl, setShareUrl] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!userId) return;
    const fetchSummary = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await getPeerReviewSummary(userId);
        setSummary(data);
      } catch (err) {
        logger.error('获取360反馈失败', String(err));
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchSummary();
  }, [userId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userId) {
      setShareUrl(resolveAppUrl(`/feedback/${userId}`));
    }
  }, [userId]);

  const handleCopyLink = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareUrl);
    toast.success('邀请链接已复制');
  };

  const hasAnyData = summary && (summary.superior || summary.peer || summary.subordinate);

  const radarOption = {
    tooltip: { trigger: 'item' as const },
    legend: { data: ['上级评价', '平级评价', '下属评价'], bottom: 0, textStyle: { fontSize: 11 } },
    radar: {
      indicator: [
        { name: '拿结果', max: 100 },
        { name: '带团队', max: 100 },
        { name: '传文化', max: 100 },
      ],
      shape: 'circle' as const,
      splitNumber: 4,
    },
    series: [{
      type: 'radar' as const,
      data: [
        ...(summary?.superior ? [{ value: [summary.superior.scoreResult, summary.superior.scorePeople, summary.superior.scoreField], name: '上级评价', itemStyle: { color: '#10b981' } }] : []),
        ...(summary?.peer ? [{ value: [summary.peer.scoreResult, summary.peer.scorePeople, summary.peer.scoreField], name: '平级评价', itemStyle: { color: '#3b82f6' } }] : []),
        ...(summary?.subordinate ? [{ value: [summary.subordinate.scoreResult, summary.subordinate.scorePeople, summary.subordinate.scoreField], name: '下属评价', itemStyle: { color: '#f59e0b' } }] : []),
      ],
    }],
  };

  return (
    <section className="w-full space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
            <UserCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-foreground">360度反馈</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">来自上级、平级、下属的匿名评价</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-2" onClick={handleCopyLink}>
          <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          邀请评价
        </Button>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <Card><CardContent className="p-6"><div className="h-64 bg-muted/30 rounded animate-pulse" /></CardContent></Card>
          <Card><CardContent className="p-6"><div className="h-64 bg-muted/30 rounded animate-pulse" /></CardContent></Card>
        </div>
      ) : !hasAnyData ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="py-12 text-center">
            <Image src={EMPTY_STATE_ILLUSTRATIONS.feedbackCircle} width={120} height={120} alt="暂无360反馈数据" className="mx-auto mb-4 object-contain" />
            <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-1">暂无360反馈数据</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground/60 mb-4">邀请您的上级、同事或下属为您进行匿名评价</p>
            <Button variant="default" size="sm" className="gap-2" onClick={handleCopyLink}>
              <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />
              复制邀请链接
            </Button>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader><CardTitle className="text-base">三维度雷达图</CardTitle></CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <ReactECharts option={radarOption} style={{ height: 280 }} />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader><CardTitle className="text-base">评分汇总</CardTitle></CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4">
              {(['superior', 'peer', 'subordinate'] as const).map(relation => {
                const data = summary?.[relation];
                if (!data) return null;
                return (
                  <div key={relation} className="p-3 rounded-lg border border-border/50">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <span className={`font-medium text-sm ${relationColors[relation]}`}>{relationLabels[relation]}</span>
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">{data.count}人</Badge>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
                      <div><div className="text-lg font-bold">{data.scoreResult}</div><div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">拿结果</div></div>
                      <div><div className="text-lg font-bold">{data.scorePeople}</div><div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">带团队</div></div>
                      <div><div className="text-lg font-bold">{data.scoreField}</div><div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">传文化</div></div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      {summary && summary.reviews.length > 0 && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader><CardTitle className="text-base">反馈详情</CardTitle></CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-3">
            {summary.reviews.map((review: any) => (
              <div key={review.id} className="p-3 rounded-lg border border-border/50">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">{relationLabels[review.reviewerRelation as PeerRelation]}</Badge>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{new Date(review.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                </div>
                {review.comment && (
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">{review.comment}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </section>
  );
};

// ============================================
// 积分与等级展示卡片
// ============================================
const PointsAndLevelCard: React.FC = () => {
  const [pointsData, setPointsData] = useState<IUserPoints | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchUserPoints().then((data) => {
      setPointsData(data);
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, []);

  const points = pointsData?.totalPoints ?? 0;
  const levelInfo = getLevelInfo(points);
  const progressPercent = levelInfo.level >= 5
    ? 100
    : Math.min(100, Math.round(((points - (levelInfo.level === 1 ? 0 : [0, 0, 101, 301, 601, 1001][levelInfo.level])) / ([0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 0][levelInfo.level])) * 100));

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <section className="w-full">
        <Card className="border-border/50">
          <CardContent className="p-6"><div className="h-40 bg-muted/30 rounded animate-pulse" /></CardContent>
        </Card>
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section className="w-full">
      <Card className="border-border/50 bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-50/50 to-transparent">
        <CardHeader className="pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-100">
                <Star className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600" />
              </div>
              <CardTitle className="text-lg">积分与等级</CardTitle>
            </div>
            <Badge className="bg-amber-500 text-white text-xs">
              {levelInfo.name}
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
            <span className="text-4xl font-bold text-amber-600">{points}</span>
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">积分</span>
            {pointsData && pointsData.streakDays > 0 && (
              <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs ml-auto text-orange-600 border-orange-200">
                <Flame className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                连续{pointsData.streakDays}天
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>
          {levelInfo.level < 5 ? (
            <>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  <span>Lv.{levelInfo.level}</span>
                  <span>距 Lv.{levelInfo.level + 1} 还差 {levelInfo.pointsToNext} 分</span>
                </div>
                <Progress value={progressPercent} className="h-2" />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1 mt-2">
                {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((lv: number) => (
                  <div
                    key={lv}
                    className={`text-center py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-medium ${
                      lv <= levelInfo.level
                        ? 'bg-amber-500 text-white'
                        : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'
                    }`}
                  >
                    Lv.{lv}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200">
              <Trophy className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600" />
              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-amber-700">已达最高等级，继续挑战自我！</span>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
            <Zap className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-500" />
            <span>完成陪练、行动计划和复盘可获得积分</span>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </section>
  );
};

const BadgesDisplayCard: React.FC = () => {

const DashboardPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [userStats, setUserStats] = useState<IUserStats | null>(null);
  const [statsLoading, setStatsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<ICoachingSession[]>([]);
  const [scenes, setScenes] = useState<ICoachingScene[]>([]);
  const [dataLoading, setDataLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    getUserStats()
      .then((data) => {
        setUserStats(data);
        setStatsLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        logger.error('获取学习统计失败', String(err));
        setStatsLoading(false);
      });

    Promise.all([
      getMySessions().catch((err: unknown) => {
        logger.error('获取陪练记录失败', String(err));
        return [] as ICoachingSession[];
      }),
      getAllScenes().catch((err: unknown) => {
        logger.error('获取陪练场景失败', String(err));
        return [] as ICoachingScene[];
      }),
    ])
      .then(([sessionsData, scenesData]) => {
        setSessions(sessionsData);
        setScenes(scenesData);
        setDataLoading(false);
      });
  }, []);

  // Build scene lookup map
  const sceneMap = React.useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, ICoachingScene>();
    scenes.forEach((s) => map.set(s.id, s));
    return map;
  }, [scenes]);

  // Compute current scores from userStats or sessions
  const currentScore: IThreeDimensionsScore = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (userStats && userStats.totalSessions > 0) {
      return {
        result: Math.round(userStats.avgScores.result),
        people: Math.round(userStats.avgScores.people),
        field: Math.round(userStats.avgScores.field),
      };
    }
    return { result: 0, people: 0, field: 0 };
  }, [userStats]);

  // Compute initial scores from assessment localStorage or first session
  const initialScore: IThreeDimensionsScore = React.useMemo(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem('mdp_assessment_scores');
      if (stored) {
        const scores = JSON.parse(stored);
        if (scores && typeof scores === 'object') {
          return {
            result: Number(scores.result) || 0,
            people: Number(scores.people) || 0,
            field: Number(scores.field) || 0,
          };
        }
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    // Fallback: use first completed session scores
    const completedSessions = sessions
      .filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && s.completedAt)
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.completedAt!).getTime() - new Date(b.completedAt!).getTime());
    if (completedSessions.length > 0) {
      const first = completedSessions[0];
      return {
        result: first.scoreResult || 0,
        people: first.scorePeople || 0,
        field: first.scoreField || 0,
      };
    }
    return { result: 0, people: 0, field: 0 };
  }, [sessions]);

  // Build score history from completed sessions
  const scoreHistory: IScoreHistoryPoint[] = React.useMemo(() => {
    const completedSessions = sessions
      .filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && s.completedAt)
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.completedAt!).getTime() - new Date(b.completedAt!).getTime());
    return completedSessions.map((s) => ({
      date: s.completedAt!.slice(0, 10),
      result: s.scoreResult || 0,
      people: s.scorePeople || 0,
      field: s.scoreField || 0,
    }));
  }, [sessions]);

  // Build coaching records from sessions
  const coachingRecords: ICoachingRecord[] = React.useMemo(() => {
    return sessions
      .filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' || s.status === 'abandoned')
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const dateA = a.completedAt || '';
        const dateB = b.completedAt || '';
        return dateB.localeCompare(dateA);
      })
      .map((s) => {
        const scene = sceneMap.get(s.sceneId);
        return {
          id: s.id,
          sceneName: scene?.name || '未知场景',
          dimension: (scene?.dimension || 'result') as 'result' | 'people' | 'field',
          date: s.completedAt ? s.completedAt.slice(0, 10) : '--',
          finalScore: {
            result: s.scoreResult || 0,
            people: s.scorePeople || 0,
            field: s.scoreField || 0,
          },
          rounds: s.roundCount || 0,
          status: s.status as 'completed' | 'abandoned',
        };
      });
  }, [sessions, sceneMap]);

  // Course progress: no API available, derive from sessions' associated courses
  const courseProgress: ICourseProgress[] = React.useMemo(() => {
    const courseMap = new Map<string, { courseId: string; courseName: string; dimension: 'result' | 'people' | 'field'; sessionCount: number }>();
    sessions
      .filter((s) => s.status === 'completed')
      .forEach((s) => {
        const scene = sceneMap.get(s.sceneId);
        if (scene?.sourceCourseId && scene.sourceCourseName) {
          const existing = courseMap.get(scene.sourceCourseId);
          if (existing) {
            existing.sessionCount++;
          } else {
            courseMap.set(scene.sourceCourseId, {
              courseId: scene.sourceCourseId,
              courseName: scene.sourceCourseName,
              dimension: (scene.dimension || 'result') as 'result' | 'people' | 'field',
              sessionCount: 1,
            });
          }
        }
      });
    return Array.from(courseMap.values()).map((c) => ({
      id: c.courseId,
      title: c.courseName,
      dimension: c.dimension,
      progress: Math.min(100, c.sessionCount * 25),
      totalDuration: 15,
      completedDuration: Math.min(15, c.sessionCount * 4),
    }));
  }, [sessions, sceneMap]);

  const stats = userStats;
  const hasData = stats && stats.hasEnoughData;
  const hasSessionData = sessions.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed').length > 0;

  return (
    <div className="w-full space-y-6">
      {/* 页面标题 */}
      <section className="w-full">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">成长轨迹</h1>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">追踪您的领导力成长轨迹</p>
            <p className="text-amber-600 text-sm mt-1 font-medium">
              成长是一段旅程，不是终点。回顾你的每一步，都值得骄傲。
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
              总学习时长: {stats ? `${stats.coachingHours}小时` : '--'}
            </Badge>
            <Badge className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground text-xs">
              完成陪练: {stats ? `${stats.totalSessions}次` : '--'}
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* 业务价值与行为改变概览 */}
      <section className="w-full grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {/* 我的学习ROI */}
        <Card className={`border-border/50 ${hasData ? 'bg-gradient-to-br from-primary/5 to-transparent' : ''}`}>
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground mb-2">
              <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span className="text-xs">我的学习ROI</span>
            </div>
            {hasData ? (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                  <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-primary">{stats.roi}%</p>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">投入¥{(stats.learningCost / 10000).toFixed(2)}万，产出¥{(stats.estimatedBusinessValue / 10000).toFixed(1)}万</p>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                  <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-muted-foreground/50">--</p>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Database className="w-3 h-3" />
                  完成更多陪练和实战后展示
                </p>
              </>
            )}
            <div className="mt-2">
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/70 leading-tight">
                计算方式：{stats?.methodology?.roiFormula || '(业务价值-学习投入)/学习投入×100%'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 行为改变进度 */}
        <Card className="border-border/50">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground mb-2">
              <Activity className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span className="text-xs">行为改变进度</span>
            </div>
            {stats && stats.totalPlans > 0 ? (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                  <p className="text-3xl font-bold">{stats.behaviorScore}</p>
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">/ 5分</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">基于行动计划执行情况</p>
                <div className="mt-2">
                  <Progress value={stats.behaviorScore * 20} className="h-1.5" />
                </div>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                  <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-muted-foreground/50">--</p>
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">/ 5分</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Database className="w-3 h-3" />
                  创建行动计划后展示
                </p>
              </>
            )}
            <div className="mt-2">
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/70 leading-tight">
                计算方式：{stats?.methodology?.behaviorScoreFormula || '行动计划执行率 × 5分制'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 行动计划执行率 */}
        <Card className="border-border/50">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground mb-2">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span className="text-xs">行动计划执行率</span>
            </div>
            {stats && stats.totalPlans > 0 ? (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                  <p className="text-3xl font-bold">{stats.executionRate}%</p>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">已完成 {stats.reviewedPlans}/{stats.totalPlans} 项行动</p>
                <div className="mt-2 flex gap-1">
                  {Array.from({ length: Math.min(stats.totalPlans, 10) }).map((_, i) => (
                    <div
                      key={i}
                      className={`flex-1 h-2 rounded-sm ${i < stats.reviewedPlans ? 'bg-green-500' : 'bg-gray-200'}`}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                  <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-muted-foreground/50">--</p>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Database className="w-3 h-3" />
                  创建行动计划后展示
                </p>
              </>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 业务价值贡献 */}
        <Card className={`border-border/50 ${hasData ? '' : ''}`}>
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground mb-2">
              <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span className="text-xs">业务价值贡献</span>
            </div>
            {hasData ? (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                  <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-600">¥{(stats.estimatedBusinessValue / 10000).toFixed(1)}</p>
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">万</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">基于实战成果的量化估算</p>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                  <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-muted-foreground/50">--</p>
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">万</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Database className="w-3 h-3" />
                  完成实战复盘后展示
                </p>
              </>
            )}
            <div className="mt-2">
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/70 leading-tight">
                计算方式：{stats?.methodology?.businessValueFormula || '已复盘计划数 × 单计划平均业务价值估算'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </section>

      {/* 数据说明 */}
      {!statsLoading && (!stats || !stats.hasEnoughData) && (
        <section className="w-full">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/50 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <Info className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div>
              <span className="font-medium">数据说明：</span>
              学习ROI和业务价值贡献基于真实学习数据科学换算（完成至少3次陪练+2项行动计划后展示）。
              学习投入 = 陪练时长 × 管理者平均时薪(¥200/h)；业务价值 = 已复盘计划数 × 单计划估算均值。数据越丰富，指标越准确。
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {/* 图表区域 */}
      <section className="w-full grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        {dataLoading ? (
          <>
            <Card><CardContent className="p-6"><div className="h-80 bg-muted/30 rounded animate-pulse" /></CardContent></Card>
            <Card><CardContent className="p-6"><div className="h-80 bg-muted/30 rounded animate-pulse" /></CardContent></Card>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <RadarChartSection
              currentScore={currentScore}
              initialScore={initialScore}
              hasData={hasSessionData}
            />
            <TrendChartSection scoreHistory={scoreHistory} />
          </>
        )}
      </section>

      {/* 积分与等级 + 徽章展示区 */}
      <section className="w-full grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <PointsAndLevelCard />

      </section>

      {/* 行动成果时间线 */}
      <ActionOutcomeSection />

        <Tabs defaultValue="progress" className="w-full">
          <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4 mb-6">
