];

const EvalFormSection: React.FC = () => {
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<IEvaluationFormData>({
    evaluatorRole: null,
    scores: {},
    overallComment: '',
    strengths: '',
    improvements: ''
  });
  const [isSubmitted, setIsSubmitted] = useState(false);

  const totalSteps = 5;
  const progress = (currentStep / totalSteps) * 100;

  const handleRoleSelect = (role: 'supervisor' | 'peer' | 'subordinate') => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, evaluatorRole: role }));
  };

  const handleScoreChange = (questionId: string, score: number) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      scores: { ...prev.scores, [questionId]: score }
    }));
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (currentStep < totalSteps) {
      setCurrentStep(prev => prev + 1);
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  };

  const handlePrev = () => {
    if (currentStep > 1) {
      setCurrentStep(prev => prev - 1);
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    setIsSubmitted(true);
  };

  const calculateDimensionScore = (dimensionId: string) => {
    const dimension = dimensions.find(d => d.id === dimensionId);
    if (!dimension) return 0;
    
    const scores = dimension.questions.map(q => formData.scores[q.id] || 0);
    const validScores = scores.filter(s => s > 0);
    if (validScores.length === 0) return 0;
    
    return validScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / validScores.length;
  };

  const calculateTotalProgress = () => {
    const totalQuestions = dimensions.reduce((acc, d) => acc + d.questions.length, 0);
    const answeredQuestions = Object.keys(formData.scores).length;
    return Math.round((answeredQuestions / totalQuestions) * 100);
  };

  if (isSubmitted) {
    return (
      <section className="w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto py-8">
        <Card className="border-border/50">
          <CardContent className="p-8 text-center">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-10 h-10 text-emerald-600" />
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mb-3">评估提交成功</h2>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-6 max-w-md mx-auto">
              感谢您的反馈！您的评估将被匿名处理，用于帮助管理者了解自身优势和发展空间。
            </p>
            <div className="bg-muted/50 rounded-xl p-4 mb-6 max-w-sm mx-auto">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm mb-2">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">评估对象</span>
                <span className="font-medium">张明</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm mb-2">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">您的角色</span>
                <span className="font-medium">
                  {roleOptions.find(r => r.id === formData.evaluatorRole)?.label}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">提交时间</span>
                <span className="font-medium">{new Date().toLocaleDateString()}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <Button onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>返回评估中心</Button>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto py-6 space-y-6">
      {/* 进度条 */}
      <Card className="border-border/50 sticky top-0 z-10">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                步骤 {currentStep} / {totalSteps}
              </span>
              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
                {calculateTotalProgress()}% 完成
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {currentStep === 1 && '选择角色'}
              {currentStep === 2 && '拿结果评估'}
              {currentStep === 3 && '带团队评估'}
              {currentStep === 4 && '传文化评估'}
              {currentStep === 5 && '综合评价'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <Progress value={progress} className="h-2" />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* 步骤1：选择评估角色 */}
      {currentStep === 1 && (
        <Card className="border-border/50">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2">
              <User className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
              选择您的评估角色
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 p-4 bg-muted/50 rounded-xl">
              <Avatar className="w-12 h-12">
                <AvatarFallback className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground">张</AvatarFallback>
              </Avatar>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-foreground">张明</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">产品经理 · 产品一部</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {roleOptions.map((role) => {
                const Icon = role.icon;
                const isSelected = formData.evaluatorRole === role.id;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={role.id}
                    onClick={() => handleRoleSelect(role.id as any)}
                    className={`p-4 rounded-xl border-2 text-left transition-all ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5'
                        : 'border-border hover:border-primary/50'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center mb-3 ${
                      isSelected ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'bg-muted'
                    }`}>
                      <Icon className="w-5 h-5" />
                    </div>
                    <h4 className="font-semibold text-foreground mb-1">{role.label}</h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{role.description}</p>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-start gap-3 p-4 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg">
              <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <p className="text-sm text-amber-800">
                请根据您与被评估人的实际关系选择角色，这将影响评估问题的侧重点。您的评估将匿名提交。
              </p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* 步骤2-4：三维度评估 */}
      {currentStep >= 2 && currentStep <= 4 && (
        <>
          {dimensions.slice(currentStep - 2, currentStep - 1).map((dimension) => {
            const dimensionScore = calculateDimensionScore(dimension.id);
            const answeredCount = dimension.questions.filter(q => formData.scores[q.id]).length;
            
            return (
              <Card key={dimension.id} className="border-border/50">
                <CardHeader>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-primary">
                        {dimension.icon}
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <CardTitle className="text-xl">{dimension.name}</CardTitle>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{dimension.description}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {dimensionScore > 0 && (
                      <Badge className="text-base px-3 py-1">
                        {dimensionScore.toFixed(1)} 分
                      </Badge>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="space-y-6">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                      已完成 {answeredCount} / {dimension.questions.length} 题
                    </span>
                    <Progress 
                      value={(answeredCount / dimension.questions.length) * 100} 
                      className="w-32 h-1.5"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <Separator />

                  {dimension.questions.map((question, index) => (
                    <div key={question.id} className="space-y-3">
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                        <span className="flex-shrink-0 w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-muted flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-medium">
                          {index + 1}
                        </span>
                        <div className="flex-1">
                          <p className="text-foreground font-medium">{question.text}</p>
                          <Badge variant="secondary" className="mt-1 text-xs">
                            {question.category}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      
                      <RadioGroup
                        value={formData.scores[question.id]?.toString()}
                        onValueChange={(value) => handleScoreChange(question.id, parseInt(value))}
                        className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2 pl-9"
                      >
                        {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((score) => {
                          const label = scoreLabels.find(l => l.value === score);
                          const isSelected = formData.scores[question.id] === score;
                          return (
                            <div key={score}>
                              <RadioGroupItem
                                value={score.toString()}
                                id={`${question.id}_${score}`}
                                className="sr-only"
                              />
                              <Label
                                htmlFor={`${question.id}_${score}`}
                                className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-3 rounded-lg border-2 cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                                  isSelected
                                    ? label?.color
                                    : 'border-border hover:border-primary/30'
                                }`}
                              >
                                <Star className={`w-4 h-4 mb-1 ${isSelected ? 'fill-current' : ''}`} />
                                <span className="text-lg font-semibold">{score}</span>
                                <span className="text-xs">{label?.label}</span>
                              </Label>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </RadioGroup>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            );
          })}
        </>
      )}

      {/* 步骤5：综合评价 */}
      {currentStep === 5 && (
        <Card className="border-border/50">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2">
              <Star className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
              综合评价
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-6">
            {/* 三维度得分汇总 */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-muted/50 rounded-xl">
              <h4 className="font-medium text-foreground mb-4">三维度得分</h4>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                {dimensions.map((dim) => {
                  const score = calculateDimensionScore(dim.id);
                  return (
                    <div key={dim.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-card rounded-lg border border-border/50">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-primary">
                        {dim.icon}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{dim.name}</p>
                        <p className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">
                          {score > 0 ? score.toFixed(1) : '-'}
                          <span className="text-sm font-normal text-muted-foreground"> / 5</span>
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            <Separator />

            {/* 优势评价 */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="strengths" className="text-base font-medium">
                被评估人的突出优势
              </Label>
              <Textarea
                id="strengths"
                placeholder="请描述被评估人在管理工作中表现最突出的方面（如：目标管理能力强、善于激励团队等）..."
                value={formData.strengths}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, strengths: e.target.value }))}
                className="min-h-[100px] resize-none"
              />
            </div>

            {/* 改进建议 */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="improvements" className="text-base font-medium">
                建议改进的方向
              </Label>
              <Textarea
                id="improvements"
                placeholder="请提出有助于被评估人持续提升的建议（如：增强跨部门沟通、加强风险预判等）..."
                value={formData.improvements}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, improvements: e.target.value }))}
                className="min-h-[100px] resize-none"
              />
            </div>

            {/* 总体评价 */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="overallComment" className="text-base font-medium">
                总体评价
              </Label>
              <Textarea
                id="overallComment"
                placeholder="请对被评估人的整体管理能力给予综合评价..."
                value={formData.overallComment}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, overallComment: e.target.value }))}
                className="min-h-[120px] resize-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-start gap-3 p-4 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg">
              <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="text-sm text-blue-800">
                <p className="font-medium mb-1">提示</p>
                <p>您的评估将被匿名处理。请基于实际观察和工作互动，提供真实、客观的反馈。</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* 导航按钮 */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-4">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          onClick={handlePrev}
          disabled={currentStep === 1}
          className="gap-2"
        >
          <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          上一步
        </Button>

        {currentStep < totalSteps ? (
          <Button
            onClick={handleNext}
            className="gap-2"
          >
            下一步
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button
            onClick={handleSubmit}
            className="gap-2"
          >
            <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
            提交评估
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

export default EvalFormSection;

const EvaluatorCard: React.FC<{ evaluator: IEvaluator }> = ({ evaluator }) => {
  const roleColors = {
    supervisor: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 border-blue-200',
    peer: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 border-purple-200',
    subordinate: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 border-green-200',
  };

  const averageScore = Math.round(
    (evaluator.scores.result + evaluator.scores.people + evaluator.scores.field) / 3
  );

  return (
    <Card className={`border-border/50 ${!evaluator.completed ? 'opacity-70' : ''}`}>
      <CardContent className="p-5">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
              <UserCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h4 className="font-medium text-foreground">{evaluator.name}</h4>
              <Badge variant="secondary" className={`text-xs mt-1 ${roleColors[evaluator.role]}`}>
                {evaluator.roleName}
              </Badge>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right">
            {evaluator.completed ? (
              <>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">{averageScore}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">综合评分</div>
              </>
            ) : (
              <Badge variant="outline" className="text-amber-600 border-amber-200 bg-amber-50">
                待评价
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {evaluator.completed && (
          <>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mb-3">
              <div className="text-center p-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{evaluator.scores.result}</div>

// 综合评价组件
const OverallEvaluationCard: React.FC<{ evaluation: ILevel3Evaluation }> = ({ evaluation }) => {
  const completedCount = evaluation.evaluators.filter(e => e.completed).length;
  const totalCount = evaluation.evaluators.length;
  const completionRate = Math.round((completedCount / totalCount) * 100);

  return (
    <Card className="border-border/50">
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
              <ClipboardList className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-lg">三级评估概览</CardTitle>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">评估周期: {evaluation.evaluationPeriod}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Badge variant={completionRate === 100 ? 'default' : 'secondary'}>
            {completedCount}/{totalCount} 已评价
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        <Progress value={completionRate} className="h-2" />

        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <div className="text-center p-4 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-100">
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-600">{evaluation.overallScore.result}</div>
            <div className="text-xs text-emerald-600/70 mt-1">拿结果</div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-center p-4 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 border border-blue-100">
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">{evaluation.overallScore.people}</div>
            <div className="text-xs text-blue-600/70 mt-1">带团队</div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-center p-4 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-100">
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-amber-600">{evaluation.overallScore.field}</div>
            <div className="text-xs text-amber-600/70 mt-1">传文化</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-primary/5 border border-primary/10">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 inline mr-1 text-primary" />
            与前置测评相比，三维度平均提升 <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">12分</span>，
            其中"带团队"维度提升最为显著。
          </p>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

const Level3EvalPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [evaluation] = useState<ILevel3Evaluation>(mockEvaluation);

  return (
    <div className="w-full space-y-6">
      {/* 页面标题 */}
      <section className="w-full">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">三级评估</h1>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">柯氏三级评估：行为改变追踪与行动计划落实</p>
          </div>
          <Button>
            <Send className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            发起评估邀请
          </Button>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* 综合评价卡片 */}
      <section className="w-full">
        <OverallEvaluationCard evaluation={evaluation} />
      </section>

      {/* Tabs 切换 */}
      <section className="w-full">
        <Tabs defaultValue="evaluation" className="w-full">
          <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3">
            <TabsTrigger value="evaluation" className="gap-2">
              <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
              360度评价
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="behavior" className="gap-2">
              <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4" />

const MetricCard: React.FC<{ metric: IBusinessMetric }> = ({ metric }) => {
  const isPositive = metric.improvement > 0;
  const metTarget = metric.postValue >= metric.targetValue;

  const categoryIcons = {
    sales: <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4" />,
    project: <Briefcase className="w-4 h-4" />,
    team: <Users className="w-4 h-4" />,

    other: <Target className="w-4 h-4" />,
  };

  const categoryColors = {
    sales: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700',
    project: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700',
    team: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700',
    customer: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700',
    other: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700',
  };

  const categoryNames = {
    sales: '销售指标',
    project: '项目指标',
    team: '团队指标',
    customer: '客户指标',
    other: '其他指标',
  };

  return (
    <Card className="border-border/50">
      <CardContent className="p-5">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-4">
          <div className={`p-2 rounded-lg ${categoryColors[metric.category]}`}>
            {categoryIcons[metric.category]}
          </div>
          <Badge variant={metTarget ? 'default' : 'secondary'} className="text-xs">
            {metTarget ? '已达标' : '进行中'}

        </div>

        </div>

  low: { label: '低', color: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 border-green-200' },

const statusConfig = {
  pending: { label: '待处理', color: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700', icon: Clock, columnColor: 'border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/50' },
  in_progress: { label: '进行中', color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700', icon: AlertCircle, columnColor: 'border-blue-200 bg-blue-50/50' },
  adopted: { label: '已上线', color: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700', icon: CheckCircle, columnColor: 'border-green-200 bg-green-50/50' },

};

// 计算处理时效
const getProcessingDays = (createdAt: string) => {
  const created = new Date(createdAt);
  const now = new Date();
  const diffTime = Math.abs(now.getTime() - created.getTime());
  return Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
};

// 检查是否超期
const isOverdue = (createdAt: string, deadline?: string) => {
  if (deadline) {
    const deadlineDate = new Date(deadline);
    const now = new Date();
    return now > deadlineDate;
  }
  // 无截止日期时，超过7天视为超期
  return getProcessingDays(createdAt) > 7;
};

  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'list' | 'board'>('board');

  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [isSubmitDialogOpen, setIsSubmitDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSuggestion, setSelectedSuggestion] = useState<ISuggestion | null>(null);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');

  const [draggedSuggestion, setDraggedSuggestion] = useState<ISuggestion | null>(null);

    targetModule: '',

      suggestion.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      suggestion.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());

                  {priorityConfig[suggestion.priority].label}

                    const CategoryIcon = categoryConfig[suggestion.category].icon;

                    const overdue = isOverdue(suggestion.createdAt, suggestion.deadline);

                    return (
                      <Card key={suggestion.id} className="hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
                        <CardContent className="p-6">
                          <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                            <img
                              src={suggestion.expertAvatar}
                              alt={suggestion.expertName}
                              className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover border-2 border-border"
                            />
                            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                                <div>
                                  <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground mb-1">
                                    {suggestion.title}
                                  </h3>
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-3">
                                    <span>{suggestion.expertName}</span>
                                    <span>·</span>
                                    <span>{suggestion.expertType}</span>
                                    <span>·</span>
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                      <Calendar className="w-3 h-3" />
                                      {suggestion.createdAt}
                                    </span>
                                    {overdue && (
                                      <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-xs">
                                        <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                                        超期{processingDays - 7}天
                                      </Badge>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                  <Badge className={categoryConfig[suggestion.category].color}>
                                    <CategoryIcon className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                                    {categoryConfig[suggestion.category].label}
                                  </Badge>
                                  <Badge className={priorityConfig[suggestion.priority].color}>
                                    {priorityConfig[suggestion.priority].label}
                                  </Badge>
                                  <Badge className={statusConfig[suggestion.status].color}>
                                    <StatusIcon className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                                    {statusConfig[suggestion.status].label}
                                  </Badge>
                                </div>
                              </div>

                              <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-4 leading-relaxed">
                                {suggestion.description}
                              </p>

                              <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground">
                                  <Target className="w-4 h-4" />
                                  <span>目标模块：{suggestion.targetModule}</span>
                                </div>
                                {suggestion.handler && (
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground">
                                    <User className="w-4 h-4" />
                                    <span>负责人：{suggestion.handler}</span>
                                  </div>
                                )}
                                {suggestion.progress !== undefined && suggestion.status === 'in_progress' && (
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-1 max-w-xs">
                                    <Progress value={suggestion.progress} className="h-2 flex-1" />
                                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{suggestion.progress}%</span>
                                  </div>
                                )}
                                {suggestion.impact && (
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-green-600">
                                    <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                                    <span>{suggestion.impact}</span>
                                  </div>
                                )}
                              </div>

                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-border/50">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                                  <Button
                                    variant="ghost"
                                    size="sm"
                                    className="text-muted-foreground"
                                  >
                                    <ThumbsUp className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                                    {suggestion.likes}
                                  </Button>
                                  <Button
                                    variant="ghost"
                                    size="sm"
                                    className="text-muted-foreground"
                                    onClick={() => setSelectedSuggestion(suggestion)}
                                  >
                                    <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                                    {suggestion.comments.length} 评论
                                  </Button>
                                </div>
                                <Button
                                  variant="outline"
                                  size="sm"
                                  onClick={() => setSelectedSuggestion(suggestion)}
                                >
                                  查看详情
                                  <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-1" />
                                </Button>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </CardContent>
                      </Card>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </section>

      {/* 建议详情对话框 */}
      <Dialog
        open={!!selectedSuggestion}
        onOpenChange={() => setSelectedSuggestion(null)}
      >
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto">
          {selectedSuggestion && (
            <>
              <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle>{selectedSuggestion.title}</DialogTitle>
                <DialogDescription>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
                    <img
                      src={selectedSuggestion.expertAvatar}
                      alt={selectedSuggestion.expertName}
                      className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full"
                    />
                    <span>{selectedSuggestion.expertName}</span>
                    <span>·</span>
                    <span>{selectedSuggestion.expertType}</span>
                  </div>
                </DialogDescription>
              </DialogHeader>
              <div className="space-y-4 py-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Badge className={categoryConfig[selectedSuggestion.category].color}>
                    {categoryConfig[selectedSuggestion.category].label}
                  </Badge>
                  <Badge className={priorityConfig[selectedSuggestion.priority].color}>
                    {priorityConfig[selectedSuggestion.priority].label}
                  </Badge>
                  <Badge className={statusConfig[selectedSuggestion.status].color}>
                    {statusConfig[selectedSuggestion.status].label}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h4 className="text-sm font-medium mb-2">建议描述</h4>
                  <p className="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                    {selectedSuggestion.description}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h4 className="text-sm font-medium mb-2">目标模块</h4>
                  <p className="text-muted-foreground">{selectedSuggestion.targetModule}</p>
                </div>
                {selectedSuggestion.handler && (
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-medium mb-2">负责人</h4>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">{selectedSuggestion.handler}</p>
                  </div>
                )}
                {selectedSuggestion.progress !== undefined && (
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-medium mb-2">完成进度</h4>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Progress value={selectedSuggestion.progress} className="h-2 flex-1 max-w-xs" />
                      <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{selectedSuggestion.progress}%</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
                {selectedSuggestion.impact && (
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-medium mb-2">预期影响</h4>
                    <p className="text-green-600">{selectedSuggestion.impact}</p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* 评论区域 */}
                <div className="border-t border-border pt-4">
                  <h4 className="text-sm font-medium mb-4">
                    评论 ({selectedSuggestion.comments.length})
                  </h4>
                  <div className="space-y-3 mb-4">
                    {selectedSuggestion.comments.map((comment) => (
                      <div key={comment.id} className="flex items-start gap-3 p-3 bg-muted rounded-lg">
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                          <User className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                            <span className="font-medium text-sm">{comment.author}</span>
                            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{comment.createdAt}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{comment.content}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Input
                      placeholder="添加评论..."
                      value={newComment}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                      onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleAddComment()}
                    />
                    <Button onClick={handleAddComment}>
                      <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                      发送
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
};

export default OptimizationCenterPage;

                      </Badge>

                        {statusConfig[suggestion.status].label}
                      </Badge>
                      <Badge variant="outline" className={priorityConfig[suggestion.priority].color}>
                        {priorityConfig[suggestion.priority].label}

                      <p className="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                        {suggestion.description}

                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2">目标模块</h4>
                      <p className="text-muted-foreground">{suggestion.targetModule}</p>
                    </div>
                    {suggestion.impact && (
                      <div className="p-3 bg-green-50 rounded-lg border border-green-100">
                        <h4 className="font-semibold text-green-700 mb-1">预期效果</h4>
                        <p className="text-green-600">{suggestion.impact}</p>
                      </div>
                    )}

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        <span>提交时间：{suggestion.createdAt}</span>
                        <span>更新时间：{suggestion.updatedAt}</span>
                      </div>

                          评论 ({suggestion.comments})
                        </Button>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
                          <ThumbsUp className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                          点赞 ({suggestion.likes})
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

              </Dialog>

            .filter((s) => s.status === 'adopted')
            .map((suggestion) => {
              const CategoryIcon = categoryConfig[suggestion.category].icon;
              const StatusIcon = statusConfig[suggestion.status].icon;
              return (
                <Card key={suggestion.id} className="border-green-200">
                  <CardContent className="p-5">
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                      <img
                        src={suggestion.expertAvatar}
                        alt={suggestion.expertName}
                        className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover flex-shrink-0"
                      />
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                          <h3 className="font-semibold text-foreground text-lg">
                            {suggestion.title}
                          </h3>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
                            <Badge className={categoryConfig[suggestion.category].color}>
                              <CategoryIcon className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                              {categoryConfig[suggestion.category].label}
                            </Badge>
                            <Badge className={statusConfig[suggestion.status].color}>
                              <StatusIcon className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                              {statusConfig[suggestion.status].label}
                            </Badge>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-2 line-clamp-2">
                          {suggestion.description}
                        </p>
                        {suggestion.impact && (
                          <div className="mt-3 p-2 bg-green-50 rounded-lg border border-green-100">
                            <p className="text-sm text-green-700 flex items-center gap-2">
                              <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                              预期效果：{suggestion.impact}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              );
            })}
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="in_progress" className="m-0 space-y-4">
          {filteredSuggestions
            .filter((s) => s.status === 'in_progress')
            .map((suggestion) => (
              <Card key={suggestion.id} className="border-blue-200">
                <CardContent className="p-5">
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                    <img
                      src={suggestion.expertAvatar}
                      alt={suggestion.expertName}
                      className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover flex-shrink-0"
                    />
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <h3 className="font-semibold text-foreground text-lg">
                          {suggestion.title}
                        </h3>
                        <Badge className={statusConfig[suggestion.status].color}>
                          <Clock className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                          {statusConfig[suggestion.status].label}

                      <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-2 line-clamp-2">
                        {suggestion.description}

                      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div className="flex-1 h-2 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                          <div className="h-full w-1/2 bg-blue-500 rounded-full" />
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">50%</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                </CardContent>
              </Card>

        <TabsContent value="pending" className="m-0 space-y-4">
          {filteredSuggestions
            .filter((s) => s.status === 'pending')
            .map((suggestion) => (
              <Card key={suggestion.id} className="border-gray-200">
                <CardContent className="p-5">
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                    <img
                      src={suggestion.expertAvatar}

                      className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover flex-shrink-0"

                      </p>

                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <Button size="sm">
                          查看详情
                          <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-1" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            ))}
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </section>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
  CardDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Clock, CheckCircle2, FileText, Upload, X, Paperclip, Loader2, PlusCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { Image } from '@/components/ui/image';
import { EMPTY_STATE_ILLUSTRATIONS } from '@/utils/img-resources/illustrations';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { awardPoints } from '@/api/gamification';
import { logger } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/logger';
import { getDataloom } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/dataloom';
import { getDefaultBucketId } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/tools/storage';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { axiosForBackend } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/utils/getAxiosForBackend';
import type { IPracticePlan, IPracticeAttachment } from '@/api/practice';
import dayjs from 'dayjs';
import { UniversalLink } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/components/UniversalLink';

const REVIEW_PERIOD_OPTIONS: Record<string, string> = {
  '1m': '1个月',
  '3m': '3个月',
  '6m': '6个月',
};

const ANIM_VARIANTS = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 16 },
  visible: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
};

function formatPeriod(period: string | null): string {
  if (!period) return '—';
  return REVIEW_PERIOD_OPTIONS[period] ?? period;
}

const GrowthTimelineSection: React.FC<{
  plans: IPracticePlan[];
  dueIds: Set<string>;
  onReview: (id: string, data: {
    growthReflection: string;
    businessValue: string;
    attachments?: IPracticeAttachment[];
  }) => Promise<void>;
}> = ({ plans, dueIds, onReview }) => {
  const [reviewingId, setReviewingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [growthReflection, setGrowthReflection] = useState('');
  const [businessValue, setBusinessValue] = useState('');
  const [showAddDialog, setShowAddDialog] = useState(false);
  const [newAchievement, setNewAchievement] = useState('');
  const [newValue, setNewValue] = useState('');
  const [uploadingFiles, setUploadingFiles] = useState<IPracticeAttachment[]>([]);
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const reviewedPlans = plans.filter(
    (p: IPracticePlan) => p.status === 'completed' || p.reviewed
  );
  const duePlans = plans.filter(
    (p: IPracticePlan) => dueIds.has(p.id) && !p.reviewed
  );

  const handleFileUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files || files.length === 0) return;

    setIsUploading(true);
    try {
      const dataloom = await getDataloom();
      const bucketId = getDefaultBucketId();

      for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
        const file = files[i];
        const { data, error } = await dataloom.storage.from(bucketId).uploadFile(file);
        if (error || !data) {
          toast.error(`${file.name} 上传失败`);
          continue;
        }
        setUploadingFiles(prev => [...prev, {
          fileName: file.name,
          downloadUrl: data.download_url,
          uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        }]);
      }
      toast.success('文件上传成功');
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('文件上传失败', String(err));
      toast.error('文件上传失败');
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveFile = (index: number) => {
    setUploadingFiles(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const handleReviewSubmit = async () => {
    if (!reviewingId) return;
    if (!growthReflection.trim() || !businessValue.trim()) {
      toast.error('请填写完整的成果内容');
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await onReview(reviewingId, {
        growthReflection: growthReflection.trim(),
        businessValue: businessValue.trim(),
        attachments: uploadingFiles.length > 0 ? uploadingFiles : undefined,
      });
      setReviewingId(null);
      setGrowthReflection('');
      setBusinessValue('');
      setUploadingFiles([]);
      toast.success('🎉 完成复盘获得30积分！');
      awardPoints('review_complete', 30, '完成复盘');
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('提交成果失败', err);
      toast.error('提交失败，请重试');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const startReview = (planId: string) => {
    setReviewingId(planId);
    setGrowthReflection('');
    setBusinessValue('');
    setUploadingFiles([]);
  };

  const handleAddSubmit = async () => {
    if (!newAchievement.trim() || !newValue.trim()) {
      toast.error('请填写完整的成果内容');
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await axiosForBackend({
        url: '/api/practice/results',
        method: 'POST',
        data: { growthReflection: newAchievement.trim(), businessValue: newValue.trim() },
      });
      setShowAddDialog(false);
      setNewAchievement('');
      setNewValue('');
      toast.success('🎉 提交实战成果获得35积分！');
      awardPoints('result_submit', 35, '提交实战成果');
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('提交成果失败', String(err));
      toast.error('提交失败，请重试');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const allItems = [...duePlans, ...reviewedPlans].sort(
    (a: IPracticePlan, b: IPracticePlan) =>
      dayjs(b.updatedAt).unix() - dayjs(a.updatedAt).unix()
  );

  return (
    <motion.div variants={ANIM_VARIANTS} initial="hidden" animate="visible">
      <Card className="border-border/50">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
              <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <CardTitle>实战成果</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>记录实战成果与业务价值</CardDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {allItems.length === 0 && (
            <div className="py-6 text-center space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-center">
                <Image src={EMPTY_STATE_ILLUSTRATIONS.seedling} width={120} height={120} alt="暂无实战成果" className="object-contain" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">暂无实战成果</p>
              <div className="max-w-md mx-auto text-left space-y-2 p-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/30 border border-border/30">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-2">实战成果参考样例：</p>
                <div className="flex gap-2 items-start">
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs shrink-0">成果</Badge>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70">完成Q3车位去化目标，去化率从45%提升至78%</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2 items-start">
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs shrink-0">价值</Badge>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70">优化跨部门协作流程，项目交付周期缩短15天</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2 items-start">
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs shrink-0">成果</Badge>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70">建立团队周例会制度，信息同步效率提升40%</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2 items-start">
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs shrink-0">价值</Badge>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70">形成3项标准化管理制度并推广至华东区域</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <Button className="gap-2" onClick={() => setShowAddDialog(true)}>
                <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                新增实战成果
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="relative space-y-0">
            {allItems.map((plan: IPracticePlan, idx: number) => {
              const isDue = dueIds.has(plan.id) && !plan.reviewed;
              const isLast = idx === allItems.length - 1;
              const planAttachments = plan.attachments || [];
              return (
                <div key={plan.id} className="flex gap-4 pb-6">
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
                    <div
                      className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-full mt-1.5 shrink-0 ${
                        isDue ? 'bg-destructive' : 'bg-primary'
                      }`}
                    />
                    {!isLast && (
                      <div className="w-px flex-1 bg-border mt-1" />
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 -mt-0.5">
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {dayjs(plan.updatedAt).format('YYYY-MM-DD')}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium mt-1">
                      {plan.sceneName ?? '自主学习'}
                    </p>
                    <div className="flex gap-2 mt-1">
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                        {formatPeriod(plan.reviewPeriod)}
                      </Badge>
                      {plan.reviewed && (
                        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                          已完成
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {plan.growthReflection && (
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-2">
                        成果说明：{plan.growthReflection}
                      </p>
                    )}
                    {plan.businessValue && (
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                        业务价值：{plan.businessValue}
                      </p>
                    )}
                    {planAttachments.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="mt-2 space-y-1">
                        {planAttachments.map((att: IPracticeAttachment, i: number) => (
                          <UniversalLink
                            key={i}
                            to={att.downloadUrl}
                            target="_blank"
                            rel="noopener noreferrer"
                            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-primary hover:underline"
                          >
                            <Paperclip className="w-3 h-3" />
                            {att.fileName}
                          </UniversalLink>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {isDue && reviewingId !== plan.id && (
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        variant="outline"
                        className="mt-3"
                        onClick={() => startReview(plan.id)}
                      >
                        <FileText className="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5" />
                        记录成果
                      </Button>
                    )}
                    {reviewingId === plan.id && (
                      <motion.div
                        variants={ANIM_VARIANTS}
                        initial="hidden"
                        animate="visible"
                        className="mt-3 space-y-3 p-3 rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-muted/30"
                      >
                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          <label className="text-sm font-medium">
                            成果说明
                          </label>
                          <Textarea
                            placeholder="取得了哪些成果？"
                            value={growthReflection}
                            onChange={(
                              e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>
                            ) => setGrowthReflection(e.target.value)}
                            className="min-h-[64px] resize-none"
                          />
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/50 italic mt-1">
                            例：完成Q3车位去化目标，去化率从45%提升至78%；建立团队周例会制度，信息同步效率提升40%
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          <label className="text-sm font-medium">
                            业务价值
                          </label>
                          <Textarea
                            placeholder="带来了哪些业务上的改善？"
                            value={businessValue}
                            onChange={(
                              e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>
                            ) => setBusinessValue(e.target.value)}
                            className="min-h-[64px] resize-none"
                          />
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/50 italic mt-1">
                            例：优化跨部门协作流程，项目交付周期缩短15天；形成3项标准化管理制度并推广至华东区域
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          <label className="text-sm font-medium">
                            成果材料
                          </label>
                          <input
                            ref={fileInputRef}
                            type="file"
                            multiple
                            onChange={handleFileUpload}
                            className="hidden"
                          />
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <Button
                              type="button"
                              variant="outline"
                              size="sm"
                              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                              disabled={isUploading}
                            >
                              {isUploading ? (
                                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5 animate-spin" />
                              ) : (
                                <Upload className="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5" />
                              )}
                              {isUploading ? '上传中...' : '上传附件'}
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                          {uploadingFiles.length > 0 && (
                            <div className="space-y-1.5 mt-2">
                              {uploadingFiles.map((file, i) => (
                                <div
                                  key={i}
                                  className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-md bg-background border border-border/50"
                                >
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                                    <Paperclip className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                                    <span className="text-xs truncate">{file.fileName}</span>
                                  </div>
                                  <Button
                                    type="button"
                                    variant="ghost"
                                    size="sm"
                                    className="h-6 w-6 p-0 shrink-0"
                                    onClick={() => handleRemoveFile(i)}
                                  >
                                    <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                                  </Button>
                                </div>
                              ))}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex gap-2 justify-end">
                          <Button
                            variant="outline"
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setReviewingId(null);
                              setUploadingFiles([]);
                            }}
                          >
                            取消
                          </Button>
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={handleReviewSubmit}
                            disabled={submitting}
                          >
                            提交成果
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </motion.div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
      <Dialog open={showAddDialog} onOpenChange={setShowAddDialog}>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>新增实战成果</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>记录您在实战中取得的成果与业务价值</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-sm font-medium">成果说明</label>
              <Textarea
                placeholder="请描述您取得的实战成果..."
                value={newAchievement}
                onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => setNewAchievement(e.target.value)}
                className="min-h-[80px] resize-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-sm font-medium">业务价值</label>
              <Textarea
                placeholder="请描述该成果带来的业务价值..."
                value={newValue}
                onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => setNewValue(e.target.value)}
                className="min-h-[80px] resize-none"
              />

            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowAddDialog(false);
                  setNewAchievement('');
                  setNewValue('');
                }}
              >
                取消
              </Button>
              <Button onClick={handleAddSubmit} disabled={submitting}>
                {submitting && <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5 animate-spin" />}
                提交
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </motion.div>);
};

export default GrowthTimelineSection;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
  CardDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { FileText, Plus, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { Image } from '@/components/ui/image';
import { EMPTY_STATE_ILLUSTRATIONS } from '@/utils/img-resources/illustrations';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { logger } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/logger';
import type { IPracticePlan } from '@/api/practice';

const ANIM_VARIANTS = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 16 },
  visible: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
};

const LearningSection: React.FC<{
  plan: IPracticePlan | null;
  onNoPlanCreate: () => void;
  onUpdate: (id: string, data: Record<string, string>) => Promise<void>;
}> = ({ plan, onNoPlanCreate, onUpdate }) => {
  const [learnings, setLearnings] = useState(plan?.learnings ?? '');
  const [inspirations, setInspirations] = useState(plan?.inspirations ?? '');
  const [applicationPoints, setApplicationPoints] = useState(
    plan?.applicationPoints ?? ''
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    setLearnings(plan?.learnings ?? '');
    setInspirations(plan?.inspirations ?? '');
    setApplicationPoints(plan?.applicationPoints ?? '');
  }, [plan]);

  const handleBlur = useCallback(
    async (field: string, value: string) => {
      if (!plan) return;
      const trimmed = value.trim();
      const current =
        field === 'learnings'
          ? plan.learnings
          : field === 'inspirations'
            ? plan.inspirations
            : plan.applicationPoints;
      if (current === trimmed) return;
      try {
        await onUpdate(plan.id, { [field]: trimmed });
      } catch (err) {
        logger.error('自动保存失败', err);
        toast.error('保存失败');
      }
    },
    [plan, onUpdate]
  );

  if (!plan) {
    return (
      <Card className="border-border/50">
        <CardContent className="py-12 flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
          <Image src={EMPTY_STATE_ILLUSTRATIONS.bookWithLamp} width={110} height={110} alt="暂无学习记录" className="object-contain" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
            还没有学习记录，开始记录你的收获吧
          </p>
          <Button onClick={onNoPlanCreate}>
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5" />
            开始记录
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  return (
    <motion.div variants={ANIM_VARIANTS} initial="hidden" animate="visible">
      <Card className="border-border/50">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
              <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <CardTitle>学习收获</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>记录陪练中的学习心得与启发</CardDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">学习收获</label>
            <Textarea
              placeholder="这次陪练我学到了..."
              value={learnings}
              onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) =>
                setLearnings(e.target.value)
              }
              onBlur={() => handleBlur('learnings', learnings)}
              className="min-h-[72px] resize-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">启发思考</label>
            <Textarea
              placeholder="这次陪练让我思考..."
              value={inspirations}
              onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) =>
                setInspirations(e.target.value)
              }
              onBlur={() => handleBlur('inspirations', inspirations)}
              className="min-h-[72px] resize-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">应用点</label>
            <Textarea
              placeholder="我打算在工作中这样应用..."
              value={applicationPoints}
              onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) =>
                setApplicationPoints(e.target.value)
              }
              onBlur={() => handleBlur('applicationPoints', applicationPoints)}
              className="min-h-[72px] resize-none"
            />
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

export default LearningSection;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
  CardDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Target, Plus, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { Image } from '@/components/ui/image';
import { EMPTY_STATE_ILLUSTRATIONS } from '@/utils/img-resources/illustrations';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { logger } from '@lark-apaas/client-toolkit/logger';
import type { IPracticePlan } from '@/api/practice';
import dayjs from 'dayjs';

const REVIEW_PERIOD_OPTIONS: Record<string, string> = {
  '1m': '1个月',
  '3m': '3个月',
  '6m': '6个月',
};

const STATUS_MAP: Record<
  string,
  { label: string; variant: 'default' | 'secondary' | 'outline' }
> = {
  active: { label: '进行中', variant: 'default' },
  completed: { label: '已完成', variant: 'secondary' },
};

const ANIM_VARIANTS = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 16 },
  visible: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
};

function formatPeriod(period: string | null): string {
  if (!period) return '—';
  return REVIEW_PERIOD_OPTIONS[period] ?? period;
}

const PlanListSection: React.FC<{
  plans: IPracticePlan[];
  dueIds: Set<string>;
  onCreate: (data: {
    applicationPoints: string;
    reviewPeriod: string;
  }) => Promise<void>;
  pointsHint?: string;
}> = ({ plans, dueIds, onCreate, pointsHint }) => {
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [applicationPoints, setApplicationPoints] = useState('');
  const [reviewPeriod, setReviewPeriod] = useState('1m');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!applicationPoints.trim()) {
      toast.error('请填写行动项');
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await onCreate({
        applicationPoints: applicationPoints.trim(),
        reviewPeriod,
      });
      setApplicationPoints('');
      setReviewPeriod('1m');
      setShowForm(false);
      toast.success('计划创建成功');
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('创建计划失败', err);
      toast.error('创建失败，请重试');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const activePlans = plans.filter(
    (p: IPracticePlan) => p.status === 'active'
  );

  return (
    <motion.div variants={ANIM_VARIANTS} initial="hidden" animate="visible">
      <Card className="border-border/50">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
                <Target className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <CardTitle>实战计划</CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>追踪你的行动计划进展</CardDescription>
                {pointsHint && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-amber-600 font-medium mt-1">{pointsHint}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setShowForm(!showForm)}>
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5" />
              创建新计划
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          {showForm && (
            <motion.div
              variants={ANIM_VARIANTS}
              initial="hidden"
              animate="visible"
              className="space-y-4 p-4 rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-muted/30"
            >
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-sm font-medium">行动项</label>
                <Textarea
                  placeholder="描述你的行动计划..."
                  value={applicationPoints}
                  onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) =>
                    setApplicationPoints(e.target.value)
                  }
                  className="min-h-[72px] resize-none"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-sm font-medium">回顾周期</label>
                <Select value={reviewPeriod} onValueChange={setReviewPeriod}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    <SelectItem value="1m">1个月</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="3m">3个月</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="6m">6个月</SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2 justify-end">
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setShowForm(false)}>
                  取消
                </Button>
                <Button onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={submitting}>
                  创建
                </Button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}

          {activePlans.length === 0 && !showForm && (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center py-6">
              <Image src={EMPTY_STATE_ILLUSTRATIONS.notebook} width={100} height={100} alt="暂无计划" className="mb-3 object-contain" />
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center">
                暂无进行中的计划，点击上方按钮创建
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="space-y-3">
            {activePlans.map((plan: IPracticePlan) => (
              <motion.div
                key={plan.id}
                variants={ANIM_VARIANTS}
                initial="hidden"
                animate="visible"
                className="flex items-start gap-4 p-4 rounded-lg border border-border/50 hover:bg-muted/20 transition-colors"
              >
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                    {plan.sceneId ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="text-sm font-medium text-primary hover:underline"
                        onClick={() =>
                          navigate(`/coaching?scene=${plan.sceneId}`)
                        }
                      >
                        {plan.sceneName ?? '场景'}
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                        {plan.sceneName ?? '自主学习'}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                      {formatPeriod(plan.reviewPeriod)}
                    </Badge>
                    <Badge
                      variant={STATUS_MAP[plan.status]?.variant ?? 'outline'}
                    >
                      {STATUS_MAP[plan.status]?.label ?? plan.status}
                    </Badge>
                    {dueIds.has(plan.id) && (
                      <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-xs">
                        待回顾
                      </Badge>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                    创建于 {dayjs(plan.createdAt).format('YYYY-MM-DD')}
                  </p>
                  {plan.applicationPoints && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-2 line-clamp-2">
                      {plan.applicationPoints}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/practice/${plan.id}`)}
                >
                  查看详情
                  <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-1" />
                </Button>
              </motion.div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

export default PlanListSection;

import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { awardPoints } from '@/api/gamification';
