===FILE:./server/common/constants/api_response_code.ts===
import { HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';

// 业务状态码与HTTP状态码的映射
export enum ResponseCode {
  // 成功状态
  SUCCESS = 'SUCCESS',
  CREATED = 'CREATED',
  ACCEPTED = 'ACCEPTED',
  NO_CONTENT = 'NO_CONTENT',

  // 客户端错误
  BAD_REQUEST = 'BAD_REQUEST',
  UNAUTHORIZED = 'UNAUTHORIZED',
  FORBIDDEN = 'FORBIDDEN',
  NOT_FOUND = 'NOT_FOUND',
  VALIDATION_ERROR = 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
  CONFLICT = 'CONFLICT',
  TOO_MANY_REQUESTS = 'TOO_MANY_REQUESTS',

  // 服务端错误
  INTERNAL_ERROR = 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
  BAD_GATEWAY = 'BAD_GATEWAY',
  SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE = 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE',

  // 业务错误
  BUSINESS_ERROR = 'BUSINESS_ERROR',
}

// 状态码映射配置
export const RESPONSE_CODE_TO_HTTP_STATUS_MAP: Record<ResponseCode, number> = {
  [ResponseCode.SUCCESS]: HttpStatus.OK,
  [ResponseCode.CREATED]: HttpStatus.CREATED,
  [ResponseCode.ACCEPTED]: HttpStatus.ACCEPTED,
  [ResponseCode.NO_CONTENT]: HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT,

  [ResponseCode.BAD_REQUEST]: HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
  [ResponseCode.UNAUTHORIZED]: HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
  [ResponseCode.FORBIDDEN]: HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
  [ResponseCode.NOT_FOUND]: HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
  [ResponseCode.VALIDATION_ERROR]: HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
  [ResponseCode.CONFLICT]: HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
  [ResponseCode.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS]: HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,

  [ResponseCode.INTERNAL_ERROR]: HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
  [ResponseCode.BAD_GATEWAY]: HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY,
  [ResponseCode.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE]: HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,

  [ResponseCode.BUSINESS_ERROR]: HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, // 通用业务错误状态码
};

// 自动生成的HTTP状态码映射
export const HTTP_STATUS_TO_RESPONSE_CODE_MAP: Record<number, ResponseCode> = Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(RESPONSE_CODE_TO_HTTP_STATUS_MAP).map(([code, status]) => [status, code as ResponseCode]),
) as Record<number, ResponseCode>;

===FILE:./server/common/filters/exception.filter.ts===
import { ExceptionFilter, Catch, ArgumentsHost, HttpException, HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Response } from 'express';
import { BusinessException } from '../interfaces/exception.interface';
import { HTTP_STATUS_TO_RESPONSE_CODE_MAP, ResponseCode } from '../constants/api_response_code';
import { ApiErrorResponse } from '../interfaces/api_response.interface';

// 全局异常过滤器，用于捕获所有未处理的异常
@Catch()
export class GlobalExceptionFilter implements ExceptionFilter {
  catch(exception: unknown, host: ArgumentsHost) {
    const ctx = host.switchToHttp();
    const response = ctx.getResponse<Response>();
     
    // 如果响应头已发送，则不处理
    if (response.headersSent) {
      return;
    }

    let errorResponse: Omit<ApiErrorResponse, 'httpStatus'>;
    let httpStatus: HttpStatus;

    if (exception instanceof BusinessException) {
      // 业务异常
      httpStatus = exception.httpStatus;
      errorResponse = {
        error: {
          code: exception.code,
          message: exception.message,
          details: exception.details,
          fieldErrors: exception.fieldErrors,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        },
      };
    } else if (exception instanceof HttpException) {
      // HTTP异常
      httpStatus = exception.getStatus() as HttpStatus;
      const exceptionResponse = exception.getResponse();

      errorResponse = {
        error: {
          code: HTTP_STATUS_TO_RESPONSE_CODE_MAP[httpStatus],
          message: typeof exceptionResponse === 'string' ? exceptionResponse : exception.message,
          details: typeof exceptionResponse === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(exceptionResponse) : undefined,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        },
      };
    } else if (
      typeof exception === 'object' &&
      exception !== null &&
      (exception as { code?: unknown }).code === '22P02'
    ) {
      // Postgres invalid_text_representation：路径/查询参数与列类型不匹配（最常见是非法 UUID）
      // 与「合法 UUID 但记录不存在」走同一条 not-found 语义，避免 500 噪声
      httpStatus = HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND;
      errorResponse = {
        error: {
          code: ResponseCode.NOT_FOUND,
          message: '资源不存在',
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        },
      };
    } else {
      // 未知异常
      httpStatus = HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR;
      const isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';
      errorResponse = {
        error: {
          code: ResponseCode.INTERNAL_ERROR,
          message: '服务器内部错误',
          ...(isDev ? {
            stack: (exception as Error).stack,
            cause: (exception as Error).cause as string,
          } : {}),
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        },
      };
    }

    response.status(httpStatus).json(errorResponse);
  }
}

===FILE:./server/common/interfaces/api_response.interface.ts===
// 错误统一响应
export interface ApiErrorResponse {
  /** 错误详情 */
  error: {
    /** 错误代码 */
    code: string;
    /** 错误消息 */
    message: string;
    /** 错误详情 */
    details?: string;
    /** 字段验证错误 */
    fieldErrors?: Record<string, string[]>;
    /** 调用栈（仅开发环境） */
    stack?: string;
    /** 错误原因 */
    cause?: string;
    /** 错误发生时间 */
    timestamp?: number;
  };
}


===FILE:./server/common/interfaces/exception.interface.ts===
// 业务异常类
import { HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';
import { RESPONSE_CODE_TO_HTTP_STATUS_MAP, ResponseCode } from '../constants/api_response_code';

export class BusinessException extends Error {
  constructor(
    public readonly code: ResponseCode,
    public readonly message: string,
    public readonly httpStatus: HttpStatus = HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
    public readonly details?: string,
    public readonly fieldErrors?: Record<string, string[]>,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'BusinessException';
  }
  getHttpStatus(): HttpStatus {
    return RESPONSE_CODE_TO_HTTP_STATUS_MAP[this.code];
  }
}

  toDriver(value: string) {
    return sql`ROW(${value})::user_profile`;
  },
  fromDriver(value: string) {
    const [userId] = value.slice(1, -1).split(',');
    return userId.trim();
  },
});

export type FileAttachment = {
  bucket_id: string;
  file_path: string;
};

export const fileAttachment = customType<{
  data: FileAttachment;
  driverData: string;
}>({
  dataType() {
    return 'file_attachment';
  },
  toDriver(value: FileAttachment) {
    return sql`ROW(${value.bucket_id},${value.file_path})::file_attachment`;
  },
  fromDriver(value: string): FileAttachment {
    const [bucketId, filePath] = value.slice(1, -1).split(',');
    return { bucket_id: bucketId.trim(), file_path: filePath.trim() };
  },
});

/** Escape single quotes in SQL string literals */
function escapeLiteral(str: string): string {
  return `'${str.replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
}

export const userProfileArray = customType<{
  data: string[];
  driverData: string;
}>({
  dataType() {
    return 'user_profile[]';
  },
  toDriver(value: string[]) {
    if (!value || value.length === 0) {
      return sql`'{}'::user_profile[]`;
    }
    const elements = value.map(id => `ROW(${escapeLiteral(id)})::user_profile`).join(',');
    return sql.raw(`ARRAY[${elements}]::user_profile[]`);
  },
  fromDriver(value: string): string[] {
    if (!value || value === '{}') return [];
    const inner = value.slice(1, -1);
    const matches = inner.match(/\([^)]*\)/g) || [];
    return matches.map(m => m.slice(1, -1).split(',')[0].trim());
  },
});

export const fileAttachmentArray = customType<{
  data: FileAttachment[];
  driverData: string;
}>({
  dataType() {
    return 'file_attachment[]';
  },
  toDriver(value: FileAttachment[]) {
    if (!value || value.length === 0) {
      return sql`'{}'::file_attachment[]`;
    }
    const elements = value.map(f =>
      `ROW(${escapeLiteral(f.bucket_id)},${escapeLiteral(f.file_path)})::file_attachment`
    ).join(',');
    return sql.raw(`ARRAY[${elements}]::file_attachment[]`);
  },
  fromDriver(value: string): FileAttachment[] {
    if (!value || value === '{}') return [];
    const inner = value.slice(1, -1);
    const matches = inner.match(/\([^)]*\)/g) || [];
    return matches.map(m => {
      const [bucketId, filePath] = m.slice(1, -1).split(',');
      return { bucket_id: bucketId.trim(), file_path: filePath.trim() };
    });
  },
});

export const customTimestamptz = customType<{
  data: Date;
  driverData: string;
  config: { precision?: number};
}>({
  dataType(config) {
    const precision = typeof config?.precision !== 'undefined'
      ? ` (${config.precision})`
      : '';
    return `timestamptz${precision}`;
  },
  toDriver(value: Date | string | number){
    if(value == null) return value as any;
    if (typeof value === 'number') {
      return new Date(value).toISOString();
    }
    if(typeof value === 'string') {
      return value;
    }
    if (value instanceof Date) {
      return value.toISOString();
    }
    throw new Error('Invalid timestamp value');
  },
  fromDriver(value: string | Date): Date {
    if(value instanceof Date) return value;
    return new Date(value);
  },
});

===FILE:./server/main.ts===
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { configureApp } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { join } from 'path';
import { __express as hbsExpressEngine } from 'hbs';

import type { NestExpressApplication } from '@nestjs/platform-express';
import { AppModule } from './app.module';

async function bootstrap() {
  const app = await NestFactory.create<NestExpressApplication>(AppModule, {
    abortOnError: process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'development',
  });
  await configureApp(app, { 
    disableSwagger: true,
  });
  const logger = new Logger('Bootstrap');
  const host = process.env.SERVER_HOST || 'localhost';
  const port = Number(process.env.SERVER_PORT || '3000');

  // 注册视图引擎, 渲染 client 目录下的 html 文件
  app.setBaseViewsDir(join(process.cwd(), 'dist/client'));
  app.setViewEngine('html');
  app.engine('html', hbsExpressEngine);

  await app.listen(port, host);
  logger.log(`Server running on ${host}:${port}`);
  logger.log(`API endpoints ready at http://${host}:${port}/api`);
}

bootstrap();

===FILE:./server/modules/admin/admin.controller.ts===
import { Controller, Post, Body, Req, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NeedLogin } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';

const ADMIN_PASSWORD = process.env.MDP_ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'mdp-admin-2024';

@Controller('api/admin')
export class AdminController {
  @NeedLogin()
  @Post('verify')
  async verifyAdmin(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Body() body: { password: string },
  ) {
    if (!body.password || body.password !== ADMIN_PASSWORD) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException('管理员密码错误');
    }

    const { userId, userName } = (req as any).userContext;
    return {
      isAdmin: true,
      userId,
      adminName: userName || '管理员',
    };
  }
}

===FILE:./server/modules/admin/security-check.automation.ts===
import { Injectable, Inject, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Automation, BindTrigger, CapabilityService } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

interface ICheckResult {
  name: string;
  status: 'pass' | 'warn' | 'risk';
  issues: string[];
}

function resolveProjectRoot(): string {
  const distRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');
  if (fs.existsSync(path.join(distRoot, 'server', 'modules'))) return distRoot;
  return path.resolve(__dirname, '../..');
}

@Automation()
@Injectable()
export class SecurityCheckAutomationService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SecurityCheckAutomationService.name);
  private readonly projectRoot: string;

  constructor(
    @Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase,
    @Inject() private readonly capabilityService: CapabilityService,
  ) {
    this.projectRoot = resolveProjectRoot();
  }

  @BindTrigger('mdp_weekly_security_check')
  async runWeeklySecurityCheck() {
    this.logger.log('=== 开始每周系统安全性检查 ===');

    const results: ICheckResult[] = [];

    results.push(this.checkApiAuthCoverage());
    results.push(this.checkFrontendSecurity());
    results.push(this.checkAdminConfig());
    results.push(this.checkCodeSecurityPatterns());
    results.push(this.checkPlatformFileIntegrity());

    const report = this.buildReport(results);
    this.logger.log(report);

    await this.sendReport(report);

    const riskCount = results.filter((r: ICheckResult) => r.status === 'risk').length;
    const warnCount = results.filter((r: ICheckResult) => r.status === 'warn').length;
    this.logger.log(`=== 检查完成: ${riskCount}个风险, ${warnCount}个警告 ===`);
  }

  private checkApiAuthCoverage(): ICheckResult {
    const issues: string[] = [];
    const modulesDir = path.join(this.projectRoot, 'server', 'modules');

    if (!fs.existsSync(modulesDir)) {
      return { name: 'API鉴权覆盖', status: 'warn', issues: ['无法访问modules目录'] };
    }

    const controllerFiles = this.findFiles(modulesDir, /\.controller\.ts$/);
    const PUBLIC_READ_ROUTES = ['api/courses', 'view'];

    for (const file of controllerFiles) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf-8');
      const controllerMatch = content.match(/@Controller\(['"]([^'"]+)['"]\)/);
      if (!controllerMatch) continue;

      const routePrefix = controllerMatch[1];
      const isPublicRead = PUBLIC_READ_ROUTES.some((r: string) => routePrefix.includes(r));
      const hasClassLevelAuth = /@NeedLogin\(\)\s*\nexport class/.test(content) ||
        /@NeedLogin\(\)\s*\n@(?:Controller)/.test(content);

      if (hasClassLevelAuth) continue;

      const writeDecorators = ['Post', 'Put', 'Patch', 'Delete'];
      const methodPattern = new RegExp(
        `(@NeedLogin\\(\\)\\s*\\n\\s*)?@(${writeDecorators.join('|')})\\(`,
        'g',
      );

      let match: RegExpExecArray | null;
      while ((match = methodPattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
        const hasAuth = match[1] !== undefined;
        const decorator = match[2];

        if (!hasAuth && !isPublicRead) {
          const afterSnippet = content.substring(match.index + match[0].length, match.index + match[0].length + 60);
          const routeMatch = afterSnippet.match(/['"]([^'"]*)['"]/);
          const route = routeMatch ? routeMatch[1] : '?';
          issues.push(`${decorator} /${routePrefix}/${route} 缺少 @NeedLogin()`);
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      name: 'API鉴权覆盖',
      status: issues.length === 0 ? 'pass' : 'risk',
      issues: issues.length === 0 ? ['所有写操作端点均已添加鉴权'] : issues,
    };
  }

  private checkFrontendSecurity(): ICheckResult {
    const issues: string[] = [];
    const sanitizePath = path.join(this.projectRoot, 'client', 'src', 'utils', 'sanitize.ts');

    if (!fs.existsSync(sanitizePath)) {
      return { name: '前端安全防护', status: 'risk', issues: ['sanitize.ts 文件缺失'] };
    }

    const sanitizeContent = fs.readFileSync(sanitizePath, 'utf-8');
    const requiredExports = ['escapeHtml', 'sanitizeHtml', 'isSafeUrl'];

    for (const fn of requiredExports) {
      if (!sanitizeContent.includes(`export function ${fn}`)) {
        issues.push(`sanitize.ts 缺少导出函数: ${fn}`);
      }
    }

    if (!sanitizeContent.includes('DOMPurify')) {
      issues.push('sanitize.ts 未使用 DOMPurify 库');
    }

    const dangerousTags = ['script', 'iframe', 'object', 'embed'];
    const allowedMatch = sanitizeContent.match(/ALLOWED_TAGS:\s*\[([^\]]+)\]/);
    if (allowedMatch) {
      const allowedStr = allowedMatch[1];
      for (const tag of dangerousTags) {
        if (allowedStr.includes(`'${tag}'`)) {
          issues.push(`ALLOWED_TAGS 包含危险标签: ${tag}`);
        }
      }
    }

    const pkgPath = path.join(this.projectRoot, 'package.json');
    if (fs.existsSync(pkgPath)) {
      const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(pkgPath, 'utf-8'));
      const hasDompurify = pkg.dependencies?.dompurify || pkg.devDependencies?.dompurify;
      if (!hasDompurify) {
        issues.push('package.json 缺少 dompurify 依赖');
      }
    }

    return {
      name: '前端安全防护',
      status: issues.length === 0 ? 'pass' : 'risk',
      issues: issues.length === 0 ? ['XSS防护完整，DOMPurify已配置，白名单最小化'] : issues,
    };
  }

  private checkAdminConfig(): ICheckResult {
    const issues: string[] = [];
    const adminControllerPath = path.join(
      this.projectRoot, 'server', 'modules', 'admin', 'admin.controller.ts',
    );

    if (!fs.existsSync(adminControllerPath)) {
      return { name: '管理员配置安全', status: 'warn', issues: ['AdminController 文件不存在'] };
    }

    const content = fs.readFileSync(adminControllerPath, 'utf-8');

    if (!content.includes('@NeedLogin()')) {
      issues.push('管理员验证接口缺少 @NeedLogin() 装饰器');
    }

    if (content.includes("'mdp-admin-2024'") || content.includes('"mdp-admin-2024"')) {
      if (!process.env.MDP_ADMIN_PASSWORD) {
        issues.push('使用默认管理员密码且未配置 MDP_ADMIN_PASSWORD 环境变量');
      }
    }

    return {
      name: '管理员配置安全',
      status: issues.length === 0 ? 'pass' : issues.some((i: string) => i.includes('默认管理员密码')) ? 'risk' : 'warn',
      issues: issues.length === 0 ? ['管理员鉴权已配置，密码非默认值'] : issues,
    };
  }

  private checkCodeSecurityPatterns(): ICheckResult {
    const issues: string[] = [];
    const serverDir = path.join(this.projectRoot, 'server');
    const clientDir = path.join(this.projectRoot, 'client', 'src');

    if (fs.existsSync(serverDir)) {
      const serverFiles = this.findFiles(serverDir, /\.ts$/);
      for (const file of serverFiles) {
        const content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf-8');
        const relPath = path.relative(this.projectRoot, file);

        if (/\beval\s*\(/.test(content)) {
          issues.push(`${relPath}: 使用了 eval()`);
        }
        if (/\bnew\s+Function\s*\(/.test(content)) {
          issues.push(`${relPath}: 使用了 new Function()`);
        }
        if (/child_process/.test(content)) {
          issues.push(`${relPath}: 引用了 child_process`);
        }

        const fsWriteMatch = content.match(/fs\.(?:writeFile|writeFileSync)\s*\(\s*['"]([^'"]+)/);
        if (fsWriteMatch && !fsWriteMatch[1].startsWith('/tmp')) {
          issues.push(`${relPath}: fs写入非/tmp路径: ${fsWriteMatch[1]}`);
        }
      }
    }

    if (fs.existsSync(clientDir)) {
      const clientFiles = this.findFiles(clientDir, /\.(ts|tsx)$/);
      for (const file of clientFiles) {
        const content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf-8');
        const relPath = path.relative(this.projectRoot, file);

        if (/dangerouslySetInnerHTML/.test(content) && !content.includes('sanitize')) {
          issues.push(`${relPath}: dangerouslySetInnerHTML 未配合 sanitize`);
        }
        if (/\.innerHTML\s*=/.test(content)) {
          issues.push(`${relPath}: 直接赋值 innerHTML`);
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      name: '代码安全模式',
      status: issues.length === 0 ? 'pass' : 'warn',
      issues: issues.length === 0 ? ['未发现危险代码模式'] : issues,
    };
  }

  private checkPlatformFileIntegrity(): ICheckResult {
    const issues: string[] = [];

    const criticalFiles: Array<{ path: string; keywords: string[] }> = [
      { path: 'server/main.ts', keywords: ['bootstrap', 'NestFactory'] },
      { path: 'client/src/index.tsx', keywords: ['createRoot', 'render'] },
      { path: 'client/index.html', keywords: ['<!DOCTYPE', '<html'] },
      { path: 'client/src/app.tsx', keywords: ['Routes', 'Route'] },
      { path: 'server/modules/view/view.controller.ts', keywords: ['Controller', 'Get'] },
      { path: 'vite.config.ts', keywords: ['defineConfig', 'vite'] },
    ];

    for (const file of criticalFiles) {
      const fullPath = path.join(this.projectRoot, file.path);

      if (!fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
        issues.push(`平台关键文件缺失: ${file.path}`);
        continue;
      }

      const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf-8');
      if (content.trim().length === 0) {
        issues.push(`平台关键文件为空: ${file.path}`);
        continue;
      }

      const hasKeyword = file.keywords.some((kw: string) => content.includes(kw));
      if (!hasKeyword) {
        issues.push(`平台关键文件缺少关键标识: ${file.path} (需含 ${file.keywords.join('/')})`);
      }
    }

    return {
      name: '平台文件完整性',
      status: issues.length === 0 ? 'pass' : 'risk',
      issues: issues.length === 0 ? ['所有平台关键文件完整'] : issues,
    };
  }

  private buildReport(results: ICheckResult[]): string {
    const statusIcon = (s: string) => {
      if (s === 'pass') return 'PASS';
      if (s === 'warn') return 'WARN';
      return 'RISK';
    };

    const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('zh-CN');
    const lines: string[] = [
      `MDP系统安全性检查报告 (${dateStr})`,
      '',
    ];

    for (const result of results) {
      lines.push(`[${statusIcon(result.status)}] ${result.name}`);
      for (const issue of result.issues) {
        lines.push(`  - ${issue}`);
      }
      lines.push('');
    }

    const passCount = results.filter((r: ICheckResult) => r.status === 'pass').length;
    const warnCount = results.filter((r: ICheckResult) => r.status === 'warn').length;
    const riskCount = results.filter((r: ICheckResult) => r.status === 'risk').length;

    lines.push(`汇总: ${passCount}通过 / ${warnCount}警告 / ${riskCount}风险`);

    if (riskCount > 0) {
      lines.push('建议: 请尽快处理标记为风险的项目');
    }

    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  private async sendReport(report: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const activeUsersRaw = await this.db.execute(sql`
        SELECT DISTINCT user_id
        FROM coaching_sessions
        ORDER BY _created_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
      `);

      const userIds = [...activeUsersRaw].map(
        (r: Record<string, unknown>) => r.user_id as string,
      );

      if (userIds.length === 0) {
        this.logger.log('未找到活跃用户，跳过飞书推送，报告仅记录在日志中');
        return;
      }

      await this.capabilityService
        .load('system_security_check_report_push_1')
        .call('send_feishu_message', {
          security_check_result: report,
          receiver_user_ids: userIds,
        });

      this.logger.log(`安全检查报告已推送给 ${userIds.length} 位用户`);
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.error(`飞书推送失败，报告仅记录在日志中: ${String(err)}`);
    }
  }

  private findFiles(dir: string, pattern: RegExp): string[] {
    const results: string[] = [];

    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return results;

    const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);
      if (entry.name === 'node_modules' || entry.name === 'dist') continue;
      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
        results.push(...this.findFiles(fullPath, pattern));
      } else if (pattern.test(entry.name)) {
        results.push(fullPath);
      }
    }

    return results;
  }
}

import { Injectable, Inject, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { eq, desc, and, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  DRIZZLE_DATABASE,
  type PostgresJsDatabase,
} from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import {
  behaviorCheckins,
  mentorEscalations,
  businessImpacts,
} from '@server/database/schema';

@Injectable()
export class BehaviorTrackingService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(BehaviorTrackingService.name);

  constructor(
    @Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase,
  ) {}

  async createCheckin(userId: string, data: {
    planId?: string;
    weekNumber: number;
    behaviorApplied: string;
    contextDescription?: string;
    outcomeRating?: number;
    lessonsLearned?: string;
    nextAction?: string;
  }) {
    const result = await this.db.insert(behaviorCheckins).values({
      userId,
      planId: data.planId,
      weekNumber: data.weekNumber,
      behaviorApplied: data.behaviorApplied,
      contextDescription: data.contextDescription,
      outcomeRating: data.outcomeRating ?? 3,
      lessonsLearned: data.lessonsLearned,
      nextAction: data.nextAction,
    }).returning();
    this.logger.log('Created behavior checkin: ' + JSON.stringify({ userId, weekNumber: data.weekNumber }));
    return result[0];
  }

  async getMyCheckins(userId: string) {
    return this.db
      .select()
      .from(behaviorCheckins)
      .where(eq(behaviorCheckins.userId, userId))
      .orderBy(desc(behaviorCheckins.weekNumber));
  }

  async getCheckinStats(userId: string) {
    const checkins = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(behaviorCheckins)
      .where(eq(behaviorCheckins.userId, userId));

    const totalCheckins = checkins.length;
    const avgOutcomeRating = totalCheckins > 0
      ? Math.round((checkins.reduce((sum: number, c: typeof checkins[0]) => sum + (c.outcomeRating || 0), 0) / totalCheckins) * 10) / 10
      : 0;

    const sortedWeeks = checkins
      .map((c: typeof checkins[0]) => c.weekNumber)
      .sort((a: number, b: number) => b - a);
    let streakWeeks = 0;
    if (sortedWeeks.length > 0) {
      streakWeeks = 1;
      for (let i = 1; i < sortedWeeks.length; i++) {
        if (sortedWeeks[i - 1] - sortedWeeks[i] <= 2) {
          streakWeeks++;
        } else {
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    return { totalCheckins, avgOutcomeRating, streakWeeks };
  }

  async createEscalation(userId: string, data: {
    sceneId: string;
    sceneName?: string;
    sessionId?: string;
    escalationReason?: string;
    contextSummary?: string;
    userConcern?: string;
  }) {
    const result = await this.db.insert(mentorEscalations).values({
      userId,
      sceneId: data.sceneId,
      sceneName: data.sceneName,
      sessionId: data.sessionId,
      escalationReason: data.escalationReason || 'high_risk',
      contextSummary: data.contextSummary,
      userConcern: data.userConcern,
    }).returning();
    this.logger.log('Created mentor escalation: ' + JSON.stringify({ userId, sceneId: data.sceneId }));
    return result[0];
  }

  async getMyEscalations(userId: string) {
    return this.db
      .select()
      .from(mentorEscalations)
      .where(eq(mentorEscalations.userId, userId))
      .orderBy(desc(mentorEscalations.createdAt));
  }

  async getPendingEscalations() {
    return this.db
      .select()
      .from(mentorEscalations)
      .where(eq(mentorEscalations.status, 'pending'))
      .orderBy(desc(mentorEscalations.createdAt));
  }

  async resolveEscalation(id: string, mentorNotes: string) {
    const result = await this.db
      .update(mentorEscalations)
      .set({
        status: 'resolved',
        mentorNotes,
        resolvedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(mentorEscalations.id, id))
      .returning();
    return result[0];
  }

  async createBusinessImpact(userId: string, data: {
    impactType: string;
    description: string;
    relatedSceneId?: string;
    relatedPlanId?: string;
    metricName?: string;
    metricBefore?: string;
    metricAfter?: string;
    confidenceLevel?: number;
  }) {
    const result = await this.db.insert(businessImpacts).values({
      userId,
      impactType: data.impactType,
      description: data.description,
      relatedSceneId: data.relatedSceneId,
      relatedPlanId: data.relatedPlanId,
      metricName: data.metricName,
      metricBefore: data.metricBefore,
      metricAfter: data.metricAfter,
      confidenceLevel: data.confidenceLevel ?? 3,
    }).returning();
    this.logger.log('Created business impact: ' + JSON.stringify({ userId, impactType: data.impactType }));
    return result[0];
  }

  async getMyBusinessImpacts(userId: string) {
    return this.db
      .select()
      .from(businessImpacts)
      .where(eq(businessImpacts.userId, userId))
      .orderBy(desc(businessImpacts.createdAt));
  }

  async getTrackingStats(userId: string) {
    const checkinStats = await this.getCheckinStats(userId);

    const escalations = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(mentorEscalations)
      .where(eq(mentorEscalations.userId, userId));

    const impacts = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(businessImpacts)
      .where(eq(businessImpacts.userId, userId));

    return {
      ...checkinStats,
      escalationCount: escalations.length,
      resolvedEscalations: escalations.filter((e: typeof escalations[0]) => e.status === 'resolved').length,
      businessImpactCount: impacts.length,
    };
  }
}

  @Get('export-pr-scenes-html')
  async exportPRScenesHTML(@Res() res: import('express').Response) {
    const html = generatePRScenesHTML();
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8');
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', 'attachment; filename="pr-scenes-background.html"');

    await this.coachingService.deleteScenarioCard(id);
    return { success: true };
  }

  @NeedLogin()
  @Post('seed-scenarios')
  async seedScenarios(@Body() body: { scenarios: any[] }) {
    const results = [];
    for (const card of body.scenarios) {
      const scene = await this.coachingService.createScenarioCard({
        scenarioCard: card,
        dVector: card.meta.d_vector,
        pSequence: card.meta.p_sequence,
        progressionChain: card.meta.progression_chain,
        title: card.meta.title,
      });
      results.push({ id: scene.id, title: card.meta.title });
    }
    return { seeded: results.length, scenarios: results };
  }

===FILE:./server/modules/coaching/coaching.service.ts===
import { Injectable, Inject, Logger, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { eq, and, desc, sql, inArray, gte, isNotNull } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { coachingScenes, coachingSessions, feedbackLog, courses, userCases } from '@server/database/schema';
import { GamificationService } from '../gamification/gamification.service';

@Injectable()
export class CoachingService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(CoachingService.name);

  constructor(
    @Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase,
    private readonly gamificationService: GamificationService,
  ) {}

  async getAllScenes() {
    try {
      const results = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingScenes)
        .orderBy(desc(coachingScenes.createdAt));

      return results.map(scene => this.mapSceneToDto(scene));
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('获取陪练场景列表失败', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getSceneById(sceneId: string) {
    try {
      const [scene] = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingScenes)
        .where(eq(coachingScenes.sceneId, sceneId));

      if (!scene) {
        return null;
      }

      return this.mapSceneToDto(scene);
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取陪练场景详情失败: ${sceneId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getScenesByDimension(dimension: string) {
    try {
      const results = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingScenes)
        .where(eq(coachingScenes.dimension, dimension))
        .orderBy(desc(coachingScenes.createdAt));

      return results.map(scene => this.mapSceneToDto(scene));
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取维度场景失败: ${dimension}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getScenesByDifficulty(difficulty: string) {
    try {
      const results = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingScenes)
        .where(eq(coachingScenes.difficulty, difficulty))
        .orderBy(desc(coachingScenes.createdAt));

      return results.map(scene => this.mapSceneToDto(scene));
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取难度场景失败: ${difficulty}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getGreentownScenes() {
    try {
      const results = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingScenes)
        .where(eq(coachingScenes.isEnterpriseSpecific, true))
        .orderBy(desc(coachingScenes.createdAt));

      return results.map(scene => this.mapSceneToDto(scene));
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('获取企业专属场景失败', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getCourseBasedScenes() {
    try {
      const results = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingScenes)
        .where(sql`${coachingScenes.sourceCourseId} IS NOT NULL`)
        .orderBy(desc(coachingScenes.createdAt));

      return results.map(scene => this.mapSceneToDto(scene));
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('获取课程案例场景失败', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async createSession(userId: string, sceneId: string) {
    try {
      const [session] = await this.db
        .insert(coachingSessions)
        .values({
          userId,
          sceneId,
          messages: [],
          status: 'active',
        })
        .returning();

      return {
        id: session.id,
        userId: session.userId,
        sceneId: session.sceneId,
        status: session.status,
        messages: session.messages || [],
        scoreResult: session.scoreResult,
        scorePeople: session.scorePeople,
        scoreField: session.scoreField,
        roundCount: session.roundCount,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('创建陪练会话失败', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getSessionById(sessionId: string) {
    try {
      const [session] = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingSessions)
        .where(eq(coachingSessions.id, sessionId));

      if (!session) {
        return null;
      }

      return {
        id: session.id,
        userId: session.userId,
        sceneId: session.sceneId,
        status: session.status,
        messages: session.messages || [],
        scoreResult: session.scoreResult,
        scorePeople: session.scorePeople,
        scoreField: session.scoreField,
        roundCount: session.roundCount,
        completedAt: session.completedAt,
        selfAssessment: session.selfAssessment || null,
        decisionPath: typeof (session as any).decisionPath === 'string'
          ? JSON.parse((session as any).decisionPath)
          : ((session as any).decisionPath || null),
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取陪练会话失败: ${sessionId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async updateSession(sessionId: string, userId: string, data: {
    messages?: any[];
    scoreResult?: number;
    scorePeople?: number;
    scoreField?: number;
    scoreFollowup?: number;
    roundCount?: number;
    status?: string;
    completedAt?: Date;
    selfAssessment?: any;
    difficulty?: string;
    principlesScores?: any;
    antiPatterns?: any;
    revealedInfo?: any;
    phaseHistory?: any;
  }) {
    try {
      const [existing] = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingSessions)
        .where(eq(coachingSessions.id, sessionId));
      if (!existing || existing.userId !== userId) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Session not found');
      }
      const [session] = await this.db
        .update(coachingSessions)
        .set({
          ...data,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(coachingSessions.id, sessionId))
        .returning();

      if (data.status === 'completed') {
        try {
          await this.gamificationService.addPoints(
            session.userId,
            'coaching_complete',
            30,
            `完成陪练场景: ${session.sceneId}`,
            sessionId,
          );
          await this.gamificationService.checkAndAwardBadges(session.userId);
        } catch (gamErr) {
          this.logger.error(`积分奖励失败: ${sessionId}`, String(gamErr));
        }
      }

      return {
        id: session.id,
        userId: session.userId,
        sceneId: session.sceneId,
        status: session.status,
        messages: session.messages || [],
        scoreResult: session.scoreResult,
        scorePeople: session.scorePeople,
        scoreField: session.scoreField,
        roundCount: session.roundCount,
        completedAt: session.completedAt,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`更新陪练会话失败: ${sessionId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getUserSessions(userId: string, limit: number = 10) {
    try {
      const results = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingSessions)
        .where(eq(coachingSessions.userId, userId))
        .orderBy(desc(coachingSessions.createdAt))
        .limit(limit);

      return results.map(session => ({
        id: session.id,
        userId: session.userId,
        sceneId: session.sceneId,
        status: session.status,
        scoreResult: session.scoreResult,
        scorePeople: session.scorePeople,
        scoreField: session.scoreField,
        roundCount: session.roundCount,
        completedAt: session.completedAt,
        createdAt: session.createdAt,
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取用户会话失败: ${userId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getUserSessionsWithMessages(userId: string, limit: number = 20) {
    try {
      const results = await this.db
        .select({
          id: coachingSessions.id,
          userId: coachingSessions.userId,
          sceneId: coachingSessions.sceneId,
          status: coachingSessions.status,
          messages: coachingSessions.messages,
          scoreResult: coachingSessions.scoreResult,
          scorePeople: coachingSessions.scorePeople,
          scoreField: coachingSessions.scoreField,
          roundCount: coachingSessions.roundCount,
          completedAt: coachingSessions.completedAt,
          createdAt: coachingSessions.createdAt,
          sceneName: coachingScenes.name,
          dimension: coachingScenes.dimension,
          difficulty: coachingScenes.difficulty,
        })
        .from(coachingSessions)
        .leftJoin(coachingScenes, eq(coachingSessions.sceneId, coachingScenes.sceneId))
        .where(eq(coachingSessions.userId, userId))
        .orderBy(desc(coachingSessions.createdAt))
        .limit(limit);

      return results.map(session => ({
        id: session.id,
        userId: session.userId,
        sceneId: session.sceneId,
        sceneName: session.sceneName || session.sceneId,
        dimension: session.dimension || 'result',
        difficulty: session.difficulty || 'medium',
        status: session.status,
        messages: session.messages || [],
        scoreResult: session.scoreResult,
        scorePeople: session.scorePeople,
        scoreField: session.scoreField,
        roundCount: session.roundCount,
        completedAt: session.completedAt,
        createdAt: session.createdAt,
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取用户会话（含消息）失败: ${userId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getAllSessionsForAdmin(page: number = 1, pageSize: number = 20, status?: string, sceneId?: string) {
    try {
      const offset = (page - 1) * pageSize;

      const conditions = [];
      if (status) {
        conditions.push(eq(coachingSessions.status, status));
      }
      if (sceneId) {
        conditions.push(eq(coachingSessions.sceneId, sceneId));
      }

      const whereClause = conditions.length > 0 ? and(...conditions) : undefined;

      const countResult = await this.db
        .select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
        .from(coachingSessions)
        .where(whereClause);
      const total = countResult[0]?.count || 0;

      const query = conditions.length > 0
        ? this.db
            .select({
              id: coachingSessions.id,
              userId: coachingSessions.userId,
              sceneId: coachingSessions.sceneId,
              status: coachingSessions.status,
              messages: coachingSessions.messages,
              scoreResult: coachingSessions.scoreResult,
              scorePeople: coachingSessions.scorePeople,
              scoreField: coachingSessions.scoreField,
              roundCount: coachingSessions.roundCount,
              completedAt: coachingSessions.completedAt,
              createdAt: coachingSessions.createdAt,
              sceneName: coachingScenes.name,
              dimension: coachingScenes.dimension,
              difficulty: coachingScenes.difficulty,
            })
            .from(coachingSessions)
            .leftJoin(coachingScenes, eq(coachingSessions.sceneId, coachingScenes.sceneId))
            .where(and(...conditions))
            .orderBy(desc(coachingSessions.createdAt))
            .limit(pageSize)
            .offset(offset)
        : this.db
            .select({
              id: coachingSessions.id,
              userId: coachingSessions.userId,
              sceneId: coachingSessions.sceneId,
              status: coachingSessions.status,
              messages: coachingSessions.messages,
              scoreResult: coachingSessions.scoreResult,
              scorePeople: coachingSessions.scorePeople,
              scoreField: coachingSessions.scoreField,
              roundCount: coachingSessions.roundCount,
              completedAt: coachingSessions.completedAt,
              createdAt: coachingSessions.createdAt,
              sceneName: coachingScenes.name,
              dimension: coachingScenes.dimension,
              difficulty: coachingScenes.difficulty,
            })
            .from(coachingSessions)
            .leftJoin(coachingScenes, eq(coachingSessions.sceneId, coachingScenes.sceneId))
            .orderBy(desc(coachingSessions.createdAt))
            .limit(pageSize)
            .offset(offset);

      const results = await query;

      return {
        items: results.map(session => ({
          id: session.id,
          userId: session.userId,
          sceneId: session.sceneId,
          sceneName: session.sceneName || session.sceneId,
          dimension: session.dimension || 'result',
          difficulty: session.difficulty || 'medium',
          status: session.status,
          messages: session.messages || [],
          scoreResult: session.scoreResult,
          scorePeople: session.scorePeople,
          scoreField: session.scoreField,
          roundCount: session.roundCount,
          completedAt: session.completedAt,
          createdAt: session.createdAt,
        })),
        total,
        page,
        pageSize,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('管理员获取所有会话失败', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getLatestSessionByScene(userId: string, sceneId: string) {
    try {
      const results = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingSessions)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(coachingSessions.userId, userId),
            eq(coachingSessions.sceneId, sceneId),
          ),
        )
        .orderBy(desc(coachingSessions.createdAt))
        .limit(1);

      if (!results.length) return null;

      const session = results[0];
      return {
        id: session.id,
        userId: session.userId,
        sceneId: session.sceneId,
        status: session.status,
        messages: session.messages || [],
        scoreResult: session.scoreResult,
        scorePeople: session.scorePeople,
        scoreField: session.scoreField,
        roundCount: session.roundCount,
        completedAt: session.completedAt,
        createdAt: session.createdAt,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取场景最近会话失败: userId=${userId}, sceneId=${sceneId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async createFeedback(data: {
    sessionId: string;
    sceneId: string;
    userId: string;
    messageId: string;
    feedbackType: string;
    suggestion?: string;
    dimension?: string;
  }) {
    try {
      const [feedback] = await this.db
        .insert(feedbackLog)
        .values({
          sessionId: data.sessionId,
          sceneId: data.sceneId,
          userId: data.userId,
          messageId: data.messageId,
          feedbackType: data.feedbackType,
          suggestion: data.suggestion,
          dimension: data.dimension,
        })
        .returning();

      return {
        id: feedback.id,
        sessionId: feedback.sessionId,
        sceneId: feedback.sceneId,
        userId: feedback.userId,
        messageId: feedback.messageId,
        feedbackType: feedback.feedbackType,
        suggestion: feedback.suggestion,
        dimension: feedback.dimension,
        createdAt: feedback.createdAt,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('创建反馈失败', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getUserFeedbacks(userId: string) {
    try {
      const results = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(feedbackLog)
        .where(eq(feedbackLog.userId, userId))
        .orderBy(desc(feedbackLog.createdAt));

      return results.map(feedback => ({
        id: feedback.id,
        sessionId: feedback.sessionId,
        sceneId: feedback.sceneId,
        userId: feedback.userId,
        messageId: feedback.messageId,
        feedbackType: feedback.feedbackType,
        suggestion: feedback.suggestion,
        dimension: feedback.dimension,
        createdAt: feedback.createdAt,
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取用户反馈失败: ${userId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getCoachingTrend(userId: string) {
    try {
      const sessions = await this.db
        .select({
          id: coachingSessions.id,
          sceneId: coachingSessions.sceneId,
          scoreResult: coachingSessions.scoreResult,
          scorePeople: coachingSessions.scorePeople,
          scoreField: coachingSessions.scoreField,
          roundCount: coachingSessions.roundCount,
          completedAt: coachingSessions.completedAt,
          createdAt: coachingSessions.createdAt,
        })
        .from(coachingSessions)
        .where(and(
          eq(coachingSessions.userId, userId),
          eq(coachingSessions.status, 'completed'),
          gte(coachingSessions.createdAt, new Date(Date.now() - 180 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)),
        ))
        .orderBy(coachingSessions.createdAt);

      return sessions.map((s: typeof sessions[0]) => ({
        id: s.id,
        sceneId: s.sceneId,
        scoreResult: s.scoreResult || 0,
        scorePeople: s.scorePeople || 0,
        scoreField: s.scoreField || 0,
        avgScore: Math.round(((s.scoreResult || 0) + (s.scorePeople || 0) + (s.scoreField || 0)) / 3),
        roundCount: s.roundCount || 0,
        completedAt: s.completedAt || s.createdAt,
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取陪练趋势失败: ${userId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getLearningPath(userId: string) {
    try {
      // Get user's completed sessions
      const sessions = await this.db
        .select({
          sceneId: coachingSessions.sceneId,
          scoreResult: coachingSessions.scoreResult,
          scorePeople: coachingSessions.scorePeople,
          scoreField: coachingSessions.scoreField,
        })
        .from(coachingSessions)
        .where(and(
          eq(coachingSessions.userId, userId),
          eq(coachingSessions.status, 'completed'),
        ));

      // Get all scenes
      const allScenes = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingScenes);

      const completedSceneIds = new Set(
        sessions.map((s: { sceneId: string }) => s.sceneId),
      );

      // Calculate average scores per dimension
      const avgScores = {
        result: sessions.length > 0
          ? Math.round(
              sessions.reduce(
                (sum: number, s: { scoreResult: number | null }) =>
                  sum + (s.scoreResult || 0),
                0,
              ) / sessions.length,
            )
          : 0,
        people: sessions.length > 0
          ? Math.round(
              sessions.reduce(
                (sum: number, s: { scorePeople: number | null }) =>
                  sum + (s.scorePeople || 0),
                0,
              ) / sessions.length,
            )
          : 0,
        field: sessions.length > 0
          ? Math.round(
              sessions.reduce(
                (sum: number, s: { scoreField: number | null }) =>
                  sum + (s.scoreField || 0),
                0,
              ) / sessions.length,
            )
          : 0,
      };

      // Find weakest dimension
      const weakestDimension = Object.entries(avgScores).sort(
        ([, a], [, b]) => (a as number) - (b as number),
      )[0][0];

      const dimensionLabel: Record<string, string> = {
        result: '拿结果',
        people: '带团队',
        field: '传文化',
      };

      // Build 3-phase learning path
      const phases = [
        {
          phase: 1,
          name: '基础强化',
          description: `重点提升「${dimensionLabel[weakestDimension] || weakestDimension}」维度`,
          scenes: allScenes
            .filter(
              (s) =>
                !completedSceneIds.has(s.sceneId) &&
                s.difficulty === 'easy',
            )
            .slice(0, 3)
            .map((s) => ({
              sceneId: s.sceneId,
              name: s.name,
              dimension: s.dimension,
              difficulty: s.difficulty,
            })),
        },
        {
          phase: 2,
          name: '进阶挑战',
          description: '完成中等难度场景，全面提升管理能力',
          scenes: allScenes
            .filter(
              (s) =>
                !completedSceneIds.has(s.sceneId) &&
                s.difficulty === 'medium',
            )
            .slice(0, 3)
            .map((s) => ({
              sceneId: s.sceneId,
              name: s.name,
              dimension: s.dimension,
              difficulty: s.difficulty,
            })),
        },
        {
          phase: 3,
          name: '高阶突破',
          description: '挑战高难度场景，检验学习成果',
          scenes: allScenes
            .filter(
              (s) =>
                !completedSceneIds.has(s.sceneId) &&
                s.difficulty === 'hard',
            )
            .slice(0, 3)
            .map((s) => ({
              sceneId: s.sceneId,
              name: s.name,
              dimension: s.dimension,
              difficulty: s.difficulty,
            })),
        },
      ];

      return {
        completedCount: sessions.length,
        totalCount: allScenes.length,
        avgScores,
        weakestDimension,
        phases,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取学习路径失败: ${userId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getUserSceneHistory(userId: string, sceneId: string) {
    try {
      const sessions = await this.db
        .select({
          scoreResult: coachingSessions.scoreResult,
          scorePeople: coachingSessions.scorePeople,
          scoreField: coachingSessions.scoreField,
        })
        .from(coachingSessions)
        .where(and(
          eq(coachingSessions.userId, userId),
          eq(coachingSessions.sceneId, sceneId),
          eq(coachingSessions.status, 'completed'),
        ));

      if (sessions.length === 0) {
        return { sessionCount: 0, avgScore: 0, pressureLevel: 'medium' as const };
      }

      const totalScore = sessions.reduce(
        (sum: number, s: { scoreResult: number | null; scorePeople: number | null; scoreField: number | null }) =>
          sum + ((s.scoreResult || 0) + (s.scorePeople || 0) + (s.scoreField || 0)) / 3,
        0,
      );
      const avgScore = Math.round(totalScore / sessions.length);

      let pressureLevel: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
      if (avgScore >= 75) {
        pressureLevel = 'high';
      } else if (avgScore >= 55) {
        pressureLevel = 'medium';
      } else {
        pressureLevel = 'low';
      }

      return { sessionCount: sessions.length, avgScore, pressureLevel };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取用户场景历史失败: ${userId} ${sceneId}`, String(error));
      return { sessionCount: 0, avgScore: 0, pressureLevel: 'medium' as const };
    }
  }

  private mapSceneToDto(scene: any) {
    return {
      id: scene.sceneId,
      name: scene.name,
      dimension: scene.dimension,
      difficulty: scene.difficulty,
      aiRole: scene.aiRole,
      description: scene.description,
      duration: scene.duration,
      maxRounds: scene.maxRounds,
      tags: scene.tags || [],
      isEnterpriseSpecific: scene.isEnterpriseSpecific,
      businessContext: scene.businessContext,
      businessTags: scene.businessTags || [],
      sourceCourseId: scene.sourceCourseId,
      sourceCourseName: scene.sourceCourseName,
      sourceCaseId: scene.sourceCaseId,
      sourceCaseTitle: scene.sourceCaseTitle,
      initialScoreResult: scene.initialScoreResult,
      initialScorePeople: scene.initialScorePeople,
      initialScoreField: scene.initialScoreField,
      positiveTriggerWords: scene.positiveTriggerWords || [],
      negativeTriggerWords: scene.negativeTriggerWords || [],
      aiCharacter: scene.aiCharacter,
      scenarioContext: scene.scenarioContext,
    };
  }

  async getCourseKnowledge(courseId: string, weakness?: string) {
    try {
      const [course] = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(courses)
        .where(eq(courses.courseId, courseId));

      if (!course) {
        return null;
      }

      const knowledgePoints: string[] = course.knowledgePoints || [];
      const rawCards = course.knowledgeCards;
      const knowledgeCards: Array<{ title: string; category: string; content: string; tag?: string }> = Array.isArray(rawCards) ? rawCards : [];

      const theoryCards = knowledgeCards.filter((c: { category: string }) => c.category === 'theory');
      const practiceCards = knowledgeCards.filter((c: { category: string }) => c.category === 'practice' || c.category === 'case');

      const weaknessTheoryMap: Record<string, string[]> = {
        empathy: ['NVC非暴力沟通', 'SBI反馈模型', '积极倾听', '共情能力'],
        support: ['SMART原则', 'PDCA循环', '资源协调', '目标分解'],
        pressure: ['SLII情境领导', '托马斯-基尔曼冲突模型', '压力管理'],
        avoid: ['GROW教练模型', 'Lencioni团队障碍', '承诺管理'],
      };

      const relevantTheories = weakness ? (weaknessTheoryMap[weakness] || []) : [];

      return {
        courseId: course.courseId,
        title: course.title,
        dimension: course.dimension,
        knowledgePoints,
        theoryCards: theoryCards.slice(0, 5),
        practiceCards: practiceCards.slice(0, 5),
        relevantTheories,
        totalCards: knowledgeCards.length,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取课程知识失败: ${courseId}`, String(error));
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async submitCase(userId: string, data: {
    sceneName: string;
    backgroundDesc: string;
    responseDesc: string;
    trainingDimensions: string[];
  }) {
    try {
      const [record] = await this.db
        .insert(userCases)
        .values({
          userId,
          sceneName: data.sceneName,
          backgroundDesc: data.backgroundDesc,
          responseDesc: data.responseDesc,
          trainingDimensions: data.trainingDimensions,
          reviewStatus: 'pending',
          isConverted: false,
        })
        .returning();

      return { id: record.id };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`提交案例失败: ${userId}`, String(error));
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getUserCases(userId: string, status?: string) {
    try {
      const conditions = [eq(userCases.userId, userId)];
      if (status) {
        conditions.push(eq(userCases.reviewStatus, status));
      }
      const query = conditions.length > 0
        ? this.db.select().from(userCases).where(and(...conditions)).orderBy(desc(userCases.createdAt))
        : this.db.select().from(userCases).orderBy(desc(userCases.createdAt));
      const results = await query;
      return results.map((c: typeof results[0]) => ({
        id: c.id,
        userId: c.userId,
        sceneName: c.sceneName,
        backgroundDesc: c.backgroundDesc,
        responseDesc: c.responseDesc,
        trainingDimensions: c.trainingDimensions,
        isConverted: c.isConverted,
        convertedSceneId: c.convertedSceneId,
        reviewStatus: c.reviewStatus,
        adminNotes: c.adminNotes,
        createdAt: c.createdAt,
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取案例列表失败`, String(error));
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async reviewCase(caseId: string, data: { status: 'approved' | 'rejected'; adminNotes?: string }) {
    try {
      const [updated] = await this.db
        .update(userCases)
        .set({
          reviewStatus: data.status,
          adminNotes: data.adminNotes || null,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(userCases.id, caseId))
        .returning();

      if (data.status === 'approved' && updated) {
        await this.convertCaseToScene(updated);
      }

      return { id: updated.id, reviewStatus: updated.reviewStatus };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`审核案例失败: ${caseId}`, String(error));
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async convertCaseToScene(caseRecord: {
    id: string;
    sceneName: string | null;
    backgroundDesc: string | null;
    responseDesc: string | null;
    trainingDimensions: string[] | null;
  }) {
    try {
      const sceneId = `scene_user_${caseRecord.id.slice(0, 8)}`;
      const dimension = caseRecord.trainingDimensions?.[0] || 'result';
      const name = caseRecord.sceneName || '学员实战场景';

      await this.db.insert(coachingScenes).values({
        sceneId,
        name,
        dimension,
        difficulty: 'medium',
        aiRole: '员工',
        description: caseRecord.backgroundDesc || '',
        maxRounds: 8,
        tags: caseRecord.trainingDimensions || [],
        isEnterpriseSpecific: true,
        sourceCaseId: caseRecord.id,
        sourceCaseTitle: name,
        aiCharacter: {
          name: '团队成员',
          role: '下属',
          personality: '认真但有些困惑，希望得到指导',
          speakingStyle: '直接但有礼貌，偶尔带点情绪',
          commonPhrases: ['领导，这件事我想跟您聊聊', '我不太确定这样做对不对', '希望能得到您的支持'],
          background: caseRecord.backgroundDesc || '真实管理场景中的团队成员',
          painPoints: ['不确定方向', '需要认可'],
          motivation: '希望得到领导的理解和支持',
        },
        scenarioContext: {
          situation: caseRecord.backgroundDesc || '真实管理场景',
          conflict: caseRecord.responseDesc || '管理挑战',
          goal: '通过有效沟通解决问题',
          successCriteria: ['建立信任', '达成共识', '制定行动计划'],
        },
      });

      await this.db
        .update(userCases)
        .set({
          isConverted: true,
          convertedSceneId: sceneId,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(userCases.id, caseRecord.id));

      this.logger.log(`案例 ${caseRecord.id} 已转换为场景 ${sceneId}`);
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`转换案例为场景失败: ${caseRecord.id}`, String(error));
    }
  }

  async getExportData() {
    try {
      const allCourses = await this.db
        .select({
          courseId: courses.courseId,
          title: courses.title,
          description: courses.description,
          dimension: courses.dimension,
          duration: courses.duration,
          knowledgePoints: courses.knowledgePoints,
        })
        .from(courses)
        .orderBy(courses.dimension);

      const allScenes = await this.db
        .select({
          sceneId: coachingScenes.sceneId,
          name: coachingScenes.name,
          dimension: coachingScenes.dimension,
          difficulty: coachingScenes.difficulty,
          aiRole: coachingScenes.aiRole,
          description: coachingScenes.description,
          duration: coachingScenes.duration,
          maxRounds: coachingScenes.maxRounds,
          tags: coachingScenes.tags,
          businessContext: coachingScenes.businessContext,
          sourceCourseId: coachingScenes.sourceCourseId,
          sourceCourseName: coachingScenes.sourceCourseName,
          positiveTriggerWords: coachingScenes.positiveTriggerWords,
          negativeTriggerWords: coachingScenes.negativeTriggerWords,
        })
        .from(coachingScenes)
        .orderBy(coachingScenes.dimension);

      const allFeedbacks = await this.db
        .select({
          sceneId: feedbackLog.sceneId,
          feedbackType: feedbackLog.feedbackType,
          suggestion: feedbackLog.suggestion,
          dimension: feedbackLog.dimension,
          createdAt: feedbackLog.createdAt,
        })
        .from(feedbackLog)
        .orderBy(desc(feedbackLog.createdAt));

      const sessionStats = await this.db
        .select({
          sceneId: coachingSessions.sceneId,
          totalSessions: sql<number>`count(*)::int`,
          completedSessions: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${coachingSessions.status} = 'completed')::int`,
          avgScoreResult: sql<number>`coalesce(avg(${coachingSessions.scoreResult}), 0)::int`,
          avgScorePeople: sql<number>`coalesce(avg(${coachingSessions.scorePeople}), 0)::int`,
          avgScoreField: sql<number>`coalesce(avg(${coachingSessions.scoreField}), 0)::int`,
        })
        .from(coachingSessions)
        .groupBy(coachingSessions.sceneId);

      return {
        courses: allCourses,
        scenes: allScenes,
        feedbacks: allFeedbacks,
        sessionStats,
        exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('获取导出数据失败', String(error));
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async updateScene(sceneId: string, updateData: { scenarioContext?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
    try {
      const [existing] = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingScenes)
        .where(eq(coachingScenes.sceneId, sceneId));

      if (!existing) {
        throw new Error(`场景不存在: ${sceneId}`);
      }

      const mergedContext = updateData.scenarioContext
        ? { ...(existing.scenarioContext as Record<string, unknown> || {}), ...updateData.scenarioContext }
        : existing.scenarioContext;

      const [updated] = await this.db
        .update(coachingScenes)
        .set({
          scenarioContext: mergedContext,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(coachingScenes.sceneId, sceneId))
        .returning();

      this.logger.log(`场景 ${sceneId} scenarioContext 已更新`);
      return this.mapSceneToDto(updated);
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`更新场景失败: ${sceneId}`, String(error));
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async createScenarioCard(data: {

        dVector: data.dVector,
        pSequence: data.pSequence,
        progressionChain: data.progressionChain,
        status: 'draft',
      } as any)

  }

  async getScenarioCard(id: string) {
    let [scene] = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(coachingScenes)
      .where(eq(coachingScenes.sceneId, id));

    if (!scene) {
      [scene] = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingScenes)
        .where(eq(coachingScenes.id, id));
    }

    if (!scene) return null;

    return {
      ...scene,
      scenarioCard: typeof (scene as any).scenarioCard === 'string'
        ? JSON.parse((scene as any).scenarioCard)
        : (scene as any).scenarioCard,
      dVector: typeof (scene as any).dVector === 'string'
        ? JSON.parse((scene as any).dVector)
        : (scene as any).dVector,
    };
  }

  async deleteScenarioCard(sceneId: string) {
    let result = await this.db
      .delete(coachingScenes)
      .where(eq(coachingScenes.sceneId, sceneId))
      .returning({ id: coachingScenes.id });
    if (result.length === 0) {
      result = await this.db
        .delete(coachingScenes)
        .where(eq(coachingScenes.id, sceneId))
        .returning({ id: coachingScenes.id });
    }
    return result.length > 0;
  }

  async listScenarioCards() {
    const results = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(coachingScenes)
      .where(isNotNull(coachingScenes.scenarioCard))
      .orderBy(desc(coachingScenes.createdAt));
    return results.map((s: any) => ({
      ...s,
      scenarioCard: typeof s.scenarioCard === 'string'
        ? JSON.parse(s.scenarioCard)
        : s.scenarioCard,
    }));
  }

  async updateScenarioStatus(sceneId: string, status: string) {
    await this.db
      .update(coachingScenes)
      .set({ status, updatedAt: new Date() } as any)
      .where(eq(coachingScenes.sceneId, sceneId));
  }

  // ====== 新增：会话决策路径 ======

  async createSessionWithDecisionPath(
    userId: string,
    sceneId: string,
    decisionPath: any,
  ) {
    const [session] = await this.db
      .insert(coachingSessions)
      .values({
        userId,
        sceneId,
        scenarioId: sceneId,
        messages: [],
        decisionPath,
        status: 'active',
      } as any)
      .returning();
    return session;
  }

  async updateDecisionPath(sessionId: string, decisionPath: any) {
    const goldenPathMatchRate = decisionPath.decisions?.length > 0
      ? decisionPath.decisions.filter((d: any) => d.is_correct).length / decisionPath.decisions.length
      : 0;

    const [session] = await this.db
      .update(coachingSessions)
      .set({
        decisionPath,
        goldenPathMatchRate,
        completedAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      } as any)
      .where(eq(coachingSessions.id, sessionId))
      .returning();
    return session;
  }

  async getSessionWithDecisionPath(sessionId: string) {
    const [session] = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(coachingSessions)
      .where(eq(coachingSessions.id, sessionId));

    if (!session) return null;

    return {
      ...session,
      decisionPath: typeof (session as any).decisionPath === 'string'
        ? JSON.parse((session as any).decisionPath)
        : (session as any).decisionPath,
    };
  }
}
