import { Injectable, Inject, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { eq, and, desc, sql, count, gte, lt, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { coachingScenes, coachingSessions, feedbackLog } from '@server/database/schema';

export interface SceneHealth {
  sceneId: string;
  sceneName: string;
  dimension: string;
  difficulty: string;
  healthScore: number;
  usefulRate: number;
  completionRate: number;
  avgScoreImprovement: number;
  totalFeedback: number;
  totalSessions: number;
  recentUsefulRate: number;
  recentTrend: 'up' | 'down' | 'stable';
  diagnosis: string;
}

export interface SystemOverview {
  totalFeedback: number;
  usefulRate: number;
  activeScenes: number;
  unhealthyScenes: number;
  totalSessions: number;
  completionRate: number;
  avgScoreImprovement: number;
  feedbackByDimension: { dimension: string; useful: number; notUseful: number; total: number }[];
  dailyFeedbackTrend: { date: string; total: number; useful: number; usefulRate: number }[];
}

export interface TriggerWordAnalysis {
  sceneId: string;
  sceneName: string;
  positiveTriggers: { word: string; usageCount: number; avgScoreImpact: number }[];
  negativeTriggers: { word: string; usageCount: number; avgScoreImpact: number }[];
  candidatePositive: { phrase: string; count: number; avgScore: number }[];
  candidateNegative: { phrase: string; count: number; avgScore: number }[];
}

@Injectable()
export class InsightService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(InsightService.name);

  constructor(@Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase) {}

  async getSystemOverview(): Promise<SystemOverview> {
    try {
      const allFeedback = await this.db
        .select({
          total: count(),
          useful: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where feedback_type = 'useful')`,
        })
        .from(feedbackLog);

      const totalFeedback = Number(allFeedback[0]?.total) || 0;
      const usefulCount = Number(allFeedback[0]?.useful) || 0;
      const usefulRate = totalFeedback > 0 ? Math.round((usefulCount / totalFeedback) * 100) : 0;

      const allSessions = await this.db
        .select({
          total: count(),
          completed: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where status = 'completed')`,
          finalAvg: sql<number>`avg((score_result + score_people + score_field) / 3.0)`,
        })
        .from(coachingSessions);

      const totalSessions = Number(allSessions[0]?.total) || 0;
      const completedSessions = Number(allSessions[0]?.completed) || 0;
      const completionRate = totalSessions > 0 ? Math.round((completedSessions / totalSessions) * 100) : 0;
      const finalAvg = Number(allSessions[0]?.finalAvg) || 50;
      const avgScoreImprovement = Math.round((finalAvg - 50) * 10) / 10;

      const scenesResult = await this.db
        .select({ sceneId: coachingScenes.sceneId })
        .from(coachingScenes);
      const activeScenes = scenesResult.length;

      const feedbackByDim = await this.db
        .select({
          dimension: feedbackLog.dimension,
          useful: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where feedback_type = 'useful')`,
          notUseful: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where feedback_type = 'not_useful')`,
          total: count(),
        })
        .from(feedbackLog)
        .groupBy(feedbackLog.dimension);

      const feedbackByDimension = feedbackByDim.map((d: any) => ({
        dimension: d.dimension || '未标记',
        useful: Number(d.useful) || 0,
        notUseful: Number(d.notUseful) || 0,
        total: Number(d.total) || 0,
      }));

      const fourteenDaysAgo = new Date();
      fourteenDaysAgo.setDate(fourteenDaysAgo.getDate() - 14);

      const recentFeedback = await this.db
        .select({
          date: sql<string>`date(_created_at)`,
          total: count(),
          useful: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where feedback_type = 'useful')`,
        })
        .from(feedbackLog)
        .where(gte(feedbackLog.createdAt, fourteenDaysAgo))
        .groupBy(sql`date(_created_at)`)
        .orderBy(sql`date(_created_at)`);

      const dailyFeedbackTrend = recentFeedback.map((d: any) => {
        const total = Number(d.total) || 0;
        const useful = Number(d.useful) || 0;
        return {
          date: d.date,
          total,
          useful,
          usefulRate: total > 0 ? Math.round((useful / total) * 100) : 0,
        };
      });

      const sceneHealths = await this.getSceneHealthList();
      const unhealthyScenes = sceneHealths.filter(s => s.healthScore < 50).length;

      return {
        totalFeedback,
        usefulRate,
        activeScenes,
        unhealthyScenes,
        totalSessions,
        completionRate,
        avgScoreImprovement,
        feedbackByDimension,
        dailyFeedbackTrend,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('获取系统概览失败', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getSceneHealthList(): Promise<SceneHealth[]> {
    try {
      const scenes = await this.db
        .select({
          sceneId: coachingScenes.sceneId,
          name: coachingScenes.name,
          dimension: coachingScenes.dimension,
          difficulty: coachingScenes.difficulty,
        })
        .from(coachingScenes);

      if (scenes.length === 0) return [];

      const sceneIds = scenes.map(s => s.sceneId);
      const sevenDaysAgo = new Date();
      sevenDaysAgo.setDate(sevenDaysAgo.getDate() - 7);
      const fourteenDaysAgo = new Date();
      fourteenDaysAgo.setDate(fourteenDaysAgo.getDate() - 14);

      const [feedbackStats, sessionStats, recentFeedbackStats, prevFeedbackStats] = await Promise.all([
        this.db
          .select({
            sceneId: feedbackLog.sceneId,
            total: count(),
            useful: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where feedback_type = 'useful')`,
          })
          .from(feedbackLog)
          .where(inArray(feedbackLog.sceneId, sceneIds))
          .groupBy(feedbackLog.sceneId),
        this.db
          .select({
            sceneId: coachingSessions.sceneId,
            total: count(),
            completed: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where status = 'completed')`,
            avgScore: sql<number>`avg((score_result + score_people + score_field) / 3.0) filter (where status = 'completed')`,
          })
          .from(coachingSessions)
          .where(inArray(coachingSessions.sceneId, sceneIds))
          .groupBy(coachingSessions.sceneId),
        this.db
          .select({
            sceneId: feedbackLog.sceneId,
            total: count(),
            useful: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where feedback_type = 'useful')`,
          })
          .from(feedbackLog)
          .where(and(
            inArray(feedbackLog.sceneId, sceneIds),
            gte(feedbackLog.createdAt, sevenDaysAgo),
          ))
          .groupBy(feedbackLog.sceneId),
        this.db
          .select({
            sceneId: feedbackLog.sceneId,
            total: count(),
            useful: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where feedback_type = 'useful')`,
          })
          .from(feedbackLog)
          .where(and(
            inArray(feedbackLog.sceneId, sceneIds),
            gte(feedbackLog.createdAt, fourteenDaysAgo),
            lt(feedbackLog.createdAt, sevenDaysAgo),
          ))
          .groupBy(feedbackLog.sceneId),
      ]);

      const feedbackMap = new Map(feedbackStats.map(s => [s.sceneId, s]));
      const sessionMap = new Map(sessionStats.map(s => [s.sceneId, s]));
      const recentMap = new Map(recentFeedbackStats.map(s => [s.sceneId, s]));
      const prevMap = new Map(prevFeedbackStats.map(s => [s.sceneId, s]));

      const results: SceneHealth[] = scenes.map(scene => {
        const fb = feedbackMap.get(scene.sceneId);
        const totalFeedback = Number(fb?.total) || 0;
        const usefulCount = Number(fb?.useful) || 0;
        const usefulRate = totalFeedback > 0 ? Math.round((usefulCount / totalFeedback) * 100) : 0;

        const sess = sessionMap.get(scene.sceneId);
        const totalSessions = Number(sess?.total) || 0;
        const completedSessions = Number(sess?.completed) || 0;
        const completionRate = totalSessions > 0 ? Math.round((completedSessions / totalSessions) * 100) : 0;
        const avgFinalScore = Number(sess?.avgScore) || 50;
        const avgScoreImprovement = Math.round((avgFinalScore - 50) * 10) / 10;

        const recent = recentMap.get(scene.sceneId);
        const recentTotal = Number(recent?.total) || 0;
        const recentUseful = Number(recent?.useful) || 0;
        const recentUsefulRate = recentTotal > 0 ? Math.round((recentUseful / recentTotal) * 100) : usefulRate;

        const prev = prevMap.get(scene.sceneId);
        const prevTotal = Number(prev?.total) || 0;
        const prevUseful = Number(prev?.useful) || 0;
        const prevRate = prevTotal > 0 ? Math.round((prevUseful / prevTotal) * 100) : 0;

        let recentTrend: 'up' | 'down' | 'stable' = 'stable';
        if (recentTotal > 0 && prevTotal > 0) {
          const diff = recentUsefulRate - prevRate;
          if (diff > 10) recentTrend = 'up';
          else if (diff < -10) recentTrend = 'down';
        }

        const healthScore = totalFeedback >= 10
          ? Math.round(usefulRate * 0.4 + completionRate * 0.3 + Math.min(avgScoreImprovement + 50, 100) * 0.3)
          : null;

        let diagnosis = '';
        if (totalFeedback < 10) {
          diagnosis = '数据积累中，需更多反馈才能生成诊断';
        } else if (healthScore < 50) {
          if (usefulRate < 50) {
            diagnosis = `反馈满意度仅${usefulRate}%，建议检查AI角色设定和prompt配置`;
          } else if (completionRate < 50) {
            diagnosis = `完成率仅${completionRate}%，场景可能过难或缺乏吸引力`;
          } else {
            diagnosis = `综合评分偏低，建议优化场景难度或丰富AI角色表现`;
          }
        } else if (healthScore >= 80) {
          diagnosis = `场景表现优秀，满意度${usefulRate}%，完成率${completionRate}%`;
        } else {
          diagnosis = `场景运行正常，满意度${usefulRate}%，完成率${completionRate}%`;
        }

        return {
          sceneId: scene.sceneId,
          sceneName: scene.name,
          dimension: scene.dimension,
          difficulty: scene.difficulty,
          healthScore: healthScore ?? 0,
          usefulRate,
          completionRate,
          avgScoreImprovement,
          totalFeedback,
          totalSessions,
          recentUsefulRate,
          recentTrend,
          diagnosis,
        };
      });

      return results.sort((a, b) => b.healthScore - a.healthScore);
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('获取场景健康度失败', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getTriggerWordAnalysis(sceneId?: string): Promise<TriggerWordAnalysis[]> {
    try {
      const sceneFilter = sceneId
        ? eq(coachingScenes.sceneId, sceneId)
        : undefined;

      const scenes = await this.db
        .select({
          sceneId: coachingScenes.sceneId,
          name: coachingScenes.name,
          positiveTriggerWords: coachingScenes.positiveTriggerWords,
          negativeTriggerWords: coachingScenes.negativeTriggerWords,
        })
        .from(coachingScenes)
        .where(sceneFilter);

      const results: TriggerWordAnalysis[] = [];

      // Batch query: fetch all sessions for all scenes at once
      const sceneIds = scenes.map((s: typeof scenes[0]) => s.sceneId);
      const allSessions = sceneIds.length > 0
        ? await this.db
            .select({
              sceneId: coachingSessions.sceneId,
              scoreResult: coachingSessions.scoreResult,
              scorePeople: coachingSessions.scorePeople,
              scoreField: coachingSessions.scoreField,
              messages: coachingSessions.messages,
            })
            .from(coachingSessions)
            .where(and(
              inArray(coachingSessions.sceneId, sceneIds),
              eq(coachingSessions.status, 'completed'),
            ))
        : [];

      // Group sessions by sceneId in memory
      const sessionsByScene = new Map<string, typeof allSessions>();
      for (const session of allSessions) {
        const list = sessionsByScene.get(session.sceneId) || [];
        list.push(session);
        sessionsByScene.set(session.sceneId, list);
      }

      for (const scene of scenes) {
        const positiveTriggers = (scene.positiveTriggerWords || []).map((word: string) => ({
          word,
          usageCount: 0,
          avgScoreImpact: 0,
        }));

        const negativeTriggers = (scene.negativeTriggerWords || []).map((word: string) => ({
          word,
          usageCount: 0,
          avgScoreImpact: 0,
        }));

        const sessions = sessionsByScene.get(scene.sceneId) || [];

        for (const session of sessions) {
          const messages = session.messages || [];
          const userMessages = (messages as Record<string, unknown>[])
            .filter((m: Record<string, unknown>) => m.role === 'user')
            .map((m: Record<string, unknown>) => m.content as string)
            .join(' ');

          const avgScore = (Number(session.scoreResult) + Number(session.scorePeople) + Number(session.scoreField)) / 3;

          for (const trigger of positiveTriggers) {
            if (userMessages.includes(trigger.word)) {
              trigger.usageCount++;
              trigger.avgScoreImpact = Math.round(
                ((trigger.avgScoreImpact * (trigger.usageCount - 1)) + avgScore) / trigger.usageCount
              );
            }
          }

          for (const trigger of negativeTriggers) {
            if (userMessages.includes(trigger.word)) {
              trigger.usageCount++;
              trigger.avgScoreImpact = Math.round(
                ((trigger.avgScoreImpact * (trigger.usageCount - 1)) + avgScore) / trigger.usageCount
              );
            }
          }
        }

        results.push({
          sceneId: scene.sceneId,
          sceneName: scene.name,
          positiveTriggers,
          negativeTriggers,
          candidatePositive: [],
          candidateNegative: [],
        });
      }

      return results;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('获取触发词分析失败', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async classifyErrors(userId: string) {
    try {
      const feedbacks = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(feedbackLog)
        .where(eq(feedbackLog.userId, userId));

      const categories: Record<string, { count: number; examples: string[] }> = {
        '提问方式': { count: 0, examples: [] },
        '共情不足': { count: 0, examples: [] },
        '目标模糊': { count: 0, examples: [] },
        '理论应用': { count: 0, examples: [] },
        '倾听不足': { count: 0, examples: [] },
        '沟通技巧': { count: 0, examples: [] },
      };

      for (const fb of feedbacks) {
        if (fb.feedbackType === 'not_useful' && fb.suggestion) {
          const text = fb.suggestion.toLowerCase();
          if (text.includes('提问') || text.includes('问题')) categories['提问方式'].count++;
          else if (text.includes('共情') || text.includes('理解') || text.includes('感受')) categories['共情不足'].count++;
          else if (text.includes('目标') || text.includes('方向')) categories['目标模糊'].count++;
          else if (text.includes('理论') || text.includes('框架') || text.includes('模型')) categories['理论应用'].count++;
          else if (text.includes('倾听') || text.includes('聆听')) categories['倾听不足'].count++;
          else categories['沟通技巧'].count++;
        }
      }

      return Object.entries(categories)
        .map(([name, data]) => ({ name, count: data.count }))
        .filter(c => c.count > 0)
        .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`错误分类失败: ${userId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getScenePromptOptimization(sceneId: string): Promise<string> {
    try {
      const feedbackResult = await this.db
        .select({
          total: count(),
          useful: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where feedback_type = 'useful')`,
        })
        .from(feedbackLog)
        .where(eq(feedbackLog.sceneId, sceneId));

      const totalFeedback = Number(feedbackResult[0]?.total) || 0;
      const usefulCount = Number(feedbackResult[0]?.useful) || 0;

      if (totalFeedback < 10) {
        return '';
      }

      const usefulRate = Math.round((usefulCount / totalFeedback) * 100);

      const suggestions = await this.db
        .select({ suggestion: feedbackLog.suggestion })
        .from(feedbackLog)
        .where(and(
          eq(feedbackLog.sceneId, sceneId),
          eq(feedbackLog.feedbackType, 'not_useful'),
        ))
        .limit(20);

      const suggestionTexts = suggestions
        .map((s: any) => s.suggestion)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' ');

      if (usefulRate < 50) {
        let optimization = `【系统优化指令 - 来自用户反馈数据】\n根据${totalFeedback}条用户反馈分析，此场景满意度仅${usefulRate}%。`;

        if (suggestionTexts.includes('固执') || suggestionTexts.includes('配合')) {
          optimization += '请在第3轮对话后适当松动态度，当用户提供了合理方案时应表现出"虽然还有顾虑，但愿意尝试"的渐进转化。';
        }
        if (suggestionTexts.includes('空洞') || suggestionTexts.includes('敷衍')) {
          optimization += '请给出更具体、更有细节的回复，包含具体的数据、时间或例子。';
        }
        if (suggestionTexts.includes('角色') || suggestionTexts.includes('人设')) {
          optimization += '请更严格地保持角色人设一致性，避免跳出角色。';
        }
        if (suggestionTexts.length === 0) {
          optimization += '请适当降低对抗强度，在用户展示诚意时更快给予正面反馈。';
        }

        return optimization;
      }

      if (usefulRate >= 80) {
        return `【系统优化指令 - 来自用户反馈数据】\n根据${totalFeedback}条用户反馈，此场景满意度${usefulRate}%，表现优秀。请保持当前的互动风格，特别注意保持角色真实感和反馈的具体性。`;
      }

      return '';
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('获取场景prompt优化失败', error);
      return '';
    }
  }
}

===FILE:./server/modules/coaching/pr2/coaching-engine.service.ts===
import { Injectable, Logger, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { coachingSessions } from '@server/database/schema';
import type {
  PR2Phase, PR2NpcMood, PR2PrincipleScores,
  PR2AntiPatterns, PR2RevealedInfo, PR2PhaseHistoryEntry,
  PR2Difficulty,
} from '@shared/coaching-pr2';

/** Detected intent from user message */
interface UserIntent {
  type: string;
  scoreChanges: Partial<PR2PrincipleScores>;
  revealedUpdates: Partial<PR2RevealedInfo>;
  antiPatternHits: Partial<PR2AntiPatterns>;
}

@Injectable()
export class CoachingEngineService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(CoachingEngineService.name);

  constructor(@Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase) {}

  // ── Initial state helpers ──────────────────────────────

  getInitialScores(difficulty: PR2Difficulty): PR2PrincipleScores {
    const base: PR2PrincipleScores = { trust: 55, purpose: 50, encourage: 50, listen: 50, end: 45 };
    if (difficulty === 'hard') {
      return { trust: 45, purpose: 40, encourage: 40, listen: 40, end: 35 };
    }
    if (difficulty === 'easy') {
      return { trust: 65, purpose: 60, encourage: 60, listen: 60, end: 55 };
    }
    return base;
  }

  getInitialRevealed(): PR2RevealedInfo {
    return {
      ratingGiven: false,
      ratingValue: null,
      factsGiven: false,
      factsList: [],
      selfAssessmentAsked: false,
      supportOffered: false,
      followupSet: false,
      structureExplained: false,
      effortRecognized: false,
      managerAdmittedFault: false,
    };
  }

  getInitialAntiPatterns(): PR2AntiPatterns {
    return {
      goingThroughMotions: 0,
      onlyCriticism: 0,
      feelingsNoFacts: 0,
      emptyPlatitudes: 0,
      onlyPastNoFuture: 0,
    };
  }

  getInitialMood(difficulty: PR2Difficulty): PR2NpcMood {
    return difficulty === 'hard' ? 'CURIOUS' : 'RELAXED';
  }

  // ── Session DB access (PR2 fields) ─────────────────────

  async getPR2Session(sessionId: string) {
    const [session] = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(coachingSessions)
      .where(eq(coachingSessions.id, sessionId));
    if (!session) return null;
    return {
      id: session.id,
      userId: session.userId,
      sceneId: session.sceneId,
      status: session.status,
      messages: (session.messages ?? []) as Array<{ id: string; role: string; content: string; timestamp: string }>,
      roundCount: session.roundCount ?? 0,
      difficulty: (session.difficulty ?? 'normal') as PR2Difficulty,
      selfAssessment: session.selfAssessment as Record<string, number> | null,
      principlesScores: (session.principlesScores as PR2PrincipleScores | null) ?? this.getInitialScores((session.difficulty as PR2Difficulty) ?? 'normal'),
      antiPatterns: (session.antiPatterns as PR2AntiPatterns | null) ?? this.getInitialAntiPatterns(),
      revealedInfo: (session.revealedInfo as PR2RevealedInfo | null) ?? this.getInitialRevealed(),
      phaseHistory: (session.phaseHistory as PR2PhaseHistoryEntry[] | null) ?? [{ phase: 'ATMOSPHERE' as PR2Phase, enteredAtRound: 0 }],
      completedAt: session.completedAt,
    };
  }

  async updatePR2Session(sessionId: string, data: {
    messages?: Array<{ id: string; role: string; content: string; timestamp: string }>;
    roundCount?: number;
    principlesScores?: PR2PrincipleScores;
    antiPatterns?: PR2AntiPatterns;
    revealedInfo?: PR2RevealedInfo;
    phaseHistory?: PR2PhaseHistoryEntry[];
    status?: string;
    completedAt?: Date;
  }) {
    const [updated] = await this.db
      .update(coachingSessions)
      .set({
        messages: data.messages,
        roundCount: data.roundCount,
        principlesScores: data.principlesScores,
        antiPatterns: data.antiPatterns,
        revealedInfo: data.revealedInfo,
        phaseHistory: data.phaseHistory,
        status: data.status,
        completedAt: data.completedAt,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(coachingSessions.id, sessionId))
      .returning();
    return updated;
  }

  // ── Intent Detection (20+ patterns) ────────────────────

  detectIntent(userMessage: string): UserIntent {
    const msg = userMessage.toLowerCase();
    const result: UserIntent = {
      type: 'neutral',
      scoreChanges: {},
      revealedUpdates: {},
      antiPatternHits: {},
    };

    // Empathy patterns → trust+2
    if (/我理解|辛苦了|不容易|我能感受到|你在意|我知道你很|谢谢你/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'empathy';
      result.scoreChanges = { trust: 2 };
      return result;
    }

    // Acknowledge effort → trust+1, encourage+1
    if (/你做得不错|你的努力|你付出|我看到你|认可|你一直在/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'acknowledge_effort';
      result.scoreChanges = { trust: 1, encourage: 1 };
      result.revealedUpdates = { effortRecognized: true };
      return result;
    }

    // Open question → encourage+2
    if (/你怎么看|你觉得|你想法|你认为|你怎么想|想听听|说说你|你感受|你有什么/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'open_question';
      result.scoreChanges = { encourage: 2 };
      result.revealedUpdates = { selfAssessmentAsked: true };
      return result;
    }

    // Self-assessment prompt → phase trigger
    if (/你觉得.*怎么样|自己评价|自我评估|对自己|打个分|表现如何|满意吗/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'self_assess_prompt';
      result.scoreChanges = { encourage: 2, purpose: 1 };
      result.revealedUpdates = { selfAssessmentAsked: true };
      return result;
    }

    // Explain purpose → purpose+3
    if (/今天.*谈|这次.*目的|聊聊.*因为|想了解|面谈.*目的|我们.*为什么/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'explain_purpose';
      result.scoreChanges = { purpose: 3 };
      result.revealedUpdates = { structureExplained: true };
      return result;
    }

    // Reflect feelings → listen+2
    if (/你感到|你好像|听起来你|我听到你|你是不是觉得|能感受/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'reflect_feeling';
      result.scoreChanges = { listen: 2 };
      return result;
    }

    // Paraphrase → listen+1
    if (/也就是说|你的意思是|所以你是说|换句话说|我理解你是/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'paraphrase';
      result.scoreChanges = { listen: 1 };
      return result;
    }

    // Set follow-up → end+3
    if (/下次|跟进|之后我们|约.*时间|下次谈|后续|回头再/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'set_followup';
      result.scoreChanges = { end: 3 };
      result.revealedUpdates = { followupSet: true };
      return result;
    }

    // Summary → end+2
    if (/总结一下|回顾一下|今天谈了|我们聊了|整理一下|概括/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'summary';
      result.scoreChanges = { end: 2 };
      return result;
    }

    // Offer support → trust+1
    if (/我可以帮|我支持你|需要什么帮助|我能做什么|一起想办法|我来协调/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'offer_support';
      result.scoreChanges = { trust: 1, encourage: 1 };
      result.revealedUpdates = { supportOffered: true };
      return result;
    }

    // Admit fault → trust+2
    if (/我也有责任|我做得不好|我的问题|我承认|我反思|我应该/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'admit_fault';
      result.scoreChanges = { trust: 2 };
      result.revealedUpdates = { managerAdmittedFault: true };
      return result;
    }

    // Small talk (casual chat, no performance keywords) → trust+1, encourage+1
    if (/最近|这周|这阵子|还好吗|怎么样|忙不忙|辛苦/.test(msg) && !/绩效|等级|评估|考核|评级/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'small_talk';
      result.scoreChanges = { trust: 1, encourage: 1 };
      return result;
    }

    // Compare with others → trust-2, encourage-2
    if (/你看.*别人|别人.*都|同期.*都|跟你一起.*进来|人家.*怎么|你看.*小王|你看.*小李/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'compare_others';
      result.scoreChanges = { trust: -2, encourage: -2 };
      return result;
    }

    // Threaten consequences → trust-5, encourage-3
    if (/再不.*就|如果.*还是.*c|下.*季度.*再|公司.*考虑|调整.*人员|pip|绩效.*改进.*计划|辞退|劝退|不适合.*这个.*岗位/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'threaten';
      result.scoreChanges = { trust: -5, encourage: -3 };
      return result;
    }

    // Distinguish effort from results → trust+2, purpose+1
    if (/努力.*但.*结果|不是.*不努力.*方向|肯定.*努力.*但|付出.*但.*质量|辛苦.*但.*标准|努力.*是.*真.*的.*但/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'distinguish_effort';
      result.scoreChanges = { trust: 2, purpose: 1 };
      result.revealedUpdates = { effortRecognized: true };
      return result;
    }

    // Give rating info → reveal rating
    if (/c级|C级|绩效.*c|c等|评估.*c|等级.*c|结果是c|评级.*c|就是c|拿了c|给了c|被评为c|c\+|C\+|c加|评分是|你的评级|绩效等级|这次评分/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'give_rating';
      result.scoreChanges = { purpose: 1 };
      result.revealedUpdates = { ratingGiven: true, ratingValue: 'C' };
      return result;
    }

    // Give specific facts → reveal facts
    if (/具体.*例子|比如|上个月|上周|那一次|项目.*延期|客户.*投诉|数据.*下降/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'give_facts';
      result.scoreChanges = { purpose: 1, listen: 1 };
      result.revealedUpdates = { factsGiven: true };
      return result;
    }

    // Command/dismiss → trust-3
    if (/你必须|你应该|不要|不许|听我的|按我说的|少废话|别说了/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'command';
      result.scoreChanges = { trust: -3, encourage: -2 };
      return result;
    }

    // Vague opening → purpose-2
    if (/嗯|好的|哦|行吧|随便聊|没什么/.test(msg) && msg.length < 15) {
      result.type = 'vague';
      result.scoreChanges = { purpose: -2 };
      result.antiPatternHits = { goingThroughMotions: 1 };
      return result;
    }

    // Generic encouragement without specifics → emptyPlatitudes
    if (/加油|你可以的|相信自己|继续努力|会好的|没问题的/.test(msg) && !/因为|具体|比如/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'empty_platitude';
      result.antiPatternHits = { emptyPlatitudes: 1 };
      return result;
    }

    // Dismiss feelings → listen-2
    if (/别想太多|没什么大不了|不至于|想开点|别纠结/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'dismiss_feeling';
      result.scoreChanges = { listen: -2, trust: -1 };
      return result;
    }

    // Only criticism → anti-pattern
    if (/不行|不够好|太差|失望|问题很多|哪里做得不好/.test(msg) && !/不错|好|可以|进步/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'criticism_only';
      result.scoreChanges = { trust: -1, encourage: -2 };
      result.antiPatternHits = { onlyCriticism: 1 };
      return result;
    }

    // Discuss future plans → goal setting
    if (/计划|目标|接下来|打算|未来|提升|改进|发展|学习/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'future_planning';
      result.scoreChanges = { end: 2 };
      return result;
    }

    // Wait/patience → encourage+1
    if (/不着急|慢慢来|想一想|没关系.*想好了再说/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'wait';
      result.scoreChanges = { encourage: 1, listen: 1 };
      return result;
    }

    // Goodbye / closing → end+3
    if (/再见|拜拜|今天就到这|先到这里|那我先走了|就这样吧|好的.*结束|结束了|今天.*到这里/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'goodbye';
      result.scoreChanges = { end: 3 };
      return result;
    }

    // Interrupt pattern → anti-pattern
    if (/打断|等等.*我说|先听我说|让我说/.test(msg)) {
      result.type = 'interrupt';
      result.scoreChanges = { listen: -2, encourage: -2 };
      return result;
    }

    return result;
  }

  // ── Score Update ───────────────────────────────────────

  updatePrincipleScores(
    current: PR2PrincipleScores,
    changes: Partial<PR2PrincipleScores>,
  ): PR2PrincipleScores {
    const next = { ...current };
    for (const [key, delta] of Object.entries(changes)) {
      const k = key as keyof PR2PrincipleScores;
      next[k] = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, next[k] + (delta ?? 0)));
    }
    return next;
  }

  // ── Phase Detection (content-based) ────────────────────

  detectPhase(
    messages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>,
    currentPhase: PR2Phase,
    revealedInfo: PR2RevealedInfo,
  ): PR2Phase {
    const lastUserMsg = [...messages].reverse().find(m => m.role === 'user');
    if (!lastUserMsg) return currentPhase;

    const msg = lastUserMsg.content.toLowerCase();

    // If already in GOAL_SETTING, stay
    if (currentPhase === 'GOAL_SETTING') return 'GOAL_SETTING';

    // Detect GOAL_SETTING: discussing future plans, follow-up dates
    if (currentPhase === 'DIAGNOSIS' || currentPhase === 'RATING_GIVEN') {
      if (/计划|目标|接下来.*怎么|打算|未来|提升|改进|跟进|下次/.test(msg)) {
        return 'GOAL_SETTING';
      }
    }

    // Detect DIAGNOSIS: discussing specific performance issues
    if (currentPhase === 'RATING_GIVEN' || currentPhase === 'SELF_ASSESS') {
      if (revealedInfo.ratingGiven && /为什么|原因|具体|问题|哪里|分析|改进/.test(msg)) {
        return 'DIAGNOSIS';
      }
    }

    // Detect RATING_GIVEN: NPC reveals C rating
    if (currentPhase === 'SELF_ASSESS') {
      if (revealedInfo.ratingGiven) {
        return 'RATING_GIVEN';
      }
    }

    // Detect SELF_ASSESS: user asks for self-evaluation
    if (currentPhase === 'ATMOSPHERE') {
      if (/你觉得.*怎么样|自己评价|自我评估|对自己|打个分|表现如何|满意吗|你怎么看.*工作/.test(msg)) {
        return 'SELF_ASSESS';
      }
    }

    return currentPhase;
  }

  // ── NPC Mood State Machine ─────────────────────────────

  getMoodDescription(mood: PR2NpcMood): string {
    const descriptions: Record<PR2NpcMood, string> = {
      RELAXED: '放松，对你的到来感到平常',
      CURIOUS: '好奇，想知道这次谈话的目的',
      SHOCKED: '惊讶，被信息触动，情绪波动中',
      EMOTIONAL: '情绪涌上来，正在消化感受',
      PROCESSING: '在思考，开始理性处理信息',
      CONSTRUCTIVE: '积极，愿意一起想办法解决问题',
      SHUTDOWN: '关闭了，不想继续对话',
    };
    return descriptions[mood] ?? '正在对话中';
  }

  // ── Anti-Pattern Detection ─────────────────────────────

  detectAntiPatterns(
    current: PR2AntiPatterns,
    intent: string,
    roundCount: number,
    revealedInfo: PR2RevealedInfo,
  ): PR2AntiPatterns {
    const next = { ...current };

    // goingThroughMotions: no empathy after 5+ rounds
    if (roundCount >= 5 && intent === 'neutral') {
      next.goingThroughMotions += 1;
    }

    // onlyCriticism: tracked via intent
    if (intent === 'criticism_only') {
      next.onlyCriticism += 1;
    }

    // feelingsNoFacts: discussing feelings without specific examples
    if (intent === 'reflect_feeling' && !revealedInfo.factsGiven) {
      next.feelingsNoFacts += 1;
    }

    // emptyPlatitudes: generic encouragement
    if (intent === 'empty_platitude') {
      next.emptyPlatitudes += 1;
    }

    // onlyPastNoFuture: past discussion in later phases without goal setting
    if (roundCount >= 8 && intent !== 'future_planning' && intent !== 'set_followup' && intent !== 'summary') {
      next.onlyPastNoFuture += 1;
    }

    return next;
  }

  getActiveAntiPatterns(ap: PR2AntiPatterns): string[] {
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    if (ap.goingThroughMotions >= 3) warnings.push('走流程：多轮对话缺少共情');
    if (ap.onlyCriticism >= 2) warnings.push('只有批评：缺少正面认可');
    if (ap.feelingsNoFacts >= 2) warnings.push('谈感受缺事实：缺少具体例子');
    if (ap.emptyPlatitudes >= 2) warnings.push('空话套话：鼓励缺少具体内容');
    if (ap.onlyPastNoFuture >= 3) warnings.push('只看过去：缺少未来目标规划');
    return warnings;
  }

  // ── Whisper Generation ─────────────────────────────────

  generateWhisper(
    phase: PR2Phase,
    roundCount: number,
    antiPatterns: PR2AntiPatterns,
    scores: PR2PrincipleScores,
  ): { text: string; type: 'hint' | 'warn' } | null {
    // Priority 1: Anti-pattern warnings
    const activeWarnings = this.getActiveAntiPatterns(antiPatterns);
    if (activeWarnings.length > 0) {
      return { text: `⚠ ${activeWarnings[0]}`, type: 'warn' };
    }

    // Priority 2: Low score warnings
    const lowScores = Object.entries(scores)
      .filter(([, v]) => v < 30)
      .map(([k]) => k);
    if (lowScores.length > 0) {
      const labelMap: Record<string, string> = {
        trust: '信任', purpose: '目的说明', encourage: '鼓励表达', listen: '倾听', end: '结束方式',
      };
      return { text: `${labelMap[lowScores[0]]}得分较低，试试换个方式`, type: 'warn' };
    }

    // Priority 3: Phase-based hints (every 3 rounds)
    if (roundCount % 3 === 0 && roundCount > 0) {
      const phaseHints: Record<PR2Phase, string> = {
        ATMOSPHERE: '试着问一个开放式问题，让她多说',
        SELF_ASSESS: '她可能对自己评价比你想象的高或低——先听完',
        RATING_GIVEN: '她会需要时间消化。别急着解释。',
        DIAGNOSIS: '给她具体的事实和数据，而不是笼统的评价',
        GOAL_SETTING: '一起制定一个具体的下一步计划',
      };
      return { text: phaseHints[phase], type: 'hint' };
    }

    return null;
  }

  // ── Phase label helpers ────────────────────────────────

  getPhaseLabel(phase: PR2Phase): string {
    const labels: Record<PR2Phase, string> = {
      ATMOSPHERE: '营造氛围',
      SELF_ASSESS: '引导自评',
      RATING_GIVEN: '绩效反馈',
      DIAGNOSIS: '绩效诊断',
      GOAL_SETTING: '下阶段目标',
    };
    return labels[phase] ?? phase;
  }

  getPhaseDescription(phase: PR2Phase): string {
    const descriptions: Record<PR2Phase, string> = {
      ATMOSPHERE: '先聊聊日常，让她放松下来。这场对话不是审判。',
      SELF_ASSESS: '引导她评价自己的工作。先听，别急着纠正。',
      RATING_GIVEN: '她已经知道了评级结果。给她时间消化。',
      DIAGNOSIS: '一起分析具体问题，给出事实和例子。',
      GOAL_SETTING: '制定具体的改进计划和跟进时间。',
    };
    return descriptions[phase] ?? '';
  }

  // ── Format prompt data for plugin ──────────────────────

  formatPrinciplesForPrompt(scores: PR2PrincipleScores): string {
    return `信任=${scores.trust} 目的=${scores.purpose} 鼓励=${scores.encourage} 倾听=${scores.listen} 结束=${scores.end}`;
  }

  formatRevealedForPrompt(info: PR2RevealedInfo): string {
    const parts: string[] = [];
    if (info.ratingGiven) parts.push(`已告知评级:${info.ratingValue ?? '未知'}`);
    if (info.factsGiven) parts.push(`已给出具体事实:${info.factsList.length}条`);
    if (info.selfAssessmentAsked) parts.push('已询问自评');
    if (info.supportOffered) parts.push('已提供支持');
    if (info.followupSet) parts.push('已设定跟进');
    if (info.structureExplained) parts.push('已说明面谈结构');
    if (info.effortRecognized) parts.push('已认可付出');
    if (info.managerAdmittedFault) parts.push('管理者已承认责任');
    return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join('；') : '暂无披露信息';
  }
}

import { Injectable, Logger, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  DRIZZLE_DATABASE,
  CapabilityService,
  type PostgresJsDatabase,
} from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import type {
  PR2FeedbackData,
  PR2PrincipleScores,
  PR2AntiPatterns,
  PR2SelfAssessment,
  PR2VerdictComparison,
  PR2BehaviorFinding,
  PR2FeedbackRecommendation,
  PR2PhaseHistoryEntry,
} from '@shared/coaching-pr2';

interface SessionData {
  messages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>;
  principlesScores: PR2PrincipleScores | null;
  antiPatterns: PR2AntiPatterns | null;
  selfAssessment: PR2SelfAssessment | null;
  phaseHistory: PR2PhaseHistoryEntry[] | null;
  revealedInfo: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  roundCount: number;
}

interface MessageAnalysis {
  type: string;
  principleKey: string;
  content: string;
  round: number;
}

@Injectable()
export class FeedbackAnalysisService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(FeedbackAnalysisService.name);

  private static readonly FEEDBACK_PLUGIN_ID = 'performance_interview_feedback_analysis_1';

  constructor(
    @Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase,
    private readonly capabilityService: CapabilityService,
  ) {}

  private readonly PRINCIPLE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
    trust: '建立信任',
    purpose: '说明目的',
    encourage: '鼓励表达',
    listen: '认真倾听',
    end: '积极结束',
  };

  private readonly PRINCIPLE_COURSES: Record<string, Array<{ id: string; name: string; url: string }>> = {
    trust: [
      { id: 'course_trust_01', name: '非暴力沟通（NVC）', url: '/courses' },
      { id: 'course_trust_02', name: '积极倾听的艺术', url: '/courses' },
    ],
    purpose: [
      { id: 'course_purpose_01', name: 'SMART目标设定', url: '/courses' },
      { id: 'course_purpose_02', name: 'GROW教练模型', url: '/courses' },
    ],
    encourage: [
      { id: 'course_encourage_01', name: '乔哈里视窗与开放沟通', url: '/courses' },
      { id: 'course_encourage_02', name: '提问技巧与引导', url: '/courses' },
    ],
    listen: [
      { id: 'course_listen_01', name: '积极倾听的四个层次', url: '/courses' },
      { id: 'course_listen_02', name: 'SBI反馈模型', url: '/courses' },
    ],
    end: [
      { id: 'course_end_01', name: 'PDCA循环与后续跟进', url: '/courses' },
      { id: 'course_end_02', name: '赋能式对话技巧', url: '/courses' },
    ],
  };

  findWeakestPrinciple(scores: PR2PrincipleScores): { key: string; label: string; score: number } {
    const entries = Object.entries(scores) as [string, number][];
    const [key, score] = entries.reduce((min, cur) => (cur[1] < min[1] ? cur : min), entries[0]);
    return { key, label: this.PRINCIPLE_LABELS[key] ?? key, score };
  }

  private findStrongestPrinciple(scores: PR2PrincipleScores): { key: string; label: string; score: number } {
    const entries = Object.entries(scores) as [string, number][];
    const [key, score] = entries.reduce((max, cur) => (cur[1] > max[1] ? cur : max), entries[0]);
    return { key, label: this.PRINCIPLE_LABELS[key] ?? key, score };
  }

  generateSelfComparison(
    scores: PR2PrincipleScores,
    selfAssessment: PR2SelfAssessment | null,
  ): PR2VerdictComparison[] {
    const keys: (keyof PR2PrincipleScores)[] = ['trust', 'purpose', 'encourage', 'listen', 'end'];
    return keys.map((key) => {
      const selfScore = selfAssessment?.[key] ?? null;
      const actualScore = scores[key] ?? 0;
      const gap = selfScore !== null ? actualScore - selfScore * 10 : 0;
      return {
        principle: this.PRINCIPLE_LABELS[key],
        selfScore: selfScore !== null ? selfScore * 10 : null,
        actualScore,
        gap,
      };
    });
  }

  generateVerdict(
    scores: PR2PrincipleScores,
    revealedInfo: Record<string, unknown> | null,
  ): string {
    const strongest = this.findStrongestPrinciple(scores);
    const weakest = this.findWeakestPrinciple(scores);
    const avg = (scores.trust + scores.purpose + scores.encourage + scores.listen + scores.end) / 5;

    const supportOffered = revealedInfo?.supportOffered === true;
    const followupSet = revealedInfo?.followupSet === true;
    const factsGiven = revealedInfo?.factsGiven === true;

    if (!supportOffered && !followupSet && factsGiven) {
      return `你的面谈有清晰的诊断——她用数据看懂了自己的差距。但收尾少了一个关键动作：具体的跟进约定。${strongest.label}是你的长板，发力点在${weakest.label}。`;
    }
    if (supportOffered && followupSet) {
      return `一场扎实的面谈。从氛围进、从约定出——她走的时候手里有一个能抓住的东西。五条原则接近均衡，${strongest.label}继续保持。`;
    }
    if (avg < 45) {
      return `这场面谈的冲击大于帮助。她知道了C，但不确定接下来怎么办。重点看${weakest.label}——这是你最大的杠杆。`;
    }
    return `几个关键行为到位了，一两个还差一点。她理解了自己的差距——但走出会议室时手里握的东西还不够具体。${strongest.label}做到了，${weakest.label}是下次的发力点。`;
  }

  generateStructureAnalysis(phaseHistory: PR2PhaseHistoryEntry[] | null, roundCount: number): string {
    if (!phaseHistory || phaseHistory.length === 0) {
      return `${roundCount}轮对话 · 建议按「营造氛围→引导自评→绩效诊断→下阶段目标」四段式结构进行面谈`;
    }
    const goalRounds = phaseHistory.filter((p) => p.phase === 'GOAL_SETTING').length;
    if (goalRounds > 0) {
      return `${roundCount}轮对话 · 目标阶段占${goalRounds}轮——你给了她方向`;
    }
    return `${roundCount}轮对话 · 诊断阶段占大头——绩效面谈的终点不是结论，是行动`;
  }

  async generateFeedback(
    session: SessionData,
    selfAssessment: PR2SelfAssessment | null,
  ): Promise<PR2FeedbackData> {
    const scores = session.principlesScores ?? { trust: 55, purpose: 50, encourage: 50, listen: 50, end: 45 };
    const antiPatterns = session.antiPatterns ?? { goingThroughMotions: 0, onlyCriticism: 0, feelingsNoFacts: 0, emptyPlatitudes: 0, onlyPastNoFuture: 0 };

    const verdict = this.generateVerdict(scores, session.revealedInfo);
    const selfComparison = this.generateSelfComparison(scores, selfAssessment);
    const structureAnalysis = this.generateStructureAnalysis(session.phaseHistory, session.roundCount);
    const weakest = this.findWeakestPrinciple(scores);
    const strongest = this.findStrongestPrinciple(scores);
    const recommendation: PR2FeedbackRecommendation = {
      weakestPrinciple: weakest.label,
      weakestKey: weakest.key,
      courses: this.PRINCIPLE_COURSES[weakest.key] ?? [],
    };

    let behaviorReview: PR2BehaviorFinding[];
    let consolidatedInsight: string;
    let pattern: string;
    let insight: string;
    let reflectionQuestion: string;

    const aiResult = await this.analyzeWithAI(session, scores, antiPatterns, selfAssessment);
    if (aiResult) {
      behaviorReview = aiResult.behaviorReview.length > 0
        ? aiResult.behaviorReview
        : this.generateBehaviorAnalysis(session.messages, scores, antiPatterns);
      consolidatedInsight = aiResult.consolidatedInsight || this.generateConsolidatedInsight(session.messages, scores, antiPatterns);
      pattern = aiResult.pattern || this.generatePatternNarrative(scores, antiPatterns, session.messages);
      insight = aiResult.insight || this.generateInsightDeep(scores, antiPatterns, weakest);
      reflectionQuestion = aiResult.reflectionQuestion || this.generateReflectionQuestion(weakest, session.messages);
    } else {
      behaviorReview = this.generateBehaviorAnalysis(session.messages, scores, antiPatterns);
      consolidatedInsight = this.generateConsolidatedInsight(session.messages, scores, antiPatterns);
      pattern = this.generatePatternNarrative(scores, antiPatterns, session.messages);
      insight = this.generateInsightDeep(scores, antiPatterns, weakest);
      reflectionQuestion = this.generateReflectionQuestion(weakest, session.messages);
    }

    return {
      overall: { principlesScores: scores, verdict, selfComparison, structureAnalysis },
      insight: { pattern, insight, reflectionQuestion },
      behaviorReview,
      recommendation,
      sessionRoundCount: session.roundCount,
      consolidatedInsight,
      antiPatternsData: antiPatterns,
    };
  }

  private async analyzeWithAI(
    session: SessionData,
    scores: PR2PrincipleScores,
    antiPatterns: PR2AntiPatterns,
    selfAssessment: PR2SelfAssessment | null,
  ): Promise<{
    behaviorReview: PR2BehaviorFinding[];
    consolidatedInsight: string;
    pattern: string;
    insight: string;
    reflectionQuestion: string;
  } | null> {
    try {
      const userMessages = session.messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'user');
      if (userMessages.length < 2) {
        this.logger.log('对话轮次不足，跳过AI分析');
        return null;
      }

      const dialogueLines = session.messages
        .filter((m) => m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'ai')
        .map((m) => {
          const label = m.role === 'user' ? '管理者' : '管理者B';
          const cleaned = m.content.replace(/\n/g, ' ').trim();
          return `${label}: ${cleaned}`;
        })
        .join('\n');

      const scoresStr = `建立信任: ${scores.trust}, 说明目的: ${scores.purpose}, 鼓励表达: ${scores.encourage}, 认真倾听: ${scores.listen}, 积极结束: ${scores.end}`;

      const antiStr = `走过场: ${antiPatterns.goingThroughMotions}, 只有批评: ${antiPatterns.onlyCriticism}, 凭感觉: ${antiPatterns.feelingsNoFacts}, 空泛鼓励: ${antiPatterns.emptyPlatitudes}, 只看过去: ${antiPatterns.onlyPastNoFuture}`;

      const selfStr = selfAssessment
        ? `建立信任: ${selfAssessment.trust ?? '未评'}, 说明目的: ${selfAssessment.purpose ?? '未评'}, 鼓励表达: ${selfAssessment.encourage ?? '未评'}, 认真倾听: ${selfAssessment.listen ?? '未评'}, 积极结束: ${selfAssessment.end ?? '未评'}`
        : '未填写自评';

      const phaseStr = session.phaseHistory
        ? session.phaseHistory.map((p) => `${p.phase}(第${p.enteredAtRound}轮${p.exitedAtRound ? `→第${p.exitedAtRound}轮` : '→结束'})`).join(' → ')
        : '无阶段记录';

      const result = await this.capabilityService
        .load(FeedbackAnalysisService.FEEDBACK_PLUGIN_ID)
        .call('textGenerate', {
          dialogue_record: dialogueLines,
          five_principles_score: scoresStr,
          anti_pattern_data: antiStr,
          self_assessment_baseline: selfStr,
          process_stage_history: phaseStr,
        });

      const output = result as { content?: string; response?: string };
      const rawText = output.content || output.response || '';
      if (!rawText) {
        this.logger.warn('AI反馈分析返回空内容');
        return null;
      }

      return this.parseAIResponse(rawText);
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.error(`AI反馈分析失败，降级为规则分析: ${String(err)}`);
      return null;
    }
  }

  private parseAIResponse(rawText: string): {
    behaviorReview: PR2BehaviorFinding[];
    consolidatedInsight: string;
    pattern: string;
    insight: string;
    reflectionQuestion: string;
  } | null {
    try {
      const jsonMatch = rawText.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
      if (!jsonMatch) {
        this.logger.warn('AI返回内容中未找到JSON');
        return null;
      }

      const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]);

      const findings: PR2BehaviorFinding[] = [];
      const discoveries = parsed.behavior_discoveries;
      if (Array.isArray(discoveries)) {
        for (let i = 0; i < discoveries.length; i++) {
          const d = discoveries[i];
          if (!d.dialogue_original || !d.behavior_analysis) continue;

          const finding: PR2BehaviorFinding = {
            type: i < Math.ceil(discoveries.length / 2) ? 'good' : 'improve',
            quote: String(d.dialogue_original).slice(0, 120),
            note: [
              String(d.behavior_analysis),
              d.impact ? String(d.impact) : '',
            ].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
          };

          if (d.alternative) {
            finding.alternative = String(d.alternative);
            finding.forkActual = String(d.dialogue_original).slice(0, 80);
            finding.forkAlternative = String(d.alternative);
          }

          findings.push(finding);
        }
      }

      const reflectionQuestions = Array.isArray(parsed.reflection_questions)
        ? parsed.reflection_questions.map((q: string) => String(q)).join('\n')
        : '';

      return {
        behaviorReview: findings,
        consolidatedInsight: parsed.methodology_observation ? `方法论观察：${String(parsed.methodology_observation)}` : '',
        pattern: parsed.pattern_description ? String(parsed.pattern_description) : '',
        insight: parsed.deep_insight ? String(parsed.deep_insight) : '',
        reflectionQuestion: reflectionQuestions,
      };
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.error(`AI反馈JSON解析失败: ${String(err)}`);
      return null;
    }
  }

  private analyzeMessages(messages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>): MessageAnalysis[] {
    const results: MessageAnalysis[] = [];
    const userMessages = messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'user');

    userMessages.forEach((msg, idx) => {
      const round = idx + 1;
      const text = msg.content;

      if (/你觉得|你怎么看|你的想法|你认为|你怎么想|你来说|你的感受|你觉得呢|说说你的/.test(text)) {
        results.push({ type: 'open_question', principleKey: 'encourage', content: text, round });
      }
      if (/我理解|我能感受|确实不容易|你说得有道理|我听到你了|我懂|这确实|换作是我/.test(text)) {
        results.push({ type: 'empathy', principleKey: 'trust', content: text, round });
      }
      if (/\d+个|\d+次|\d+%|上周|上个月|具体|数据|返工率|方案/.test(text) && /你|这个|这次/.test(text)) {
        results.push({ type: 'specific_facts', principleKey: 'purpose', content: text, round });
      }
      if (/不行|不够|问题很大|太差|做不好|很失望|不行啊|这样不行/.test(text)) {
        results.push({ type: 'criticism', principleKey: 'encourage', content: text, round });
      }
      if (/加油|你可以的|没问题的|相信自己|你能行|别担心/.test(text) && !/具体|因为|比如/.test(text)) {
        results.push({ type: 'empty_encouragement', principleKey: 'listen', content: text, round });
      }
      if (/下次|计划|目标|跟进|约定|时间安排|什么时候|我们定|回头/.test(text)) {
        results.push({ type: 'goal_setting', principleKey: 'end', content: text, round });
      }
      if (/你好|最近怎么样|聊聊|坐|轻松|别紧张|随便聊/.test(text) && round <= 2) {
        results.push({ type: 'warm_opening', principleKey: 'trust', content: text, round });
      }
      if (/但是|不过|可是|话说回来/.test(text) && /别人|其他人|同事|主管|经理|总监|项目总/.test(text)) {
        results.push({ type: 'comparison', principleKey: 'trust', content: text, round });
      }
      if (/我复述一下|你的意思是|你说的是|让我确认|所以你是说/.test(text)) {
        results.push({ type: 'paraphrase', principleKey: 'listen', content: text, round });
      }
      if (/我注意到|我看到|我发现|我观察/.test(text)) {
        results.push({ type: 'observation', principleKey: 'listen', content: text, round });
      }
    });

    return results;
  }

  private generateBehaviorAnalysis(
    messages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>,
    scores: PR2PrincipleScores,
    antiPatterns: PR2AntiPatterns,
  ): PR2BehaviorFinding[] {
    const findings: PR2BehaviorFinding[] = [];
    const analysis = this.analyzeMessages(messages);
    const userMessages = messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'user');

    const warmOpenings = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'warm_opening');
    if (warmOpenings.length > 0) {
      const msg = warmOpenings[0];
      findings.push({
        type: 'good',
        quote: this.truncateQuote(msg.content),
        note: '以轻松的方式开场，有助于缓解紧张氛围。在绩效面谈中，前2分钟的氛围决定了对方是否愿意说真话。',
        principleKey: 'trust',
        principleLabel: '建立信任',
      });
    } else if (userMessages.length > 0 && scores.trust >= 55) {
      findings.push({
        type: 'good',
        quote: this.truncateQuote(userMessages[0].content),
        note: '开场直接进入对话，没有过多寒暄。对于熟悉的管理关系，这也是一种信任的表现——她知道你不会浪费时间。',
        principleKey: 'trust',
        principleLabel: '建立信任',
      });
    }

    const openQuestions = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'open_question');
    if (openQuestions.length > 0) {
      const msg = openQuestions[0];
      findings.push({
        type: 'good',
        quote: this.truncateQuote(msg.content),
        note: `第${msg.round}轮使用了开放式提问，把话语权交给了对方。绩效面谈中，管理者说的比例不应超过40%——你在这一点上做得不错。`,
        principleKey: 'encourage',
        principleLabel: '鼓励表达',
      });
    }

    const empathyExprs = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'empathy');
    if (empathyExprs.length > 0) {
      const msg = empathyExprs[0];
      findings.push({
        type: 'good',
        quote: this.truncateQuote(msg.content),
        note: '表达了共情和理解。当对方感到被理解时，她更容易接受后续的反馈——即使反馈内容并不轻松。',
        principleKey: 'trust',
        principleLabel: '建立信任',
      });
    }

    const specificFacts = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'specific_facts');
    if (specificFacts.length > 0) {
      const msg = specificFacts[0];
      findings.push({
        type: 'good',
        quote: this.truncateQuote(msg.content),
        note: '引用了具体的数据和事实。SBI反馈模型的核心就是用事实说话——"你上周三次迟到"比"你最近不在状态"有说服力得多。',
        principleKey: 'purpose',
        principleLabel: '说明目的',
      });
    }

    const paraphrases = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'paraphrase');
    if (paraphrases.length > 0) {
      const msg = paraphrases[0];
      findings.push({
        type: 'good',
        quote: this.truncateQuote(msg.content),
        note: '使用了复述确认的技巧。这不仅让对方感到被听到，也帮你确认了自己理解得对不对——避免"我以为你说了X"的误解。',
        principleKey: 'listen',
        principleLabel: '认真倾听',
      });
    }

    const observations = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'observation');
    if (observations.length > 0) {
      const msg = observations[0];
      findings.push({
        type: 'good',
        quote: this.truncateQuote(msg.content),
        note: '以"我注意到"开头分享观察，而不是直接下判断。这是非暴力沟通（NVC）的核心技巧——区分观察和评价。',
        principleKey: 'listen',
        principleLabel: '认真倾听',
      });
    }

    const goalSettings = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'goal_setting');
    if (goalSettings.length > 0) {
      const msg = goalSettings[0];
      findings.push({
        type: 'good',
        quote: this.truncateQuote(msg.content),
        note: '提到了具体的后续安排。PDCA循环的关键不在于"计划了什么"，而在于"是否有明确的检查节点"——你做到了。',
        principleKey: 'end',
        principleLabel: '积极结束',
      });
    }

    const criticisms = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'criticism');
    if (criticisms.length > 0 || antiPatterns.onlyCriticism > 0) {
      const msg = criticisms[0];
      const actualQuote = msg ? this.truncateQuote(msg.content) : '部分对话中批评性语言偏多';
      findings.push({
        type: 'improve',
        quote: actualQuote,
        note: '直接的否定性语言会让对方进入防御模式。一旦防御机制启动，后续的理性分析就很难被听进去了。',
        alternative: '试试"三明治反馈法"：先肯定她的努力和投入（这是事实），再用数据指出差距（这也是事实），最后表达你对她能改进的信心。',
        principleKey: 'encourage',
        principleLabel: '鼓励表达',
        forkActual: msg ? this.truncateQuote(msg.content) : '直接的否定评价',
        forkAlternative: '"我注意到你在这个方案上花了很多时间。同时，有几个细节我想和你一起看看……"',
      });
    }

    const emptyEncourages = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'empty_encouragement');
    if (emptyEncourages.length > 0 || antiPatterns.emptyPlatitudes > 1) {
      const msg = emptyEncourages[0];
      const actualQuote = msg ? this.truncateQuote(msg.content) : '部分鼓励缺乏具体内容';
      findings.push({
        type: 'improve',
        quote: actualQuote,
        note: '没有具体内容的鼓励，听起来像客套。"加油"不如"你上次那个方案里数据分析的部分做得很扎实"——后者让她知道你真的在关注。',
        alternative: '用"具体行为+正面影响"的方式肯定：指出她哪个具体行为做得好，以及这个行为带来了什么正面结果。',
        principleKey: 'listen',
        principleLabel: '认真倾听',
        forkActual: msg ? this.truncateQuote(msg.content) : '"加油，你可以的"',
        forkAlternative: '"你上次做的那个用户调研，问题设计得很具体，拿到了很有价值的反馈。这个能力是可以迁移到方案撰写上的。"',
      });
    }

    const comparisons = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'comparison');
    if (comparisons.length > 0) {
      const msg = comparisons[0];
      findings.push({
        type: 'improve',
        quote: this.truncateQuote(msg.content),
        note: '拿其他同事做比较会破坏信任感。她听到的不是"你应该学习"，而是"你觉得别人比我好"——这会让她站到对立面。',
        alternative: '用她自己的进步做比较："你上个月的数据比上上个月好了不少，但这个月又有所回落"——纵向对比比横向对比更有效。',
        principleKey: 'trust',
        principleLabel: '建立信任',
        forkActual: this.truncateQuote(msg.content),
        forkAlternative: '"你自己跟上个月比一比，是不是有些方面其实在退步？"',
      });
    }

    if (antiPatterns.feelingsNoFacts > 1) {
      findings.push({
        type: 'improve',
        quote: '部分反馈缺少具体事实支撑',
        note: '"感觉你最近不在状态"不如"上周三次会议你都迟到了"有说服力。没有事实支撑的反馈，对方有理由不接受。',
        alternative: '用SBI模型（情境-行为-影响）组织反馈：在什么情境下，你做了什么行为，产生了什么影响。让评价有据可循。',
        principleKey: 'purpose',
        principleLabel: '说明目的',
        forkActual: '"我觉得你最近状态不太好"',
        forkAlternative: '"上周二的项目评审会上（情境），你的方案有三处数据错误（行为），导致客户对我们的专业度产生了质疑（影响）"',
      });
    }

    if (scores.end < 55 && goalSettings.length === 0) {
      findings.push({
        type: 'improve',
        quote: '面谈结束阶段较为仓促',
        note: '缺少明确的后续行动计划和跟进安排。一场绩效面谈如果没有具体的行动约定，走出会议室后她就不知道该怎么做了。',
        alternative: '结束时确认三件事：① 双方认可的1-2个改进方向 ② 具体的行动步骤和时间节点 ③ 下次检查进展的日期。让她走出去时手里有一个能抓住的东西。',
        principleKey: 'end',
        principleLabel: '积极结束',
        forkActual: '"好，今天我们就聊到这里"',
        forkAlternative: '"我们来定一下：下周三下午3点，你带着改好的方案来找我。重点检查数据准确性和格式规范这两项。可以吗？"',
      });
    }

    if (findings.filter((f) => f.type === 'good').length === 0) {
      const firstUser = userMessages.length > 0 ? userMessages[0] : null;
      findings.unshift({
        type: 'good',
        quote: firstUser ? this.truncateQuote(firstUser.content) : '面谈对话',
        note: '你完成了整场面谈，没有回避困难话题。愿意坐下来认真谈绩效本身，就是一种管理勇气。',
        principleKey: 'trust',
        principleLabel: '建立信任',
      });
    }

    return findings;
  }

  private generateConsolidatedInsight(
    messages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>,
    scores: PR2PrincipleScores,
    antiPatterns: PR2AntiPatterns,
  ): string {
    const analysis = this.analyzeMessages(messages);
    const userMsgCount = messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'user').length;
    const questionCount = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'open_question').length;
    const empathyCount = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'empathy').length;
    const factCount = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'specific_facts').length;

    const parts: string[] = [];

    if (questionCount >= 2) {
      parts.push('你多次使用了开放式提问，把话语权交给了对方');
    } else if (questionCount === 1) {
      parts.push('你使用了一次开放式提问');
    } else {
      parts.push('整场面谈中你较少使用开放式提问');
    }

    if (empathyCount > 0) {
      parts.push('在关键节点表达了共情');
    }

    if (factCount > 0) {
      parts.push('引用了具体数据来支撑反馈');
    }

    const totalAnti = Object.values(antiPatterns).reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0);
    if (totalAnti > 3) {
      parts.push('但部分时刻出现了批评性语言偏多或鼓励过于空泛的情况');
    }

    if (scores.end < 55) {
      parts.push('收尾阶段缺少具体的行动约定');
    }

    return `方法论观察：${parts.join('，')}。${userMsgCount}轮对话中，你说的比例${userMsgCount > 6 ? '偏高，下次试试多问少说' : '相对合理'}。`;
  }

  private generatePatternNarrative(
    scores: PR2PrincipleScores,
    antiPatterns: PR2AntiPatterns,
    messages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>,
  ): string {
    const strongest = this.findStrongestPrinciple(scores);
    const weakest = this.findWeakestPrinciple(scores);
    const totalAnti = Object.values(antiPatterns).reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0);
    const analysis = this.analyzeMessages(messages);
    const questionCount = analysis.filter((a) => a.type === 'open_question').length;

    if (totalAnti > 5) {
      return `在本次面谈中，你的沟通模式偏向于「说教式」面谈。${strongest.label}做得相对到位（${strongest.score}分），但你说的比例明显高于她说的。当她试图解释时，你倾向于打断或直接给出结论——这个模式让她越来越沉默，而你越来越需要自己"填满"对话。`;
    }

    if (scores.encourage > 65 && questionCount >= 2) {
      return `你在面谈中展现了一个值得保持的模式：先问、再听、最后给反馈。${strongest.label}是你的强项（${strongest.score}分），说明你善于用提问引导对方思考，而不是直接给答案。这个模式在大多数场景下都有效——除了当她情绪特别强烈的时候。`;
    }

    return `你在面谈中展现了一定的管理意识。${strongest.label}是你的强项（${strongest.score}分），说明你善于${this.getPrincipleBehavior(strongest.key)}。但有一个模式值得注意：你倾向于在她还没说完的时候就开始给建议。${weakest.label}（${weakest.score}分）的不足，往往不是因为你不知道该说什么，而是因为你太快进入了"解决问题"模式。`;
  }

  private generateInsightDeep(
    scores: PR2PrincipleScores,
    antiPatterns: PR2AntiPatterns,
    weakest: { key: string; label: string; score: number },
  ): string {
    if (antiPatterns.onlyCriticism > 2) {
      return '过多的批评会关闭沟通通道。非暴力沟通（NVC）的核心不是"不说负面话"，而是区分观察和评价——"你上周交了3份有错误的方案"是观察，"你做事不认真"是评价。前者她可以接受，后者她会反击。';
    }
    if (antiPatterns.emptyPlatitudes > 2) {
      return '空洞的鼓励不如具体的肯定。SBI模型（情境-行为-影响）不仅适用于批评，也适用于表扬——"在项目评审会上（情境），你的数据可视化做得很清楚（行为），客户当场说 impressed（影响）"比"做得不错"有价值得多。';
    }
    if (weakest.key === 'listen') {
      return '倾听不只是"不打断"。积极倾听包含四个层次：下载式（只听自己想听的）、事实式（注意新信息）、同理式（感受对方情绪）、生成式（听到对方没说出口的东西）。下一次试试在对方说完后先说"我理解你的意思是……"，然后再说你的想法。';
    }
    if (weakest.key === 'end') {
      return '绩效面谈的价值不在于"谈了什么"，而在于"谈完之后她做了什么"。PDCA循环告诉我们：没有Check和Act的Plan等于没有Plan。一个具体的跟进日期（"下周三下午3点"）比一句模糊的"随时找我"有用得多。';
    }
    return `${weakest.label}的提升关键在于：关注下属的真实感受和需求，而非仅仅完成任务流程。管理面谈的价值不在"说了什么"，而在"被听到什么"。`;
  }

  private generateReflectionQuestion(
    weakest: { key: string; label: string },
    messages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>,
  ): string {
    const questions: Record<string, string> = {
      trust: '回想这次面谈，她是否在你面前展现了真实的脆弱？如果没有，是什么让她选择了"安全"的回答？',
      purpose: '面谈开始时，她是否清楚知道这次面谈的目的？你的开场是否让她感到安心而非紧张？',
      encourage: '在这次面谈中，你说的和她说的比例大约是多少？你是否给了足够的空间让她主动表达？',
      listen: '她说的哪些话让你产生了共鸣？你是否让她知道你"听到了"？',
      end: '面谈结束时，她是带着方向感离开的，还是仅仅"结束了谈话"？',
    };
    return questions[weakest.key] ?? `在下次面谈中，你准备用什么方式提升${weakest.label}的表现？`;
  }

  private truncateQuote(content: string): string {
    const cleaned = content.replace(/\n/g, ' ').trim();
    if (cleaned.length <= 80) return cleaned;
    return cleaned.slice(0, 77) + '...';
  }

  private getPrincipleBehavior(key: string): string {
    const behaviors: Record<string, string> = {
      trust: '营造安全的沟通氛围，让下属敢于表达真实想法',
      purpose: '清晰地传达面谈目的，让对话有方向感',
      encourage: '用开放式提问激发下属的主动思考',
      listen: '用心倾听并准确回应，让对方感受到被理解',
      end: '以积极的行动承诺收尾，确保面谈成果落地',
    };
    return behaviors[key] ?? '有效管理沟通';
  }
}

===FILE:./server/modules/coaching/pr2/pr2-chat.controller.ts===
import { Controller, Post, Patch, Body, Req, Logger, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NeedLogin, CapabilityService } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { CoachingEngineService } from './coaching-engine.service';
import type {
  PR2SendMessageRequest,
  PR2SendMessageResponse,
  PR2SaveSessionRequest,
  PR2EndSessionResponse,
  PR2Phase,
  PR2NpcMood,
  PR2PhaseHistoryEntry,
} from '@shared/coaching-pr2';

const NPC_PLUGIN_ID = 'performance_interview_xiaolin_npc_reply_generate_1';

@Controller('api/coaching/pr2')
export class PR2ChatController {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(PR2ChatController.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly engine: CoachingEngineService,
    @Inject() private readonly capabilityService: CapabilityService,
  ) {}

  @Post('send-message')
  @NeedLogin()
  async sendMessage(
    @Req() req,
    @Body() body: PR2SendMessageRequest,
  ): Promise<PR2SendMessageResponse> {
    const { userId } = req.userContext;
    const { sessionId, message } = body;

    // 1. Load session from DB
    const session = await this.engine.getPR2Session(sessionId);
    if (!session || session.userId !== userId) {
      this.logger.error(`Session not found or unauthorized: ${sessionId}`);
      return {
        npcReply: '会话未找到，请重新开始。',
        phase: 'ATMOSPHERE',
        npcMood: 'RELAXED',
        principlesScores: this.engine.getInitialScores('normal'),
        whisper: null,
        whisperType: null,
        round: 0,
      };
    }

    // 2. Detect intent & update state
    const intent = this.engine.detectIntent(message);
    const newScores = this.engine.updatePrincipleScores(session.principlesScores, intent.scoreChanges);
    const newRevealed = { ...session.revealedInfo, ...intent.revealedUpdates };
    const currentPhase: PR2Phase = session.phaseHistory.length > 0
      ? session.phaseHistory[session.phaseHistory.length - 1].phase
      : 'ATMOSPHERE';

    const messagesSoFar = [
      ...session.messages,
      { id: `msg_${Date.now()}_user`, role: 'user', content: message, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
    ];

    const detectedPhase = this.engine.detectPhase(
      messagesSoFar.map(m => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content })),
      currentPhase,
      newRevealed,
    );

    // Update phase history
    const phaseHistory: PR2PhaseHistoryEntry[] = [...session.phaseHistory];
    if (detectedPhase !== currentPhase) {
      // Close previous phase
      if (phaseHistory.length > 0 && !phaseHistory[phaseHistory.length - 1].exitedAtRound) {
        phaseHistory[phaseHistory.length - 1].exitedAtRound = session.roundCount + 1;
      }
      phaseHistory.push({ phase: detectedPhase, enteredAtRound: session.roundCount + 1 });
    }

    const newRound = session.roundCount + 1;
    // Read previous mood from last AI message metadata, or use initial
    const lastAiMsg = [...session.messages].reverse().find(m => m.role === 'ai');
    const prevMood: PR2NpcMood = (lastAiMsg as Record<string, unknown>)?.npcMood as PR2NpcMood
      ?? this.engine.getInitialMood(session.difficulty);
    const newMood: PR2NpcMood = this.engine.updateNpcMood(intent.type, prevMood);

    // 3. Detect anti-patterns
    const newAntiPatterns = this.engine.detectAntiPatterns(
      session.antiPatterns,
      intent.type,
      newRound,
      newRevealed,
    );

    // 4. Generate NPC reply via AI plugin (with conversation history for context)
    const recentHistory = messagesSoFar.slice(-8).map(m => ({
      role: m.role,
      content: m.content,
    }));
    const npcReply = await this.callNpcPlugin(message, newMood, detectedPhase, newScores, newRevealed, recentHistory);

    // 5. Generate whisper hint
    const whisperResult = this.engine.generateWhisper(detectedPhase, newRound, newAntiPatterns, newScores);

    // 6. Save updated session
    const aiMessage = { id: `msg_${Date.now()}_ai`, role: 'ai', content: npcReply, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), npcMood: newMood };
    const allMessages = [...messagesSoFar, aiMessage];

    await this.engine.updatePR2Session(sessionId, {
      messages: allMessages as Array<{ id: string; role: string; content: string; timestamp: string }>,
      roundCount: newRound,
      principlesScores: newScores,
      antiPatterns: newAntiPatterns,
      revealedInfo: newRevealed,
      phaseHistory,
    });

    return {
      npcReply,
      phase: detectedPhase,
      npcMood: newMood,
      principlesScores: newScores,
      whisper: whisperResult?.text ?? null,
      whisperType: whisperResult?.type ?? null,
      round: newRound,
    };
  }

  @Patch('save-session')
  @NeedLogin()
  async saveSession(@Req() req, @Body() body: PR2SaveSessionRequest) {
    const { userId } = req.userContext;
    const session = await this.engine.getPR2Session(body.sessionId);
    if (!session || session.userId !== userId) {
      return { success: false };
    }
    await this.engine.updatePR2Session(body.sessionId, {
      principlesScores: body.principlesScores,
      antiPatterns: body.antiPatterns,
      revealedInfo: body.revealedInfo,
      phaseHistory: body.phaseHistory,
    });
    return { success: true };
  }

  @Post('end-session')
  @NeedLogin()
  async endSession(
    @Req() req,
    @Body() body: { sessionId: string },
  ): Promise<PR2EndSessionResponse> {
    const { userId } = req.userContext;
    const session = await this.engine.getPR2Session(body.sessionId);
    if (!session || session.userId !== userId) {
      return { feedbackId: '', sessionId: body.sessionId };
    }
    await this.engine.updatePR2Session(body.sessionId, {
      status: 'completed',
      completedAt: new Date(),
    });
    return { feedbackId: body.sessionId, sessionId: body.sessionId };
  }

  // ── Private helpers ────────────────────────────────────

  private static readonly NPC_CHARACTER_DATA = `【管理者B人物设定 — 最高优先级】
身份：管理者B，25岁，2022届通用胜任力，你带了她两年。
性格：外向、对工作很上心、同事都喜欢她。
已知事实（她不知道这些统计数据）：
- 上半年交付14个方案，其中5个需要别人帮改才能过
- 返工率36%（全组平均仅11%）
- 细节错误8处，有3次是同事补位才完成
- 主管常夸她"进步很大"，同事帮她改方案说"没事下次注意"
核心矛盾：她以为自己至少是B，实际绩效评级是C。
隐藏信息：同事们关系好，没人当面说过她的问题。

【信息渐进披露规则】
- 管理者未提及评级前 → 她不知道今天是绩效面谈，以为普通沟通，只聊最近工作
- 管理者引导自评 → 她觉得自己做得不错，期待至少B
- 管理者说出C → 震惊，需要具体理由，不接受笼统评价
- 管理者给出具体数据（如返工率36%）→ 第一次听到这些数据，震惊+反思"为什么没人早告诉我"
- 管理者认可努力+给出改进方向 → 转为建设性，愿意一起想办法
- 管理者威胁/拿她和别人比 → 关闭，沉默或简短回复`;

  private static readonly V7_BEHAVIOR_RULES = `
【V7行为约束 — 生成回复时必须遵守】
1. 你是管理者B，不是AI助手。用第一人称回复，带情绪和细节。
2. 回复中必须包含具体的行为描写（如"她咬了咬嘴唇""她看着窗外""她攥紧了衣角"）。
3. 不要笼统地说"我会努力"——要有具体的困惑或想法。
4. 如果管理者给出具体数据（如返工率36%），你要表现出"第一次听到这个数据"的反应。
5. 如果管理者只说空话（"加油""你可以的"），你要表现出敷衍感或追问具体怎么做。
6. 如果管理者拿你跟别人比或威胁你，你会关闭（沉默或极简回复）。
7. 如果管理者肯定你的努力但指出方向问题，你会从情绪转为思考。
8. 绝不主动提及自己不知道的绩效数据（返工率、错误数等），除非管理者先说出来。
9. 每次回复控制在2-4句话，不要太长。包含一段场景描写（括号内的动作/表情）。
10. 提到同事时一律使用正式职业称呼（如"主管""经理""总监""项目总"），禁止使用"X哥""X姐""X叔""X姨"等随意称呼，不要编造具体人名。`;


  private async callNpcPlugin(
    managerInput: string,
    npcMood: PR2NpcMood,
    phase: PR2Phase,
    scores: import('@shared/coaching-pr2').PR2PrincipleScores,
    revealedInfo: import('@shared/coaching-pr2').PR2RevealedInfo,
    conversationHistory?: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>,
  ): Promise<string> {
    try {
      const parts: string[] = [];

      if (conversationHistory && conversationHistory.length > 2) {
        const historyLines = conversationHistory.slice(0, -1).map(h => {
          const label = h.role === 'user' ? '管理者' : '管理者B';
          return `${label}: ${h.content}`;
        });
        parts.push(`[对话上下文]\n${historyLines.join('\n')}`);
      }

      parts.push(`[当前输入]\n管理者: ${managerInput}`);
      parts.push(PR2ChatController.NPC_CHARACTER_DATA);
      parts.push(PR2ChatController.V7_BEHAVIOR_RULES);
      parts.push('请根据以上对话上下文和角色设定生成管理者B的回复，不要重复之前已经说过的内容。');

      const enrichedInput = parts.join('\n\n');

      const result = await this.capabilityService
        .load(NPC_PLUGIN_ID)
        .call('textGenerate', {
          manager_input: enrichedInput,
          current_dialogue_state: npcMood,
          current_process_stage: phase,
          five_principles_score: this.engine.formatPrinciplesForPrompt(scores),
          disclosed_info_status: this.engine.formatRevealedForPrompt(revealedInfo),
        });
      const output = result as { content?: string; response?: string };
      return output.content || output.response || '（管理者B沉默了一下）';
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.error(`NPC plugin call failed: ${String(err)}`);
      return '（管理者B看着你，等你继续说）';
    }
  }
}

import { Controller, Get, Post, Body, Param, Req, Logger, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NeedLogin, DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { eq, and, desc, ne } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { coachingSessions } from '@server/database/schema';
import { FeedbackAnalysisService } from './feedback-analysis.service';
import { PracticeCommitService } from '@server/modules/practice-commit/practice-commit.service';
import type {
  PR2FeedbackData,
  PR2SaveCommitRequest,
  PR2PrincipleScores,
  PR2AntiPatterns,
  PR2SelfAssessment,
  PR2PhaseHistoryEntry,
  PR2PastSessionsResponse,
} from '@shared/coaching-pr2';

@Controller('api/coaching/pr2')
export class PR2FeedbackController {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(PR2FeedbackController.name);

  constructor(
    @Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase,
    private readonly feedbackService: FeedbackAnalysisService,
    private readonly commitService: PracticeCommitService,
  ) {}

  @Get('feedback/:sessionId')
  @NeedLogin()
  async getFeedback(@Req() req, @Param('sessionId') sessionId: string): Promise<PR2FeedbackData> {
    const userId: string = req.userContext?.userId;

    const [session] = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(coachingSessions)
      .where(eq(coachingSessions.id, sessionId));

    if (!session || session.userId !== userId) {
      this.logger.error(`Session not found or unauthorized: ${sessionId}`);
      return this.getEmptyFeedback();
    }

    const messages = (session.messages ?? []) as Array<{ role: string; content: string }>;
    const principlesScores = (session.principlesScores ?? null) as PR2PrincipleScores | null;
    const antiPatterns = (session.antiPatterns ?? null) as PR2AntiPatterns | null;
    const selfAssessment = (session.selfAssessment ?? null) as PR2SelfAssessment | null;
    const phaseHistory = (session.phaseHistory ?? null) as PR2PhaseHistoryEntry[] | null;
    const revealedInfo = (session.revealedInfo ?? null) as Record<string, unknown> | null;
    const roundCount = session.roundCount ?? 0;

    const feedback = await this.feedbackService.generateFeedback(
      {
        messages,
        principlesScores,
        antiPatterns,
        selfAssessment,
        phaseHistory,
        revealedInfo,
        roundCount,
      },
      selfAssessment,
    );

    return feedback;
  }

  @Post('save-commit')
  @NeedLogin()
  async saveCommit(@Req() req, @Body() body: PR2SaveCommitRequest) {
    const userId: string = req.userContext?.userId;
    const { sessionId, commitContent } = body;

    if (!sessionId || !commitContent?.trim()) {
      return { success: false };
    }

    const [session] = await this.db
      .select({ sceneId: coachingSessions.sceneId, userId: coachingSessions.userId })
      .from(coachingSessions)
      .where(eq(coachingSessions.id, sessionId));

    if (!session || session.userId !== userId) {
      return { success: false };
    }

    await this.commitService.saveCommit(userId, session.sceneId, sessionId, commitContent.trim());
    return { success: true };
  }

  @Get('past-sessions')
  @NeedLogin()
  async getPastSessions(@Req() req): Promise<PR2PastSessionsResponse> {
    const userId: string = req.userContext?.userId;

    const sessions = await this.db
      .select({
        id: coachingSessions.id,
        completedAt: coachingSessions.completedAt,
        principlesScores: coachingSessions.principlesScores,
        messages: coachingSessions.messages,
      })
      .from(coachingSessions)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(coachingSessions.userId, userId),
          eq(coachingSessions.sceneId, 'scene_pr_002'),
          eq(coachingSessions.status, 'completed'),
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(desc(coachingSessions.completedAt))
      .limit(5);

    const result = sessions
      .filter((s) => s.principlesScores && s.completedAt)
      .map((s) => {
        const scores = s.principlesScores as PR2PrincipleScores;
        const entries = Object.values(scores);
        const avgScore = Math.round(entries.reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0) / entries.length);
        return {
          sessionId: s.id,
          completedAt: s.completedAt instanceof Date
            ? s.completedAt.toISOString()
            : new Date(s.completedAt as string).toISOString(),
          principlesScores: scores,
          messages: (s.messages ?? []) as Array<{ role: string; content: string }>,
          avgScore,
        };
      });

    return { sessions: result };
  }

  private getEmptyFeedback(): PR2FeedbackData {
    const defaultScores: PR2PrincipleScores = { trust: 0, purpose: 0, encourage: 0, listen: 0, end: 0 };
    return {
      overall: {
        principlesScores: defaultScores,
        verdict: '未找到会话数据',
        selfComparison: [],
        structureAnalysis: '',
      },
      insight: { pattern: '', insight: '', reflectionQuestion: '' },
      behaviorReview: [],
      recommendation: { weakestPrinciple: '', weakestKey: '', courses: [] },
      sessionRoundCount: 0,
    };
  }
}

import { Controller, Get, Post, Body, Req, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NeedLogin } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { CoachingService } from '../coaching.service';
import { PracticeCommitService } from '../../practice-commit/practice-commit.service';
import type { PR2InitSessionRequest, PR2InitSessionResponse } from '@shared/coaching-pr2';

@Controller('api/coaching/pr2')
export class PR2PrepareController {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(PR2PrepareController.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly coachingService: CoachingService,
    private readonly practiceCommitService: PracticeCommitService,
  ) {}

  @NeedLogin()
  @Get('scenes/pr2_xiaolin')
  async getSceneConfig() {
    return this.coachingService.getSceneById('scene_pr_002');
  }

  @Get('history')
  @NeedLogin()
  async getHistory(@Req() req) {
    const { userId } = req.userContext;
    return this.practiceCommitService.getHistory(userId, 'scene_pr_002');
  }

  @Post('init-session')
  @NeedLogin()
  async initSession(
    @Req() req,
    @Body() body: PR2InitSessionRequest,
  ): Promise<PR2InitSessionResponse> {
    const { userId } = req.userContext;
    this.logger.log(`[PR2] initSession userId=${userId} difficulty=${body.difficulty}`);

    const session = await this.coachingService.createSession(userId, 'scene_pr_002');

    // Save selfAssessment and difficulty to the session
    await this.coachingService.updateSession(session.id, userId, {
      selfAssessment: body.selfAssessment,
      difficulty: body.difficulty,
    });

    const focusPrinciple = this.findWeakestPrinciple(body.selfAssessment);
    return {
      sessionId: session.id,
      bridgeMessage: focusPrinciple
        ? `你给自己的「${focusPrinciple.label}」打了 ${focusPrinciple.score} 分（满分10分）。今天练习中，重点关注这一条。`
        : '她推门进来了。她还不知道接下来要谈什么。',
      bridgeHint: focusPrinciple
        ? '在对话中，每当你想跳过这一条的时候——轻声提醒会出现。那是你的教练在说话。'
        : '先聊两句让她放松。这场对话不是审判。',
    };
  }

  private findWeakestPrinciple(
    selfAssessment: PR2InitSessionRequest['selfAssessment'],
  ) {
    const entries = Object.entries(selfAssessment).filter(
      ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null,
    ) as [string, number][];
    if (entries.length === 0) return null;

    const labelMap: Record<string, string> = {
      trust: '建立信任',
      purpose: '说明目的',
      encourage: '鼓励表达',
      listen: '认真倾听',
      end: '积极结束',
    };
    const [key, score] = entries.reduce((min, cur) =>
      cur[1] < min[1] ? cur : min,
    );
    return { key, label: labelMap[key] ?? key, score };
  }
}
