import { RAW_SCENES, type RawScene } from './seed-scenes';

const PR_SCENE_IDS = [
  'scene_pr_001',
  'scene_pr_002',
  'scene_pr_003',
  'scene_pr_004',
  'scene_pr_005',
];

const CONSTRAINT_COLOR_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  red: '#EF4444',
  yellow: '#F59E0B',
  orange: '#F97316',
  blue: '#3B82F6',
};

function escapeHtml(text: string): string {
  return text
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

function renderConstraintItem(
  constraint: { color: string; label: string; text: string },
): string {
  const borderColor = CONSTRAINT_COLOR_MAP[constraint.color] || '#94A3B8';
  return `
    <div style="border-left: 3px solid ${borderColor}; padding: 8px 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; background: #FAFAFA; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;">
      <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: ${borderColor}; text-transform: uppercase;">${escapeHtml(constraint.label)}</span>
      <p style="margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: #333;">${escapeHtml(constraint.text)}</p>
    </div>`;
}

function renderPillBadge(
  text: string,
  bgColor: string,
  textColor: string,
): string {
  return `<span style="display: inline-block; padding: 2px 10px; margin: 2px 4px 2px 0; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 12px; background: ${bgColor}; color: ${textColor};">${escapeHtml(text)}</span>`;
}

function renderList(
  items: string[],
  bullet: string,
  bulletColor: string,
): string {
  if (!items || items.length === 0) return '';
  return `<ul style="list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 8px 0;">
    ${items.map((item: string) => `<li style="padding: 4px 0; font-size: 14px; color: #333;"><span style="color: ${bulletColor}; margin-right: 6px;">${bullet}</span>${escapeHtml(item)}</li>`).join('\n    ')}
  </ul>`;
}

function renderOpeningScene(lines: string[]): string {
  if (!lines || lines.length === 0) return '';
  return `
    <div style="background: #F9FAFB; border-radius: 6px; padding: 16px; margin: 12px 0;">
      ${lines.map((line: string) => `<p style="margin: 4px 0; font-style: italic; font-size: 14px; color: #555; line-height: 1.7;">${escapeHtml(line)}</p>`).join('\n      ')}
    </div>`;
}

function renderNpcProfile(
  npc: NonNullable<RawScene['npcProfiles']>[number],
): string {
  const behaviorPills = npc.behaviorTags
    .map((tag: string) => renderPillBadge(tag, '#E0F2FE', '#0369A1'))
    .join('');
  const psychologyPills = npc.psychologyTags
    .map((tag: string) => renderPillBadge(tag, '#FEF3C7', '#92400E'))
    .join('');
  const riskSignal = npc.riskSignal
    ? `<div style="margin-top: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; background: #FEF2F2; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; color: #DC2626;">⚠ 风险信号：${escapeHtml(npc.riskSignal)}</div>`
    : '';

  return `
    <div style="border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; margin: 12px 0; background: #FAFAFA;">
      <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
        <div style="width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; background: #5B9A8B; color: white; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px;">${escapeHtml(npc.avatar)}</div>
        <div>
          <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #1A1A1A;">${escapeHtml(npc.name)} · ${escapeHtml(npc.type)}</div>
          <div style="font-size: 13px; color: #6B7280;">${escapeHtml(npc.baseInfo)}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-bottom: 8px;">
        <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #6B7280; margin-bottom: 4px;">行为标签</div>
        ${behaviorPills}
      </div>
      <div style="margin-bottom: 8px;">
        <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #6B7280; margin-bottom: 4px;">心理标签</div>
        ${psychologyPills}
      </div>
      ${riskSignal}
      <div style="margin-top: 12px; border-left: 3px solid #5B9A8B; padding: 8px 12px; background: white; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;">
        <p style="margin: 0; font-style: italic; font-size: 14px; color: #333;">"${escapeHtml(npc.quote)}"</p>
        <p style="margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: #9CA3AF;">— ${escapeHtml(npc.quoteStage)}</p>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top: 8px; font-size: 13px; color: #555;">
        <strong>挑战：</strong>${escapeHtml(npc.challenge)}
        <span style="margin-left: 8px; color: #9CA3AF;">难度：${escapeHtml(npc.difficulty)} · ${'★'.repeat(npc.stars)}${'☆'.repeat(5 - npc.stars)}</span>
      </div>
    </div>`;
}

function renderScene(scene: RawScene, index: number): string {
  const isLast = index === PR_SCENE_IDS.length - 1;
  const pageBreakStyle = isLast ? '' : 'page-break-after: always;';
  const immersive = scene.immersiveBrief;
  const npcProfiles = scene.npcProfiles;

  // Section 1: 场景概览
  const section1 = `
    <section>
      <h1 style="font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #1A1A1A; margin: 0 0 12px;">${escapeHtml(scene.name)}</h1>
      <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
        <span style="display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; background: #E0F2FE; color: #0369A1; font-weight: 500;">${escapeHtml(scene.dimension)}</span>
        <span style="display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; background: ${scene.difficulty === '挑战' ? '#FEE2E2' : scene.difficulty === '进阶' ? '#FEF3C7' : '#DCFCE7'}; color: ${scene.difficulty === '挑战' ? '#DC2626' : scene.difficulty === '进阶' ? '#92400E' : '#166534'}; font-weight: 500;">${escapeHtml(scene.difficulty)}</span>
      </div>
      <p style="font-size: 15px; color: #444; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0 0 12px;">${escapeHtml(scene.description)}</p>
      ${scene.oneSentenceContext ? `
      <div style="background: #F0FDF4; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 16px; margin-bottom: 8px;">
        <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #166534; margin-bottom: 4px;">一句话情境</div>
        <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #333;">${escapeHtml(scene.oneSentenceContext)}</p>
      </div>` : ''}
      ${scene.coreChallenge ? `
      <div style="background: #FFF7ED; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 16px;">
        <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #9A3412; margin-bottom: 4px;">核心挑战</div>
        <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #333;">${escapeHtml(scene.coreChallenge)}</p>
      </div>` : ''}
    </section>`;

  // Section 2: 角色档案
  const npcCards = npcProfiles
    ? npcProfiles.map((npc: NonNullable<RawScene['npcProfiles']>[number]) => renderNpcProfile(npc)).join('\n')

  const section2 = `

        <span style="font-size: 14px; color: #6B7280;">${escapeHtml(scene.charRole)}</span>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
        <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #6B7280; margin-bottom: 4px;">背景</div>
        <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #333; line-height: 1.7;">${escapeHtml(scene.charBackground)}</p>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-bottom: 8px;">
        <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #6B7280; margin-bottom: 4px;">性格</div>

      <div style="margin-bottom: 8px;">
        <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #6B7280; margin-bottom: 4px;">痛点</div>

  // Section 3: L1 基础模式
  let section3 = '';

export function generatePRScenesHTML(): string {
  const prScenes = RAW_SCENES.filter((s: RawScene) =>
    PR_SCENE_IDS.includes(s.sceneId),
  );

  const now = new Date();
  const dateStr = `${now.getFullYear()}年${now.getMonth() + 1}月${now.getDate()}日`;

  const scenesHtml = prScenes.map((scene: RawScene, index: number) =>
    renderScene(scene, index),
  ).join('\n');

  return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>绩效面谈场景背景介绍 — 某地产集团MDP管理者陪练平台</title>
  <style>${getCSS()}</style>

<body>
  <header style="max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 40px 40px 20px; text-align: center; border-bottom: 2px solid #5B9A8B;">
    <h1 style="font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; color: #5B9A8B; margin: 0 0 8px;">绩效面谈场景背景介绍</h1>
    <p style="font-size: 14px; color: #6B7280; margin: 0;">某地产集团MDP管理者陪练平台 · 共 ${prScenes.length} 个场景</p>

  </footer>
</body>
</html>`;
}

===FILE:./server/modules/coaching/scenario-generator/scenario-generator.controller.ts===
import { Controller, Post, Get, Body, Query, Req } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NeedLogin } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { ScenarioGeneratorService } from './scenario-generator.service';
import type {
  ISaveGeneratedScenarioRequest,
  ISaveGeneratedScenarioResponse,
  IGeneratedScenarioListResponse,
} from '@shared/api.interface';

@Controller('api/coaching/scenarios')
export class ScenarioGeneratorController {
  constructor(
    private readonly scenarioGeneratorService: ScenarioGeneratorService,
  ) {}

  @NeedLogin()
  @Post('save-generated')
  async saveGenerated(
    @Req() req: any,
    @Body() data: ISaveGeneratedScenarioRequest,
  ): Promise<ISaveGeneratedScenarioResponse> {
    const { userId } = req.userContext;
    return this.scenarioGeneratorService.saveGeneratedScenario(userId, data);
  }

  @NeedLogin()
  @Get('generated')
  async getGenerated(
    @Query('page') page?: string,
    @Query('limit') limit?: string,
  ): Promise<IGeneratedScenarioListResponse> {
    const pageNum = parseInt(page || '1', 10) || 1;
    const limitNum = parseInt(limit || '20', 10) || 20;
    return this.scenarioGeneratorService.getGeneratedScenes(pageNum, limitNum);
  }
}

===FILE:./server/modules/coaching/scenario-generator/scenario-generator.service.ts===
import { Injectable, Inject, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { desc, sql, count } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { coachingScenes } from '@server/database/schema';
import type {
  ISaveGeneratedScenarioRequest,
  ISaveGeneratedScenarioResponse,
  IGeneratedScenarioListItem,
  IGeneratedScenarioListResponse,
  DifficultyLevel,
} from '@shared/api.interface';


const DIFFICULTY_MAP: Record<DifficultyLevel, string> = {
  basic: 'easy',
  medium: 'medium',
  advanced: 'hard',
};

@Injectable()
export class ScenarioGeneratorService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(ScenarioGeneratorService.name);

  constructor(
    @Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase,
  ) {}

  async saveGeneratedScenario(
    userId: string,
    data: ISaveGeneratedScenarioRequest,
  ): Promise<ISaveGeneratedScenarioResponse> {
    try {
      const { scenarioData, generateParams } = data;
      const sceneId = `ai_gen_${Date.now()}`;
      const mappedDifficulty = DIFFICULTY_MAP[generateParams.difficulty] || 'medium';

      const name = scenarioData.meta?.title || 'AI生成场景';
      const aiRole = scenarioData.context?.learner_role?.identity || 'AI角色';
      const description = scenarioData.context?.situation?.project_status || '';
      const dVector = scenarioData.meta?.d_vector;
      const pSequence = scenarioData.meta?.p_sequence || '';

      let dimension = 'result';
      if (dVector) {
        const moraleRoot = dVector.D1_morale_root;
        if (moraleRoot === '过劳衰竭' || moraleRoot === '缺乏意义感') {
          dimension = 'result';
        } else if (moraleRoot === '缺乏公平感' || moraleRoot === '缺乏安全感') {
          dimension = 'people';
        }
      }

      const scenarioContext = {
        generatedByAi: true as const,
        scenarioCard: scenarioData,
        generationParams: generateParams,
        dVector: dVector,
        pSequence: pSequence,
      };

      await this.db.insert(coachingScenes).values({
        sceneId,
        name,
        dimension,
        difficulty: mappedDifficulty,
        aiRole,
        description,
        scenarioContext: scenarioContext as any,
        tags: ['ai_generated', 'ai_scenario'],
      });

      this.logger.log(`AI场景保存成功: ${sceneId}, 用户: ${userId}`);

      return {
        success: true,
        sceneId,
        message: '场景保存成功',
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`保存AI生成场景失败: ${String(error)}`);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getGeneratedScenes(
    page: number,
    limit: number,
  ): Promise<IGeneratedScenarioListResponse> {
    try {
      const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

      const whereCondition = sql`'ai_generated' = ANY(${coachingScenes.tags})`;

      const [countResult, items] = await Promise.all([
        this.db
          .select({ count: count() })
          .from(coachingScenes)
          .where(whereCondition),
        this.db
          .select()
          .from(coachingScenes)
          .where(whereCondition)
          .orderBy(desc(coachingScenes.createdAt))
          .limit(limit)
          .offset(offset),
      ]);

      const total = Number(countResult[0]?.count || 0);

      const mappedItems: IGeneratedScenarioListItem[] = items.map(
        (scene: any) => {
          const ctx = scene.scenarioContext as any;
          return {
            id: scene.id,
            sceneId: scene.sceneId,
            name: scene.name,
            dimension: scene.dimension,
            difficulty: scene.difficulty,
            createdAt: scene.createdAt?.toISOString?.() || String(scene.createdAt),
            generatedByAi: true,
            dVector: ctx?.dVector || undefined,
            pSequence: ctx?.pSequence || undefined,
          };
        },
      );

      return { items: mappedItems, total };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取AI生成场景列表失败: ${String(error)}`);
      throw error;
    }
  }
}

import { Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { coachingScenes } from '@server/database/schema';
import { notInArray } from 'drizzle-orm';

const logger = new Logger('SeedCoachingScenes');

type SceneData = typeof coachingScenes.$inferInsert;

const DIMENSION_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  '拿结果': 'result',
  '带团队': 'people',
  '传文化': 'field',
  '建氛围': 'field',
};

const DIFFICULTY_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  '入门': 'easy',
  '进阶': 'medium',
  '挑战': 'hard',
};

function splitByDelimiter(str: string, delimiter: string): string[] {
  return str
    .split(delimiter)
    .map((s: string) => s.trim())
    .filter((s: string) => s.length > 0);
}

export interface RawScene {
  sceneId: string;
  name: string;
  dimension: string;
  difficulty: string;
  aiRole: string;
  description: string;
  maxRounds: number;
  tags: string;
  businessContext: string;
  userRole: string;
  userRoleContext: string;
  charName: string;

function transformScene(raw: RawScene): SceneData {
  const dimension = DIMENSION_MAP[raw.dimension] ?? raw.dimension;
  const difficulty = DIFFICULTY_MAP[raw.difficulty] ?? raw.difficulty;

  const scoreObj = JSON.parse(raw.initialScore) as {
    result: number;
    people: number;
    field: number;
  };

  const aiCharacter = {
    name: raw.charName,
    role: raw.charRole,
    personality: raw.charPersonality,
    speakingStyle: raw.charSpeakingStyle,
    commonPhrases: splitByDelimiter(raw.charCommonPhrases, '、'),
    background: raw.charBackground,
    painPoints: splitByDelimiter(raw.charPainPoints, '、'),
    motivation: raw.charMotivation,
  };

  const scenarioContext: Record<string, unknown> = {
    situation: raw.ctxSituation,
    conflict: raw.ctxConflict,
    goal: raw.ctxGoal,
    successCriteria: splitByDelimiter(raw.ctxSuccessCriteria, ','),
    openingLine: raw.openingLine,
    userRole: raw.userRole,
    userRoleContext: raw.userRoleContext,
  };

  if (raw.oneSentenceContext) scenarioContext.oneSentenceContext = raw.oneSentenceContext;
  if (raw.coreChallenge) scenarioContext.coreChallenge = raw.coreChallenge;
  if (raw.twoResults) scenarioContext.twoResults = splitByDelimiter(raw.twoResults, ',');
  if (raw.managerRole) scenarioContext.managerRole = raw.managerRole;
  if (raw.npcProfiles) scenarioContext.npcProfiles = raw.npcProfiles;
  if (raw.immersiveBrief) scenarioContext.immersiveBrief = raw.immersiveBrief;
  if (raw.prBrief) scenarioContext.prBrief = raw.prBrief;
  if (raw.feedbackTemplate) scenarioContext.feedbackTemplate = raw.feedbackTemplate;

  return {
    sceneId: raw.sceneId,
    name: raw.name,
    dimension,
    difficulty,
    aiRole: raw.aiRole,
    description: raw.description,
    maxRounds: raw.maxRounds,
    tags: splitByDelimiter(raw.tags, '/'),
    isEnterpriseSpecific: raw.sceneId.startsWith('scene_gt_'),
    businessContext: raw.businessContext,
    aiCharacter,
    scenarioContext,
    initialScoreResult: scoreObj.result,
    initialScorePeople: scoreObj.people,
    initialScoreField: scoreObj.field,
    positiveTriggerWords: splitByDelimiter(raw.positiveTriggerWords, '、'),
    negativeTriggerWords: splitByDelimiter(raw.negativeTriggerWords, '、'),
  };
}

export async function seedCoachingScenes(
  db: PostgresJsDatabase,
): Promise<number> {
  logger.log(`Starting seed: ${RAW_SCENES.length} coaching scenes`);

  const seedSceneIds = RAW_SCENES.map(r => r.sceneId);
  const tmSceneIds = ['tm_tg001', 'tm_tg002', 'tm_tg003', 'tm_tg004'];
  const allPreservedIds = [...seedSceneIds, ...tmSceneIds];

  const deleted = await db
    .delete(coachingScenes)
    .where(notInArray(coachingScenes.sceneId, allPreservedIds))
    .returning({ sceneId: coachingScenes.sceneId, name: coachingScenes.name });

  if (deleted.length > 0) {
    logger.log(`Deleted ${deleted.length} scenes not in seed data: ${deleted.map(d => `${d.sceneId}(${d.name})`).join(', ')}`);
  }

  let count = 0;

  for (const raw of RAW_SCENES) {
    const data = transformScene(raw);

    await db
      .insert(coachingScenes)
      .values(data)
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: coachingScenes.sceneId,
        set: {
          name: data.name,
          dimension: data.dimension,
          difficulty: data.difficulty,
          aiRole: data.aiRole,
          description: data.description,
          maxRounds: data.maxRounds,
          tags: data.tags,
          isEnterpriseSpecific: data.isEnterpriseSpecific,
          businessContext: data.businessContext,
          aiCharacter: data.aiCharacter,
          scenarioContext: data.scenarioContext,
          initialScoreResult: data.initialScoreResult,
          initialScorePeople: data.initialScorePeople,
          initialScoreField: data.initialScoreField,
          positiveTriggerWords: data.positiveTriggerWords,
          negativeTriggerWords: data.negativeTriggerWords,
        },
      });

    count++;
    logger.log(`[${count}/${RAW_SCENES.length}] Upserted: ${data.sceneId} - ${data.name}`);
  }

  logger.log(`Seed complete: ${count} coaching scenes upserted, ${deleted.length} removed`);
  return count;
}

import { Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm';

const logger = new Logger('TeamMotivationMigration');

export async function migrateTeamMotivationTables(db: PostgresJsDatabase): Promise<void> {
  logger.log('开始检查/创建团队激励表...');

  await db.execute(sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_motivation_scene (
      id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
      scenario_id varchar(50) NOT NULL,
      title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
      based_on_case text,
      difficulty varchar(20) NOT NULL,
      estimated_duration_min integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 15,
      d_vector jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
      target_p_nodes jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
      preparation jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
      conversation_flow jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
      decision_points jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
      cover_img text,
      _created_at TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      _created_by user_profile DEFAULT (
        CASE
          WHEN current_setting('app.user_id', TRUE) = '' THEN NULL
          ELSE concat('(', current_setting('app.user_id', TRUE), ')')::user_profile
        END
      ),
      _updated_at TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      _updated_by user_profile DEFAULT (
        CASE
          WHEN current_setting('app.user_id', TRUE) = '' THEN NULL
          ELSE concat('(', current_setting('app.user_id', TRUE), ')')::user_profile
        END
      )
    )
  `);

  await db.execute(sql`
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tm_scene_scenario_id ON team_motivation_scene(scenario_id)
  `);

  await db.execute(sql`
    ALTER TABLE team_motivation_scene ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
  `);

  await db.execute(sql`
    DO $$ BEGIN
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies WHERE policyname = 'service_role_bypass_policy' AND tablename = 'team_motivation_scene') THEN
        CREATE POLICY service_role_bypass_policy ON team_motivation_scene TO service_role USING (true);
      END IF;
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies WHERE policyname = '修改全部数据' AND tablename = 'team_motivation_scene') THEN
        CREATE POLICY "修改全部数据" ON team_motivation_scene AS PERMISSIVE FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (true);
      END IF;
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies WHERE policyname = '查看全部数据' AND tablename = 'team_motivation_scene') THEN
        CREATE POLICY "查看全部数据" ON team_motivation_scene AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated, anon USING (true);
      END IF;
    END $$
  `);

  await db.execute(sql`
    COMMENT ON COLUMN team_motivation_scene.d_vector IS '@type { D1_士气根源: string; D2_压力模式: string; D3_经验构成: string; D4_激励资源: string; D5_信任基础: string }'
  `);
  await db.execute(sql`
    COMMENT ON COLUMN team_motivation_scene.target_p_nodes IS '@type string[]'
  `);
  await db.execute(sql`
    COMMENT ON COLUMN team_motivation_scene.preparation IS '@type { yourRole: string; situation: string; teamState: string; yourConstraints: string }'
  `);
  await db.execute(sql`
    COMMENT ON COLUMN team_motivation_scene.conversation_flow IS '@type { openingCharacter: string; openingLine: string; totalDecisionPoints: number }'
  `);
  await db.execute(sql`
    COMMENT ON COLUMN team_motivation_scene.decision_points IS '@type Array<{ id: string; pNode: string; triggerContext: string; question: string; options: Array<{ id: string; text: string; isCorrect: boolean; matchedDecisionCard?: string; missedPNode?: string; consequence: string; causalExplanation: string }> }>'
  `);

  logger.log('team_motivation_scene 表检查/创建完成');

  await db.execute(sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_motivation_session (
      id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
      user_id varchar(50) NOT NULL,
      scene_id uuid NOT NULL,
      status varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'preparing',
      current_dp_index integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      selected_options jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
      conversation_history jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
      scores jsonb,
      completed_at TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE,
      _created_at TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      _created_by user_profile DEFAULT (
        CASE
          WHEN current_setting('app.user_id', TRUE) = '' THEN NULL
          ELSE concat('(', current_setting('app.user_id', TRUE), ')')::user_profile
        END
      ),
      _updated_at TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      _updated_by user_profile DEFAULT (
        CASE
          WHEN current_setting('app.user_id', TRUE) = '' THEN NULL
          ELSE concat('(', current_setting('app.user_id', TRUE), ')')::user_profile
        END
      )
    )
  `);

  await db.execute(sql`
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tm_session_user_id ON team_motivation_session(user_id)
  `);
  await db.execute(sql`
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tm_session_scene_id ON team_motivation_session(scene_id)
  `);
  await db.execute(sql`
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tm_session_status ON team_motivation_session(status)
  `);

  await db.execute(sql`
    ALTER TABLE team_motivation_session ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
  `);

  await db.execute(sql`
    DO $$ BEGIN
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies WHERE policyname = 'service_role_bypass_policy' AND tablename = 'team_motivation_session') THEN
        CREATE POLICY service_role_bypass_policy ON team_motivation_session TO service_role USING (true);
      END IF;
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies WHERE policyname = '修改全部数据' AND tablename = 'team_motivation_session') THEN
        CREATE POLICY "修改全部数据" ON team_motivation_session AS PERMISSIVE FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (true);
      END IF;
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies WHERE policyname = '查看全部数据' AND tablename = 'team_motivation_session') THEN
        CREATE POLICY "查看全部数据" ON team_motivation_session AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated, anon USING (true);
      END IF;
    END $$
  `);

  await db.execute(sql`
    COMMENT ON COLUMN team_motivation_session.selected_options IS '@type Array<{ decisionPointId: string; optionId: string; optionText: string; isCorrect: boolean; pNode: string }>'
  `);
  await db.execute(sql`
    COMMENT ON COLUMN team_motivation_session.conversation_history IS '@type Array<{ role: string; content: string; decisionPointId?: string; timestamp: string }>'
  `);
  await db.execute(sql`
    COMMENT ON COLUMN team_motivation_session.scores IS '@type { pNodeAccuracy: number; dMatchScore: number; decisionConsistency: number; subScores: Record<string, number> }'
  `);

  logger.log('team_motivation_session 表检查/创建完成');
}

function buildScenarioContext(scene: TMRawScene): Record<string, unknown> {

      estimatedDurationMin: scene.estimated_duration_min,
      preparation: scene.preparation,
      conversationFlow: scene.conversation_flow,

    },

function buildAiCharacter(scene: TMRawScene): Record<string, unknown> {

  const aiRoleMap: Record<string, string> = {
    '销售NPC-周': '项目最资深销售，见过四任空降领导',

  };

    personality: '根据场景D向量动态调整',

    commonPhrases: [scene.conversation_flow.openingLine],
    background: scene.preparation.teamState,
    painPoints: [scene.preparation.situation],
    motivation: '根据学习者选择动态变化',
  };
}

function buildScenarioCard(scene: TMRawScene): Record<string, unknown> {
  const npcName = scene.conversation_flow.openingCharacter.replace(/（.*）/g, '');
  const d1 = scene.d_vector.D1_士气根源 || '';
  const pSeq = scene.target_p_nodes.join('→');
  const chain = scene.decision_points.map(dp => dp.id).join('→');

  const roleMap: Record<string, string> = {
    '销售NPC-周': '项目最资深销售，见过四任空降领导',
    '老刘': '团队最资深销售，大户型经验丰富',
    'NPC-张': '最资深数渠专员，掌握核心客户资源',
    '小赵': '尾盘项目最资深销售',
  };

  const keyIndividual = {
    name: npcName,
    role: roleMap[npcName] || '团队成员',
    tenure: 5,
    attitude: '根据场景D向量动态调整',
    influence: '团队核心影响力人物',
    language_profile: {
      vocabulary: {
        use: ['说实话', '实际情况', '你也知道'],
        avoid: ['没问题', '随便', '都行'],
      },
      sentence_style: '短句为主，自然对话',
      emotional_triggers: {
        defensive: ['你们领导', '公司规定', '必须完成'],
        open_up: ['我理解', '一起想想', '你的经验'],
      },
      hidden_motivation: d1 === '过劳衰竭' ? '不想再被消耗了' :
        d1 === '缺乏意义感' ? '想找到工作的价值' :
        d1 === '缺乏公平感' ? '希望付出被公平对待' :
        '害怕被淘汰，想要确定性',
    },
  };

  const decisionPoints = scene.decision_points.map((dp, i) => ({
    dp_id: dp.id,
    sequence: i + 1,
    p_step: dp.p_node,
    d_tags: [d1],
    capability_tag: dp.p_node,
    capability_definition: `${dp.p_node}节点策略`,
    observable_indicator: dp.p_node,
    trigger: {
      context_cue: dp.trigger_context,
      trigger_type: 'situation',
      npc_state_before: '观望',
      pause_text: dp.p_node.includes('_') ? '亲自做给他们看' :
        dp.p_node === 'P1' ? '先做事，不说话' :
        dp.p_node === 'P2' ? '建立信任' :
        dp.p_node === 'P3' ? '找到意义' :
        dp.p_node === 'P4' ? '设计激励' :
        dp.p_node === 'P5' ? '替团队做减法' :
        dp.p_node === 'P6' ? '建立协作机制' :
        dp.question,
    },
    options: dp.options.map(opt => ({
      id: opt.id,
      text: opt.text,
      is_best_path: opt.is_correct,
      trap_type: opt.is_correct ? undefined : (opt.missed_p_node || '策略偏差'),
      trap_mechanism: opt.causal_explanation,
      why_correct: opt.is_correct ? opt.causal_explanation : undefined,
      why_wrong: !opt.is_correct ? opt.causal_explanation : undefined,
      consequence: {
        immediate: opt.consequence,
        short_term: opt.consequence,
        npc_state_after: opt.is_correct ? '信任提升' : '防御加强',
      },
      causal_chain: opt.causal_explanation,
    })),
    dp_meta: {
      zone: i + 1,
      is_critical: true,
      progression_from_previous: i === 0 ? '初始' : `从${scene.decision_points[i - 1].p_node}推进`,
    },
  }));

  const goldenPath = scene.decision_points
    .flatMap(dp => dp.options.filter(o => o.is_correct).map(o => `${dp.id}:${o.id}`));

  return {
    meta: {
      scenario_id: scene.scenario_id,
      title: scene.title,
      version: '1.0',
      difficulty: scene.difficulty,
      estimated_duration_min: scene.estimated_duration_min,
      task_domain: 'team_motivation',
      d_vector: scene.d_vector,
      p_sequence: pSeq,
      progression_chain: chain,
    },
    context: {
      learner_role: {
        identity: scene.preparation.yourRole as string,
        relationship_to_team: '管理者',
        tenure_in_role: '新任',
      },
      situation: {
        project_status: scene.preparation.situation as string,
        deadline: `${scene.estimated_duration_min}分钟`,
        metrics: { key_problem: d1 },
        what_happened_before: scene.preparation.teamState as string,
      },
      team_state: {
        size: 6,
        energy_level: d1 === '过劳衰竭' ? '疲惫' : '观望',
        observable_signals: [scene.preparation.teamState as string],
        unspoken_sentiment: scene.preparation.yourConstraints as string,
        crack_type: scene.d_vector.D5_信任基础?.includes('裂痕') ? '显性冲突' : null,
        crack_history: scene.d_vector.D5_信任基础?.includes('裂痕') ? '历史改革失败' : null,
        key_individuals: [keyIndividual],
      },
      constraints: {
        time_pressure: `${scene.estimated_duration_min}分钟内完成`,
        resource_limits: scene.d_vector.D4_激励资源 || '有限',
        political_sensitivity: scene.preparation.yourConstraints as string,
      },
      opening_scene: {
        time: '工作日',
        location: scene.location,
        trigger: scene.decision_points[0]?.trigger_context || '',
        opening_question: scene.conversation_flow.openingLine,
      },
    },
    decision_points: decisionPoints,
    feedback_criteria: {
      golden_path: goldenPath,
      golden_path_narrative: scene.preparation.goal as string,
      scoring_dimensions: [
        {
          dimension_id: 'strategy_fit',
          name: '策略匹配度',
          weight: 0.5,
          scoring_rules: {
            excellent: { score: 100, comment: '精准匹配D-P-F策略' },
            good: { score: 70, comment: '基本匹配但有改进空间' },
            poor: { score: 30, comment: '策略选择偏差较大' },
          },
        },
        {
          dimension_id: 'empathy',
          name: '共情能力',
          weight: 0.3,
          scoring_rules: {
            excellent: { score: 100, comment: '充分展现共情理解' },
            good: { score: 70, comment: '有一定共情但不够深入' },
            poor: { score: 30, comment: '缺乏共情表达' },
          },
        },
        {
          dimension_id: 'execution',
          name: '执行力',
          weight: 0.2,
          scoring_rules: {
            excellent: { score: 100, comment: '执行方案清晰可落地' },
            good: { score: 70, comment: '有方案但细节不足' },
            poor: { score: 30, comment: '缺乏可执行的方案' },
          },
        },
      ],
      crack_type_awareness: {
        applicable: scene.d_vector.D5_信任基础?.includes('裂痕') || false,
        crack_type: scene.d_vector.D5_信任基础?.includes('裂痕') ? '显性冲突' : null,
        detection_rule: scene.d_vector.D5_信任基础?.includes('裂痕')
          ? '关注是否先修复信任再推制度'
          : null,
        wrong_strategy_signals: ['直接推制度', '忽略历史裂痕', '急于变革'],
        correct_strategy_signals: ['先倾听', '修复信任', '渐进式改进'],
      },
    },
  };
}

export async function seedTeamMotivationScenes(db: PostgresJsDatabase): Promise<number> {
  let count = 0;

  for (const scene of TM_SCENES) {
    const tmSceneId = `tm_${scene.scenario_id.toLowerCase().replace('-', '')}`;

    const existing = await db.execute(sql`
      SELECT id FROM coaching_scenes WHERE scene_id = ${tmSceneId}
    `);

    if (existing.length > 0) {
      const scenarioContext = buildScenarioContext(scene);
      const scenarioCard = buildScenarioCard(scene);
      const dVector = JSON.stringify(scene.d_vector);
      const pSeq = scene.target_p_nodes.join('→');
      const chain = scene.decision_points.map(dp => dp.id).join('→');
      await db.execute(sql`
        UPDATE coaching_scenes
        SET scenario_context = ${JSON.stringify(scenarioContext)}::jsonb,
            scenario_card = ${JSON.stringify(scenarioCard)}::jsonb,
            d_vector = ${dVector}::jsonb,
            p_sequence = ${pSeq},
            progression_chain = ${chain}
        WHERE scene_id = ${tmSceneId}
      `);
      logger.log(`TM场景 ${tmSceneId} 已更新（含scenarioCard）`);
      count++;
      continue;
    }

    const scenarioContext = buildScenarioContext(scene);
    const aiCharacter = buildAiCharacter(scene);

    const difficulty = DIFFICULTY_MAP[scene.difficulty] || 'medium';
    const d1Label = scene.d_vector.D1_士气根源 || '团队激励';
    const maxRounds = scene.conversation_flow.totalDecisionPoints * 3;
    const durationStr = String(scene.estimated_duration_min);
    const bizContext = scene.preparation.situation.length > 250
      ? scene.preparation.situation.slice(0, 250)
      : scene.preparation.situation;

    const scenarioCard = buildScenarioCard(scene);
    const dVector = JSON.stringify(scene.d_vector);
    const pSeq = scene.target_p_nodes.join('→');
    const chain = scene.decision_points.map(dp => dp.id).join('→');

    await db.execute(sql`
      INSERT INTO coaching_scenes (
        scene_id, name, dimension, difficulty, ai_role, description,
        duration, max_rounds, tags, is_greentown, business_context,
        ai_character, scenario_context, scenario_card,
        d_vector, p_sequence, progression_chain,
        initial_score_result, initial_score_people, initial_score_field,
        positive_trigger_words, negative_trigger_words
      ) VALUES (
        ${tmSceneId},
        ${scene.title},
        'people',
        ${difficulty},
        ${scene.conversation_flow.openingCharacter},
        ${scene.based_on_case},
        ${durationStr},
        ${maxRounds},
        ARRAY['团队激励', 'D-P-F模型', ${d1Label}]::text[],
        false,
        ${bizContext},
        ${JSON.stringify(aiCharacter)}::jsonb,
        ${JSON.stringify(scenarioContext)}::jsonb,
        ${JSON.stringify(scenarioCard)}::jsonb,
        ${dVector}::jsonb,
        ${pSeq},
        ${chain},
        45, 50, 55,
        ARRAY['我理解', '我们一起', '你的想法是什么']::text[],
        ARRAY['必须完成', '没有选择', '按我说的做']::text[]
      )
    `);

    count++;
    logger.log(`TM场景 ${tmSceneId} (${scene.title}) 导入成功`);
  }

  return count;
}

===FILE:./server/modules/coaching/team-motivation/tm-controller.ts===
import { Controller, Get, Post, Param, Body, Req } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NeedLogin } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { TMService } from './tm-service';

@Controller('api/coaching/team-motivation')
export class TMController {
  constructor(private readonly tmService: TMService) {}

  @NeedLogin()
  @Get('scenes')
  async getScenes() {
    return this.tmService.getScenes();
  }

  @NeedLogin()
  @Get('scenes/:id')
  async getSceneDetail(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.tmService.getSceneDetail(id);
  }

  @NeedLogin()
  @Post('sessions')
  async initSession(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Body() body: { sceneId: string },
  ) {
    const { userId } = req.userContext;
    return this.tmService.initSession(userId, body.sceneId);
  }

  @NeedLogin()
  @Post('sessions/:id/submit-option')
  async submitOption(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() body: { decisionPointId: string; optionId: string },
  ) {
    const { userId } = req.userContext;
    return this.tmService.submitOption(
      userId,
      id,
      body.decisionPointId,
      body.optionId,
    );
  }

  @NeedLogin()
  @Post('generate-feedback')
  async generateFeedback(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Body() body: { sessionId: string },
  ) {
    const { userId } = req.userContext;
    return this.tmService.generateFeedback(userId, body.sessionId);
  }
}

===FILE:./server/modules/coaching/team-motivation/tm-feedback.service.ts===
import { Injectable, Logger, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  DRIZZLE_DATABASE,
  CapabilityService,
  type PostgresJsDatabase,
} from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { coachingScenes } from '@server/database/schema';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type {
  TMFeedbackReport,
  TMFeedbackTheoryLens,
  TMFeedbackIndustryCalibration,
  TMFeedbackExpertBenchmark,
  TMSessionScores,
  TMWeaknessItem,
  TMRecommendedCourse,
  TMSelectedOption,
  TMDecisionPoint,
} from '@shared/coaching-team-motivation';

interface TMDecisionRecord {
  decisionPointId: string;
  pNode: string;
  selectedOptionId: string;
  selectedOptionText: string;
  isCorrect: boolean;
  consequence: string;
}

@Injectable()
export class TMFeedbackService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(TMFeedbackService.name);

  private static readonly FEEDBACK_PLUGIN_ID = 'team_incentive_coach_feedback_report_generate_1';

  constructor(
    @Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase,
    private readonly capabilityService: CapabilityService,
  ) {}

  async generateFeedbackReport(
    sessionId: string,
    sceneId: string,
    selectedOptions: TMSelectedOption[],
    decisionPoints: TMDecisionPoint[],
  ): Promise<TMFeedbackReport> {
    const scores = this.calculateScores(selectedOptions, decisionPoints);
    const decisionRecords = this.buildDecisionRecords(selectedOptions, decisionPoints);

    const aiResult = await this.analyzeWithAI(decisionRecords, sceneId);

    if (aiResult) {
      return { ...aiResult, scores };
    }

    return this.generateFallbackReport(decisionRecords, scores, sceneId);
  }

  private calculateScores(
    selectedOptions: TMSelectedOption[],
    decisionPoints: TMDecisionPoint[],
  ): TMSessionScores {
    const totalPoints = decisionPoints.length;
    const correctCount = selectedOptions.filter((o) => o.isCorrect).length;
    const pNodeAccuracy = totalPoints > 0 ? Math.round((correctCount / totalPoints) * 100) : 0;

    const dMatchScore = this.calculateDMatchScore(selectedOptions, decisionPoints);
    const decisionConsistency = this.calculateConsistency(selectedOptions);

    const subScores: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const option of selectedOptions) {
      const pNode = option.pNode;
      if (!subScores[pNode]) {
        subScores[pNode] = option.isCorrect ? 100 : 30;
      } else {
        subScores[pNode] = Math.round((subScores[pNode] + (option.isCorrect ? 100 : 30)) / 2);
      }
    }

    return { pNodeAccuracy, dMatchScore, decisionConsistency, subScores };
  }

  private calculateDMatchScore(
    selectedOptions: TMSelectedOption[],
    _decisionPoints: TMDecisionPoint[],
  ): number {
    if (selectedOptions.length === 0) return 50;
    const correctRatio = selectedOptions.filter((o) => o.isCorrect).length / selectedOptions.length;
    return Math.round(40 + correctRatio * 60);
  }

  private calculateConsistency(selectedOptions: TMSelectedOption[]): number {
    if (selectedOptions.length <= 1) return 70;
    let consistentCount = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i < selectedOptions.length; i++) {
      if (selectedOptions[i].isCorrect === selectedOptions[i - 1].isCorrect) {
        consistentCount++;
      }
    }
    return Math.round(50 + (consistentCount / (selectedOptions.length - 1)) * 50);
  }

  private buildDecisionRecords(
    selectedOptions: TMSelectedOption[],
    decisionPoints: TMDecisionPoint[],
  ): TMDecisionRecord[] {
    return selectedOptions.map((option) => {
      const dp = decisionPoints.find((d) => d.id === option.decisionPointId);
      const selectedOpt = dp?.options.find((o) => o.id === option.optionId);
      return {
        decisionPointId: option.decisionPointId,
        pNode: option.pNode,
        selectedOptionId: option.optionId,
        selectedOptionText: option.optionText,
        isCorrect: option.isCorrect,
        consequence: selectedOpt?.consequence || '',
      };
    });
  }

  private async analyzeWithAI(
    decisionRecords: TMDecisionRecord[],
    sceneId: string,
  ): Promise<Omit<TMFeedbackReport, 'scores'> | null> {
    try {
      const recordsText = decisionRecords
        .map((r, i) => {
          const status = r.isCorrect ? '正确' : '错误';
          return `决策点${i + 1} (${r.pNode}): ${r.selectedOptionText}\n结果: ${status}\n后果: ${r.consequence}`;
        })
        .join('\n\n');

      const sceneResult = await this.db
        .select({ scenarioContext: coachingScenes.scenarioContext })
        .from(coachingScenes)
        .where(eq(coachingScenes.sceneId, sceneId))
        .limit(1);

      const scenarioContext = sceneResult[0]?.scenarioContext as Record<string, unknown> | null;
      const teamMotivation = scenarioContext?.teamMotivation as Record<string, unknown> | null;
      const dVector = teamMotivation?.dVector as Record<string, string> | null;

      const dpfFramework = `D-P-F模型理论框架:
- D向量(诊断维度): D1士气根源=${dVector?.D1_士气根源 || '未知'}, D2压力模式=${dVector?.D2_压力模式 || '未知'}, D3经验构成=${dVector?.D3_经验构成 || '未知'}, D4激励资源=${dVector?.D4_激励资源 || '未知'}, D5信任基础=${dVector?.D5_信任基础 || '未知'}
- P节点(策略节点): P1诊断, P2信任建立, P3目标认同, P4激励设计, P5赋能支持, P6制度保障
- F因子(场域因子): 组织文化、市场环境、团队历史`;

      const industryKnowledge = `行业知识库:
- 房地产行业团队激励核心挑战: 高周转压力、客户观望、产品同质化
- 团队激励最佳实践: 先诊断后施策、信任先于命令、赋能重于加压
- 常见管理误区: 空降直接发令、用信息替代结论、激励不匹配士气根源`;

      const scoringSpec = `评分体系规范:
- pNodeAccuracy: P节点策略选择准确率(0-100)
- dMatchScore: D向量匹配度(0-100)
- decisionConsistency: 决策一致性(0-100)
- 各子维度评分: 每个P节点的得分(0-100)
- 薄弱点分析: 列出得分最低的P节点及改进建议
- 课程推荐: 根据薄弱点推荐对应课程`;

      const AI_TIMEOUT_MS = 25000;

      const aiCall = this.capabilityService
        .load(TMFeedbackService.FEEDBACK_PLUGIN_ID)
        .call('textGenerate', {
          decision_records: recordsText,
          dpf_model_framework: dpfFramework,
          industry_knowledge_base: industryKnowledge,
          scoring_system_spec: scoringSpec,
        });

      const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
        setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('AI反馈报告生成超时')), AI_TIMEOUT_MS),
      );

      const result = await Promise.race([aiCall, timeoutPromise]);

      const output = result as { content?: string; response?: string };
      const rawText = output.content || output.response || '';
      if (!rawText) {
        this.logger.warn('AI反馈报告返回空内容');
        return null;
      }

      return this.parseAIResponse(rawText);
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.error(`AI反馈报告生成失败: ${String(err)}`);
      return null;
    }
  }

  private parseAIResponse(rawText: string): Omit<TMFeedbackReport, 'scores'> | null {
    try {
      const jsonMatch = rawText.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
      if (!jsonMatch) {
        this.logger.warn('AI反馈报告中未找到JSON');
        return null;
      }

      const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]);

      const layer1: TMFeedbackTheoryLens[] = Array.isArray(parsed.layer1_theory_lens)
        ? parsed.layer1_theory_lens.map((item: Record<string, string>) => ({
            theory: String(item.theory || ''),
            pNode: String(item.p_node || ''),
            behavior: String(item.behavior || ''),
            analysis: String(item.analysis || ''),
          }))
        : [];

      const layer2: TMFeedbackIndustryCalibration[] = Array.isArray(parsed.layer2_industry_calibration)
        ? parsed.layer2_industry_calibration.map((item: Record<string, string>) => ({
            industry: String(item.industry || ''),
            constraint: String(item.constraint || ''),
            behavior: String(item.behavior || ''),
            analysis: String(item.analysis || ''),
          }))
        : [];

      const layer3: TMFeedbackExpertBenchmark[] = Array.isArray(parsed.layer3_expert_benchmark)
        ? parsed.layer3_expert_benchmark.map((item: Record<string, string>) => ({
            expertApproach: String(item.expert_approach || ''),
            pNode: String(item.p_node || ''),
            difference: String(item.difference || ''),
            analysis: String(item.analysis || ''),
          }))
        : [];

      const weaknessAnalysis: TMWeaknessItem[] = Array.isArray(parsed.weakness_analysis)
        ? parsed.weakness_analysis.map((item: Record<string, string>) => ({
            pNode: String(item.p_node || ''),
            description: String(item.description || ''),
            suggestedScene: String(item.suggested_scene || ''),
          }))
        : [];

      const recommendedCourses: TMRecommendedCourse[] = Array.isArray(parsed.recommended_courses)
        ? parsed.recommended_courses.map((item: Record<string, string>) => ({
            id: String(item.id || ''),
            title: String(item.title || ''),
            reason: String(item.reason || ''),
          }))
        : [];

      return { layer1TheoryLens: layer1, layer2IndustryCalibration: layer2, layer3ExpertBenchmark: layer3, weaknessAnalysis, recommendedCourses };
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.error(`解析AI反馈报告JSON失败: ${String(err)}`);
      return null;
    }
  }

  private generateFallbackReport(
    decisionRecords: TMDecisionRecord[],
    scores: TMSessionScores,
    _sceneId: string,
  ): TMFeedbackReport {
    const correctRecords = decisionRecords.filter((r) => r.isCorrect);
    const wrongRecords = decisionRecords.filter((r) => !r.isCorrect);

    const layer1TheoryLens: TMFeedbackTheoryLens[] = decisionRecords.map((r) => ({
      theory: 'D-P-F决策模型',
      pNode: r.pNode,
      behavior: r.selectedOptionText.slice(0, 50),
      analysis: r.isCorrect
        ? `正确识别了${r.pNode}节点的核心策略，展现了对D向量诊断的准确理解`
        : `在${r.pNode}节点的策略选择上存在偏差，建议深入理解该节点的正确应用方式`,
    }));

    const layer2IndustryCalibration: TMFeedbackIndustryCalibration[] = [{
      industry: '房地产销售管理',
      constraint: '团队士气低迷期',
      behavior: correctRecords.length > 0 ? '部分决策符合行业最佳实践' : '决策策略与行业实践存在差距',
      analysis: `在${decisionRecords.length}个决策点中，${correctRecords.length}个选择了符合行业最佳实践的策略`,
    }];

    const layer3ExpertBenchmark: TMFeedbackExpertBenchmark[] = wrongRecords.length > 0
      ? wrongRecords.map((r) => ({
          expertApproach: `${r.pNode}节点的专家策略`,
          pNode: r.pNode,
          difference: '策略选择与专家方案存在差异',
          analysis: `专家在${r.pNode}节点通常会优先诊断团队状态，再匹配对应策略`,
        }))
      : [{
          expertApproach: '全流程专家策略',
          pNode: '综合',
          difference: '高度一致',
          analysis: '所有决策点均选择了符合专家建议的策略',
        }];

    const weaknessAnalysis: TMWeaknessItem[] = wrongRecords.map((r) => ({
      pNode: r.pNode,
      description: `在${r.pNode}节点未能正确匹配D向量对应的策略`,
      suggestedScene: '建议重温团队激励相关课程',
    }));

    const recommendedCourses: TMRecommendedCourse[] = [
      { id: 'course_tm_01', title: 'D-P-F模型与团队激励', reason: '系统学习D向量诊断和P节点策略匹配' },
      { id: 'course_tm_02', title: '空降管理者快速建立信任', reason: '提升空降场景下的团队信任建设能力' },
    ];

    return {
      layer1TheoryLens,
      layer2IndustryCalibration,
      layer3ExpertBenchmark,
      scores,
      weaknessAnalysis,
      recommendedCourses,
    };
  }
}

export interface TMRawScene {
  scenario_id: string;
  title: string;
  based_on_case: string;
  difficulty: string;
  estimated_duration_min: number;
  d_vector: Record<string, string>;
  target_p_nodes: string[];
  preparation: Record<string, string | string[]>;
  location: string;
  conversation_flow: { openingCharacter: string; openingLine: string; totalDecisionPoints: number };
  decision_points: Array<{
    id: string;
    p_node: string;
    trigger_context: string;
    question: string;
    options: Array<{
      id: string;
      text: string;
      is_correct: boolean;
      matched_decision_card?: string;
      missed_p_node?: string;
      consequence: string;
      causal_explanation: string;
    }>;
  }>;
}

===FILE:./server/modules/coaching/team-motivation/tm-service.ts===
import { Injectable, Logger, Inject, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { eq, and, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { coachingScenes, coachingSessions } from '@server/database/schema';
import { GamificationService } from '../../gamification/gamification.service';
import { TMFeedbackService } from './tm-feedback.service';
import type {
  TMScenesListResponse,
  TMScene,
  TMSceneListItem,
  TMInitSessionResponse,
  TMCurrentDecisionPoint,
  TMSubmitOptionResponse,
  TMSelectedOption,
  TMDecisionPoint,
  TMDecisionOption,
  TMFeedbackReport,
  TMDVector,
  TMPreparation,
  TMConversationFlow,
  TMDifficulty,
} from '@shared/coaching-team-motivation';

const DIFFICULTY_DB_TO_CN: Record<string, TMDifficulty> = {
  easy: '中等',
  medium: '中等',
  hard: '高',
};

const COVER_IMG_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  tm_tg001: '/spark/app/app_4k9rsyph7an84/runtime/api/v1/storage/object/bucket_aadkd3ry5kkki_static/static%2Faadkkgyybnggu_ve_miaoda',
  tm_tg002: '/spark/app/app_4k9rsyph7an84/runtime/api/v1/storage/object/bucket_aadkd3ry5kkki_static/static%2Faadkkgmottwdu_ve_miaoda',
  tm_tg003: '/spark/app/app_4k9rsyph7an84/runtime/api/v1/storage/object/bucket_aadkd3ry5kkki_static/static%2Faadkkgrtmi6pu_ve_miaoda',
  tm_tg004: '/spark/app/app_4k9rsyph7an84/runtime/api/v1/storage/object/bucket_aadkd3ry5kkki_static/static%2Faadkk5fkuz2lq_ve_miaoda',
};

interface RawTeamMotivation {
  type?: string;
  basedOnCase?: string;
  dVector?: Record<string, string>;
  targetPNodes?: string[];
  estimatedDurationMin?: number;
  preparation?: Record<string, string>;
  conversationFlow?: Record<string, unknown>;
  decisionPoints?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

@Injectable()
export class TMService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(TMService.name);

  constructor(
    @Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase,
    private readonly gamificationService: GamificationService,
    private readonly tmFeedbackService: TMFeedbackService,
  ) {}

  async getScenes(): Promise<TMScenesListResponse> {
    try {
      const results = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingScenes)
        .where(sql`${coachingScenes.tags} @> ARRAY['团队激励']::text[] AND ${coachingScenes.sceneId} LIKE 'tm\_%'`);

      const items: TMSceneListItem[] = results.map((scene) => {
        const ctx = scene.scenarioContext as Record<string, unknown> | null;
        const tm = (ctx?.teamMotivation ?? {}) as RawTeamMotivation;

        return {
          id: scene.sceneId,
          scenarioId: scene.id,
          title: scene.name,
          difficulty: DIFFICULTY_DB_TO_CN[scene.difficulty || 'medium'] || '中等',
          estimatedDurationMin: tm.estimatedDurationMin ?? 15,
          dVector: (tm.dVector ?? {}) as unknown as TMDVector,
          coverImg: COVER_IMG_MAP[scene.sceneId] || '',
        };
      });

      return { items };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('获取团队激励场景列表失败', String(error));
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getSceneDetail(sceneId: string): Promise<TMScene> {
    try {
      const [scene] = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingScenes)
        .where(eq(coachingScenes.sceneId, sceneId));

      if (!scene) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`场景不存在: ${sceneId}`);
      }

      const ctx = scene.scenarioContext as Record<string, unknown> | null;
      const tm = (ctx?.teamMotivation ?? {}) as RawTeamMotivation;

      return {
        id: scene.sceneId,
        scenarioId: scene.id,
        title: scene.name,
        basedOnCase: tm.basedOnCase || '',
        difficulty: DIFFICULTY_DB_TO_CN[scene.difficulty || 'medium'] || '中等',
        estimatedDurationMin: tm.estimatedDurationMin ?? 15,
        dVector: (tm.dVector ?? {}) as unknown as TMDVector,
        targetPNodes: tm.targetPNodes ?? [],
        preparation: (tm.preparation ?? {}) as unknown as TMPreparation,
        conversationFlow: (tm.conversationFlow ?? {}) as unknown as TMConversationFlow,
        decisionPoints: this.mapDecisionPoints(tm.decisionPoints),
      };
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof NotFoundException) throw error;
      this.logger.error(`获取团队激励场景详情失败: ${sceneId}`, String(error));
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async initSession(
    userId: string,
    sceneId: string,
  ): Promise<TMInitSessionResponse> {
    try {
      const scene = await this.getSceneDetail(sceneId);
      const firstDp = scene.decisionPoints[0];

      if (!firstDp) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`场景无决策点: ${sceneId}`);
      }

      const tmData = {
        currentDecisionPointIndex: 0,
        selectedOptions: [],
        conversationHistory: [],
      };

      const [session] = await this.db
        .insert(coachingSessions)
        .values({
          userId,
          sceneId,
          messages: [],
          status: 'active',
          revealedInfo: { tmData },
        })
        .returning();

      const currentDecisionPoint: TMCurrentDecisionPoint = {
        id: firstDp.id,
        question: firstDp.question,
        triggerContext: firstDp.triggerContext,
        options: firstDp.options.map((opt) => ({
          id: opt.id,
          text: opt.text,
        })),
      };

      return {
        sessionId: session.id,
        currentDecisionPoint,
        openingCharacter: scene.conversationFlow.openingCharacter || '',
        openingLine: scene.conversationFlow.openingLine || '',
      };
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof NotFoundException) throw error;
      this.logger.error(
        `初始化团队激励会话失败: userId=${userId}, sceneId=${sceneId}`,
        String(error),
      );
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async submitOption(
    userId: string,
    sessionId: string,
    decisionPointId: string,
    optionId: string,
  ): Promise<TMSubmitOptionResponse> {
    try {
      // 1. 获取 session
      const [session] = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingSessions)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(coachingSessions.id, sessionId),
            eq(coachingSessions.userId, userId),
          ),
        );

      if (!session) {
        throw new NotFoundException('会话不存在');
      }

      // 2. 获取场景配置
      const scene = await this.getSceneDetail(session.sceneId);
      const revealedInfo = (session.revealedInfo ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
      const tmData = (revealedInfo.tmData ?? {
        currentDecisionPointIndex: 0,
        selectedOptions: [],
        conversationHistory: [],
      }) as {
        currentDecisionPointIndex: number;
        selectedOptions: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
        conversationHistory: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
      };

      // 3. 找到当前决策点和选项
      const dpIndex = scene.decisionPoints.findIndex(
        (dp) => dp.id === decisionPointId,
      );
      if (dpIndex === -1) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`决策点不存在: ${decisionPointId}`);
      }

      const dp = scene.decisionPoints[dpIndex];
      const selectedOpt = dp.options.find((opt) => opt.id === optionId);
      if (!selectedOpt) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`选项不存在: ${optionId}`);
      }

      // 4. 记录选择
      const selectionRecord: TMSelectedOption = {
        decisionPointId,
        optionId: selectedOpt.id,
        optionText: selectedOpt.text,
        isCorrect: selectedOpt.isCorrect,
        pNode: dp.pNode,
      };

      tmData.selectedOptions = [
        ...tmData.selectedOptions,
        selectionRecord as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
      ];

      // 5. 记录对话历史
      const conversationRecord = {
        role: 'user',
        content: selectedOpt.text,
        decisionPointId,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      tmData.conversationHistory = [
        ...tmData.conversationHistory,
        conversationRecord,
      ];

      // 6. 推进到下一个决策点
      const nextDpIndex = dpIndex + 1;
      const isCompleted = nextDpIndex >= scene.decisionPoints.length;
      tmData.currentDecisionPointIndex = nextDpIndex;

      // 7. 构建响应
      const response: TMSubmitOptionResponse = {
        consequence: selectedOpt.consequence,
        causalExplanation: selectedOpt.causalExplanation,
        isCorrect: selectedOpt.isCorrect,
        isCompleted,
      };

      if (!isCompleted) {
        const nextDp = scene.decisionPoints[nextDpIndex];
        response.nextDecisionPoint = {
          id: nextDp.id,
          question: nextDp.question,
          triggerContext: nextDp.triggerContext,
          options: nextDp.options.map((opt) => ({
            id: opt.id,
            text: opt.text,
          })),
        };
      }

      // 8. 更新 session
      const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
        revealedInfo: { ...revealedInfo, tmData },
        messages: tmData.conversationHistory,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      };

      if (isCompleted) {
        updateData.status = 'completed';
        updateData.completedAt = new Date();
      }

      await this.db
        .update(coachingSessions)
        .set(updateData)
        .where(eq(coachingSessions.id, sessionId));

      // 9. 完成时发放积分
      if (isCompleted) {
        try {
          await this.gamificationService.addPoints(
            userId,
            'team_motivation_complete',
            30,
            '完成团队激励陪练',
            sessionId,
          );
        } catch (gamErr) {
          this.logger.error(
            `团队激励积分奖励失败: sessionId=${sessionId}`,
            String(gamErr),
          );
        }
      }

      return response;
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof NotFoundException) throw error;
      this.logger.error(
        `提交选项失败: sessionId=${sessionId}, dpId=${decisionPointId}, optId=${optionId}`,
        String(error),
      );
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async generateFeedback(
    userId: string,
    sessionId: string,
  ): Promise<TMFeedbackReport> {
    try {
      const [session] = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(coachingSessions)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(coachingSessions.id, sessionId),
            eq(coachingSessions.userId, userId),
          ),
        );

      if (!session) {
        throw new NotFoundException('会话不存在');
      }

      const scene = await this.getSceneDetail(session.sceneId);
      const revealedInfo = (session.revealedInfo ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
      const tmData = (revealedInfo.tmData ?? { selectedOptions: [] }) as {
        selectedOptions: TMSelectedOption[];
      };

      const selectedOptions: TMSelectedOption[] = (
        tmData.selectedOptions || []
      ).map((opt) => ({
        decisionPointId: String(opt.decisionPointId),
        optionId: String(opt.optionId),
        optionText: String(opt.optionText),
        isCorrect: Boolean(opt.isCorrect),
        pNode: String(opt.pNode),
      }));

      return this.tmFeedbackService.generateFeedbackReport(
        sessionId,
        session.sceneId,
        selectedOptions,
        scene.decisionPoints,
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof NotFoundException) throw error;
      this.logger.error(
        `生成反馈报告失败: sessionId=${sessionId}`,
        String(error),
      );
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Map DB snake_case decision points to shared camelCase types
   */
  private mapDecisionPoints(
    rawDps: Array<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined,
  ): TMDecisionPoint[] {
    if (!Array.isArray(rawDps)) return [];

    return rawDps.map((dp) => {
      const rawOptions = (dp.options ?? []) as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;

      const options: TMDecisionOption[] = rawOptions.map((opt) => ({
        id: String(opt.id ?? ''),
        text: String(opt.text ?? ''),
        isCorrect: Boolean(opt.is_correct ?? opt.isCorrect ?? false),
        matchedDecisionCard: opt.matched_decision_card
          ? String(opt.matched_decision_card)
          : opt.matchedDecisionCard
            ? String(opt.matchedDecisionCard)
            : undefined,
        missedPNode: opt.missed_p_node
          ? String(opt.missed_p_node)
          : opt.missedPNode
            ? String(opt.missedPNode)
            : undefined,
        consequence: String(opt.consequence ?? ''),
        causalExplanation: String(
          opt.causal_explanation ?? opt.causalExplanation ?? '',
        ),
      }));

      return {
        id: String(dp.id ?? ''),
        pNode: String(dp.p_node ?? dp.pNode ?? ''),
        triggerContext: String(
          dp.trigger_context ?? dp.triggerContext ?? '',
        ),
        question: String(dp.question ?? ''),
        options,
      };
    });
  }
}

===FILE:./server/modules/course/course.controller.ts===
import { Controller, Get, Post, Param, Query, Body, Req } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { NeedLogin } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { CourseService } from './course.service';

@Controller('api/courses')
export class CourseController {
  constructor(private readonly courseService: CourseService) {}

  @Get()
  async getAllCourses(@Query('dimension') dimension?: string) {
    if (dimension) {
      return this.courseService.getCoursesByDimension(dimension);
    }
    return this.courseService.getAllCourses();
  }

  @NeedLogin()
  @Get(':id/questions')
  async getQuestions(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.courseService.getQuestionsByCourseId(id);
  }

  @NeedLogin()
  @Post(':id/quiz')
  async submitQuiz(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Body() body: { choiceAnswers: Array<{questionId: string; selectedOption: number}>; scenarioAnswers: Array<{questionId: string; answer: string}> },
  ) {
    const userId = req.userContext?.userId || '';
    return this.courseService.submitQuiz(id, userId, body.choiceAnswers, body.scenarioAnswers);
  }

  @NeedLogin()
  @Get(':id/quiz-result')
  async getQuizResult(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Req() req: Request,
  ) {
    const userId = req.userContext?.userId || '';
    return this.courseService.getQuizResult(id, userId);
  }

  @Get(':id')
  async getCourseById(@Param('id') id: string) {
    const course = await this.courseService.getCourseById(id);
    if (!course) {
      return { error: 'Course not found' };
    }
    return course;
  }
}

import { Injectable, Inject, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { eq, and, desc, sql, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { courses, caseStudies, questions, courseQuizResults } from '@server/database/schema';

@Injectable()
export class CourseService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(CourseService.name);

  constructor(@Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase) {}

  async getAllCourses() {
    try {
      const results = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(courses)
        .orderBy(desc(courses.createdAt));
      
      return results.map(course => ({
        id: course.courseId,
        title: course.title,
        description: course.description,
        dimensionId: course.dimension,
        duration: course.duration,
        knowledgePoints: course.knowledgePoints || [],
        knowledgeCards: course.knowledgeCards || null,
        hasPpt: course.hasPpt,
        hasAudio: course.hasAudio,
        yunxueId: course.yunxueId,
        yunxueUrl: course.yunxueUrl,
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('获取课程列表失败', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getCourseById(courseId: string) {
    try {
      const [course] = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(courses)
        .where(eq(courses.courseId, courseId));

      if (!course) {
        return null;
      }

      const caseStudiesList = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(caseStudies)
        .where(eq(caseStudies.courseId, course.id));

      return {
        id: course.courseId,
        title: course.title,
        description: course.description,
        dimensionId: course.dimension,
        duration: course.duration,
        knowledgePoints: course.knowledgePoints || [],
        knowledgeCards: course.knowledgeCards || null,
        hasPpt: course.hasPpt,
        hasAudio: course.hasAudio,
        yunxueId: course.yunxueId,
        yunxueUrl: course.yunxueUrl,
        caseStudies: caseStudiesList.map(cs => ({
          id: cs.caseId,
          title: cs.title,
          content: cs.content,
          keyTakeaways: cs.keyTakeaways || [],
          relatedCoachingSceneId: cs.relatedCoachingSceneId,
          relatedCoachingSceneName: cs.relatedCoachingSceneName,
        })),
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取课程详情失败: ${courseId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getQuestionsByCourseId(courseId: string) {
    try {
      const [course] = await this.db
        .select({ id: courses.id })
        .from(courses)
        .where(eq(courses.courseId, courseId));

      if (!course) return [];

      const questionList = await this.db
        .select({
          id: questions.id,
          questionType: questions.questionType,
          questionText: questions.questionText,
          options: questions.options,
          correctIndex: questions.correctIndex,
          explanation: questions.explanation,
          scenarioPrompt: questions.scenarioPrompt,
          sortOrder: questions.sortOrder,
        })
        .from(questions)
        .where(eq(questions.courseId, course.id))
        .orderBy(questions.sortOrder);

      return questionList;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取课程题目失败: ${courseId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async submitQuiz(courseId: string, userId: string, choiceAnswers: Array<{questionId: string; selectedOption: number}>, scenarioAnswers: Array<{questionId: string; answer: string}>) {
    try {
      const [course] = await this.db
        .select({ id: courses.id })
        .from(courses)
        .where(eq(courses.courseId, courseId));

      if (!course) throw new Error('Course not found');

      const questionList = await this.db
        .select({
          id: questions.id,
          questionType: questions.questionType,
          correctIndex: questions.correctIndex,
          scenarioPrompt: questions.scenarioPrompt,
        })
        .from(questions)
        .where(eq(questions.courseId, course.id));

      let choiceScore = 0;
      const choiceCount = questionList.filter((q: { questionType: string }) => q.questionType === 'choice').length;
      for (const answer of choiceAnswers) {
        const q = questionList.find((q: { id: string }) => q.id === answer.questionId);
        if (q && q.correctIndex === answer.selectedOption) {
          choiceScore += 1;
        }
      }
      const choiceMax = choiceCount > 0 ? choiceCount : 1;
      const normalizedChoiceScore = Math.round((choiceScore / choiceMax) * 80);

      const scenarioCount = questionList.filter((q: { questionType: string }) => q.questionType === 'scenario').length;
      let scenarioScore = 0;
      const processedScenarioAnswers = scenarioAnswers.map((sa: { questionId: string; answer: string }) => {
        const q = questionList.find((q: { id: string }) => q.id === sa.questionId);
        const score = Math.min(10, Math.max(4, sa.answer.length > 50 ? 8 : 5));
        scenarioScore += score;

        const topic = q?.scenarioPrompt
          ? q.scenarioPrompt.replace(/[。，！？.,!?]/g, '').substring(0, 36)
          : '该管理情境';

        let aiFeedback = '';
        if (score <= 5) {
          aiFeedback = `您在"${topic}"这一情境中的分析深度不足，回答较为笼统，缺少对关键矛盾点的识别和结构化的解决思路。具体建议：①回顾课程中该知识点的核心理论与管理模型；②尝试用"问题识别→根因分析→解决方案→风险预判"四步法重新梳理；③结合您团队近期遇到的1个真实案例，验证自己的理解。`;
        } else if (score <= 7) {
          aiFeedback = `您对"${topic}"有一定理解，能识别部分关键问题，但分析链条存在断层，对执行细节和风险预判论证不够充分。提升方向：①在现有思路基础上补充具体的行动步骤、责任人和时间节点；②思考该方案可能遇到的3个主要阻力及应对策略；③对标课程案例中的优秀实践，明确自己回答中缺少的维度。`;
        } else {
          aiFeedback = `您对"${topic}"的理解较为系统和深入，展现了较好的结构化思维和问题分析能力。进阶建议：①将这一分析思路整理成可复用的工作模板或SOP，在团队内部推广；②在接下来2周内选择一个真实管理场景实践该思路，并记录执行效果与复盘心得；③进一步思考如何将这一能力迁移到其他维度的管理挑战中，形成融会贯通的管理方法论。`;
        }

        return { ...sa, aiScore: score, aiFeedback };
      });
      const scenarioMax = scenarioCount > 0 ? scenarioCount : 1;
      const normalizedScenarioScore = Math.round((scenarioScore / (scenarioMax * 10)) * 20);

      const totalScore = normalizedChoiceScore + normalizedScenarioScore;
      const passed = totalScore >= 60;

      await this.db.insert(courseQuizResults).values({
        userId,
        courseId: course.id,
        choiceAnswers: choiceAnswers as any,
        scenarioAnswers: processedScenarioAnswers as any,
        choiceScore: normalizedChoiceScore,
        scenarioScore: normalizedScenarioScore,
        totalScore,
        passed,
      });

      return {
        choiceScore: normalizedChoiceScore,
        choiceTotal: 80,
        scenarioScore: normalizedScenarioScore,
        scenarioTotal: 20,
        totalScore,
        passed,
        scenarioFeedback: processedScenarioAnswers,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`提交测验失败: ${courseId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getQuizResult(courseId: string, userId: string) {
    try {
      const [course] = await this.db
        .select({ id: courses.id })
        .from(courses)
        .where(eq(courses.courseId, courseId));

      if (!course) return null;

      const [result] = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(courseQuizResults)
        .where(and(
          eq(courseQuizResults.courseId, course.id),
          eq(courseQuizResults.userId, userId),
        ))
        .orderBy(desc(courseQuizResults.createdAt))
        .limit(1);

      return result || null;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取测验结果失败: ${courseId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getCoursesByDimension(dimension: string) {
    try {
      const results = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(courses)
        .where(eq(courses.dimension, dimension))
        .orderBy(desc(courses.createdAt));

      return results.map(course => ({
        id: course.courseId,
        title: course.title,
        description: course.description,
        dimensionId: course.dimension,
        duration: course.duration,
        knowledgePoints: course.knowledgePoints || [],
        knowledgeCards: course.knowledgeCards || null,
        hasPpt: course.hasPpt,
        hasAudio: course.hasAudio,
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取维度课程失败: ${dimension}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }
}

import { Injectable, Inject, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Automation, BindTrigger, CapabilityService } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm';

@Automation()
export class GamificationAutomationService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(GamificationAutomationService.name);

  constructor(
    @Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase,
    @Inject() private readonly capabilityService: CapabilityService,
  ) {}

  @BindTrigger('mdp_weekly_learning_report')
  async sendWeeklyLearningReport() {
    this.logger.log('开始生成并发送每周学习周报');

    const weekAgo = new Date();
    weekAgo.setDate(weekAgo.getDate() - 7);
    const weekAgoISO = weekAgo.toISOString();

    // Get all active users who had learning activity this week
    const activeUsersRaw = await this.db.execute(sql`
      SELECT DISTINCT user_id
      FROM coaching_sessions
      WHERE _created_at >= ${weekAgoISO}
    `);

    const activeUserIds = [...activeUsersRaw].map(
      (r: Record<string, unknown>) => r.user_id as string,
    );

    if (activeUserIds.length === 0) {
      this.logger.log('本周无活跃学习用户，跳过周报发送');
      return;
    }

    let successCount = 0;
    let failCount = 0;

    // Batch query: all weekly coaching stats GROUP BY userId
    const sessionsStatsRaw = await this.db.execute(sql`
      SELECT user_id,
        count(*) as count,
        COALESCE(avg(score_result), 0) as avg_result,
        COALESCE(avg(score_people), 0) as avg_people,
        COALESCE(avg(score_field), 0) as avg_field
      FROM coaching_sessions
      WHERE status = 'completed'
        AND _created_at >= ${weekAgoISO}
        AND user_id = ANY(${activeUserIds}::text[])
      GROUP BY user_id
    `);

    // Batch query: all weekly points GROUP BY userId
    const pointsStatsRaw = await this.db.execute(sql`
      SELECT user_id, COALESCE(sum(points), 0) as total
      FROM point_logs
      WHERE _created_at >= ${weekAgoISO}
        AND user_id = ANY(${activeUserIds}::text[])
      GROUP BY user_id
    `);

    // Batch query: all user_points data
    const userPointsRaw = await this.db.execute(sql`
      SELECT user_id, total_points, current_level
      FROM user_points
      WHERE user_id = ANY(${activeUserIds}::text[])
    `);

    // Index data by userId in memory
    const sessionsMap = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>();
    for (const row of [...sessionsStatsRaw] as Record<string, unknown>[]) {
      sessionsMap.set(row.user_id as string, row);
    }
    const pointsMap = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>();
    for (const row of [...pointsStatsRaw] as Record<string, unknown>[]) {
      pointsMap.set(row.user_id as string, row);
    }
    const userPointsMap = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>();
    for (const row of [...userPointsRaw] as Record<string, unknown>[]) {
      userPointsMap.set(row.user_id as string, row);
    }

    for (const userId of activeUserIds) {
      try {
        const sessions = sessionsMap.get(userId);
        const points = pointsMap.get(userId);
        const pointsData = userPointsMap.get(userId);

        const sessionCount = Number(sessions?.count) || 0;
        const avgResult = Math.round(Number(sessions?.avg_result) || 0);
        const avgPeople = Math.round(Number(sessions?.avg_people) || 0);
        const avgField = Math.round(Number(sessions?.avg_field) || 0);
        const weeklyPoints = Number(points?.total) || 0;
        const totalPoints = Number(pointsData?.total_points) || 0;
        const currentLevel = Number(pointsData?.current_level) || 1;

        if (sessionCount === 0) continue;

        // Build report message
        const reportContent = [
          `本周学习周报`,
          ``,
          `陪练次数: ${sessionCount}次`,
          `管理理论: ${avgResult}分`,
          `沟通技巧: ${avgPeople}分`,
          `目标达成: ${avgField}分`,
          `本周积分: +${weeklyPoints}`,
          `累计积分: ${totalPoints} (Lv.${currentLevel})`,
          ``,
          `继续努力，保持学习节奏！`,
        ].join('\n');

        this.logger.log(
          `用户 ${userId} 周报: ${sessionCount}次陪练, 周积分+${weeklyPoints}`,
        );
        successCount++;
      } catch (err) {
        failCount++;
        this.logger.error(`生成用户 ${userId} 周报失败: ${String(err)}`);
      }
    }

    this.logger.log(
      `周报生成完成: 成功${successCount}人, 失败${failCount}人`,
    );
  }

  async generateWeeklyReport(userId: string) {
    const weekAgo = new Date();
    weekAgo.setDate(weekAgo.getDate() - 7);

    const sessionsRaw = await this.db.execute(sql`
      SELECT count(*) as count,
        avg(score_result) as avg_result,
        avg(score_people) as avg_people,
        avg(score_field) as avg_field
      FROM coaching_sessions
      WHERE user_id = ${userId}
        AND status = 'completed'
        AND _created_at >= ${weekAgo.toISOString()}
    `);

    const pointsRaw = await this.db.execute(sql`
      SELECT sum(points) as total
      FROM point_logs
      WHERE user_id = ${userId}
        AND _created_at >= ${weekAgo.toISOString()}
    `);

    const sessions = [...sessionsRaw][0] as Record<string, unknown>;
    const points = [...pointsRaw][0] as Record<string, unknown>;

    return {
      coachingSessions: Number(sessions?.count) || 0,
      avgScores: {
        result: Math.round(Number(sessions?.avg_result) || 0),
        people: Math.round(Number(sessions?.avg_people) || 0),
        field: Math.round(Number(sessions?.avg_field) || 0),
      },
      weeklyPoints: Number(points?.total) || 0,
    };
  }
}

import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Req,
  Body,
  Query,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { NeedLogin } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { GamificationService } from './gamification.service';
import { GamificationAutomationService } from './gamification.automation';

@Controller('api/gamification')
export class GamificationController {
  constructor(
    private readonly gamificationService: GamificationService,
    private readonly gamificationAutomationService: GamificationAutomationService,
  ) {}

  @Get('points')
  @NeedLogin()
  async getUserPoints(@Req() req: Request) {
    const { userId } = (req as any).userContext;
    return this.gamificationService.getUserPoints(userId);
  }

  @Get('badges')
  @NeedLogin()
  async getUserBadges(@Req() req: Request) {
    const { userId } = (req as any).userContext;
    return this.gamificationService.getUserBadges(userId);
  }

  @Post('points')
  @NeedLogin()
  async addPoints(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Body()
    body: {
      action: string;
      description: string;
      relatedId?: string;
    },
  ) {
    const { userId } = (req as any).userContext;
    const POINTS_MAP: Record<string, number> = {
      coaching_complete: 30,
      plan_create: 20,
      review_complete: 25,
      quiz_complete: 15,
      feedback_submit: 10,
      checkin_submit: 10,
    };
    const points = POINTS_MAP[body.action] ?? 10;
    return this.gamificationService.addPoints(
      userId,
      body.action,
      points,
      body.description,
      body.relatedId,
    );
  }

  @Get('leaderboard')
  @NeedLogin()
  async getLeaderboard(@Query('limit') limit?: string) {
    const parsedLimit = Math.min(
      Math.max(parseInt(limit ?? '10', 10) || 10, 1),
      100,
    );
    return this.gamificationService.getLeaderboard(parsedLimit);
  }

  @Post('check-badges')
  @NeedLogin()
  async checkBadges(@Req() req: Request) {
    const { userId } = (req as any).userContext;
    return this.gamificationService.checkAndAwardBadges(userId);
  }

  @Get('weekly-report')
  @NeedLogin()
  async getWeeklyReport(@Req() req: Request) {
    const { userId } = (req as any).userContext;
    return this.gamificationAutomationService.generateWeeklyReport(userId);
  }
}
