===FILE:./server/modules/gamification/gamification.service.ts===
import { Injectable, Inject, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { eq, desc, sql, and } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  coachingSessions,
  practicePlans,
  peerReviews,
  courseQuizResults,
} from '@server/database/schema';

interface BadgeDefinition {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  icon: string;
}

const BADGE_DEFINITIONS: BadgeDefinition[] = [
  { id: 'first_step', name: '初出茅庐', description: '完成首次测评', icon: '🏆' },
  { id: 'first_course', name: '学习者', description: '完成第一门课程', icon: '📚' },
  { id: 'quiz_master', name: '靶心', description: '测验获得满分', icon: '🎯' },
  { id: 'coaching_pro', name: '陪练达人', description: '完成5次AI陪练', icon: '🤖' },
  { id: 'action_taker', name: '行动派', description: '创建第一个行动计划', icon: '✍️' },
  { id: 'review_master', name: '复盘大师', description: '完成3次行动计划复盘', icon: '🔄' },
  { id: 'well_rounded', name: '全面成长', description: '三维度评分都达到70分', icon: '🌟' },
  { id: 'streak_7', name: '连胜王', description: '连续7天有学习活动', icon: '🔥' },
  { id: 'team_leader', name: '团队领袖', description: '获得3条360反馈', icon: '👥' },
  { id: 'diamond_manager', name: '钻石管理者', description: '总积分达到1000分', icon: '💎' },
];

@Injectable()
export class GamificationService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(GamificationService.name);

  constructor(@Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase) {}

  async getUserPoints(userId: string) {
    const rows = await this.db.execute(sql`
      SELECT id, user_id, total_points, current_level, streak_days, last_active_date
      FROM user_points
      WHERE user_id = ${userId}
    `);

    const result = [...rows];
    if (result.length === 0) {
      return {
        userId,
        totalPoints: 0,
        currentLevel: 1,
        streakDays: 0,
        lastActiveDate: null,
      };
    }

    const row: Record<string, unknown> = result[0] as Record<string, unknown>;
    return {
      userId: row.user_id as string,
      totalPoints: Number(row.total_points) || 0,
      currentLevel: Number(row.current_level) || 1,
      streakDays: Number(row.streak_days) || 0,
      lastActiveDate: row.last_active_date as string | null,
    };
  }

  async addPoints(
    userId: string,
    action: string,
    points: number,
    description: string,
    relatedId?: string,
  ) {
    // Insert point log
    await this.db.execute(sql`
      INSERT INTO point_logs (user_id, action, points, description, related_id)
      VALUES (${userId}, ${action}, ${points}, ${description}, ${relatedId ?? null})
    `);

    // Upsert user_points
    await this.db.execute(sql`
      INSERT INTO user_points (user_id, total_points, current_level, streak_days, last_active_date)
      VALUES (${userId}, ${points}, 1, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
      ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET
        total_points = user_points.total_points + ${points},
        current_level = GREATEST(1, FLOOR((user_points.total_points + ${points}) / 200) + 1),
        last_active_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        _updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    `);

    // Update streak days
    await this.updateStreakDays(userId);

    this.logger.log(
      `Added ${points} points to user ${userId} for action ${action}`,
    );

    return this.getUserPoints(userId);
  }

  private async updateStreakDays(userId: string) {
    const datesRaw = await this.db.execute(sql`
      SELECT DISTINCT DATE(_created_at) AS active_date
      FROM point_logs
      WHERE user_id = ${userId}
      ORDER BY active_date DESC
      LIMIT 8
    `);

    const dates: Date[] = [...datesRaw].map(
      (row: Record<string, unknown>) => new Date(row.active_date as string),
    );

    if (dates.length === 0) return;

    let streakDays = 1;
    for (let i = 1; i < dates.length; i++) {
      const diffMs = dates[i - 1].getTime() - dates[i].getTime();
      const diffDays = Math.round(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      if (diffDays === 1) {
        streakDays++;
      } else {
        break;
      }
    }

    await this.db.execute(sql`
      UPDATE user_points
      SET streak_days = ${streakDays}
      WHERE user_id = ${userId}
    `);
  }

  async getUserBadges(userId: string) {
    const badgesRaw = await this.db.execute(sql`
      SELECT id, user_id, badge_id, badge_name, badge_icon, badge_description, earned_at
      FROM user_badges
      WHERE user_id = ${userId}
      ORDER BY earned_at DESC
    `);

    return [...badgesRaw].map((row: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
      id: row.id as string,
      userId: row.user_id as string,
      badgeId: row.badge_id as string,
      badgeName: row.badge_name as string,
      badgeIcon: row.badge_icon as string,
      badgeDescription: row.badge_description as string,
      earnedAt: row.earned_at as string,
    }));
  }

  async checkAndAwardBadges(userId: string) {
    const earnedBadges = await this.getUserBadges(userId);
    const earnedBadgeIds: Set<string> = new Set(
      earnedBadges.map((b: { badgeId: string }) => b.badgeId),
    );

    // Preload all data needed for badge checks in parallel
    const [pointLogActions, quizResults, completedSessions, userPlans, userReviews, pointsData] = await Promise.all([
      // Point log actions (for first_step, first_course)
      this.db.execute(sql`
        SELECT DISTINCT action FROM point_logs WHERE user_id = ${userId}
      `).then((rows) => new Set([...rows as Record<string, unknown>[]].map((r: Record<string, unknown>) => r.action as string))),
      // Quiz results (for quiz_master)
      this.db.select().from(courseQuizResults).where(eq(courseQuizResults.userId, userId)),
      // Completed sessions (for coaching_pro, well_rounded)
      this.db.select({
        scoreResult: coachingSessions.scoreResult,
        scorePeople: coachingSessions.scorePeople,
        scoreField: coachingSessions.scoreField,
      }).from(coachingSessions).where(and(
        eq(coachingSessions.userId, userId),
        eq(coachingSessions.status, 'completed'),
      )),
      // Plans (for action_taker, review_master)
      this.db.select({ id: practicePlans.id, reviewed: practicePlans.reviewed })
        .from(practicePlans).where(eq(practicePlans.userId, userId)),
      // Peer reviews (for team_leader)
      this.db.select({ id: peerReviews.id })
        .from(peerReviews).where(eq(peerReviews.userId, userId)),
      // User points (for streak_7, diamond_manager)
      this.getUserPoints(userId),
    ]);

    const preloaded = { pointLogActions, quizResults, completedSessions, userPlans, userReviews, pointsData };

    const newBadges: BadgeDefinition[] = [];

    // Check each badge condition using preloaded data
    for (const badge of BADGE_DEFINITIONS) {
      if (earnedBadgeIds.has(badge.id)) continue;

      const earned = this.checkBadgeConditionSync(badge.id, preloaded);
      if (earned) {
        newBadges.push(badge);
      }
    }

    // Award new badges
    for (const badge of newBadges) {
      await this.db.execute(sql`
        INSERT INTO user_badges (user_id, badge_id, badge_name, badge_icon, badge_description)
        VALUES (${userId}, ${badge.id}, ${badge.name}, ${badge.icon}, ${badge.description})
        ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
      `);
      this.logger.log(
        `Awarded badge ${badge.name} to user ${userId}`,
      );
    }

    return {
      newBadges: newBadges.map((b: BadgeDefinition) => ({
        badgeId: b.id,
        badgeName: b.name,
        badgeIcon: b.icon,
        badgeDescription: b.description,
      })),
      totalBadges: earnedBadges.length + newBadges.length,
    };
  }

  private checkBadgeConditionSync(
    badgeId: string,
    data: {
      pointLogActions: Set<string>;
      quizResults: { totalScore: number | null }[];
      completedSessions: { scoreResult: number | null; scorePeople: number | null; scoreField: number | null }[];
      userPlans: { id: string; reviewed: boolean | null }[];
      userReviews: { id: string }[];
      pointsData: { streakDays: number; totalPoints: number };
    },
  ): boolean {
    switch (badgeId) {
      case 'first_step':
        return data.pointLogActions.has('assessment_complete');

      case 'first_course':
        return data.pointLogActions.has('course_learn');

      case 'quiz_master':
        return data.quizResults.some(
          (r: { totalScore: number | null }) => r.totalScore !== null && r.totalScore >= 100,
        );

      case 'coaching_pro':
        return data.completedSessions.length >= 5;

      case 'action_taker':
        return data.userPlans.length >= 1;

      case 'review_master': {
        const reviewedCount = data.userPlans.filter((p: { reviewed: boolean | null }) => p.reviewed).length;
        return reviewedCount >= 3;
      }

      case 'well_rounded': {
        if (data.completedSessions.length === 0) return false;
        const len = data.completedSessions.length;
        const avgResult = data.completedSessions.reduce(
          (sum: number, s: { scoreResult: number | null }) => sum + (s.scoreResult || 0), 0,
        ) / len;
        const avgPeople = data.completedSessions.reduce(
          (sum: number, s: { scorePeople: number | null }) => sum + (s.scorePeople || 0), 0,
        ) / len;
        const avgField = data.completedSessions.reduce(
          (sum: number, s: { scoreField: number | null }) => sum + (s.scoreField || 0), 0,
        ) / len;
        return avgResult >= 70 && avgPeople >= 70 && avgField >= 70;
      }

      case 'streak_7':
        return data.pointsData.streakDays >= 7;

      case 'team_leader':
        return data.userReviews.length >= 3;

      case 'diamond_manager':
        return data.pointsData.totalPoints >= 1000;

      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  async getLeaderboard(limit: number) {
    const rows = await this.db.execute(sql`
      SELECT user_id, total_points, current_level, streak_days
      FROM user_points
      ORDER BY total_points DESC
      LIMIT ${limit}
    `);

    return [...rows].map((row: Record<string, unknown>, index: number) => ({
      rank: index + 1,
      userId: row.user_id as string,
      totalPoints: Number(row.total_points) || 0,
      currentLevel: Number(row.current_level) || 1,
      streakDays: Number(row.streak_days) || 0,
    }));
  }
}

import { Injectable, Logger, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { eq, and, desc } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { practiceCommit, coachingSessions } from '@server/database/schema';
import type {
  PR2PracticeCommit,
  PR2HistoryData,
  PR2PrincipleScores,
} from '@shared/coaching-pr2';

@Injectable()
export class PracticeCommitService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(PracticeCommitService.name);

  constructor(@Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase) {}

  async getHistory(userId: string, sceneId: string): Promise<PR2HistoryData> {
    try {
      const commits = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(practiceCommit)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(practiceCommit.userId, userId),
            eq(practiceCommit.sceneId, sceneId),
          ),
        )
        .orderBy(desc(practiceCommit.createdAt));

      const sessions = await this.db
        .select({
          principlesScores: coachingSessions.principlesScores,
          completedAt: coachingSessions.completedAt,
        })
        .from(coachingSessions)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(coachingSessions.userId, userId),
            eq(coachingSessions.sceneId, sceneId),
            eq(coachingSessions.status, 'completed'),
          ),
        )
        .orderBy(desc(coachingSessions.completedAt));

      const lastCommit = commits.length > 0 ? commits[0].commitContent : null;
      const practiceCount = sessions.length;

      let lastPracticeScore: number | null = null;
      let weakestPrinciple: string | null = null;
      let weakestKey: string | null = null;

      if (sessions.length > 0 && sessions[0].principlesScores) {
        const scores = sessions[0].principlesScores as PR2PrincipleScores;
        const entries = Object.entries(scores) as [string, number][];
        const avg = entries.reduce((sum, [, v]) => sum + v, 0) / entries.length;
        lastPracticeScore = Math.round(avg);

        const [wKey, wScore] = entries.reduce(
          (min, cur) => (cur[1] < min[1] ? cur : min),
          entries[0],
        );
        const labels: Record<string, string> = {
          trust: '建立信任',
          purpose: '说明目的',
          encourage: '鼓励表达',
          listen: '认真倾听',
          end: '积极结束',
        };
        weakestKey = wKey;
        weakestPrinciple = labels[wKey] ?? wKey;
      }

      const scoreHistory = sessions
        .filter((s) => s.principlesScores && s.completedAt)
        .map((s) => ({
          date: s.completedAt instanceof Date
            ? s.completedAt.toISOString()
            : new Date(s.completedAt as string).toISOString(),
          scores: s.principlesScores as PR2PrincipleScores,
        }))
        .slice(0, 10);

      return {
        lastPracticeScore,
        weakestPrinciple,
        weakestKey,
        lastCommit,
        practiceCount,
        scoreHistory,
      };
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.error(`获取PR2历史数据失败: ${String(err)}`);
      return {
        lastPracticeScore: null,
        weakestPrinciple: null,
        weakestKey: null,
        lastCommit: null,
        practiceCount: 0,
        scoreHistory: [],
      };
    }
  }

  async saveCommit(
    userId: string,
    sceneId: string,
    sessionId: string,
    commitContent: string,
  ): Promise<PR2PracticeCommit> {
    try {
      const [record] = await this.db
        .insert(practiceCommit)
        .values({
          userId,
          sceneId,
          sessionId,
          commitContent,
          isVerified: false,
        })
        .returning();

      return {
        id: record.id,
        userId: record.userId,
        sceneId: record.sceneId,
        sessionId: record.sessionId ?? '',
        commitContent: record.commitContent,
        isVerified: record.isVerified ?? false,
        createdAt: record.createdAt instanceof Date
          ? record.createdAt.toISOString()
          : new Date().toISOString(),
      };
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.error(`保存行动承诺失败: ${String(err)}`);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

===FILE:./server/modules/practice/practice.automation.ts===
import { Injectable, Inject, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Automation, BindTrigger, CapabilityService } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { eq, and, lte } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { practicePlans } from '@server/database/schema';

@Automation()
export class PracticeAutomationService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(PracticeAutomationService.name);

  constructor(
    @Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase,
    @Inject() private readonly capabilityService: CapabilityService,
  ) {}

  @BindTrigger('mdp_practice_reminder_daily')
  async sendPracticeReminders() {
    this.logger.log('开始检查实战计划到期提醒');

    const sevenDaysLater = new Date();
    sevenDaysLater.setDate(sevenDaysLater.getDate() + 7);

    const duePlans = await this.db
      .select({
        userId: practicePlans.userId,
        sceneName: practicePlans.sceneName,
        reviewDate: practicePlans.reviewDate,
      })
      .from(practicePlans)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(practicePlans.status, 'active'),
          eq(practicePlans.reviewed, false),
          lte(practicePlans.reviewDate, sevenDaysLater),
        ),
      );

    if (duePlans.length === 0) {
      this.logger.log('无到期实战计划，跳过提醒');
      return;
    }

    const userPlans = new Map<string, { sceneName: string | null; reviewDate: Date | null }[]>();
    for (const plan of duePlans) {
      const plans = userPlans.get(plan.userId) || [];
      plans.push({ sceneName: plan.sceneName, reviewDate: plan.reviewDate });
      userPlans.set(plan.userId, plans);
    }

    let successCount = 0;
    let failCount = 0;

    for (const [userId, plans] of userPlans) {
      const nearestPlan = plans.sort((a: { reviewDate: Date | null }, b: { reviewDate: Date | null }) => {
        if (!a.reviewDate || !b.reviewDate) return 0;
        return new Date(a.reviewDate).getTime() - new Date(b.reviewDate).getTime();
      })[0];

      try {
        const deadline = nearestPlan.reviewDate
          ? new Date(nearestPlan.reviewDate).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')
          : '即将到期';

        await this.capabilityService
          .load('mdp_coach_practice_plan_expire_reminder_1')
          .call('send_feishu_message', {
            receiverUsers: [userId],
            scenarioName: nearestPlan.sceneName || '实战计划',
            deadline,
          });

        successCount++;
        this.logger.log(`已发送提醒给用户: ${userId}`);
      } catch (err) {
        failCount++;
        this.logger.error(`发送提醒失败，用户: ${userId}, 错误: ${String(err)}`);
      }
    }

    this.logger.log(`提醒发送完成: 成功${successCount}人, 失败${failCount}人`);
  }
}

import { Injectable, Inject, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { eq, and, desc, lte, sql, count, avg } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { practicePlans, peerReviews, coachingSessions } from '@server/database/schema';
import { GamificationService } from '../gamification/gamification.service';

@Injectable()
export class PracticeService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(PracticeService.name);

  constructor(
    @Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase,
    private readonly gamificationService: GamificationService,
  ) {}

  async createPracticePlan(data: {
    userId: string;
    sceneId?: string;
    sceneName?: string;
    learnings?: string;
    inspirations?: string;
    applicationPoints?: string;
    reviewPeriod?: string;
    reviewDate?: Date;
  }) {
    const [result] = await this.db.insert(practicePlans).values({
      userId: data.userId,
      sceneId: data.sceneId,
      sceneName: data.sceneName,
      learnings: data.learnings,
      inspirations: data.inspirations,
      applicationPoints: data.applicationPoints,
      reviewPeriod: data.reviewPeriod,
      reviewDate: data.reviewDate,
      status: 'active',
    }).returning();

    try {
      await this.gamificationService.addPoints(
        data.userId,
        'plan_create',
        20,
        '创建实战计划',
        result.id,
      );
    } catch (gamErr) {
      this.logger.error(`创建计划积分奖励失败: ${result.id}`, String(gamErr));
    }

    return result;
  }

  async getMyPracticePlans(userId: string) {
    const results = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(practicePlans)
      .where(eq(practicePlans.userId, userId))
      .orderBy(desc(practicePlans.createdAt));

    return results;
  }

  async getPracticePlanById(planId: string, userId: string) {
    const [result] = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(practicePlans)
      .where(and(eq(practicePlans.id, planId), eq(practicePlans.userId, userId)));

    return result || null;
  }

  async updatePracticePlan(
    planId: string,
    userId: string,
    data: {
      learnings?: string;
      inspirations?: string;
      applicationPoints?: string;
      growthReflection?: string;
      businessValue?: string;
      reviewed?: boolean;
      status?: string;
      attachments?: any;
    },
  ) {
    const [result] = await this.db
      .update(practicePlans)
      .set({
        ...data,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(and(eq(practicePlans.id, planId), eq(practicePlans.userId, userId)))
      .returning();

    if (result && data.reviewed === true) {
      try {
        await this.gamificationService.addPoints(
          userId,
          'review_complete',
          25,
          '完成计划复盘',
          planId,
        );
      } catch (gamErr) {
        this.logger.error(`复盘积分奖励失败: ${planId}`, String(gamErr));
      }
    }

    return result || null;
  }

  async getDuePlans(userId: string) {
    const now = new Date();
    const results = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(practicePlans)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(practicePlans.userId, userId),
          eq(practicePlans.status, 'active'),
          eq(practicePlans.reviewed, false),
          lte(practicePlans.reviewDate, now),
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(desc(practicePlans.reviewDate));

    return results;
  }

  async createPeerReview(data: {
    userId: string;
    reviewerId?: string;
    reviewerRelation: string;
    scoreResult: number;
    scorePeople: number;
    scoreField: number;
    comment?: string;
    anonymous?: boolean;
    subScores?: Record<string, number>;
  }) {
    const [result] = await this.db.insert(peerReviews).values({
      userId: data.userId,
      reviewerId: data.reviewerId,
      reviewerRelation: data.reviewerRelation,
      scoreResult: data.scoreResult,
      scorePeople: data.scorePeople,
      scoreField: data.scoreField,
      comment: data.comment,
      anonymous: data.anonymous ?? true,
      subScores: data.subScores || {},
    }).returning();

    return result;
  }

  async getPeerReviewSummary(userId: string) {
    const reviews = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(peerReviews)
      .where(eq(peerReviews.userId, userId))
      .orderBy(desc(peerReviews.createdAt));

    const relations = ['superior', 'peer', 'subordinate'] as const;
    const summary: Record<string, { scoreResult: number; scorePeople: number; scoreField: number; count: number } | null> = {};

    for (const relation of relations) {
      const group = reviews.filter((r: typeof reviews[0]) => r.reviewerRelation === relation);
      if (group.length === 0) {
        summary[relation] = null;
        continue;
      }
      const avg = (arr: number[]) => Math.round(arr.reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0) / arr.length);
      summary[relation] = {
        scoreResult: avg(group.map((r: typeof reviews[0]) => r.scoreResult)),
        scorePeople: avg(group.map((r: typeof reviews[0]) => r.scorePeople)),
        scoreField: avg(group.map((r: typeof reviews[0]) => r.scoreField)),
        count: group.length,
      };
    }

    return {
      superior: summary['superior'],
      peer: summary['peer'],
      subordinate: summary['subordinate'],
      reviews: reviews.map((r: typeof reviews[0]) => ({
        ...r,
        createdAt: r.createdAt instanceof Date ? r.createdAt.toISOString() : r.createdAt,
      })),
    };
  }

  async getDuePlansForReminder() {
    const sevenDaysLater = new Date();
    sevenDaysLater.setDate(sevenDaysLater.getDate() + 7);
    const results = await this.db
      .select({
        userId: practicePlans.userId,
        sceneName: practicePlans.sceneName,
        reviewDate: practicePlans.reviewDate,
      })
      .from(practicePlans)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(practicePlans.status, 'active'),
          eq(practicePlans.reviewed, false),
          lte(practicePlans.reviewDate, sevenDaysLater),
        ),
      );
    return results;
  }

  async commitActionPlan(userId: string, data: {
    sceneId: string;
    sceneName: string;
    actionPlan: string;
  }) {
    try {
      const followUpDays = 7;
      const reviewDate = new Date();
      reviewDate.setDate(reviewDate.getDate() + followUpDays);

      const [result] = await this.db
        .insert(practicePlans)
        .values({
          userId,
          sceneId: data.sceneId,
          sceneName: data.sceneName,
          actionPlan: data.actionPlan,
          committedAt: new Date(),
          followUpDays,
          reviewDate,
          status: 'active',
          reviewed: false,
        })
        .returning();

      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`提交行动计划失败: ${userId}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async createResult(data: {
    userId: string;
    growthReflection?: string;
    businessValue?: string;
  }) {
    const [result] = await this.db.insert(practicePlans).values({
      userId: data.userId,
      growthReflection: data.growthReflection,
      businessValue: data.businessValue,
      status: 'reviewed',
      reviewed: true,
      reviewPeriod: '1m',
    }).returning();

    return result;
  }

  async getUserStats(userId: string) {
    const HOURLY_RATE = 200;
    const AVG_SESSION_HOURS = 0.5;

    // SQL aggregation for sessions instead of full load + JS aggregation
    const sessionStats = await this.db
      .select({
        totalCount: count(),
        avgResult: avg(coachingSessions.scoreResult),
        avgPeople: avg(coachingSessions.scorePeople),
        avgField: avg(coachingSessions.scoreField),
      })
      .from(coachingSessions)
      .where(and(
        eq(coachingSessions.userId, userId),
        eq(coachingSessions.status, 'completed'),
      ));

    const totalSessions = Number(sessionStats[0]?.totalCount) || 0;
    const coachingHours = totalSessions * AVG_SESSION_HOURS;
    const avgResult = Math.round(Number(sessionStats[0]?.avgResult) || 0);
    const avgPeople = Math.round(Number(sessionStats[0]?.avgPeople) || 0);
    const avgField = Math.round(Number(sessionStats[0]?.avgField) || 0);

    // SQL aggregation for plans
    const planStats = await this.db
      .select({
        totalCount: count(),
        reviewedCount: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where reviewed = true)`,
        activeCount: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where status = 'active')`,
        businessValueCount: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where business_value is not null and trim(business_value) != '')`,
      })
      .from(practicePlans)
      .where(eq(practicePlans.userId, userId));

    const totalPlans = Number(planStats[0]?.totalCount) || 0;
    const reviewedPlans = Number(planStats[0]?.reviewedCount) || 0;
    const activePlans = Number(planStats[0]?.activeCount) || 0;
    const businessValueCount = Number(planStats[0]?.businessValueCount) || 0;
    const executionRate = totalPlans > 0 ? Math.round((reviewedPlans / totalPlans) * 100) : 0;

    const behaviorScore = totalPlans > 0
      ? Math.round((reviewedPlans / totalPlans) * 5 * 10) / 10
      : 0;

    const learningCost = coachingHours * HOURLY_RATE;
    const estimatedBusinessValue = reviewedPlans * 50000;

    const roi = learningCost > 0
      ? Math.round(((estimatedBusinessValue - learningCost) / learningCost) * 100)
      : 0;

    const hasEnoughData = totalSessions >= 3 && totalPlans >= 2;

    return {
      totalSessions,
      coachingHours,
      avgScores: { result: avgResult, people: avgPeople, field: avgField },
      totalPlans,
      reviewedPlans,
      activePlans,
      executionRate,
      behaviorScore,
      learningCost,
      estimatedBusinessValue,
      roi,
      hasEnoughData,
      businessValueCount,
      methodology: {
        learningCostFormula: '陪练次数 × 0.5h × ¥200/h（管理者平均时薪）',
        businessValueFormula: '已复盘计划数 × ¥5万（单计划平均业务价值估算）',
        roiFormula: '(业务价值 - 学习投入) / 学习投入 × 100%',
        behaviorScoreFormula: '行动计划执行率 × 5分制',
      },
    };
  }
}

  @Get('problems')

    @Query('dimension') dimension?: string,
    @Query('businessType') businessType?: string,
    @Query('group') group?: string,

    @Query('businessType') businessType?: string,

  ) {
    return this.studentDataService.getExperiences(dimension, businessType, group);
  }

  @Get('problems/:id')
  async getProblemById(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.studentDataService.getProblemById(id);
  }

  @Get('experiences/:id')
  async getExperienceById(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.studentDataService.getExperienceById(id);
  }
}

===FILE:./server/modules/student-data/student-data.service.ts===
import { Injectable, Inject, Logger, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DRIZZLE_DATABASE, type PostgresJsDatabase } from '@lark-apaas/fullstack-nestjs-core';
import { eq, and } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { studentProblems, studentExperiences } from '@server/database/schema';
import type { StudentProblem, StudentExperience } from '@shared/api.interface';

@Injectable()
export class StudentDataService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(StudentDataService.name);

  constructor(@Inject(DRIZZLE_DATABASE) private readonly db: PostgresJsDatabase) {}

  async getProblems(
    dimension?: string,
    businessType?: string,
    group?: string,
  ): Promise<StudentProblem[]> {
    try {
      const conditions = [];
      if (dimension) {
        conditions.push(eq(studentProblems.leadershipDimension, dimension));
      }
      if (businessType) {
        conditions.push(eq(studentProblems.businessType, businessType));
      }
      if (group) {
        conditions.push(eq(studentProblems.groupName, group));
      }

      const results = conditions.length > 0
        ? await this.db
            .select()
            .from(studentProblems)
            .where(and(...conditions))
        : await this.db.select().from(studentProblems);

      return results.map((row: typeof studentProblems.$inferSelect) =>
        this.mapProblemToDto(row),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('获取学员痛点列表失败', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getExperiences(
    dimension?: string,
    businessType?: string,
    group?: string,
  ): Promise<StudentExperience[]> {
    try {
      const conditions = [];
      if (dimension) {
        conditions.push(eq(studentExperiences.leadershipDimension, dimension));
      }
      if (businessType) {
        conditions.push(eq(studentExperiences.businessType, businessType));
      }
      if (group) {
        conditions.push(eq(studentExperiences.groupName, group));
      }

      const results = conditions.length > 0
        ? await this.db
            .select()
            .from(studentExperiences)
            .where(and(...conditions))
        : await this.db.select().from(studentExperiences);

      return results.map((row: typeof studentExperiences.$inferSelect) =>
        this.mapExperienceToDto(row),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('获取学员经验列表失败', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getProblemById(id: string): Promise<StudentProblem> {
    try {
      const [row] = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(studentProblems)
        .where(eq(studentProblems.id, id));

      if (!row) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`学员痛点 ${id} 不存在`);
      }

      return this.mapProblemToDto(row);
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取学员痛点详情失败: ${id}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getExperienceById(id: string): Promise<StudentExperience> {
    try {
      const [row] = await this.db
        .select()
        .from(studentExperiences)
        .where(eq(studentExperiences.id, id));

      if (!row) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`学员经验 ${id} 不存在`);
      }

      return this.mapExperienceToDto(row);
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`获取学员经验详情失败: ${id}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private mapProblemToDto(
    row: typeof studentProblems.$inferSelect,
  ): StudentProblem {
    return {
      id: row.id,
      groupName: row.groupName,
      personInfo: row.personInfo,
      company: row.company ?? '',
      region: row.region ?? '',
      businessType: row.businessType,
      leadershipDimension: row.leadershipDimension,
      challengeTheme: row.challengeTheme,
      currentSituation: row.currentSituation ?? '',
      helpNeeded: row.helpNeeded ?? '',
      tags: row.tags ?? [],
    };
  }

  private mapExperienceToDto(
    row: typeof studentExperiences.$inferSelect,
  ): StudentExperience {
    return {
      id: row.id,
      groupName: row.groupName,
      personInfo: row.personInfo,
      company: row.company ?? '',
      region: row.region ?? '',
      businessType: row.businessType,
      leadershipDimension: row.leadershipDimension,
      experienceTheme: row.experienceTheme,
      coreStory: row.coreStory ?? '',
      experienceSummary: row.experienceSummary ?? '',
      relatedSceneId: row.relatedSceneId ?? '',
      tags: row.tags ?? [],
    };
  }
}

===FILE:./shared/scenario-json-repair.ts===
import type { IScenarioCard } from './api.interface';

export function repairJSON(raw: string): string {
  const chars = raw.split('');
  const result: string[] = [];
  let inStr = false;
  let i = 0;

  while (i < chars.length) {
    const ch = chars[i];
    const code = ch.charCodeAt(0);

    if (inStr) {
      if (ch === '\\') {
        result.push(ch);
        if (i + 1 < chars.length) {
          i++;
          const next = chars[i];
          if ('"\\\/bfnrtu'.includes(next)) {
            result.push(next);
          } else {
            result.push('\\u00' + next.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).padStart(2, '0'));
          }
        }
      } else if (ch === '"') {
        inStr = false;
        result.push(ch);
      } else if (code < 32) {
        switch (ch) {
          case '\n': result.push('\\n'); break;
          case '\r': result.push('\\r'); break;
          case '\t': result.push('\\t'); break;
          case '\b': result.push('\\b'); break;
          case '\f': result.push('\\f'); break;
          default: result.push('\\u' + code.toString(16).padStart(4, '0')); break;
        }
      } else {
        result.push(ch);
      }
    } else {
      if (ch === '"') {
        inStr = true;
        result.push(ch);
      } else if (ch === '/' && i + 1 < chars.length && chars[i + 1] === '/') {
        while (i < chars.length && chars[i] !== '\n') i++;
        continue;
      } else if (ch === '/' && i + 1 < chars.length && chars[i + 1] === '*') {
        i += 2;
        while (i < chars.length && !(chars[i] === '*' && i + 1 < chars.length && chars[i + 1] === '/')) i++;
        i += 2;
        continue;
      } else {
        result.push(ch);
      }
    }
    i++;
  }

  let text = result.join('');
  text = text.replace(/,\s*([\]}])/g, '$1');
  return text;
}

function fixUnquotedValues(text: string): string {
  const chars = text.split('');
  const result: string[] = [];
  let inStr = false;
  let escaped = false;
  let i = 0;

  while (i < chars.length) {
    const ch = chars[i];

    if (inStr) {
      result.push(ch);
      if (escaped) {
        escaped = false;
      } else if (ch === '\\') {
        escaped = true;
      } else if (ch === '"') {
        inStr = false;
      }
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    if (ch === '"') {
      inStr = true;
      result.push(ch);
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    if (ch === ':') {
      result.push(ch);
      i++;

      while (i < chars.length && (chars[i] === ' ' || chars[i] === '\t' || chars[i] === '\n' || chars[i] === '\r')) {
        result.push(chars[i]);
        i++;
      }

      if (i >= chars.length) break;

      const nextCh = chars[i];

      if (nextCh === '"' || nextCh === '{' || nextCh === '[') {
        continue;
      }

      if (nextCh === '-' || (nextCh >= '0' && nextCh <= '9')) {
        let numEnd = i;
        if (chars[numEnd] === '-') numEnd++;
        while (numEnd < chars.length && chars[numEnd] >= '0' && chars[numEnd] <= '9') numEnd++;
        if (numEnd < chars.length && chars[numEnd] === '.') {
          numEnd++;
          while (numEnd < chars.length && chars[numEnd] >= '0' && chars[numEnd] <= '9') numEnd++;
        }
        if (numEnd < chars.length && (chars[numEnd] === 'e' || chars[numEnd] === 'E')) {
          numEnd++;
          if (numEnd < chars.length && (chars[numEnd] === '+' || chars[numEnd] === '-')) numEnd++;
          while (numEnd < chars.length && chars[numEnd] >= '0' && chars[numEnd] <= '9') numEnd++;
        }
        const afterNum = chars[numEnd];
        if (afterNum === ',' || afterNum === '}' || afterNum === ']' || afterNum === ' ' || afterNum === '\t' || afterNum === '\n' || afterNum === '\r') {
          continue;
        }
      }

      if (text.startsWith('true', i) || text.startsWith('false', i) || text.startsWith('null', i)) {
        const wordLen = text.startsWith('true', i) ? 4 : text.startsWith('false', i) ? 5 : 4;
        const afterWord = i + wordLen < chars.length ? chars[i + wordLen] : ' ';
        if (afterWord === ',' || afterWord === '}' || afterWord === ']' || afterWord === ' ' || afterWord === '\t' || afterWord === '\n' || afterWord === '\r') {
          continue;
        }
      }

      let valEnd = i;
      while (valEnd < chars.length) {
        const vc = chars[valEnd];
        if (vc === ',' || vc === '}' || vc === ']' || vc === '\n' || vc === '\r') break;
        valEnd++;
      }
      let rawVal = text.slice(i, valEnd).trimEnd();
      if (rawVal.length > 0) {
        rawVal = rawVal.replace(/"/g, '\\"');
        result.push('"');
        for (const c of rawVal) {
          result.push(c);
        }
        result.push('"');
        i = i + rawVal.length;
        while (i < chars.length && (chars[i] === ' ' || chars[i] === '\t')) i++;
        continue;
      }
      continue;
    }

    result.push(ch);
    i++;
  }

  return result.join('');
}

function tryParseAny(s: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const obj = JSON.parse(s);
    if (obj && typeof obj === 'object') return obj as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch { /* null */ }
  return null;
}

function tryParse(s: string): IScenarioCard | null {
  return tryParseAny(s) as unknown as IScenarioCard | null;
}

function adaptToScenarioCard(obj: Record<string, unknown>): IScenarioCard {
  const meta = (obj.meta ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const ctx = (obj.context ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const dps = obj.decision_points ?? obj.decisionPoints;
  const fb = obj.feedback_criteria ?? obj.feedbackCriteria ?? obj.feedback;

  const adaptedMeta = {
    scenario_id: String(meta.scenario_id ?? meta.scenarioId ?? meta.id ?? `scene_${Date.now()}`),
    title: String(meta.title ?? meta.scenario_name ?? ctx.scenario_name ?? ctx.scenarioName ?? '未命名场景'),
    version: String(meta.version ?? 'V19.1'),
    difficulty: String(meta.difficulty ?? meta.complexity ?? 'medium'),
    estimated_duration_min: Number(meta.estimated_duration_min ?? meta.estimatedDurationMin ?? parseDuration(meta.estimated_time ?? meta.estimatedTime) ?? 90),
    task_domain: String(meta.task_domain ?? meta.taskDomain ?? meta.industry ?? '管理'),
    d_vector: meta.d_vector ?? meta.dVector ?? {},
    p_sequence: String(meta.p_sequence ?? meta.pSequence ?? (Array.isArray(meta.steps) ? (meta.steps as string[]).join('→') : '')),
    progression_chain: String(meta.progression_chain ?? meta.progressionChain ?? ''),
  };

  const learnerRole = (ctx.learner_role ?? ctx.learnerRole ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const situation = (ctx.situation ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const teamState = (ctx.team_state ?? ctx.teamState ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const teamProfile = (ctx.team_profile ?? ctx.teamProfile ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const constraints = (ctx.constraints ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const openingScene = (ctx.opening_scene ?? ctx.openingScene ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const adaptedContext = {
    learner_role: {
      identity: String(learnerRole.identity ?? ctx.role ?? ctx.manager_role ?? '团队管理者'),
      relationship_to_team: String(learnerRole.relationship_to_team ?? ctx.relationship ?? '直属上级'),
      tenure_in_role: String(learnerRole.tenure_in_role ?? ctx.tenure ?? '3年以上'),
    },
    situation: {
      project_status: String(situation.project_status ?? ctx.background ?? ctx.scenario_description ?? '项目推进中'),
      deadline: String(situation.deadline ?? ctx.deadline ?? ctx.time_constraint ?? '本季度'),
      metrics: {
        key_problem: String((situation.metrics as Record<string, unknown>)?.key_problem ?? ctx.core_challenge ?? ctx.coreChallenge ?? '团队士气低落'),
      },
      what_happened_before: String(situation.what_happened_before ?? ctx.what_happened_before ?? ctx.prior_events ?? '近期团队出现明显的情绪波动'),
    },
    team_state: {
      size: Number(teamState.size ?? teamProfile.size ?? 15),
      energy_level: String(teamState.energy_level ?? teamProfile.energy_level ?? ctx.energy_level ?? '低迷'),
      observable_signals: Array.isArray(teamState.observable_signals)
        ? teamState.observable_signals as string[]
        : Array.isArray(teamProfile.observable_signals)
          ? teamProfile.observable_signals as string[]
          : ['工作效率下降', '团队沟通减少'],
      unspoken_sentiment: String(teamState.unspoken_sentiment ?? teamProfile.unspoken_sentiment ?? ctx.unspoken_sentiment ?? '对转型方向感到不安'),
      crack_type: (teamState.crack_type ?? teamProfile.crack_type ?? null) as string | null,
      crack_history: (teamState.crack_history ?? teamProfile.crack_history ?? null) as string | null,
      key_individuals: adaptKeyIndividuals(teamState.key_individuals ?? teamProfile.key_individuals ?? ctx.key_individuals),
    },
    constraints: {
      time_pressure: String(constraints.time_pressure ?? ctx.time_pressure ?? '中等'),
      resource_limits: String(constraints.resource_limits ?? ctx.resource_limits ?? '资源有限'),
      political_sensitivity: String(constraints.political_sensitivity ?? ctx.political_sensitivity ?? '需要注意内部关系'),
    },
    opening_scene: {
      time: String(openingScene.time ?? ctx.time ?? '工作日上午'),
      location: String(openingScene.location ?? ctx.location ?? '会议室'),
      trigger: String(openingScene.trigger ?? ctx.trigger ?? ctx.opening_event ?? '例会上气氛异常'),
      opening_question: String(openingScene.opening_question ?? ctx.opening_question ?? ctx.opening_line ?? '你觉得现在团队最大的问题是什么？'),
    },
  };

  const adaptedDps = adaptDecisionPoints(dps);

  const fbObj = (fb ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const adaptedFeedback = {
    golden_path: Array.isArray(fbObj.golden_path) ? fbObj.golden_path as string[] : ['选择最优管理策略'],
    golden_path_narrative: String(fbObj.golden_path_narrative ?? fbObj.goldenPathNarrative ?? '通过正确的管理策略带领团队度过难关'),
    scoring_dimensions: adaptScoringDimensions(fbObj.scoring_dimensions ?? fbObj.scoringDimensions),
    crack_type_awareness: adaptCrackTypeAwareness(fbObj.crack_type_awareness ?? fbObj.crackTypeAwareness),
  };

  return {
    meta: adaptedMeta as IScenarioCard['meta'],
    context: adaptedContext as IScenarioCard['context'],
    decision_points: adaptedDps as unknown as IScenarioCard['decision_points'],
    feedback_criteria: adaptedFeedback as unknown as IScenarioCard['feedback_criteria'],
  };
}

function parseDuration(val: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof val !== 'string') return null;
  const m = val.match(/(\d+)/);
  return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : null;
}

function adaptKeyIndividuals(val: unknown): Array<{ name: string; role: string; attitude: string; influence: string; tenure?: number }> {
  if (!Array.isArray(val)) return [{ name: '团队成员A', role: '核心骨干', attitude: '消极', influence: '中等' }];
  return val.map((item: unknown) => {
    const p = (item ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    return {
      name: String(p.name ?? '成员'),
      role: String(p.role ?? p.position ?? '团队成员'),
      attitude: String(p.attitude ?? p.emotion ?? '中立'),
      influence: String(p.influence ?? p.impact ?? '中等'),
      tenure: typeof p.tenure === 'number' ? p.tenure : undefined,
    };
  });
}

        trigger_type: String(trigger.trigger_type ?? trigger.triggerType ?? 'decision'),
        npc_state_before: String(trigger.npc_state_before ?? trigger.npcStateBefore ?? '观望'),
        pause_text: String(trigger.pause_text ?? trigger.pauseText ?? d.pause_text ?? '你会怎么做？'),
      },
      options: options.map((opt: unknown, oidx: number) => {
        const o = (opt ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
        const consequence = (o.consequence ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
        return {
          id: String(o.id ?? `OP${String(idx + 1).padStart(2, '0')}${String.fromCharCode(65 + oidx)}`),
          text: String(o.text ?? o.content ?? o.description ?? `选项${oidx + 1}`),

function adaptCrackTypeAwareness(val: unknown): { applicable: boolean; crack_type: string | null; detection_rule?: string | null; wrong_strategy_signals?: string[]; correct_strategy_signals?: string[] } {
  if (val && typeof val === 'object') {
    const v = val as Record<string, unknown>;
    return {
      applicable: Boolean(v.applicable ?? false),
      crack_type: (v.crack_type ?? v.crackType ?? null) as string | null,
      detection_rule: (v.detection_rule ?? v.detectionRule ?? null) as string | null,
      wrong_strategy_signals: Array.isArray(v.wrong_strategy_signals ?? v.wrongStrategySignals) ? (v.wrong_strategy_signals ?? v.wrongStrategySignals) as string[] : undefined,
      correct_strategy_signals: Array.isArray(v.correct_strategy_signals ?? v.correctStrategySignals) ? (v.correct_strategy_signals ?? v.correctStrategySignals) as string[] : undefined,
    };
  }
  return { applicable: false, crack_type: null };
}

export function parseScenarioJSON(raw: string): IScenarioCard {
  let text = raw;

  text = text.replace(/```json\s*/gi, '').replace(/```\s*/g, '');
  text = text.replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, '');

  const prefixes = ['以下是', '好的', '这是', '已经', '根据', '我为你', 'OK', '好的，'];
  for (const p of prefixes) {
    const idx = text.indexOf(p);
    if (idx >= 0 && idx < 20) {
      const afterPrefix = text.indexOf('\n', idx);
      if (afterPrefix !== -1 && afterPrefix < 100) {
        text = text.slice(afterPrefix + 1);
      }
    }
  }

  const start = text.indexOf('{');
  const end = text.lastIndexOf('}');
  if (start === -1) throw new Error('未找到JSON对象');
  text = text.slice(start, end + 1);

  let parsed = tryParseAny(text);

  if (!parsed) {
    const cleaned = text
      .replace(/,\s*}/g, '}')
      .replace(/,\s*]/g, ']')
      .replace(/\n/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\t/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\r/g, '');
    parsed = tryParseAny(cleaned);
  }

  if (!parsed) {
    const quoted = fixUnquotedValues(text);
    parsed = tryParseAny(quoted);
  }

  if (!parsed) {
    const quoted = fixUnquotedValues(text);
    const cleaned = quoted
      .replace(/,\s*}/g, '}')
      .replace(/,\s*]/g, ']')
      .replace(/\n/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\t/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\r/g, '');
    parsed = tryParseAny(cleaned);
  }

  if (!parsed) {
    const repaired = repairJSON(text);
    parsed = tryParseAny(repaired);
    if (!parsed) {
      const repairedSlice = repaired.slice(repaired.indexOf('{'));
      parsed = tryParseAny(repairedSlice);
    }
  }

  if (!parsed) {
    let open = 0, close = 0;
    for (const ch of text) {
      if (ch === '{') open++;
      if (ch === '}') close++;
    }
    if (open > close) {
      let patched = text.trimEnd();
      patched = patched.replace(/,\s*$/, '');
      patched += '}'.repeat(open - close);
      parsed = tryParseAny(patched);
      if (!parsed) {
        parsed = tryParseAny(fixUnquotedValues(patched));
      }
    }
  }

  if (!parsed) {
    const quoted = fixUnquotedValues(text);
    for (let i = quoted.length - 1; i > quoted.length / 2; i--) {
      if (quoted[i] === '}') {
        const candidate = quoted.slice(0, i + 1);
        parsed = tryParseAny(candidate);
        if (parsed) break;
      }
    }
  }

  if (!parsed) {
    throw new Error(`无法解析，前300字符: ${text.slice(0, 300)}`);
  }

  if (parsed.meta && parsed.context && Array.isArray(parsed.decision_points) && parsed.feedback_criteria) {
    return parsed as unknown as IScenarioCard;
  }

  return adaptToScenarioCard(parsed);
}

export function validateScenarioCard(data: unknown): data is IScenarioCard {
  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return false;
  const obj = data as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!obj.meta || typeof obj.meta !== 'object') return false;
  if (!obj.context || typeof obj.context !== 'object') return false;
  if (!Array.isArray(obj.decision_points)) return false;
  if (!obj.feedback_criteria || typeof obj.feedback_criteria !== 'object') return false;
  return true;
}

/** Escape single quotes in SQL string literals */
function escapeLiteral(str: string): string {
  return `'${str.replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
}

  driverData: string;
}>({

      return sql`'{}'::user_profile[]`;

});

export const customTimestamptz = customType<{
  data: Date;
  driverData: string;
  config: { precision?: number};
}>({
  dataType(config) {
    const precision = typeof config?.precision !== 'undefined'
      ? ` (${config.precision})`
      : '';
    return `timestamptz${precision}`;
  },
  toDriver(value: Date | string | number){
    if(value == null) return value as any;
    if (typeof value === 'number') {
      return new Date(value).toISOString();
    }
    if(typeof value === 'string') {
      return value;
    }
    if (value instanceof Date) {
      return value.toISOString();
    }
    throw new Error('Invalid timestamp value');
  },
  fromDriver(value: string | Date): Date {
    if(value instanceof Date) return value;
    return new Date(value);
  },
